reviews.text: Amazing dress! I wore it to the Opera and it was super comfortable and pockets were a bonus!  Ran a bit big so I suggest getting a smaller size as back up! Mine came in handy.

The dress was perfect for an evening wedding! I felt elegant and very comfortable. The fit was perfect, like a glove. It was comfortable, classy, and evoked so many compliments. I recommend this dress for anyone who is busty, yet petite (I'm a size 0 with a 30E bust). The high, fitted waist, belled skirt, and dramatic V back created visual interest that made the dress stand out. The material was perfect for the style and held up well. I didn't have any wrinkling. Oh, and pockets! Another plus, the dress is sturdy enough that I was able to rock it without a bra. I'm a photographer and this was the first wedding in years that I haven't had to shoot. So, I decided to treat myself to something special and Rent the Runway did just that for me!

The dress was the perfect style! The front was a touch long for my short legs, but with nice heels, it works well for a formal occasion. The back was beautiful and lower than anticipated, but works with a regular strapless bra. It was super comfortable and I received a ton of compliments!
Great Dress for a fun evening!  Dress was gorgeous! Loved the pockets! Does run tad bit small, but overall beautiful dress!!
This dress was super comfortable!  I would wear it again. After reading other reviews, I ordered the 0, and it fit perfectly.  Loved having the pockets.

Loved the sparkle and low back! Absolutely loved this dress! I wore it to my husband's bosses wedding. I wore the four and it was a little big on top but my extra size was a 6. I loved the sparkle and the high low of the dress. As an added bonus it has pockets which was handy! Definitely would get this dress again!
Great process! I can't wait to rent my next one!!! I truly felt like a celebrity! SO EASY! Dress was perfect and I received so many compliments!

Best dress I've rented yet !! This dress was PERFECT for a family wedding I went to. It was comfortable (I wore a regular bra, always a plus to not have to wear strapless!) and elegant. The fit was great. A perfect style for someone with wider hips and a smaller upper body , like me.  Plus the dress has pockets big enough for lip gloss, phone, cash and my license ! So no need for a clutch. The ONLY con was that the sequins around the underarms started to irritate me towards the end of the night, but this was probably cause I just danced the whole night away ! My 3rd success with RTR and I'm SURE it won't be my last !

New Years Eve wedding at a posh downtown location in Richmond, VA Pros: the cut (both the dip in the back and asymmetrical hemline) & sequins made this a very fun dress to wear. I was also a big fan of the pockets. I found this dress ran true to size. I ordered my extra dress a size up based on other reviews, but wore my 'usual' size. I did wear adhesive bra cups, but probably could have gone without (I am a small B cup). The dress was structured & tight enough that I would have survived.
Cons: the only con I can think of is the sequins frequently caught on fabric when I was hugging others.

Tight around the middle! I typically wear a size 8, but couldnt even zip this size 8 up, primarily because of the ribbon that separates the sequin top from the silk bottom. The 10 was also somewhat tight, but RTR was able to overnight me a size 12 (just to see) but it was falling off. The chest fit well, but man, maybe I have a big ribcage, but that was TIGHT! It was also a little long on me (I am only 5'1") but was doable.

Fun dress! I ordered the 8 and 10.  10 fit perfectly, although I usually wear an 8.  So order your size and one size up (which comes for free).  I received so many compliments on the dress - and it was super comfortable for dancing, too.

Beautiful, fun dress! I loved the dress and received many compliments on it throughout the night. It was relatively comfortable and the quality of it seemed very high.  The only issue I had was being scratched a little bit by the sequins under my arms, but knowing that, I would still highly recommend it and rent it again.

I Was the Star of My Homecoming I wore this dress for my high school homecoming. I have rented this dress before, and had to rent it again because I love it so much. This dress is perfect for my age because it is fun with the shape and has pockets! I rented this dress in a pink color before and believe that I prefer that color better. The only complaint I have about this dress is that it is a little tight in the arms. Other than that I love this dress!

Perfect combination of sparkles and a full skirt that's not pouffy or overblown. Plus, POCKETS. I loved this dress! It's perfect for a gala/formal event/black tie wedding. I wore it for our regional Emmy Awards and it hit the mark. I rented the 14 and the 16, but ended up wearing the 16 as the 14 was snug. The 16 was a little loose in the arms and waist, but it worked. As other reviewers have mentioned, the sparkles do rub under the arms a bit, but it's not that bad. I loved the sparkly top, the slight fullness of the skirt (without being crazy huge) and the richness of the skirt's material, the high/low hem, and the POCKETS.
It was perfect for the occasion Fit well--was very flattering.

Very comfy - love the pockets and the fabric. I normally wear a size 16 or 18 and the 16 was not available, so I went with the 18. It ran a bit large, but it still fit well enough to wear. I love the pockets and the way the fabric falls on the skirt. The sequins are just enough to add a bit of glam without overdoing it. I did not use a special bra, I just pulled my own bra down an it was enough to hid it beneath the back of the dress. 

Excuse the 2 different shoes on the photo - I was deciding which ones to wear. I would rent this gown again, but in the 16 instead.
Fun night for a great cause! I typically wear a size 0 but glad I got a size 2 for backup. It fit perfectly.
felt like a million bucks  good quality, first time rent and i will use RTR again!
I didn't wear it. Runs small.  For me the high waist was a little too tight and then the skirt was too poufy.  Pretty dress though if you have the right shape for it.
Cute and comfortable dress for a black tie event! It was a great dress, very comfortable.  Perfect for a black tie affair.

Beautiful dress, classy and comfortable! This dress is gorgeous.  Very classic.  The fabric had some weight to it but wasn't heavy to wear.  I loved the poof of the skirt and how it accentuated my waist.  The fit was very comfortable.  I did wear a low back bra because I had it but wasn't a necessity.  I was a bit unsure of what size I'd need because of recent weight loss and I was pleasantly surprised that the 14 fit just fine and could have even been a little tighter in the top. When I originally tried it on the slip was hanging down below the hem a little in the front but once I steamed the dress I didn't see it.  Overall loved the dress and felt like a million bucks. Great first RTR experience!!
STUNNING.   This dress fit perfectly.  I loved it.  I received endless compliments.  I especially liked that it had pockets and that it had such a beautiful bodice.  I would absolutely recommend it!!
Nice dress with great details It's a nice dress, but I wasn't blown away by it. Fits overall pretty well but was a little tight around the ribs.

Classy dress This dress was great for a winter wedding. The beading on the top is gorgeous and looks expensive. It runs true to size. You need to wear a very low back bra as the back comes low. The only thing I didn't like was the skirt was a bit fuller than I would like. Also the top is scratchy so my arms got pretty irritated. Overall it's a beautiful dress that looks great for a special occasion.

20 Year Class Reunion A Success!!!!!!!! Everything was perfect about this dress. From the fit of the dress to the style of the dress.

It was an absolute hit and allowed me to complete the look I was going for.  I was a little scared and nervous about how it was going to fit but I the reviews made me feel confident. Just like most the ladies who wore the dress before me, I am also a regular 18 and went with the 18 W.  It is definitely true to fit.  I read about how the details on the top might scratch underneath, but it wasn't a bother at all. I was very comfortable in this dress. The pockets gave it that extra flare when the time came to take pictures.  I was also worried about the back so I spent so much time looking for the right under garments and bra straps.  The dip in the back it at the right mark for a normal bra.  I ordered a bra from Lane Bryant along with some high waisted Spanx and it did the trick! My back was flawless as the picture shows.  The return of the dress was also effortless.  The return label came with the item.  I repacked the dress and dropped it off by as scheduled at the nearest UPS drop box.    fyi: My real bust size is a 42 C, but the selection doesn't  go that high.  THANK YOU RTR. YOU HAVE A CONTINUOUS CUSTOMER IN ME!!!!!!!

Fun, Formal, Young-ish and Flattering. Made me feel my vibrant and age appropriate at a formal event I enjoyed this dress, as it was fun, unique and made me feel like my vibrant self (but not too over the top) in a sea of formal, largely black dresses. I am not usually a fan of pockets but, this dress had them incorporated so seamlessly that I didn't even think about them twice. I did end up wearing a corset due to the low back, most bra backs would be visible.
n/a I received tons of compliments! It was a great choice.

Perfect dress for our formal engagement pictures! I really loved the way this dress fit. I typically wear between a 2 and a 4 and the 4 fit me really well. I love the pockets on this dress, how comfortable it is, and the fun skirt! I got a lot of compliments on it and would definitely rent it again! I wore a regular bra with it and had no issues with the back of the dress. I love that the back goes down so low - very fun and sexy!

I loved this dress and felt beautiful all night. This dress was nearly perfect! The only issue I had was the top was not as snug as I would have liked. I did not wear a bra because of the mostly open back, and walking around, this was not a problem and it felt like it fit well. But when I sat down, it felt a little loose in the shoulders. Other than that, it fit like a glove at the waist and the pockets were awesome. I got a lot of compliments! I loved the fit and flair style.

Perfect dress for all body types! I wish I owned this dress in every color.  This dress was so perfect! I was elated the moment I tried it on. I'm confident it will look good any any body type, big or small. I was complimented all night long and couldn't have been happier with how it fit. I typically wear a size 8, however I due to my bust size, I had to go a size up. I wore regular bra with a low back, and had no problems with anything showing. The pockets were an added perk for all of the essentials, and the dress was never bogged down with items in them.  I hope everyone's experience with RTR is as great as mine and I hope my next rental will be as perfect as this one!

Tall girl friendly, tastefully glamorous  I wore this dress for a formal award show that I planned & hosted & received compliments all night! From "Classic Hollywood glamour" to "Audrey Hepburn" this dress was a tasteful standout AND functional (the pockets allowed me to keep a walkie & my phone on me during the event)

Perfect for a Masquerade Ball! I spent a lot of time reading the reviews for this dress before renting it.  I was super nervous about sizing down for my "back up".  I typically wear a 10 in gowns/formal dresses, but I took the advice and rented the size 8 and 10.  The 10 was too large around my arms and back.  The way the sleeves are designed made them slide off my shoulders with the size 10.  The size 8 fit like a glove.

It was a black tie wedding, and I fit right in.  I loved the fit. The weather was a little blustery and windy for a beachfront wedding, and the fabric on the bottom was perfect and heavy enough to keep it's shape and not blow up.  I felt like a princess.

Not my first choice. My original choice was no longer available. This dress was one of my options. I'm usually a size 6, however the top part of the dress was a bit snug around the chest area. So moved up to the size 8 which solved that problem but the bottom looked much wider on me. Thank goodness it wasn't a fitted dress.

Fun night of dancing at a wedding with friends... The fit was 100% true to size. I wear a ten in all A-line dresses and wore the ten in this one. It's the perfect dress for women with curvy hips and smaller waists. I'm 5'7" and the front fell an inch above my knees. The longer back made dancing and sitting comfortable and easy. The only downside was the zipper: it was a two- (sometimes three-) man job. Will definitely use RTR again. The picture actually shows three RTR pieces. ;)

Great Dress for everyone I wore this to a semi-formal charity event. It fit great and was a fun dress to wear.  I love the pockets, and I think it would be a great dress for any body type.  The beading did rub a bit under my arms, but didn't make me not like the dress.

Comfortable and flattering, this was a great dress for an all night party! Low back made an adhesive bra necessary, but it was such a great dress it was worth it! Pockets and poof really worked for my short build.
I was very satisfied with the dress and with my experience with RTR   A very cute dress. I had a ton of complements.

I wore this to a charity event for work and it looked great on...I received so many compliments.  The fit was true to size. I hit my frame in all the right places and hid the areas I wanted to hide in the midsection. After having a 10 lb baby this year, this was the first time I felt like the old me again!

Not as expected I thought the pictures looked great online but this dress was not for me... and I never had a chance to wear it.  The top fit too tight and although I could zip it up it was very uncomfortable and there was no give.  The dress must have just been dry cleaned however it was pressed horizontally in a way that made it unflattering and puffy which made me look 10 pounds heavier.  Had I worn it I would not have felt comfortable all night and I don't believe going a size up would have helped, it probably would make me look bigger.

Elegant and timeless piece.  The dress was beautiful and perfect for a cocktail wedding. 
The Pros for this dress: Quality Fabric, able to wear a regular strapless bra, comfortable, great for dancing the night away because the straps stay in place. 
The Cons for this dress: The sequins rub and my arms got a little sore, the dress seemed to be a little tight in the midsection where there is a band (I usually don't have that problem). 
I could have worn the 6 but sized up for comfort. :)  I would totally recommend it!
This was truly a beautiful dress.  It is beyond comfortable and incredibly flattering! The best detail: POCKETS!  No hand bag needed!

Great for a formal wedding or holiday party! I wore this to my company's formal Holiday Party. It was the perfect style for a night of dancing with friends. The dress runs pretty true to size. I was between the 4 and the 6 and went with the 6 after much debate, went with the 6 for the party. I think the 4 might have looked a little more fitted, but the 6 was much more comfortable, as the empire waist 'band' does not have much give to it.

First time renting and it was a definite success.  I will definitely use Rent the Runway again! Overall I loved the dress and got many compliments.  The skirt was a little billowy for my ususal taste but it worked fine for my event.  Others said the sequins were scratchy but I did not have that problem.  Ran true to size.

Beautiful, fun, comfortable dress! Not your usual little black dress! I wore this dress for our club's holiday cocktail party and it was the perfect for dressing the part without overdressing, but still making a statement.  I received so many compliments.  I loved the fit! I am usually a 4, sometimes 6, and the 6 fit me perfectly, but I tend to size up with RTR.  I was not too bothered by the sequins at the arms like others mentioned.  The fuller skirt with pockets were flattering both to my torso and legs. I loved the "V" in the back. I would definitely wear, again.

What a fun, classy dress! First, let me say, this style dress was outside my comfort zone. When you are not placing your hands on your hips, it create a huge hourglass shape. Not the most flattering in my case, since I have a larger bust (32DD) for my size. However, I wore this to a formal orchestra event, so the extra flare and glam was appropriate for this more artistic event. It was much more interesting than my typical, more flattering styles (e.g., sheath dresses). I received so many compliment and I am overall very happy that I decided to step out of my comfort zone. 

One thing to note: the waist band is much tighter when you sit down. While standing, the dress fit perfectly; but during the performance, I had to unzip the dress...it was so uncomfortable.  The 4 was too big though, so I could not have sized up.

Pretty dress for a formal holiday party. Fit was a little large, could have gone down a size. The bottom was a bit more flared than I expected, but overall pretty dress and received lots of complements on all night.

Perfect for a wedding!  I received so many compliments.  Flattering for all body types. Fit was true to size but slightly uncomfortable at the arm pits.  The hi-lo skirt made it so comfortable (never worried about the back riding up too high).  The top's details are gorgeous and the empire waist made it very forgiving (even after a large cocktail hour and Viennese hour)!  I'd rent this again and again and again!

Super fun dress I rented this dress for a semi-formal work event.  It has been very difficult to find dresses that will fit my post-baby #2 body.  This dress made me feel fabulous.  I was able to wear a regular bra which was great (I just lowered the straps a bit as recommended).  I loved the full skirt as it hid everything I wanted to hide.  And it has pockets!  The sequins were a bit scratchy under the arms but it would not deter me from wearing this dress again.  Overall, it was a fun dress and I felt really beautiful.

I loved wearing this dress and felt very comfortable in it all night! It was beautiful! I got a lot of compliments all night. I'm usually a 14/16 in dresses so I ordered both as I read the dress runs big. The 16 was too big, but the 14 was a little too small, so I opted to go with the 16. I safety pinned it to make sure it stayed up and I was good all night. Great dress, I'd definitely rent it again!

This dress was perfect for a formal wedding! I received so many compliments and I felt amazing! I would suggest getting a size down from what you normally wear, as I found it ran slightly large. I loved the open back and didn't have to wear a bra. The pockets were wonderful and the length was perfect! LOVED this dress!

Conservative, Classy and Fun! I rented this dress for a family wedding where I wanted to make sure I wasn't showing too much skin but would still look fun! I love that I could still wear a bra with the dress (low back strapless bra was great) but got the low back effect. The skirt is fuller than I expected from the photos but that wasn't an issue. I would definitely recommend this for a formal affair for anyone who wants to turn heads while still looking classy!

Perfect dress for a holiday black tie!  I love love LOVED this dress. It fit perfectly, was true to size, and is very complimentary to your waist. I received many compliments on my dress all night. It's beautiful, sparkly, and has pockets. I loved this for the holiday black tie gala I went to! I usually fit into a size 4, and this dress fit great. I almost went with the 6 for comfort because it is a little tight underneath the arms, but the 6 gave too much room in the shoulders and the waist.

Very Beautiful This was my first RTR experience and I'm glad I used it. I had a baby a year ago and this is my first formal event since having him. I hadn't tried on any kind of formal dress since prior to being pregnant and didn't want to spend the money on a new dress that I most likely wouldn't wear again. Pre-baby I wore a 6 so I did a 6 and an 8 as a backup. I wound up wearing the 8. The 6 fit better in the top but was just a little too tight around the rib cage. I would have preferred to wear the 6 and probably could have without issue but went for the 8 instead. The 8 was better in the rib cage but was definitely baggier on top, hence why I would have preferred the 6. I didn't have to wear a bra with it which was nice as the low V in the back would have shown a bra. I paired with strappy black heels and some Kendra earrings/bracelet. Overall, I'd rent again. It has pockets too, I'm a sucker for pockets!
This dress was PERFECT! I am pear shaped/small chested, so I did not experience the tightness in the chest area as reported by other renters. Would totally recommend this dress!
Beautiful shape and very flattering! This dress got so many compliments, fit beautifully and looked amazing on!

Beautiful dress I LOVED wearing this dress, and I especially loved the pockets! I received multiple compliments throughout the evening. I ordered a size 2 but ended up going with my backup size 4 because it fit more comfortably. This was my first RTR experience and I will definitely be using it again in the future!

Truly elegant and classic! I am so thrilled with my choice to rent this dress for my cousin's formal wedding. I have no complaints whatsoever! I have a thin-muscular build and felt like this dress ran true to size. I would recommend getting a backup size 1 down from your 'normal' size. I range from a 0 to 2 and the 0 fit like a glove. I received so many compliments! Thanks RTR!!

Great fit, classic style I rented this dress for my husband's holiday party (which was cocktail attire, and hosted in our home).  I was a little nervous that it would be too dressy or not fit (my back-up size wasn't available), but it was just perfect.  The pockets are very deep but hidden in the full skirt.  The sequins weren't itchy or scratchy, and the narrow fit through the waist accentuated my curves.  The deep V in the back and the hi-lo skirt gave it a little bit of interest and kept it from being matronly.  I got tons of compliments on this dress - it's a stand-out!
Light air dress Nice dress, just didn't fit right around the mid section . I didn't get to wear this dress

The dress was beautiful and very comfortable.  Perfect for a black tie wedding. The one thing that gave me an issue was the hanger strings.  They would ride up and poke out in the cut out unless I tucked them into my underwear.  Once I got that down, it was not an issue.

I am 5'8", wore a 6 long and 4 inch heels, and the dress was the perfect length.

Beautiful and sleek This dress was absolutely beautiful, up there in the top 3 dresses that I have ever worn! The cut is classic with an element of surprise. I wore it to my holiday party at work and received many compliments. Would definitely recommend for a more formal party. I'm 5'3" though so this ran a little bit long. With 4 inch heels, it was still about 1 inch too long.

Dress was perfect.  Comfortable and stunning! The dress fit great.  It was a little longer than I expected, so I wore some high shoes (probably 4 or 5 inch wedges).  It is very comfortable and no special bra was needed.  I would rent it again!
Loved this dress!! Wanted to buy it. I'm tall and love to wear flats, so the 4R worked great. Super comfortable and elegant.

I had so much great compliments about how I looked in the dress.   I cannot tell you just how much I loved this dress.  It fit perfectly.  It was the perfect amount of sexy without showing cleavage.  My only negative comment was that the zipper kept unzipping and I had numerous strangers coming up to me to tell me about it.  Other than that, I would totally recommend this dress again and again.  Also, amazing experience with Rent The Runway AGAIN!
Loved this dress! Very classic looking dress but the cutouts make it unique. Fits well but I did have to adjust it often because it's basically a two-piece. The cutouts are very flattering.

Super comfortable, very flattering dress! Great for a black tie event!! Very comfortable dress - the material is a little thicker so it is very forgiving and great for fall or winter black tie events. I'm 5'9", wore 3.5" heels and the 8L was the perfect length, it touched the floor but I never had to hold up the bottom - the slit in the back made it very easy to walk and dance in all night. Highly recommend this dress - fits very true to size and is extremely flattering!

I felt amazing in this dress. Its very forgiving of a fluffy stomach. Such a classic dress. i love!! Form fitting with some stretch to it so its very comfortable. I wore a 2R and I am 5'6 and definitely needed to wear heels. I would wear it again and again
Beautiful dress for a black tie wedding  The length was good- Just a little tight in the stomach area

The dress fit like a glove and even came a day earlier than I ordered it! Only con was the hanging straps kept showing even after I had tucked them in. If I owned it I would have cut them off because you can see them in a few pictures. Other than that I had a blast wearing a fun dress! I normally would have ordered a 2 but there wasn't one available so I went with the 4 and it was perfect.

Dress fit amazingly, got lots of compliments, and felt comfortable all night! Loved this dress! I wish I had gone with the long since I was wearing heels but I still think it looked great.  I was comfortable, not too tight but very form fitting.  The zippers were great, didn't get caught at all and didn't fall down during the night.  Great first rental!

This dress is fabulous! This dress fit very true to size, and it was super comfortable because of the flexible fabric. I am 5'8", and I wore flats with it; the dress came to floor, so it was the perfect length. I loved wearing this dress, and I would definitely recommend it!
Loved the dress!   I received so many compliments.  First time using Rent the Runway - perfect!

LOVED this dress! Just too long Fit wonderfully other than the length. I am 5'4" and even with my highest heels the dress was wayyyy too long. I ended up using fashion tape to make a temporary hem. So I would suggest getting a petite size if you are below 5'7". However, I got tons of compliments and was really pleased with it other than that! The material was great and made really well. I didn't want to send it back!

Comfortable, sexy, easy to dance in! Simply sexy, the cut out and the open back were subtle ways to spice up the typical little black dress.  I am very upset that I don't have a proper picture of me in the dress...I felt so beautiful and confident and had so much at the wedding!

Very classic and comfortable! I am 5' 8'' and rented a long. The dress was VERY long. I wore 4 inch heels and had to hold up the dress to walk. Other than that, it was beautiful. I received so many compliments. The cut-outs are not forgiving but can really let you show off your body!

BEAUTIFUL GOWN AND PERFECT FIT! This was my first rental from RTR, and I am so pleased with the experience!  I was nervous about getting the dress the day before the event, but everything worked out great.  The dresses arrived on time, and the size I originally ordered fit perfectly.  It was nice to have the option of the second size though just in case!  I got so many compliments on this dress - I was nervous about the cutouts, because I am on the conservative side, but it showed just enough skin to be sexy but still elegant.     
I will definitely be renting from RTR in the future!
SO easy to accessorize   extenuates curves--so comfy

Love this dress I received a lot of compliments! Super comfortable and fit perfectly. I wore 3 1/2-4" heels and the length was perfect. The dress just hit the floor with the heels I chose. The cut was very flattering and wasn't too revealing. It was just enough! Also, you can wear a normal bra with this dress without an issue so that was another plus. I highly recommend this dress!

Comfortable dress, true to size, a little short I rented this dress for a gala. Loved the stretch to the fabric and the cutout! The dress was comfortable and easy to dance in. The only con was that I felt like the dress was a little short with heels.

Got SO many compliments on the dress. Everyone called it classy yet sexy. The dress fit perfectly. You can wear any bra you like with it or none at all. The fabric is thick enough that you would be comfortable either way. I am 5"6' and the dress was EXACTLY the right length with 4" heels on. Definitely could not have worn it with flats.

I wish I took more pictures in this dress! With 4 inch heels, the dress barely hovered over the ground; the 4L length could not have been more perfect for me at 5'7.5". The fit was perfect. I'm small chested, and regular everywhere else. Aside from my wedding, this is the prettiest I have ever felt. It has a polished, slimming, classy yet sexy look. I wish I took more pictures in this dress.

Fun/young dress to wear for black-tie event! Definitely a tighter fit - I'm normally a 6L, but wanted to feel comfortable dancing so went with the 8R! I'm 5'10" and wore little kitten heels. If I wanted to wear 3" heels I would have probably preferred the 8L! Would love to rent this one again.

Perfect dress for a black tie optional wedding!! Comfortable, flattering and unique. Runs true to size to slightly large. Very  long- I am 5'11" and I wore the 6L with 3" heels- the length was perfect

Endless Compliments! Absolutely loved this dress! I felt like the most beautiful person there and did not want to return this dress! I am 5'8" and chose to wear the 6L. For me, it was more comfortable around the chest and stomach area. The 4L was extremely tight in those areas for me. I wore 4.5 inch heels and probably could've afforded to wear an inch higher in heels. The dress dragged the ground a little and my heel did get stuck in the hem a number of times. Other than that, I couldn't have asked for a better dress! Extremely comfortable and I still managed to dance the night away and enjoy myself. Received countless compliments! Would recommend to anyone that asked! :)

I wore this dress to my sister's beautiful October in Vermont wedding.   I was nervous it would be a little bit cold for the season,  but the material was thick enough to keep me warm.  I got my normal size (6R) but I ended up wearing my back up - the 8R.  Both fit me like a glove, but the larger size allowed me to cover up a little more skin on the sides & in the back in case I actually did get too cold.  I got so many compliments.  Wish I could have kept it!

Amazing dress, I didn't want to return it! It fits VERY well, probably one of the most beautiful dresses I've ever had because it's simple but very elegant. I wore the 0R but could have wore the 2R as well, it doesn't make that much difference. It's a little bit long because I'm short (5,1) but I bought the hem tape and it worked perfectly. The fabric is very good and is a dress that fits every body!

I got so many compliments on this dress and felt like a million bucks! The dress fit perfectly. The cut outs are in a flattering part of the waist and the material is thick enough to hide problem areas. I definitely recommend this dress!

Ran shorter than I though it would, but still looked awesome! After reading the comments from others I decided to rent the regular length instead of the long. I wish that I had gotten the 6L instead, the dress was a little short for me and I was in very low heels. Besides the length I liked the dress and got a lot of complements from my friends and the other wedding guests.

great classic dress  Pros: Flattering on the body ffor the most part. Good thick material.  
Cons: If you are conscious about "back fat" probably not the dress for you 
FYI: I'm 5' 3", 123 lbs, measure 34/28/38. I would have liked the 8 to be honest because my back area is not super toned. I had a little bit sticking out so I ended up not wearing the dress. Stylist said dress is stretchy, which is true, but not so where the gaps are open so it will dig into you some.  Able to wear 3" heels no issues with length
LIKED IT!!!!! It was really pretty, and It fit good! With me being tall, it's hard to find some with a good decent LENGTH TO. There aren't any cons. :)

Loved this dress!! This dress was perfect for a black tie fall wedding in New York. The fabric was heavy so I wasn't too cold, and the cut of the dress allowed me to wear a regular bra (super nice as a DD girl!). I got the 2R with the 4R as a backup, and both fit fine- although I ended up wearing the 2. Since it was a little tighter, it stayed in place better. I got tons of compliments on the dress and loved wearing it- would definitely rent it again! Oh, I'm about 5'3" and wore very high (4"+) heels with this- it worked well, my shoes just barely peeked out.

I wore this dress for my college formal and it fit perfect! It helped make the night unforgettable! The fit was just how it was described on the website. The dress was form fitting, but the material was very comfortable and stretchy. The only problem I have was that I'm 5' 4" which isn't very tall and I ordered the regular size but I found that the heels I wanted to wear which was pretty high made the dress too short so I had to opt for some shorter ones. I would recommend if you are way taller than that and want to wear high heels to order the long.

Most flattering dress I've worn! Love love LOVE this dress for a formal event. Wore this to the Gold Gala in NYC that was black tie. It was formal yet still felt young and sexy with the cutouts on the side. Would highly recommend. Jazzed it up with a collar necklace from RTR and ring as well!
I felt amazing in this dress! The fit was perfect and a great material that stayed put all night and was super comfortable! Absolutely loved it!

I wore this to a charity ball that was black tie.   Great dress.  Looked really nice (didn't look cheap at all) and recieved compliments during the night.  HIghly recommend for something a little edgy at a formal event.

Could not have found a better dress! This dress is the REAL DEAL.  It fit perfectly from top to bottom.  The slit in the back makes it super easy to walk in. The durable stretchy fabric hugs all the right areas and would look great on anyone.  The only downside is that I wish they would have hidden the zipper more.  The zipper they used on the back of the dress is something used for suitcases, it was too bulky and felt cold on the skin. Other than that I would love to buy this dress and wear it everywhere!!

Love this dress! This dress was snug in a good way.  I just lost almost all of my baby weight, still a couple pounds up from pre-pregnancy.  Pre-pregnancy I was a 2, so I ended up wearing the 4 and it fit perfectly.  The dress is sexy, but still very classy and elegant.  I wore this to a cocktail event for my husband's work and it was perfect.  My husband loved the cut outs!  Would definitely rent this dress again.  A winner!  For tall ladies, I did not find this dress ran too long like other reviewers.  I am only 5'3 and ordered the regular length and with 5" heels it was not touching the ground.  The length was perfect for me, but if you're tall, or more of an average height, I would still order the tall length.

Great dress!! This dress was perfect for a formal medical school event. The dress was slimming without being too tight and allowed me to move around and feel comfortable. Would greatly recommend for any kind of formal gathering.

Classicly stunning I felt absolutely beautiful in this dress! The long black was a classic but the cut out and slit in the back made me feel even more stunning! The dress was the perfect length and I was able to wear a normal bra with it which was awesome. The layering on the front made any tummy disappear as well. Dancing all night in it was so easy too.

This dress was AMAZING. Fit like a glove and fit true to size. Got a million compliments.  My husband and I were attending a Black-Tie optional wedding and I needed some formal attire. The dress fit like a glove. I got a 0L and 2L and the 0L fit perfectly. I didn't need any underwear - everything was held in place ;). I would definitely recommend this dress!

Great party dress! This is my favorite rental so far! The material is thick and has a decent amount of stretch so you can easily move and dance. I love the cut outs in the dress, and that you could also wear a regular bra with no issues. I am 5'9" and the long worked out well, it had plenty of length.
I felt I looked the part while being very comfortable.  Fit perfectly. No pulling anywhere. I felt like a million dollars in this dress!

LOVED this dress. Initially ordered a different one and they sent this as backup.  ... Which honestly couldn't have been a more perfect situation. I'm tall and got the 4L and 6L -- the 4L fit perfectly, but was a little snug around my booty and I definitely didn't want to wear a bra, so I went with the 6L for the wedding. I did 2 inch block heels and the length was PERFECT, which was cool because I was really concerned about that previously. I got a ton of compliments, it was perfect for a formal wedding, and felt just the right amount of sultry without overdoing it.

Form Fitting, Flattering & Got Compliments All Night I rented a 2R and 4R. I almost went with the 4 because the 2 was very formfitting, which I do not normally wear, but after my fiance telling me to go for it I am glad I went with the 2. I received compliments all night. The 2 had a silver zipper and the 4 had a gold zipper. Perfect for a wedding, demure in black but stands out because of he side/back cutouts. Loved it!

nice dress, cheap fabric 5'8", 34A, and the 4R fit well, snug but lay flat everywhere, I think a 2R would have been too small. The length was perfect for 1 1/2 inch heels so that feet were covered but could easily walk without tripping. I had rented this and the Leona gown as well, and decided to wear the Leona to the event instead of this dress as I was disappointed in the quality of the fabric. The cut of the dress is fine--but the fabric is pretty cheap quality polyester--it felt like a prom dress--not like a gown for a professional woman. Last year I had rented a similar gown (also black and with cut outs), the Slate & Willow Black Cut Twirl Gown, and I'd recommend that over this dress. Similar style, but much higher quality dress.

Great experience and great dress! I was really worried about ordering a long, form-fitting dress since I'm tall (5'10") and am different sizes on top and bottom (small bust but large hips and booty). But this dress fit perfectly! I wore very low heels and it was the perfect length. The fabric is very thick and substantial while also forgiving. Highly recommend!

Will rent again! I was sent this as a back up when there was  FedEx mix up. I LOVED this dress! My original dress ended up coming so I wore that one but I can't wait to rent this for my next event! The fabric is thick and stretchy, with the fit highlighting your best features and camouflaging where needed.

Beautifully simple/sexy dress!  Long. I wore 3.5/4 inch heels and it was still slightly too long.  Other than that, very easy to wear! Note: if you're on the fence between two sizes, go with the smaller. Even on the 2, the back bottom part of the skirt loosened up while dancing/towards the end of the night.

Great dress, but VERY long I loved the cutouts and material. I had tried to rent the 0P or 2P but both were unavailable. Unfortunately the R is wayyy too long. I'm 5'2 and the 2R with 5 inch heels on was still 3 inches too long. I tried using hem tape but it didn't work well with the material and came undone after 30 minutes or so. If you're short, make sure to get the petite size!

Great dress for a Black Tie Optional event I ordered the 12L and 12R as I wasn't sure which would fit best with 5" heels.  The 12R fit more snug and definitely wasn't long enough.  The 12L, fit perfect though was a little too long.  I ended up taping the hem up so it didn't drag. I did receive many compliments!

The dress really helped because I felt so pretty in it!  Loved loved loved this dress! I am 5'7" and 128 lbs and I wore a 2R. I got a 4R as the backup and could have worn that, but the 2R just looked better. I wore it for my sorority formal and was so glad I did! The fabric is nice but has a stretch so I was able to bend and move comfortably. The slit in the back also made it so easy to walk in. I thought it was definitely true to size. If I could do anything different I might have gotten a 2L to see if I liked that better because I sometimes had to pull the dress down in pictures because I didn't like how my toes stuck out. I got so many compliments and it was so flattering! I would definitely recommend this dress.

AMAZING dress for the black tie optional wedding I attended! LOVED this dress! I got so many compliments on it.  It fits very true to size and I had no issues with the length which I was worried about being 5'3".  I wore this for a black tie optional wedding and it was perfect.  The material has some stretch to it and really does not get wrinkly which was nice.  I rented the "Lee Angel - Tie Up in Crystal" necklace to go with it as well for $15.

Got several compliments This dress is a safe bet!  It's not flashy but a sexy twist on your classic LBD.  I ordered a 2R and 4R, either would have worked as it is a stretchy material.  I went with the 4R to have extra room.  I ordered the R instead of L as I wasn't planning on wearing very tall heels (I'm 5'7"), although I think I would order the L if I was wearing again as it was on the shorter side.  Enjoyed my first RTR experience and would order again!

really loved my dress! the two sizes sent made it super easy to make sure i got the right size. The dress was super comfortable and loved the back. the length wasn't exactly floor length but i did have on heels. overall was awesome

Flattering & classy with a little edge Perfect for a black tie optional wedding. The cut outs added some edge and I liked customizing the look with jewelry. Very comfortable and flattering. 2P was the perfect length with 4.5" heels (I'm 5'3).

It was gorgeous. Sexy & classy all at the same time. The length and cut made me look tall and thin. I tried both the 2 and the 4. Both fit me about the same but the 2 was shorter and a better fit for my height+heels. The back zipper is a little hard to figure out. I needed to have a friend zip me up the first time, but after that I figured out how to do it myself. Usually tight dresses like these accentuate my tummy flab but the the material and the cut were able to downplay it. It looked amazing. I wish I had taken more pictures in it.
I wore this to a black tie wedding. The top of this dress fit perfect and everyone loved it; however, even wearing my highest heels, it was too long. I found myself holding it up most of the night.

This dress was a show stopper! The dress was stunning! I received so many compliments all night. I ended up wearing my back up size (6) because the size 4 was a little short since I have long legs and was wearing 4in heels. The material is so comfortable- just tight enough to hug your body, suck you in a little and you can still breathe. The cut out across the back of the dress and the slit in the back of the dress add a touch of classy sexiness. Definitely would order this dress again!

Simple but edgy dress for a wedding Loved this dress! The fabric was on the thicker side which is great for coverage, and kept me warm on a cool, early spring outdoor wedding; a light jacket or shawl was enough to cover my arms. The length was perfect since I wore 4 in. heels, no tripping and the slit in the back of the dress made it easier for me since I take long strides when I walk. I received lots of compliments on the dress and couldn't be happier with its elegance but with a little bit of a unique surprise with the cutout. The fit of the dress was a tiny bit more form fitting than I would have expected but the size I ordered was correct for me. I would definitely order this again!
Great dress! Not super comfortable but very cute and perfect for the bachelorette party I wore it to!
Fun dress for my friend's birthday!  The sleeves were slightly tight, but the rest of the dress was loose and comfortable.

TOO SMALL. NOT MEANT FOR PLUS SIZE. This dress is nice but not meant for plus size. I wear a size 20 and I could not even get into the 22.  Way to tight and short. I really wanted to love this dress and was sad I could not wear this one. Luckily, RTR has fabulous service and I was abloe to get another dress sent last minute

Glam! I rented this dress for a friends wedding. I got tons of compliments on it from friends and complete strangers. My husband LOVED it on me. 
I felt that the dress ran true to size and I wear a 4. I was snug along the hips and I have average sized hips. It fit well across the bust. The dress is short, so keep that in mind if you have a long torso. Some people who also rented this dress mentioned that the sequins were itchy, but I didn't have a problem with that at all.

Overall, I would definitely recommend this dress!

Amazing Fit and compliments ALL night! Like other reviews said, if you want to look like the model get the dress a few sizes larger. I wear an 8 and ordered a 14  as my "backup size" so I could select between the two looks. The dress looks AWESOME fitted and loose. It will not disappoint. I wore the 8 because I felt like showing the curves and the  length was better for my height. The 14 was about 2" too long for my height and extended to the top of my knee,  the size 8 that sat mid thigh and was perfect for a night of dancing, sitting, and socializing.

I was concerned that the pattern would make me look wide, it did the exact opposite. There is a bit of give in the middle for a few extra pounds of belly weight. Its sparks without being over the top. It is perfect for a work holiday party. I got so many compliments from men and women! My date told me this dress caught so many peoples attention as I walked by that we could easily triple the number of complements just from the number of peoples eyes that followed the dress that night. I would LOVE to add this dress to my collection. It is a must try!

Beautiful dress to wear to a Gatsby themed prom I chaperoned.  I ordered a 6 and an 8. The fit of the 6 around my hips and butt made it a little inappropriate for me to wear that size as  chaperone of prom. The 8 felt a little big, but I was the only one who could tell.  I wore a long pearl necklace, a black and gold headband wrap, and a pair of sandals similar to the model in the picture.
I wore this fabulous dress to Hyde in Las Vegas! I felt great in this dress!  The size two fit, but I decided to wear the size four. It fit better through the hips.

Sophsiticated glitz that lets you shine, but not be tacky!   Wore it to a company holiday party. The shape is just enough to be forgiving since I ate that extra spoonful of flan, but tapered enough so that it wasn't a potato sack on me.
If you are sitting down or reaching for the floor, be delicate about it since it is sort to show of your stems!
The gold sequins are shiny, but not tacky so you def feel glamourous in it. Would def recommend renting this

Fun! This dress worked really well for the wedding I wore it to. I originally rented the dress before I knew I would be playing the violin during the ceremony, so I was worried that it wouldn't have enough movement in the shoulders, but it was much stretchier than it looks on the model. I didn't like how the 0 fit in my stomach area so I went with the 2, which had a better length as well. It was extremely comfortable and I got several compliments as well!

I felt like Serena van der Woodsen. This dress is so gorgeous and soooo comfortable! Absolute perfect combo. I am normally a size 2 and the size 2 fit like a glove. It is more sequincy than it appears in the picture but the sequins didn't bother my skin at all. A lot of other reviews said the dress was super short so I was really afraid  because I have a long torso but it was a good/appropriate length!  Overall, this dress is classy and comfortable. Be prepared for a lot of compliments through out the night! Definitely a must Rent!

I wore this dress for my friends Great Gatsby Bachelorette Party and it was a huge hit!  This dress photographs so well. I am very self conscious and even though the dress was tighter than I had expected, I rocked it with confidence because it was just so beautiful. Know that if you have big hips you'll need to jump up a size. There is not much stretch.

Homecoming 2014! LOVEEEEE this dress! I wore it to my homecoming this year. This dress photographs beautifully, and made me feel gorgeous. my date was speechless when he saw me. The dress does not fit like shown in the picture, it is much tighter. I did not find the dress short even though other reviewers did. The only problems I had with the dress was the arms. My arms were restricted and I couldn't more them past my shoulders. However I did not care because I was having too much fun to notice. I would defiantly recommend this dress but if your busty like me, thing about going up a size or two. I couldn't even zip the 4 past my waist. I will totally be doing RTR for any other dress I need!
Very comfortable!  I got plenty if compliments and never had to worry about being exposed or the dress riding up!

Beautiful Dress  This dress was so much fun! I thought it was going to be uncomfortable because of all the sequins, but I danced around in it all night without any trouble. Was perfect for a wedding on a chilly March day.

Great festive dress that's different without being too flashy! I rented this dress for my boyfriend's holiday party and it worked great. I was worried because the reviews said it ran small and the back up larger size I ordered was unavailable last minute. I ended up making the size 8 work and although it was slightly snug, it worked out okay. It's a very pretty dress and definitely something a little different. The length was great and the only thing I'd say is that the material was a little itchy on my arms.  All in all I was pleased with it and it was a great dress for a holiday event.  I would definitely rent it again!

I felt fabulous in my dress & received several compliments. 


















 The dress fit true to form and  I was able to move around comfortably. The dress itself draws attention. The sequence on the sleeves were slightly itchy but that was minor. I would highly recommend this dress for any cocktail party and/or formal affair.

I felt dressy, elegant and fun. Perfect dress for an evening wedding reception. This dress was perfect and very age appropriate (late 50s). I am also short so the length was great on me too. The dress was super comfortable to wear and while not tight or super-fitted was flattering (IMO).
Amazing! It fit well and was so beautiful! I got so many compliments.
Didn't end up wearing it. I should have sized up instead of down.  Was very short and tight.

Had so many compliments on how flattering the dress was! I danced all night and was so comfortable. Be careful of the sequins because they easily get caught on different things. Fits true to size and the length was perfect for someone like me who's 5'6 and still likes to wear heels.

Love love LOVE! I was so sad to return this dress! Wore it for my 30th birthday party in downtown San Diego and it was a huge hit! Women stopped me all night long to compliment the dress! The sequins were stunning! What you can't really tell from the picture is that the whole black part is sparkly, and has a little bit of silver woven in as well. The slight scoop in the back is outrageously flattering, the sleeves hit in a nice spot (and don't scratch too too much under the arms) and it's short enough to be sexy but  still be able to sit comfortably. I wore it with a little tummy tucker stomach thingy because it's more fitted than you might think. I normally wear an 8, but followed advice for the hip-py girls and sized up, good thing too, because I couldn't even get the 8 over my hips, let alone zip it! As a girl with a little extra plush around the middle and thighs, it was still very flattering and comfortable. Plus, the boyfriend went nuts :) Perfect dress for a fun night!

Great dress and easy to rent  Loved the dress, stretchy and comfortable, only thing I didn't like was the sequins under the armpits was very scratchy and irritating after wearing for a bit, especially if dancing the night away.

I LOVE this dress - so cute and really flattering to a lot of body types I'm incredibly sad that I don't have pictures in this dress because I loved it soooooooooo much.  I wore this to my company's office party.  The theme was Bollywood and I refused to dress up in traditional clothing.  I thought the sequins would still remain true to the theme.  Like some of the other reviewers said, this dress is tighter - more body con, than the photo and the model.  This dress was also pretty short on me, I had to make very sure that I sat "properly" throughout the night.  

But the dress fit like a glove and was really comfortable all night.  I would definitely rent this again!

This was sparkly and gorgeous -- definitely a showstopper. The only gripe I have with this beautiful dress is that I rented it because I thought it would be more of a shift dress as it looks on the model in the picture. I had both the size 2 & 4 and both did not hang on me in that "T-shirt" style that I was desiring. If you are tall, long, and very lean, that is probably how the fit will be, but otherwise it is going to be more fitted. (I also had my hourglass-figured friend try on both dresses and it was a fitted fit on her too). However, it is still a beautiful dress and perfect for a night out with the girls.

Loooooved it This is the second dress I rented from RTR and I fell in love all over again. I rented for homecoming and it was perfect. In the picture it looks like it hangs very loosely ("babydoll" style?) but it was actually more on the slimmer side and fit me very well. It also hung a little past mid thigh, so it was the perfect length.
Great Dress! Loved the dress. It was WAY more fitted than it looks on the model. If you want it to be loose I'd order a size up. It was also not as short as it was on the model (which was nice).
Wore this dress to a fundraiser and it was the perfect balance between fun and sophisticated. Loved, loved, loved this dress! Perfect for a nice occasion but not too formal.
Perfect dress for a gatsby  party!! Definitely a bit short, but the overall fit was true to size- felt like a million bucks!

Wore this for the Bellevue Collection Fashion Show and had so many compliments! Loved the dress!  The fit was great. Short, but not too short where it felt inappropriate. Was able to wear a normal bra which I loved and the dress was comfortable despite the sequins. This was the second dress that I've rented by Slate & Willow and they all fit great. Highly recommend!

Perfect for a night of dancing in Vegas. Very flattering. Based on some of the reviews, I ordered a size up for my back-up, but because we were in Vegas, I decided to wear my regular size. It was fitted and very short, but was ultimately perfect. I'm not usually a sequin person, but it worked so well on this dress. And you can wear a regular bra, which is always a plus. One of my favorite RTR orders to date!

Perfect for a bachelorette party in Chicago! Size 8 had a rip in the seam when it arrived but the 10 was far too big.  Hips were tight but waist was a little looser. No issues with sequins bothering me. Overall a great dress! Loved the sequins and design.

It's a show stopper! Get ready for compliments I ordered a size 8 & 10 after reading reviews and ended up going with the 8 (which is my usual size)

It is tight on the hips and arms and the material doesn't have a lot of give or stretch. The sequence will irritate your arms a little but the dress is so gorgeous it doesn't even matter! Totally worth it!

Great dress, runs very small! I loved this dress! I wore it to my birthday party and got so many compliments. Couple things to keep in mind: it runs very small. I am glad I read the reviews and didn't order my regular size at all. Plan for two sizes up. Also, the sequins to scratch a bit, but I survived. 
It looks great with a pair of black tights and black patent pumps!
bff bachelorette party Thought it was perfect for an end-of-winter/is-spring-here-yet bachelorette party in Minneapolis. Dressy, but not too over the top.

Sparkle sparkle ! Dress fits true to size . Went dancing at PURE and sequins started to rub against arms which was uncomfortable ! Small snag in dress on the bottom as well. Pretty dress for a great night out !
Got so many compliments! Perfect dress for Post-Christmas, Pre-New Years event! Fit true to size. Tighter in the hips and bust than shown on the model.

Not my favorite....runs small  I usually wear an 8, but even the 10 was very right for me & I chose not to wear this dress at all. It's beautiful but something about it wasn't right for me. Disappointing since it looks amazing in the pics. Next time!

Gorgeous dress, photographs well! Get ready for tons of compliments! I went to a Friday evening wedding at the Boston Public Library. I ordered the 10 and sized up to the 12 - I'm so glad I did! The 10 was incredibly tight and inappropriately short. I ended up wearing the 12. It was still a little tight across my tummy/hips (had to wear shapewear) and was still fairly short, but nothing I couldn't handle. The sequins were a bit rough, but I got used to it after a while and didn't notice them. If you want it to fit like the model, I would suggest sizing up two sizes - I got the 12 hoping it would be loose throughout, but it wasn't at all.
Everyone said they loved the dress! It was unique and classy! Fit was true to size and comfortable ; not scratchy at all!

Loved it! The dress fit the way I expected it to. I got a 2 and a 4, and went with the 2 and that was a still a little big on me. If I were to rent it again, I would try getting the 0 and 2. The dress was a little longer than expected, so I pinned it at the bottom and that worked perfectly! The dress is all sequins, but they were all perfectly intact when I received the dress. It was super comfortable for both dancing and sitting. Awesome dress!
Classy & Sexy Dress Awesome dress, was tight, and showed off curves, but stayed classy. Loved the gold pattern. Tons of compliments
beautiful detail  shorter and more fitted than I expected. still fit the bill for a cute fun pre-wedding party dress

This dress was perfect for Vegas! I loved this dress and received so many compliments in it!! I would definitely rent this again. The only thing I didn't like  about it was the sequins made my underarms raw by the end of the night.

beautiful print, flashy. Unfortunately, it was much shorter than expected. It runs small. I normally wear a size 2 the 2 was WAY too small. The 4 fit, but was very snug and ran shorter than expected.  It is a beautiful dress though.

Perfect dress to celebrate my anniversary  Loved this dress and didn't want to take it off. Fit perfectly and true to size 4. It was comfy and don't ride up or anything. Wore it for my 2 year anniversary and my husband loved the dress too. Would highly recommend and would rent again.

Beautiful detailed dress! I wore this dress for a wedding and received compliments all night! This dress is completely sequined and looks slightly different in person than online. I rented the 6 and 8 and went with the 6 since I wanted a more fitted style because I have an hourglass figure. I do wish it slightly more fitted in the waist but it is still a beautiful dress that photographs great! It was also in excellent condition with not one sequin missing!

Rented this dress for our daughter for our sons wedding. 





 The dress was true to size. She is 17, and this is what the bride picked for her to wear. The fabric does not have much stretch, but with her body type it worked well. Put this dress on your rent list for sure! Many compliments! Thank you RTR! Will will rent again!

Perfect for New Years! I was expecting a more tunic-like fit. On me, though not too small, it was more fitted around the hips than I would have anticipated. If anyone is looking for a looser fit, I'd recommend the backup size be one size larger.

A little small this dress was for a night in Vegas. As others mentioned the sequins do rub under your arm a bit, not awful and it does run a little small. Doesn't fit like a shift would. It was fine but didn't love it.

Fabulous Dress  Loved it... Wasn't as loose at it looks on the model, go figure?? :) But still a fabulous dress, I would say it tends to run on the small end, so def go with the larger of the two sizes you normally wear. Got tons of compliments and loved wearing it.
So many compliments! I wore this to a Great Gatsby themed party and felt to elegant and beautiful in this dress.
PERFECT dress for a glitter themed bachelorette party! Fit true to size! This dress was so comfortable! Great 1st experience with rent the runway!!! Absolutely loved this dress!!!!
Easy, simple, and fabulous process! The dress fit perfectly and the reviews were so helpful. I looked smokin hot and got tons of compliments. I love RTR!
Awesome dress The fit was perfect, true to size, very sexy classy

Lots of sequins and an amazing wedding :) The dress was slightly shorter than expected which was actually a good thing. It was surprisingly sexy considering the shape. I loved the design. The sequins were very sparkly without drawing too much attention. Overall very pleased!
Wedding was great.  So many compliments on my dress! Dress fit great!  Got compliments all night on it! Would definitely use this site again!
Showstopper Everyone adored this dress. It fit so nicely, ran a little big so get a size smaller and that should be perfect.
Sparkly!  The dress was a little short and thin, but it's super sparkly and that's all that matters!

Black Tie Optional Art Deco Themed Gala - Lots of Compliments But... Many people complimented me on the dress. It was just right for the event and I am glad I rented it. 

The 3 (rather than 4) stars has more to do with the fact that there were many plastic threads sticking out where sequins had been pulled. However, you could not see that sequins were missing when the dress was on, and the complexity of the pattern helped to hide the threads. 

I wear a 4 usually but generally go for loose or A-line skirts. This is a shift dress so I had to go up a few sizes. I could have worn the 6 but the 8 was a little longer on me. The material is stretchy so that helps. I did feel like I had to subtly tug down the skirt every once in a while, especially at dinner when we were sitting, but a more confident person probably wouldn't have worried.

Amazing dress! This dress was actually chosen by RTR as a backup when my backup size in my first dress was not available. They did an amazing job choosing this dress based on my first choice. It was absolutely perfect for my black and gold themed engagement party. They only sent me the 8, and I am usually a 6 but it was perfect because the 6 would have been more form fitting. I would size up if you want it to fit more like it does on the model.

Simple, yet elegant!  Comfortable to wear all night. I wore this dress at our city's Chamber Gala.  I was so anxious for this dress to arrive.  When I first placed the order I had a 4R.  After reading some reviews I changed it to a 4L and I'm so glad I did.  It was a tad long even after putting heels on, but nothing that I had to hold my dress up for.  I would rather have it a little longer than shorter anyway.  The dress was GORGEOUS!!  It is simple but SO classy and elegant.  I got complements all night on it.  The only issue I had with the dress was every time I went to the restroom the lining would get all twisted and I would have to take some time readjusting.  The dress does have draping fabric in the front and sides, but its nothing that striked me as being odd.  After trying it on the night before, I could hardly wait to wear it.  It was so comfortable.  I wasn't itching to get home and get out of the dress.  I felt great in it.  I will definitely be renting from RTR for future Chamber Gala's.

Great dress! Very elegant and simple, yet chic. Easy to pair an eye popping necklace or earrings.  A little short for a (long) dress size. Especially if you weight heels, I would have preferred a little longer, but I'm also 6'1 with heels so this might not apply for everyone.
received a lot of compliments from a wedding  the length of the dress was just right and the slit was not to high.

This dress is VaVaVaVoom! (I'm the blonde in the picture)  In truth the chest was a bit too tight, the cross body ruching was stretched a bit more than the designer intended.  I ended up wearing a spanx tank minimizer (40DDs) instead of any kind of bra.  I wore 6inch Jimmy Choo black suede stilettos and the regular length gown was still too long!  Love the dress, great fabric (a little thick), with some give to it.  I'd wear it again in a 10 petite.

Beautiful fit, very elegant! Lots of compliments. I loved this dress. I wore it for a fundraiser ball and it was elegant and sophisticated but also sexy. I wore it with 4inch platforms and was a perfect length. As other reviewers mention there is a ruffle of material that rouches around the stomach/hip area. I was unsure to begin with but pulled it so it sat just below my hip and then it worked for me.

I absolutely loved this dress! It fit great and looked great on my body, perfect dress! This was my first time using RTR and it will not be my last. The customer service is great and fast to respond, just when I thought I wasn't going to get my dress in time for my event, customer service came through and got my package to be left at a UPS location so I could pick it up same day. The fit of the dress was true to size, I got the L because I'm tall and it was the perfect length with heels on. I got so many compliments and felt really comfortable in the dress. 10/10!

I got the dress and wasn't able to wear it because it made my hips look really large. This dress made me look about 10 lbs heavier than I actually am. I have 5'7" and 155lbs with a pretty apple shaped body. I hold my weight in my stomach, love handles and chest. I was really disappointed that the dress didn't' look good on me because it looked good on other girls in the pictures, but if you carry weight in your love handles/lower stomach/lower back this dress will make you look bigger than you are as the rouching sits right there.

I felt glamorous! Pics were taken at the end of the night and don't do this dress justice. Dress was prefect. I felt beautiful and it felt like it pulled me in in all the right places. Two neighbors saw me as we went out for the night and said I looked "gorgeous" and like I had lost weight. (Please note that one of my neighbors is about 90 and super conservative and the other is in her 30s and pretty flashy this dress was pleasing to both so I consider that a win). Overall a win and head turner.  It was a bit long but I am a shorty and wore 5 inch heels to compensate. The only issue was the dress looked like it has been extremely popular. The hem on the sleeve was unraveled and had a red tape on it. I was able to fold it over and hide the issue.

Stunning!!  This was a dress sent to me after RTR could not get my original order. I LOVED how it looked. It hung right on my hips and was tight in all the right places. It was a little hot, but I managed. Everyone game me compliments all night on his glamorous I looked at prom. It wasn't a typical dress and if you get this, make sure you get huge statement jewelry!!

The dress was overly comfortable and the long sleeves were nice for a cold night.  I wish a size 12 was available for a second dress option. The 14 was comfortable but since it was a little big it was bunchy in areas (mostly the zipper on the back). Overall, I thought the dress was very flattering and comfortable. It was a hit for the night and my husband loved it!
great basic black dress  i really like the dress it was nice ... but it was a bit short which was odd because i am short at 5'4" tall
The Perfect Dress! Perfect fit but a little short.  I added 4 inch heels and the dress did not reach the floor.

strange puckering ... too busty for this dress? fabric great, cut was beautiful, but the way it draped on my body, I had this incredibly weird (so weird that I didn't wear the dress) bunching right on my boob.
Loved!! I received compliments all night! XO   It was elegant and timeless. Everyone was asking if they could borrow it (hee hee!) ;)

Great dress. I received several compliments throughout the night. I highly recommend the dress.  Great dress. I highly recommend the dress for formal events. The dress is true to size and the material is perfect.

Very comfortable dress.  Hides things it's suppose to and very easy to wear and dress up with jewels Great dress for the colder seasons or if you want to cover your arms.  I would rent again.  The fabric is heavy enough to drape well and not ride up anywhere.  Very forgiving style and fabric.

Had to return it b/c it was too big.  Dress ran a little big. The fitting in the body was a little loose. I have long legs and normally need longer sizes but this dress was swimming on me. I recommend the regular unless you are VERY tall and going down a size from you normal selection.

I loved this dress! Sexy and comfortable I wore this dress for a James Bond themed Halloween party. I felt the part while also being very comfortable. It's a rare and perfect dress that can make you feel James Bond sexy and comfy at the same time.
Very elegant! Fit true to size for me. Slimming and forgiving with lots of stretch. Felt sexy without showing a lot! Perfect backdrop for beautiful jewelry.

My friend and I were THEEE best dressed cats in the place.  Super versatile; can be dressed up or dressed down. Comfortable, breathable, old Hollywood glamorous. Flattering on literally every body type.

Very dramatic and amazing! Wore this for the Symphony Gala. I ordered the 4 and 6L, as the 4L was not  available. The length was important for me since I am tall and wear tall heels. The 6L ended up being the dress I wore, but the 4L would have been perfect! In fact, I almost bought the dress in a 4L. 
I accessorized with Janis Savitt "Smokey Crystal Crown" earrings and the Via Spiga "Pamela" in Anthracite color.

A perfect and elegant dress for my age and the very formal event! The swagging on the torso is very kind to  curves!  The jersey is a good weight and the  leg slit is very flattering-- it was a good choice for a very formal Christmas ball!!!

LOVED IT!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! It was so comfortable and I felt so good! Totally recommend this dress.  Who knew SEXY and CLASSY could be in the same sentence. :)  It was long but I like to wear my dresses long… adds drama to the look. lol

Stunning dress! Rented for a black and white masquerade ball, it was absolute perfection. This dress is phenomenal, flattering, the definition of understated glamor.  The fabric is substantial and the drape creates interest and smooths, and it falls perfectly to create an hourglass figure.  The slit shows enough skin to balance the look, but isn't high enough for a wardrobe mishap.  It was comfortable and easy to move in.

Do take care to order the right length, you will probably need to order a longer size than you think.  I am 5'11" and wore a 14L, but if I had worn stilettos, I would have needed a 14XL. 

I would absolutely rent this dress again for a winter event.  I received compliments all night.

Simple and classy Super comfortable. Roomy for post baby body, and draping helped hide imperfections. Regular length was short, even with flats. Sleeves at the wrist were a little big, however I pulled them up a bit to 3/4 length and was perfect. Simple and classy!

Comfortable and elegant dress! LOVED it. The fit was fantastic! I loved the slit and how it was very flattering on my figure. The only con for me was that it was just a tad bit bulky where you zip the dress (on the back) Not that noticeable though. Other than that, GREAT dress,
Very classy dress. This was a classy simple dress but accessories are definitely needed. It is very plain and the slit only came to my knee. Could have used the 0P.

Great dress - comfortable and flattering I rented the 4R with the 6R as backup.  The 4R fit well; it was a little big in the shoulders so I do wish I had tried the 2R as backup.  Many people said the dress ran short, but even with heels, I thought the dress was just a touch long.  The dress was very flattering and comfortable; I have a slight tummy but did not feel like I needed to wear spanx or suck my stomach in; the draping did a nice job with the stomach area.  Overall, this was a great experience and I'd definitely rent again (and would even consider getting this dress again.)
I wore this to a local gala.  I received many compliments on the dress. The dress fit very well.  It was heavier than I was expecting, but that made it hang well.

PERFECT This dress was amazing; it fit perfectly and was so comfortable. I wore 3" heels and the 6L was the perfect length, if not a tiny bit too long. I got so many compliments about how unique the dress was and felt happy and comfortable in it all night!

I received many compliments on the dress.  The dress wasn't quite what I expected. There was more fabric than I imagined. It was heavy and the size 2 was a little big. The size 0 was way too small. The two sizes seemed to be about 4-6 inches different in length. The 2 was too long and the 0 was short. The slit went just above my knee...unlike in the image.

Too short, but gorgeous and comfortable! I ordered this dress in a 0P and 2P. I ended up wearing the 2P because it actually fit more tightly than the 0 - maybe a previous renter stretched it out. I'm 5'2"-5'3", 115 lbs, and I wish I had ordered regular length instead of petite. The petite sizes seem to be poorly-hemmed regulars, because the slit hit my leg at an awkward spot and the dress hit my ankles in the heels I was wearing - not the floor-length stunner I was expecting. All that being said, the dress got a lot of compliments, was very comfortable to wear and dance in all night, and overall I'm very happy with my experience - I just know to order a longer length next time!

Classic, Comfortable and Chic I rented this for our engagement pictures. We're getting married on NYE so I wanted something a bit more formal. I ordered the 10L and 8L. I'm 5'5" and wear a 10, but the reviews said go smaller and longer. When I got the dress, the zipper was out.  You would think I wouldn't have given this dress 5 stars, but because RTR is so amazing, they saved the day.  They overnighted me an 8R (all they had left in the dress) and it fit like a GLOVE! It was a little short, but we were able to hide that in the poses. I felt so great for our pictures, so glamorous.

Perfect for black tie event where I wanted to cover tattoos! This dress was really comfortable, and flattering for girls with bigger hips.  I was going to a black tie event for funeral directors and really looking for something with long sleeves to cover my tattoos.  This dress was perfect.  It is a little "Morticia Addams" so make sure you're okay with that.  But that was PERFECT for the event I was attending.  Very simple, elegant dress that can you can go crazy on the accessories with.

Fancy! Sophisticated! Gorgeous!  This dress was incredible!! It fit tight and has such a nice thick, yet stretchy fabric I really felt like it hugged in all the right places and even helped even smoothed in all the right places (almost like it had built in spanxx). I read reviews saying it was short, so I order a long and it worked but only because I had VERY high heels. The slit is perfect and sexy, the sleeves are tight and slimming of your arms, but still allow you to roll up your sleeves if needed. The only negative I have, is that there was a weird seam the went right across my chest (I have large breasts) but it just seemed awkward. It did not look awkward though, so all is well. I would absolutely rent this dress again!
Everyone said it was the best looking at the affair. Zipper is in back, need help with it.  Runs a bit small.

This was my first rental but not my last.  The process was so simple and enjoyable! This dress was perfect for the more traditional girl who is always cold.  It was comfortable yet sexy.  The fitted waist and side slit were perfect!  The length was perfect with 3 1/2" heels.

Beautiful dress!  Loved wearing this dress. Would recommend this for anyone looking for a classy sophisticated look. I might recommend getting the exta long if you are over 5'10 and planning on wearing heals.

Such a great dress! I got so many compliments on this! Very flattering and sexy... You will definitely need to wear a pair of Spanx! Not that this dress is tight, but it is slinky fabric that will show off any imperfections without Spanx! It is also very warm! I wore it in the winter and did not even need a jacket!
This dress was stunning!   Lovely fit. I'm 5'8, wore 3in heels & it hit the floor just right. After the seated dinner I was able to dance the night away. Very comfortable & classy.  Loved it!

Beautiful gown The dress was beautiful as I got several compliments through out the night, however my original plan was to return it for the length. I am only 5'2 and the dress did not fall correctly I had to change the shoes I originally planned on wearing.  Also it seamed quite worn, I am not sure how many wears they get before the stop renting or reduce the price but the dress had signs that it has been worn several time.

It's amazing how a simple dress can garner so many compliments! This wasn't my first choice or my second, but in the interest of time, the Go-To-Girl that helped me at the SoHo Showroom suggested this dress. Well, the dress fit beautifully and with my 4.5" shoes, the 10R was perfect. I would recommend this dress 10 times over!

Classy and a little sexy!! I rented this dress for a work awards ceremony. I was looking for something more professional that still had a little sass. The slit really made this dress. I chose to wear a necklace with a statement to dress it up. I received so many compliments on it!

The fit was perfect! Length was great and material was of high quality. It is a heavier dress, but it was perfect for the cool night. I have wider hips and was hesitant about the fabric around the mid-section and how it would hang, but with a little placement of the folds, it fell perfectly. Really wish I could have kept this dress for future functions!!! I ordered an 8L as a backup, but didn't even need to try it on because the 6L fit like a glove.
