My dress was delivered before the 8:00 cut off and the ease of return and not having to dry clean it before sending back was wonderful! I will definitely be renting from here again.

Comfortable and sexy! Extremely comfortable, but too long for my frame.  It pooled on the ground.  If you have a large mid-section, you might want the extra length.  I didn't need it.  Loved the dress!
Compliments Galore!! This dress was a showstopper!  Simply commands the room for attention. The split is high ladies, but no complaints here. It was a classy yet sexy dress.

Great basic dress! I needed a dress for a friend's company Christmas party. I wanted something all black, fitted, kinda gothy/sultry, with long sleeves, but still sexy. This totally fit the bill. It fit beautifully and was so comfortable. I'm 5'8" and the long was still a little too short for my liking. The sleeves were too short as well and one of the sleeves was unraveling when I got it. But I was really pleased. Seeing photos now I should have went with more dramatic earrings but oh well. I felt great in it nonetheless and am so excited to rent another dress from here again!

High quality fabric, great cut.  The long length was definitely necessary to wear with heels! This dress fit very well, felt like there was a bit too much fabric in the draping at he waist, (something I would address if I had purchased the dress) but overall it was very comfortable, warm (perfect for the January wedding that I attended).  One sleeve was missing part of it's hem when it arrived, and after I had it on for a bit the rest was gone too.  I received a ton of compliments, and my mom even wants to buy it for herself!
Dress was too short.  The dress was too short for me and I ordered the 4L. I was disappointed in the condition I got the dress in. It was a bit uncomfortable but the slit in the dress is sexy.

Wedding Fun I ordered the 4L and 6L. Ended up wearing the 4L, it is very long had to hold it up when i walked even with 4 inch heels. The dress was beautiful and was great for a chilly night :) I felt like a movie star with this dress was sad to return it.

This dress is elegant and comfortable, & I love that you can wear a normal bra with it.  The dress is very elegant and comfortable. It has a nice drape to it, and allows for easy movement. I loved that I could wear a normal bra with it. I paired it with a silver, sparkly shawl. and some jewelry bling, and it was perfect for my black tie charity gala.
Beautiful dress. Would rent again  It fit perfect. Was a lifesaver as I am up and down in size. I wore it to my daughters wedding and got many compliments

Amazing dress! This dress was just what I was looking for. I was attending a black tie affair for work  and needed something that was classy, sexy, and not too revealing since it was an older crowd. This dress was all of the above.  I felt amazing in it and the slit was a great touch. 

I went with the 0L since the 2L was unavailable and I am glad that I did. It was fitted and the fabric gave stretch where needed. I am almost 5'8 and the length was perfect with 3 inch heels. 

I couldn't have been any happier with my first choice, I didn't even need to try on the backups :-). 

Thanks RTR!!

The dress was perfect! RTR suggested and sent this after my first choice didn't work.  The dress was true to size and the perfect length. I'm 5'3" and I wore 3" heels. It's hard to see in the picture, but it was really dressy and also VERY comfortable. The fabric is soft and a bit stretchy. 
The slit really wasn't that high. It looks much higher in the photo. I love RTR!
Pretty dress, sad it was so short.  Ordered a 6L, but this dress was WAY too short. I'm 5'6 and without heels it was barely ankle length.

Winter Wedding! I loved this dress and received so many compliments! Just be aware that it runs so short. I'm 5'3" and picked a 10L and a 12R for sizes. I wore the long (I also had 6" pumps on) and it just grazed the floor perfectly.  At my height, I could have worn flats with the Regular and the front would have still been too short. Thankfully the dress runs a little big, so I was able to wear the smaller size.  All in all, I would recommend this dress, but when in doubt, get the long.

Perfect dress for winter Wore this to a charity event in December. It was warm, flattering, and super comfy. I am 5'8" and with heels the 8L was the perfect length. I usually wear a 6 or 8 - I also ordered the 6R and it was WAY too short, above my ankles even! The 6L was unavailable, but thankfully the 8L worked perfectly! I got compliments all night long! If you are thinking about renting this - do it!
Gorgeous, flattering & many compliments. Perfect for a winter wedding.  I wore a ~3inch heel with this dress, the 0P I rented fit but was too short.
Beautiful dress for an amazing night! This dress looks like a million bucks. it is very slimming and classic. I got a ton of compliments!

Couldn't wear it. I was really excited to wear this dress -- but tall women beware! I thought that this dress in "L" length would be just about floor length --it actually stopped about 1 inch above my ankle! Completely unwearable - luckily I had a fabulous Carmen Marc Valvo Pom Pom Peplum Sheath dress as a second style to wear to my Gala event! I'm sure tiny and shorter ladies will be fabulous. Another thing that I don't you can tell from the picture is that there is a seam that goes diagonally across your chest, which I think is a little odd.
Beautiful, simple & elegant!  I got tons of compliments on this dress. I paired it with large gold statement earrings and a emerald green BCBG clutch.

Pretty dress, but it wasn't everything I wanted I rented the white version of this dress and I LOVED it, so I figured the red would be a knock out, too. When I worn it, the red was a little more orange than it comes across in the picture, which didn't do good things for my skin. The fit was good, but I felt like the dress was overwhelming. I felt like I got lost in it. I probably won't rent the dress again in red, but I would DEFINITELY be down for the white version again!

. Great dress! I got a ton of compliments all day long. I personally like my dresses a little longer in the front so I was worried about that but everyone said it looked fine. It was very comfortable and such a fun vibrant red! :)

Thought I had rented this for an engagement party, then the couple turned it into a surprise wedding I'm so glad I had rented this dress so I looked fabulous for this surprise wedding. The color is vibrant, and the length is great. I wore it with thin black tights, black ankle booties, a thin black belt at my true waist, and a long double loop of pearls, plus my favorite scarf early in the night when I was warming up. 

The only down side is the material is such it shows every bump of your under garments, so the line of the tights, outline of bra etc. At least it did on me, where the dress fit, but fit snug to my skin on my upper torso, so specifically for the bra.  

I'd rent this dress again, just make sure your bra is seamless and lays flat.

Runs large, no defined waist As others have said, this does run large, but I figured I'd try the 12 anyways as the 10 wasn't available. The sleeves were long, going past my wrists and the zippers on the sleeves were odd. I thought I could make the dress work with a belt to cinch in the baggy shape, but while it looked good belted in the back, it was quite bunchy in the front as there are only darts around the bust and no seam around the waist line. I loved the shape of the dress and how simple it is so I think I'll rent again in a 10, or maybe an 8.

Stunner if you stand all day! I loved this dress, it was perfect for the Hearts of Hope luncheon however, you will see that it wrinkles pretty easily. I barely sat down (as I was coordinating the event) and you can see from one picture to the next how much it wrinkled after sitting down for 5-10 minutes to grab a quick snack during the program.

As suspected, not right for a petite figure I took a chance on this dress because I really love the style. As a very petite woman, it just did not fit right with the fitted waist falling too low and tight across my lower abdomen/upper hips. I think I could have gotten away with the overall length, but the sleeves were way too long. It's definitely not the fault of the dress-it's gorgeous, but not a good choice for my body.

Perfect for a birthday dinner date This dress was well constructed and perfect for my birthday dinner date in freezing cold January weather. Both the 0 and 2 fit, though I felt that the shoulders on the 0 were too narrow and squeezed the top of my arms a bit. The 2 fit comfortably, though it was not fitted at the waist - not a problem at all since I was about to eat a nice (big) meal and it wasn't too big by any stretch of the imagination. The zipper pulls on the back and wrists were both a bit worn from being cleaned after a number of rentals, but it wasn't too noticeable and I wore my hair down so the back wasn't an issue. This dress was great with heels, but since I'm short it looked a little silly with flats. The longer back of the dress made it feel more special than a standard sleeved dress and added some fun drama. Overall it was a very comfortable and flattering dress that wasn't overly formal - perfect for a dinner date.

Wore it for my dad's 60 bday fancy dinner, at the end of March. And it snowed. Glad for the sleeves! Ah, the tale of this dress.

The size 8 fit perfectly - if I had been an ounce heavier in the bust it would have been too tight. It's a bit shorter in the front than I expected, but nothing scandal-worthy. Sadly, my dress had a small stain on the sleeve - but the story has a happy ending as RTR customer service is absolutely top notch and fixed the problem. 

This dress fit and looked so good, when I saw this dress for sale at the RTR sample sale, I snagged it up!
Loved the fit and the material of the dress.  Everything about this dress was great, however, it was really wrinkled upon arrival.
Compliments! So many compliments. The dress runs large, so size down for sure. Perfect for a fall wedding.

Effortlessly stylish! I wore this dress to my friend's October wedding in Western Massachusetts. I loved that it had long sleeves and was surprised at how nice the color was on my fair skin tone. Unlike the photo, I paired the dress with a gold bib necklace and cognac heels. The fit of the dress was perfect - perfect length in the front for my 5'3" frame . I loved the hi-low hem-line, as I have a larger rear and often am concerned with the length of most dresses remaining "decent".  Overall, I highly recommend this dress!

Hello Red!! I rented this as a back up dress for a New England wedding in the fall and the color is gorgeous! The red was the perfect pop of color and I would've paired it with a chunky gold necklace. I had this as a back up and did end up wearing my original pick, but this dress was beautiful none the less. Rent a size smaller for your back up! It runs big. And the sleeves have zippers by the wrist for a little extra detail!
Great dress for a business cocktail social event ! My first RTR ! Very happy with the dress - ran exactly true to size - I'll be a frequent user this summer for all the social events !

Pretty color! I ordered this as a backup dress and only got the size 0. I think the 2 would have fit better. The sleeves were short and tight. The waist wasn't terribly flattering either. I did love the color and the way the skirt dipped lower in the back.
Loved the color! Was true to size, great fit, bright color, casual but dressy at the same time!

beautiful color, perfect dress! Wore this for a work holiday dinner. Really loved this dress! The color was stunning! Way better in person than in photos. For me it fit true to size, I sized down for my backup as recommended by other reviewers but the 0 was way too small. That being said, my regular size, 2, fit like a glove. This dress is so well made and so comfortable. Paired it with nude pumps and a gold necklace that I rented and it was perfect!!

Simple elegant dress This is not a knockout dress but it is a safe choice for many occasions. The color and the longer length in the back add a refreshing change. It is not for shorter girls, as I felt the proportions were off for me.
Eye catching dress! Beautiful dress! Got it for my Rehearsal Dinner and got so many compliments. It is very soft and comfortable. Runs a bit large so get a size down just in case.

Everyone loved the color! The size I wanted to wear was a zero but it was brand new (with the tags still on!) and was super stiff. You could tell it has never been worn. For the arms, I wasn't able to lift them over my head so I went with a size up so i could dance. The 2 was big around my waste but more comfy.
Very Cute! Loved the sleeves and fit through the hips, the fabric doesn't flow as nice as I wanted it to but all in all it did look very nice!

Great choice for a company holiday party! I wore this to my company's holiday party and could not have been more satisfied. It was the perfect mix of classy and sassy, and the fit was perfect. I received a lot of compliments! While it's a (relatively) simple dress, it is definitely stunning... sometimes simple is better!

Dress was beautiful and of course arrived right on time from RTR The dress was beautiful but something just didn't fit right, maybe too loose in certain areas. The color was great and the length allowed for dancing all through the night. It was comfy and the long sleeves were a welcomed addition for a cold church. Overall, it was ok but not the best dress I've rented so far.

This dress is simply elegant!  This dress is very flattering and is perfect for a wedding. This dress would also look great with black tights and booties/heels for the cooler months. I highly recommend getting taking advantage of the 2nd size option and use it to try out a smaller size. I am typically a 2/4, but ended up being a 0 in this dress (I can't remember ever wearing a 0 - this dress definitely runs big).

Great dress--modern and chic.   The dress does run slightly large, but I typically wear a 0-2 in dresses and the 0 fit me great and probably how it should--the dress is not very form fitting.  I loved it!

I wore this lovely dress to the ballet! The fit isn't as clean as I would like, the sleeves have zippers and the seams poke out a bit but still a simple stunner!  Wore this with a chignon bun and my favorite red lipsticks and felt right at home!

The color! It's the perfect red. The fit was great! As it was a littler looser fit, you could size down a little. I wore mine with brown tights and my tall brown boots. It was a perfect outfit to wear out to dinner in the city! The fabric is luxurious. And pretty warm for a chilly night.

Great color but obviously worn The Size 4 would have fit better but the material looked like it had been worn a lot, so I wore the 6.  Material isn't very heavy so make sure you have the appropriate undergarments.

Great red dress! Looks exactly as pictured! Simple, but elegant and beautiful. Wore to a March wedding (6 months post-partum) which made the long sleeves perfect because it ended up being freezing! With a statement necklace, this is amazing!

Didn't know whether the fluctuating weather would be warm or cold, this dress was perfect for either The dress was most snug through the arms and shoulders, but was considerably looser through the bust, torso, hips and skirt.  It was incredibly comfortable, and had a thick lining which was perfect for colder weather.  The dress overall ran a little large.  I got a 4 based off the size chart, with a 2 as back up, but ended up wearing the 2 as the most fitted portion was the arms.

Amazing dress that got complimented all night! I wore this dress to an Oct outdoor wedding. The main reason I picked it was because it has long sleeves, something I don't usually wear in dresses. As soon as I tried it on I fell in love with the fit. It hits all the right places just right and flares out a tiny bit after the waist which helps hide larger hips. Almost everyone at the event commented on it (all compliments), would definitely recommend!

PERFECTION :) I wore this for my engagement photos and it looked perfect! I am having a Christmas wedding so we took pictures in the snow with the red and i couldn't have been happier. The dress did not look worn at all! I received a million compliments on the dress!
Dress fit perfectly and I got compliments all night! Perfect, would rent again! Fit perfectly, the high-low style was very flattering & fun!

Tis the season! Perfect for the holidays!  Ordered the 2 and 4, usually a 2 but wore the 4 for length purposes being a taller girl. Wore on Christmas Eve and was the perfect dress for family dinners and church services.

I love RTR, and I can't wait to rent again!! The dress was beautiful! Everyone was asking where I got it from! I usually am a size 2 but I got the 0 because I read the previous reviews about the dress running large. I tried on the 0 first which was still a little loose, so I never even tried on the size 2.  The color was perfect for a holiday wedding. I was so busy enjoying the party, I didn't get a chance to take a picture!

Kept me warm and stylish in a wine cellar. I always wear a 6- across sizes and designers. In this dress I wore a 4 and it fit perfectly. Order a size down.
I loved this dress. It is cut wonderfully and is really comfortable! It is short enough to be sexy but long enough to sit down. It was perfect for a fall wedding in Northern California with an outdoor cocktail hour and a reception in a wine cellar set at 63 degrees. Also great for pear shape- pick a size based on your bust, shoulders, and waist.

Super comfortable dress!  Tons of compliments on the color. The dress fits a bit tight in the bodice.  I would've upsized to the 10 but then it looked to big in the shoulders.  Overall, very comfortable dress.  Would definitely recommend it.

Beautiful red color!  Perfect for holiday cocktail party I usually wear 4 or 6 depending on dress and designer. I wore a 4 and fit great.  Was a little tight in the bust but still looked fine!
Got so many compliments.  Very festive.   No stretch in fabric and shows any wet mark so try not to spill!
Gorgeous dress. Would rent again. Highly recommend

This dress was perfect for the formal Red Cross event I attended! This dress was super comfortable! It was snowing that day so it was perfect for the weather as well. I paired it with a statement necklace - the dress is great for necklaces!

I would rent this again...and have in other colors! I threw a baby shower for my sister in law and the theme was 'Alice in Wonderland' 
I loved the red color to align with the Queen of Hearts, and this dress was comfortable and photographed well!

Great dress for a fall/winter wedding After reading other comments I sized down for my back-up dress, which is the one I ended up wearing. It fit well and I received many compliments all night. Very happy with my rental!

Bold color and slimming fit are effortless! Dress was perfect for a winter wedding. It is a simple cut, but very flattering and easy to dress up. Got endless compliments and didn't have to think about it once - no adjusting or worries with this dress. Would definitely rent again!
This dress fit amazing and I received SO many compliment! Great choice. Fit perfect. Comfortable. Great red color! Bold but not too loud.
It was perfectly simple. Fit is true to size, very comfortable.

Great dress Dress runs large, the 0 fit well. A little looser in the mid section but I think that's how it's supposed to fit. I got so many compliments on this dress. It was perfect to wear to an outdoor fall wedding. Very comfortable and fun to wear.

Fabulous dress! Simply beautiful and classy. Loved it! I wore this dress for a fundraiser event. I was a little worried when I tried it on because I thought it would be sung, but I actually liked how it fell effortlessly on my petite frame. In addition, I never wear red, but I was really drawn to this dress. I paired it with an nude/African print platform. Well I was absolutely in love with the style and ease of this dress. I felt beautiful in red! I danced all night in my and very glam. Kudos to RTR, from packaging to customer service.

Comfy dress with great color I wasn't sure I loved this dress when I first tried it on, but once I had the whole outfit together it was a hit! Received compliments all night. Long sleeves were perfect for an October wedding. Color was fantastic, it photographs really well. I'm tall (5'10) so I was a bit nervous about length and sleeves, but it wasn't an issue.  Definitely needs some accessories to complete the look.
The quality of the dress. I wore the 4 but could have worn the 6 as well, it was just looser in the body. Beautiful dress! Wore it as a prom chaperone. It was adult and teenager approved.

Rented this dress for a wedding. I LOVED the dress, and I got lots of compliments from other guests. I'm typically a 4 (S) in clothing. I ordered the size 4 as my main with the size 2 as my backup and ended up going with the size 2 based on wanting a slightly tighter fit around my midsection. I have broader shoulders and a longer torso so smalls sometimes are too tight around my shoulders and the length ends up a little too short on me; however the dress fit perfectly in regards to length in the sleeves and tail. It helps that the dress was designed to slightly longer in the back anyways.

Spectacular I wore this dress to a brunch, the color was a striking red beauty that demanded attention but the unique cut of the dress insisted on a gaze that most of the attendees of the brunch could not resist.  I was inundated with compliments and blushed when my husband who always says "you look good, lets go" changed his tune to "you look so good maybe we shouldn't go". I am a size 4 and the 4 fit true to size. It is  nicely lined and could easily be worn in the winter months, but cool enough for a summer event because of it's attractive length.  Gorgeous dress, would rent again but why would I when I have such a vast closet choice.

Received many compliments on the color and fit of the dress on me. I'm petite, full-figured, ample breasted.  The dress fit beautifully.  I ordered a 6 and a 4. I liked the fit of the 4 better.  It's a 'blue' red.  The long sleeves were perfect for the cool evening and hiding my "aging" arms.  I've never received so many compliments.
Did not wear this dress is an awkward length for someone that is short, and the arms were very long. Overall it was not very flattering

This dress will make you stand out The dress fit perfectly. The cut is not too clingy but follows your curves. The dress is not stretchy but has a slight give so it is comfortable. When I first put it on at home I thought this was just a regular red dress. BUT in the lights of the evening and under the camera flashes it turned into a bright shining star. It has a special reflective quality that makes it stand out in photos. 
It was a little hard to zip up at the top so you will need assistance and I can see how this dress would not fit larger chest or shoulders. However, I loved it and received tons of compliments.
Pretty dress, stunning color This dress is beautiful in its simplicity.  I wore this with pulled back hair and gorge red, navy and turquoise statement earrings and got tons of compliments.

Engaged in RentTheRunway! What a *perfect* dress for a winter engagement! My boyfriend, now fiance, took me on a carriage ride to see the nearby Christmas lights and surprised me with a proposal! The dress was classy, elegant and fun and popped in pictures. Can't say enough about this dress!

Added a belt & it worked great! This dress was beautiful, but I may order a size down next time. It was very spacious around the waist- so much so that I needed to wear a belt. Loved the slight high-low.

Wore this for my engagement photos and I could not have been happier with the color and style. Runs a size bigger than I thought. Probably could have worn an 8. Sleeves were a bit large and not too flattering in the bust. But overall great dress and color was amazing.

Love this dress! I want to buy it now! Perfect length. I tried on the 16 and it was just a bit snug in my post-baby mid-section.
The 18 gave me just a bit more breathing room. The quality and color are excellent
Easy to wear and eye-catching A little baggy on the waist. Nice to have zippers on the sleeves.

Felt extremely classy in this one! Rented this dress for Christmas dinner with an acquaintance.  I have always had long arms and was concerned about how the dress would fit but it worked out perfectly.  I think the sateen fabric had something to do with that.  The length was also perfect and I wish I would have taken more photos to be able to show off.

Very classy in its simple design. Wore this to a winter wedding. The dress is great quality, simple, yet classy design. I really loved wearing this. It was very comfortable for a long night of dancing at a Christmastime wedding. Packing it swiftly in the waiting bag and dropping it off for delivery makes renting from RTR enjoyable. I am a first time customer and am very pleased with the quality, service and process of renting. This will be my first go-to for future events.

Elegant, flattering, versatile! Great fabric, high / low hem very cool.  It's conservative but much more interesting than an average white dress.  I can't imagine regretting this rental if you aren't sure what to wear for a nicer party  - would work for a wedding only if the bride wants you in white too.  It's dressy, so maybe not a work or everyday dress.  The fabric is thick and warm so more of a winter/fall outfit.   It's flattering without being boxy or too form fitting, I would rent this again, but there is so much to choose from, it's hard to know if I'd ever repeat a rental.
Classic white dress, nice material and flattering fit This dress wrinkled very easily for me after I steamed it which was upsetting but understandable, I just wish I would've known this beforehand.

Made a pregnant gal feel good! I got this for my cousin's wedding, which I officiated. She wore gold so I was ok to wear white, lol! I was 5mo pregnant at the time. I thought it would be a good choice to for my growing bump. I'm happy with the way it turned out, but it fit really long in the sleeves and large across the shoulders. I belted it, but in retrospect, I think it might have looked a little better without one. I was comfortable the whole night and got lots of compliments on how great I looked. It definitely made me feel better about being pregnant and having to dress up during an awkward size!

Such a classic and chic dress! Perfect to feel bridal!  Wore for my Engagement Party! Perfect dress for it! It was short in the front, but paired with tights it was great! Runs small on top and might be a problem for girls with bigger busts!

Beautiful dress and I felt very elegant in it! The dress was supposed to be delivered on Friday but it did not come until 2:00 on Saturday afternoon. My event was at 5:00 that evening an hour away from where I lived. Needless to say, I was STRESSING out big time. BUT the dress was beautiful and fit like a glove. I received many compliments.

Loved this dress. Got so many condiments! I normally wear a 4, but based off of others reviews, I had them send a 2 and a 4. The 2 ended up working best for me. It was very comfortable, simple but super stylish. Would def rent again!

Perfect easy dress! I wore this dress for my winter bridal shower and it was perfect - I felt comfortable and fit well.  I am usually a 2, sometimes a 0, and I wore the 0 in this dress. I would order down for your backup size.

Perfect for work to evening attire. Very comfortable and was not too tight. Because I am only 5'3", the front was not too short for work. The zipper on the sleeves helps give it a more summery look and the material is thinner than it appears but is not see through and has a liner inside.
Gorgeous dress!!! Lovely dress- wore it to my rehearsal dinner and received compliments all evening!  The shape and material is absolutely gorgeous.

I have never received more compliments than I got when I wore this dress!!! This dress was amazing! The fabric is very cool and comfortable. It can be dressed up or dressed down. I wore it to a semi-formal engagement party and reviewed compliments all night! It's the first dress I've worn that made me feel like a bride to be! I recommended RTR to everyone at the party!

Gorgeous and elegant!  I wore this dress to my bridal shower. Everyone LOVED it! I am a small girl, so it did run a little large, but nothing that a belt couldn't fix. I was afraid that it would be a bit see-through but the thickness in the lining was perfect! I paired it with nude heels but black complimented the dress just as well. I am extremely pleased with this rent and cannot wait to rent my rehearsal dinner dress!

I wore this dress to my bridal shower and it was stunning. I received a lot of compliments! The fit was great. I was able to wear regular undergarments, as it wasn't too see-through. I wore this dress in a 4 but I also ordered it in a 6 just in case. The sleeves and cut of the bottom of the dress were simply beautiful and I'd recommend this dress for any cold weather bridal events.
I wore this to my wedding and loved it! It was the perfect casual, modern dress. The lining made this not see-through.

Crisp white look that's great for spring/summer date. Fitted through the shoulders/arms/bust w/a loose and flowy skirt w/cute detail in the back. Cuffs have low-visibility zippers if you need to adjust the fit (tightness) on the arms, but I didn't since they hit about 3/4 length for me at 5' 10'' height. This style is loose through the hips and in the skirt, so no-go if you're looking for a fitted/body con look. This dress fits high and high close to the neck, so while I could size down to a 2, it was too tight across the throat to be comfortable for the evening. Fully lined, so I didn't have any trouble with it looking too see through, but make sure you've got low profile skivvies because the slightest bit of lace texture shows through.

simple and elegant!  I rented this dress for Valentine's. It's pretty, but quite sober, so I had to complement it with a long and colorful necklace - I used jade - and nice shoes. The fabric is light but warm, so it was ok for an air conditioned place without need for a top.

Elegant Winter White I wore this for my civil wedding ceremony. It doesn't look like much when you take it out of the bag but when I put it on it flowed nicely. It's comfortable and I got many compliments. I recommend this dress.

One small detail, I ordered this in both the four and six, fully expecting to wear the six but I ordered the four based on other reviews I read. It turns out the four fit just right (with Spanx underneath). Good thing because the size six had a small faint blue dot on the front of the dress. Make sure to closely inspect garments as soon as they arrive.

I wore the dress to our wedding rehearsal and rehearsal dinner. I wore it with 9W blue suede shoes. The dress runs small on top and loose below the waist. I would not recommend it for busty women. I got plenty of compliments throughout the night. #bridetobe #wedding

Simply Stunning Don't let the simplicity of this dress fool you, it is absolutely beautiful! I wore it for an office Christmas luncheon and I received numerous compliments from very fashionable colleagues. My husband loved this dress and could not stop raving about it. Classy and unique, this is a must rent! It DEFINITELY runs large, so size down.

Incredible I was afraid to wear this because I don't usually wear white, but the color looked incredible.
I rented this from the store in Chicago, and the size 2 was the only one they had available. It was barely too tight, but that was understandable since I'm usually a size 4. I wore this for my 4 year anniversary date to a very nice restaurant. This dress was beautiful and glamorous. I wanted to keep it.

Elegant dress! I loved the look of this white dress and how it elongated in the back.  The material was light and was not see through as I had originally feared.  This is a great dress for a bridal shower, bachelorette party or rehearsal dinner (which is what I wore it to).

Perfect dress for my bridal shower The dress is simple but really classy and comfortable.   I wore it with a bold necklace to stand out a bit more since I wore it to my bridal shower.  It was the perfect dress for the occasion!
awkward fit too loose thru the midsection and arms and was a really awkward fit for me so I didn't end up wearing it.
cure dress, figure flatering more white than winter white

A fun and flattering party dress! Order one size smaller than usual - a 2 fit perfectly, although I'm usually a 4.  Sleeves were a little short and had zippers, which I wasn't aware of.  Dress is fully lined and falls nicely.
The dress was perfect for my Civil Wedding! - Perfect length & Material I usually wear a size 6, I ordered the 6, & the size 4 as my second size and it fit perfectly! Not too tight :)
I wore this dress for my "surprise" engagement party and received many compliments on it! Order a size down than you would normally order.  I am usually a 4 and wore a size 2 and it fit perfectly.
Classic and flattering cocktail dress Great little white dress, I wore it to my company's holiday party. I normally wear a 2, and the 2 in this dress fit perfectly! Easy to dress up or down.
Charity gala I have super broad shoulders and a bit of a bust so it was a little tight up top, but other than that it was wonderful! Very elegant yet modern.
Wore this for my rehearsal dinner and it was perfect for the occasion. It fit really well and was well lined so I didn't have to worry about it being see-through or showing pantie lines.

Simple, Chic, Flattering I wore this dress for my bridal shower and loved it! I was comfortable, effortless and chic. I got so many compliments and felt great. I usually wear a size 4 and ended up wearing the 2 which fit great. The dress does get a little wrinkly on the bottom but nothing crazy. If I had something else to wear all white to I would absolutely order again!
Easter  Sunday! Working the dress. I just loved the fit! Right  This Dress was Perfect!
Pretty white winter dress Beware it is pretty sheer and really tight around the middle, but would be great if you had toned abs.

I received so many compliments! I usually wear a size 4, but other reviews stated that this dress runs a bit large. I am glad I read the reviews! I ordered a size 2 and size 4 - ended up wearing the size 2! It fit perfectly! Most of the other women at the party wore something more risqué but I received so many compliments and ladies wanting to know where I got the dress!

The dress is amazing! I rented this dress for my niece's Confirmation as I was her sponsor and needed something nice to wear.   I am normally a size 4 but rented a 4 and 6.  The size 4 fit perfectly!  The fit was amazing and my favorite part is the zippers on the sleeves to make the sleeves bell out.   I also loved how it was a little longer in the back.  I got so many compliments on this dress and hope I have something else to go to that I can rent this dress again!
Beautiful dress. Tight in the arms though! The top half is tighter than the bottom. It was difficult to bend my arms in this dress. The bottom half is forgiving without being loose.

Very pretty, but not my favorite.  I normally wear size 10, and this dress fit well in size 8.  It wasn't a perfect fit, however, and it wasn't very forgiving when it came to hiding my tummy.  Overall, it was a nice looking dress, but I didn't LOVE it.

I wore this for my rehearsal dinner and everyone said how classy and elegant was the dress - GREAT! Like other people, I agree this dress runs a little big. I tend to wear a 4 or maybe a 2, but the 0 was perfect for this dress. It's a little short, but given that you're so covered on top, it is still really tasteful. It is also pretty thick so you don't have to worry about it being see-through or really showing any lines. Overall really GREAT dress.

Great dress! The dress was really comfortable and the size 4 fit me perfectly. It is really nicely made and didn't have to worry about it being see through. The cut is what makes it really cute otherwise it's a pretty plain dress. Need a necklace for sure. Overall, highly recommended.

Elegant dress, so many compliments all night! I tried the size 2 first, and could hardly get it zipped up mid back (i have broad shoulders but my usual size is a 2) so I freaked out a little, because my backup was a 0! I ended up trying it on anyway, and it fit SO MUCH BETTER! Maybe it had been worn more than the other one, is all I could figure. So weird, but I was relieved! I could zip it up and still move my arms. The sleeves were a bit short, but luckily there were zippers on the sleeves so I just unzipped those and left them like that and they looked fine. I paired it with gold accessories and shoes, and felt so glam all night. I received so many compliments and was comfortable with dancing all night, especially with the back being a little longer than the front. Would definitely recommend!
Love this dress! Received so many compliments, would totally wear again. I am usually a size 0 in designer brands and this was a perfect fit- no complaints on fit at all!
Didn't get a chance to wear.  Too much material and came very wrinkly. Never wore it. Would be cute for the right occasion. Just not what I had in mind.

You can make this dress look hot and sexy or simple and classy...a very versatile dress! I didn't think I would like this dress, but I loved it.  I purposely ordered a size down so it can fit tight (see Kim Kardashian on the Nha Kahn page), and I think it looked hotter that way!  The material was warm, perfect for fall weather.  The white color is not a crisp white but it's not an off-white either...it's hard to describe but at first I thought it was dingy but after several people convincing me that it wasn't, I went with it.  It fits snug in the chest and waist, but again I sized down from my normal size.  You can make this dress what you want it to be with the right accessories and shoes, therefore I think it's can work for a night out or a business dinner.  I would rent this one again (and also in the red color).  And as always, a seamless rental transaction from Rent the Runway!

It was the perfect dress for a bridal shower!! The dress was gorgeous. I really wanted to keep it. It was flowy, classy and flattering. The arms were snug (not tight) on me, but I have large arms. The way it fell hid belly imperfections. I normally wear an 8, but that was baggy on me, so I wore the 6. Just love it! Also, despite being white, it's not see-through in the slightest.

Beautiful and comfortable! I typically wear a size 10, but the size 8 was perfect and I was glad I ordered both sizes.  The dress just lays really well and is a great fabric.  I was super comfortable and got a ton of compliments.  Loved it!  One of my guests actually liked it so much that she rented it for another event she had coming up.  Very versatile.

Perfect dress for my civil wedding!  I wore this dress for my civil wedding and it was perfect! I got so many compliments. This dress is perfect for anything wedding/bridal related. Highly recommend it.

This dress was perfect for my low-key wedding. The dress was comfortable, but still sexy. Loved! My husband and I got married on our roof deck at home, so I wanted a dress that wasn't too formal, but still somewhat classy/elegant. This dress was perfect, clean modern lines. I usually wear between an 8/10 and went with the 10 just to have more room in the shoulder/arm area. The length hit above the knees, but the high/low hem kept it interesting. Thick fabric was perfect for a nighttime outside event. Thank you, RTR for making my wedding day special!!
Great dress for engagement pictures! It was a super comfortable dress and perfect for engagement pictures. I ordered a 8 and 10 and ended up wearing the 10.

Wore this for a murder/mystery dinner party! This was my first time ever using RTR. Over all, I LOVED this dress. I will probably be renting it again for my wedding rehearsal dinner in a few months. It is incredibly classy and just lovely. That said, if you happen to have a little "pouch" as I like to call it, spanx will go a long way! I usually like things a little looser in the belly area and this wasn't as loose as I'd like it. But spanx solved that problem. Also, it wrinkled very easily! That was annoying. I left the zippers on the arm fully zipped as others mentioned.
Gorgeous dress that was very flattering Wore this dress to prom. Good length even though I have short legs runs a bit big. I usually wear a 6 but the 4 worked better.
Love love love this dress Comfortable fit and I had a great bachelorette night in it.

Loved it!  A great alternative to the LBD! It's always a crap shoot with a-line dresses for me but this one nipped in right above my natural waist and made me look tall and thin.  Loved the slight train effect in the back since I'm not entirely comfortable with mini length.  But the extra length in the back allowed me to feel comfortable my bum wouldn't show bending over but still showed off my legs in front.  The arms had zippers on the wrist to help in getting the tighter arms on but they didn't feel restrictive or odd.  It's lined so no issues with undergarments showing and I could wear a regular bra and panties- no Spanx!
Don't need a jacket in weather that's a bit nippy. This dress fits great! Very comfortable. Room to breathe but still accents your curves

I got a TON of compliments and I felt like a million bucks at my Engagement Party! It was all-around an awesome dress. I wore it to my Engagement Party which was a night-time cocktail and apps event. It does run a little big so I'd order a size down. The only thing I didn't love about the dress was the flare at the bottom is a little awkward straight on as it flares a little too much. I moved around enough and posed in pictures in ways that it didn't matter though. Definitely recommend!!
this was my 2nd rental with renttherunway and I really enjoy their business! I enjoyed this dress    it fit lose on the stomach area but other than that extremely beautiful

okay dress... The dress wasn't was I expected. The material is stiff so it lay a bit funny. Not comfortable to bed your arms for long since the sleeves are stiff as well. They have zippers which I found odd. Length was fine quite a bit longer in the back. Overall, it was fine for a couple hours but I wouldn't rent it again
Not great.  Material seemed very cheap. Overall the dress seemed very cheap.  The material was not nice.  It looks good in pictures, but in real life, it's cheap looking.

Not what I expected I ordered a 4 and a 6 in this dress and couldn't get the right fit. The 4 too small and the 6 too big. The waistline and hem hit rather low in this gown which swallowed me up. This dress is for a taller woman. The fabric is slightly see through as well, so if you like to wear undergarments, they may show. It's always a risk wearing a high neck if you have a full bust and this one makes you pay the price. My chest looked twice as large. I wasn't able to wear this dress, but the good people at RTR allowed me to return it and issued me a credit.

Elegant and comfortable!  i'm 5 months pregnant with my second baby. i ordered this dress for my first baby's baptism and I loved it like no other! Very comfortable and classic. Fit me very well even tho I'm pregnant it fit great. I had an issue to find a dress that fits my changing body and that i felt comfy in. I got lots of compliments on the dress, and I got so many parties in May that I would wear that dress to  every one of them, unfortunately same people going to be there... Great dress, super comfortable and elegant! 10/10

I wore this dress for my bridal shower. It was perfect!  Wore this dress at my bridal shower. I received so many compliments and felt very comfortable in it. I read the comments that it runs big, so I ordered a 4 and a 6, 6 being my normal size. The 4 fit fine, but I liked having more wiggle room in the 6 since I knew I'd be moving around a lot that day. Perfect dress for a shower!

Perfect dress for my engagement party! Beautiful material and amazing lining-I'm usually a little nervous about white being see through but it wasn't in the least.  I am a bit more of an athletic build, so the only negative was the tightness in the arms but it wasn't too uncomfortable.  I was worried about the length, but it was perfect for a family function.  I would highly recommend this beauty!
Absolutely beautiful~ I wanted to find a dress to change it to at the end of my wedding. This was the perfect party dress. The color was beautiful and it sparkled all evening.

If you like it then you should put a rent on it!!! I purchased this dress to wear to VIP at a Beyonce concert in DC.  It was the perfect choice!!  I got so many compliments from friends, family and strangers.  It is a lot more "sparkly" in person and will definitely get you noticed.  The zipper is a little hard to get up so you will need a second person to help with that.  I could wear my regular bra and panties without a problem which is always nice.  I will DEFINITELY be renting again!!

Great dress! I couldn't be happier with my RTR experience.  I picked the dress based on looking at submitted photos and realizing everyone  looked great in this dress.  I ordered a 12 and 14.  I went with the 14 because it gave me a little more coverage on the top but the 12 fit as well.   I can't tell you how many compliments I received!  The dress was so comfortable I didn't want to take it off.  My one concern was that the dress would be in bad condition from prior rentals but aside from a weird smell ( from dry cleaning Im sure - I hung it outside to air out and it was fine)  the dress was perfect.  The whole experience was great and sooo easy. I feel like I should be a paid spokesperson for RTR because I couldn't shut up all night about my rental dress.  If your not sure about renting - go for it!  you won't be disappointed!

Great "Bump-Friendly" dress I'm 7 months pregnant and needed a 'bump-friendly' dress - RTR search recommended this one. It was definitely bump-friendly as there is space just below the ribcage. I had to size up and could've sized up twice because it's quite fitted around the ribs. The top made me look a little wider in the chest than I am, I think. But overall, it's a really beautiful dress! I hope this is somehow helpful! I didn't manage to get a very good photo. :(

Wore this at my bridal shower and I was definitely the star of the day.   This dress fit beautifully and I was given SO many compliments. It is a little low cut but not too terrible. The only con was the zipper. We had a real fight trying either dress zipped. I ended up wearing the sz 8 because there was only a slight difference in size and we were able to get the 8 zipped. Be prepared for a struggle.

This dress is AMAZING. All night long, people were asking where I got it! (: I wish I could keep it! I LOVE THIS DRESS! I wore it to my Homecoming. I loved knowing that I was the only one wearing it. There were so many people with the same dresses and I'm so glad mine was unique! I liked that it wasn't too short or revealing. The size I wore was a 4, I usually wear a 6/8. I was unsure about it at first because I'd never used this website before, but I absolutely LOVE this site. I recommend this dress to anyone. It is very flattering to all body types.
The event was great, it was NYE! Dress from RTR was too large and very worn looking Didn't fit me well so I returned and had to go buy a dress for NYE last year.
great service Stunning dress, but way too flashy for me.  I did not end up wearing the dress.  I also thought the draping/pleating in the front had an odd look and was not flattering on my body type.
So comfortable yet sexy! I normally wear an 8 but wore the 10 to accommodate my bust. So fun to dance and and got compliments all night!
Beautiful, fun dress!  Zipper sticks a bit but great dress! Had to pin top a little at bust line for when I bent over but loved it and was very comfortable.

Shine bright like a diamond!!! This dress fit very well but if you have a small bust be prepared with a safety pin because may front a little. I used a safety pin and as you can see on the pic it's not noticeable. This dress is true to size. 

Pros: fits well on most figures, great length. 

Cons: its was bothersome under the arms once I started dancing because the sequin rubbed on my arm. Other than that nothing. 

Besides the bride A LOT of people complimented me on my dress... even the wedding photograher.LOL.  This dress is definitely a showstopper and I look foward ordering this dress in another color. LOVED IT!!!!!

Beautiful clothing. I thought the dress ran large.  Based on other reviews, I ordered a size up for my back up size.  I wish I had ordered a size down.  The 8 fit, but was a little too big.  This took away from the beauty of the dress.  It needed to fit more snug around the middle.  I am not someone who wears my clothes tight.....but felt this dress was a little too big.  

The color is gorgeous.  The dress was VERY comfortable.
dress fit perfectly- so many compliments! It fits probably a little bigger- normally I wear a 4/6 and the 4 fit me best.  It covers all the "problem areas" and makes you feel really good!

Perfect Birthday Dress! I loved the dress so much, it is definitely appropriate for any affair where you will be the center of attention! I received so many compliments, and the rose gold color worked well with my skin tone. I would be careful when it comes to the neckline, as the V is plunging and reveals a lot of cleavage. I had a hard time finding the perfect accessories but I ultimately when with a nude clutch and nude open-toed heels. I would recommend the dress to anyone!

It was my very first time renting a dress, I felt like a million dollars! It was a GREAT IDEA!!




 I'm very glad I rented this dress, I did not want to spent a lot of money on a dress that I'll probably wear only once.  I ordered this dress for my niece's Quinceañera and I receive many compliments, the only issue was the zipper, my kids actually had a little trouble zipping it up. Just like I read on the other reviews, but other than that it fit perfectly! I felt like a million dollars!
fabulous  dress. got so many compliments. great dress! all of the reviews were so true. very comfortable. runs a little big up top, needed to buy a great lift bra

The dress came on time, it firt, i got tons of compliments, especialy from my husband. And sending it back was simple as can be! I am the queen of black for all occasions, so this was a very out of the box choice for me. Loved this dress! I was nervious it wouldnt fit, I am curvy and very busty. Very flattering fit. As someone who is large chested i loved being able to wear a bra and not having to worry about any straps showing. The dress was stunning. It looks more yellow gold in the picture, but it is actually a pinkish gold. Great first experience on rent the runway!!! And I got tons of compliments, especialy from my husband.

I was getting compliments on my dress all night! The only trouble I had was that my B-cup size left the front a little loose, luckily I ha my super VS bombshell bra with extra gel inserts lol and then everything filled out nicely. So if your larger than a B cup you may have no problem, if your A-B you may want to prepare fill it out ;)

This was THE perfect bachelorette party dress!! This dress was an absolutely perfect choice to wear to my bachelorette party.  With all the girls wearing black, this def stood out but was a little more exciting than a basic white dress.  As far as fit, it was a great choice for a bigger bust and I probably could have gone with the 10 but just felt a little more  comfortable in the 12 for a night of dancing and drinking.  I'd recommend this dress, hands down, to anyone who wants to have a little sparkle!

Sparkly in Vegas! This dress is gorgeous and you will feel like you are walking the red carpet all night! I'd say it does rub under your arms and on your thighs because the slip doesn't cover the hem (nothing you can't get past for a few hours of looking pretty). I have rented other Badgley Mischka dresses and the 14 always fit perfectly. I actually wish I got the 12 as a backup. This dress ran a little bigger in the waist and was a little long. Maybe the 12 would have fit since the dress is stretchy... Overall, this is an awesome dress - if I ever need sparkles again, I know what dress to get!
Great dress!  The sequins are much more costumey than they look in the picture--very New Years Eve looking. Otherwise, great dress! Fit is true to size.

Great Dress! Very forgiving!!! The size 12 was not too big or too small it just had a very sticky zipper! Loved the dress otherwise! It definitely needed some body tape to hold the girls in....it was a bit too revealing for my taste. I am petite so I worry about fit, and the dress did not swallow me at all, it was a great length and fit great! I received a ton of compliments! I wore the 10 even though it was snug because the 12 had some zipper issues. Thank you RTR!!

The delivery was prompt and efficient.  Great! This dress fits true to size.  I would recommend ordering a size smaller also. Great dress! Cons...the base of the zipper in the back is a little cheap. It doesn't lay flat.

Fantastic price for a fantastic dress! Rented this dress for my daughter's homecoming dance. She said she got dozens of compliments about how stunning she looked. The dress is very sparkly and figure-flattering, the only problems were that the zipper is kind of hard to zip and the top area is quite large for someone with a smaller bust-- nothing a bobby pin can't fix. This was my first order at RTR, and it didn't disappoint! If you're on the edge of deciding whether to buy this dress, I would say go for it, as it is gorgeous and well worth the price.

surprisingly comfortable with just the right amount of sparkle!  i loved the length-- right above the knee so it was still flattering for my legs, but it was also comfortable to sit down in. the v neck is pretty low, but i wasn't uncomfortable. i was worried that without a summer tan, the rose gold would wash me out, but it had enough sparkle to it that it will be flattering for any skin tone. i loved the quality, it had a really nice fit, and it was surprisingly comfortable to wear for the 6 hours i was in it! I received so many compliments, it made me feel so confident!

Bump friendly Wore the dress when I was 32wk pregnant and went up a couple sizes (usually wear a 6/8, ended up wearing the 12).   It fit great and I actually felt like I looked good.  Perfect amount of sparkle and glitz.

Grand entrance dress to my Post-Wedding PARTY! I wore this AMAZINGLY sexy and sparkly dress to my wedding after-party.  I felt like everyone in the room stoped and stared when I walked in.  It was the perfect dress to wear after I took off my beautiful wedding dress :) Fit like a glove!  I rented both the 6 and the 8 and choose the 6 becuse it was a little more snug but not too tight.  Rent this glamorous dress you won't be sorry!

This dress was a showstopper! I received so many compliments throughout the night!  The fit was perfect. I ordered the 10 and 12 and ended up wearing the 10. I was able to wear normal undergarments, and I was completely comfortable all night. I just had to put a safety pin near the bust so that my bra didn't show, as it looked like there was a stitch that came undone. Overall, this dress was a complete hit - and great for most figures!
Surprisingly matronly This was surprisingly itchy, heavy, and not nearly as sexy as I'd hoped. Made my already-large chest look top heavy.

This dress is simply dazzling!  I'm very happy that I ordered it in two sizes although the fit was very true to size I felt the arm openings were a little tight in the 4 for my measurements. This dress is a stunner and the way the front falls below the waist is incredibly feminine and flattering. The fabric is so hard to describe and was gold with blush undertones so gorgeous in every detail. This dress is not stretchy it fits snugly. It is lined but I wore a bodysuit under because it was a little itchy. It's heavy and thick so was warm in the FL heat but easy to dance in. Fabulous dress!

Showstopper!! This dress was absolutely to die for! I got this dress and a back up for a wedding and I ended up wearing this for the reception. It is certainly an attention grabber! The sparkle of the dress certainly made it one of a kind. Definitely would rent this dress again!!

Felt like a million bucks! Pros - this dress was enough coverage for a church and still fun and flirty.  Plus, I'm a mom of 2 boys, so coverage is a big thing!  I was able to wear this dress comfortably all day long.

Cons - this is a very popular style.  There was another girl wearing the same dress in blue and 2 other wearing a very similar dress - there were only 200 guests at the wedding.

I had RTR send the dress to my hotel and it worked out great.  Much easier than packing a dress!
I got so many compliments the whole night! Everyone kept telling me how great I looked! Great for girls with a large bust and curvy figure! It was very comfortable and was the perfect length!

Sparkly Beautiful Dress I rented this dress and another similiar one for my friends wedding.  This is a classic cut that will work best on and hourglass shape, the waist has very little give and I found there to be more room than I needed in the hips.  The ruching at shoulders and deep V make this perfect for someone bustier - the extra material kinda swallowed my chest up!  I ended up going with the other option based on fit but the sparkles are beautiful without being over the top!!

Loved everything about this dress! I wore this dress to my company holiday party and it did not disapoint. It fit perfectly (though I did order a size up as back up just in case).  Normally, I would wear black, but wanted to break out of the box. I am super fair (light blue eyes and red hair), but the color of this dress was ideal. I was worried I would be washed out, but the rose colored was quite flattering . I styled the dress with rose gold earrings and hot pink pumps.  I received compliments all night-- and was so pleased to sing the praises of RtR. I wish I had an excuse to wear this dress again-- it was that wondeful!

Pretty Dress but not for me!  The dress fit fine and was thick in material because of the sequins, but it made me look paler than I really was. It was a nice dress but definitely not meant for my body type or complexion!! It wont be going back in my hearts.
Love, Love, Love this dress Attention grabbing dress, it was absolutely amazing. This dress is not for the meek, it sparkles with every move you make. Totally fun dress

Perfect for Black Tie (optional) Gala The week before the gala I still didn't have a dress AND still had the dresses from the past 3 galas hanging in my closet (none of which had been worn since!). A friend told me about RTR and the rest is history.  Both the 2 and the 4 fit well.  The 2 was a little snug around my ribcage and I feared it would become uncomfortable during the 1-2 hour, seated, presentation and auction.  

Favorite feature - ability to wear normal bra!   

The number of people who commented positively on my dress was astounding!   Warning... If someone uses a camera with a low-grade flash you will be one big sparkle!  (Not saying it is a bad thi - but was funny!).

A fantastic choice for my sorority formal I ordered both the 10 and the 12 of this dress; both sizes fit but I chose the 12 simply for comfort. Overall it fit very nicely and I felt beautiful. If you have a smaller chest, take caution when ordering this dress because the V dips very low. I used two small safety pins to prevent the fabric from gapping and it was perfectly fine. Also the zipper on this dress was quite difficult, but with someone to help me it worked out.

OVERALL VERY COMFORTABLE AND FIT ALMOST TRUE TO SIZE.  I'M SMALL ON THE TOP SO THE SZ 6 WAS A LITTLE TOO LARGE IN THE TOP, FIT GREAT AROUND MY HIPS.  THE SZ 4 FIT PERFECT FOR MY BUST AND ONCE I PUT MY SPANX HOSE ON, THE SZ 4 FIT GREAT AROUND MY HIPS.  VERY FORGIVING AFTER A DINNER AND THE FRONT IS GATHERED SO THAT HELPS OFFSET ANY BLOATING.  GOT LOTS OF COMPLIMENTS!
So beautiful! I was definitely glad I got size 6! Despite how the picture looks, the dress is more rosey than gold, but I absolutely loved it! I got compliments all night!

Sexy but easy I loved this dress!  I was a little surprised I fit in the 8 (I got a 10 as my back up); as I have previously worn Badgley Mischka dresses in 10s.  But there is plenty of room in the bust, and I think that's why I didn't have to go up a size.  I'm a 36DD and didn't feel restricted by this dress.  Also loved that I could wear a normal bra with it.  I loved the low neckline, but it was too low for the bra I was wearing so I had to safety pin it shut a bit.  I'm 6 feet tall, the dress hit about mid thigh and didn't feel uncomfortably short.  Fabric is heavy, but that was kind of nice on a chilly fall evening in LA.  The sequins didn't bother me at all.  I was told I looked beautiful yet comfortable - perfect way to sum up this dress!

Such a fun dress! I was getting compliments all night. Total strangers asking where I got it.  I don't think I would ever buy a fancy designer dress so renting one was perfect. I went to a wedding in Vegas and had the dress mailed to the hotel. Came with fun samples too! I'm totally renting again!

Sexy, head-turning dress for my bachelorette party! This dress is absolutely gorgeous. I wore it for my bachelorette party in Vegas, and it was perfect. I got so many compliments from random strangers. Fits small in the top if you are large-chested like me, so I had to go with a the 14 instead of a 12. Large-chested girls understand that this is the norm, so I wasn't surprised. This was my first RTR experience and it was great! I think even George Takei liked my dress :)

I received TONS of compliments and this style really is flattering. It had a nice stretch to it, so I never felt constricted at all. Length was appropriate. It does rub a little but with sequence that is to be expected. Very happy with my first RTR experience.
Shine bright like a diamond This dress makes you feel like the belle of the ball, it's glamorous and sexy.  The sequins can be a tiny bit itchy but otherwise it's a beautiful dress.

The dress was lovely and very comfortable to wear at a black tie wedding! I'm normally a 6 in dresses, but this one ran a little large, so I'm happy I listened to the other girls and ordered a size down.  The dress looks a bit more gold in the photo, but it is definitely *blush* and looks best with gold-toned jewelry.

Full of sparkles! The fit was a little large - I ordered the 10 and 12 and ended up wearing the 10. It has stretch and give through the stomach and hips, which is where I always need it. The dress is a little long, even at 5'8" It still hit at my knees. I received a ton of compliments on the dress and it fit my occasion perfectly!

Stunner I wore this dress for a semi-formal NYE party - it was perfect! Super sparkly and gorgeous in person, and so fun to wear. I read a lot of reviews that said it ran large, but I still ordered my normal sizes (I usually wear an 8 or 10 in dresses). I'm glad I got my usual sizes - I ended up wearing the 10. I think this dress is perfect for hourglass shapes, and not the best for pear shapes (aka my shape ;). The draping did add to my hips and bootie, which is why I sized up. Still loved it, would recommend!

This dress was brilliantly stunning! Definitely a "Showstopper"!!
 I wore this dress to Awards night at the 50th Anniversary Mary Kay Seminar in Dallas!  It was so fun to wear! 

Pros: 
price!!! : great price for this designer, who I had never heard of until they gave away a Badgley Mischka purse at one of the events at Seminar!!
Color: It is gold but under certain light looked like a rose gold (which I loved since Mary Kay ladies are known for their pink)
Function: I wore dress to awards ceremony but also to the site party and it was definitely appropriate for both sitting in an arena and dancing at the after party!!

Cons:
A little scratchy under the arms at moments but not at all unbearable. It was worth it for how good it felt!
Size runs a little big and was loose in my bust area. I ordered two sizes though, but just didn't try the smaller one.

I got SO many compliments all night long! I felt so beautiful for my bachelorette party!  I LOVE this dress! I am glad I also ordered a size down (2), as it ran a little large for my frame. It was not uncomfortable at all, but was pretty low-cut. I had to wear a special bra so that it wouldn't show in the front. This dress made me feel so glamorous and beautiful, and I received tons of compliments all night from men and women alike! I would definitely recommend it!

Sparkling! This dress was a big hit at the wedding I attended in May. It fit perfectly! My bust is large and it accentuated it beautifully. I could wear a regular bra with it. What a great service, too!!!

Wore this as a bridesmaids dress and the sparkle made us excellent accents to the beautiful bride! Very flattering and comfortable! The only thing that might be annoying to some is the sequins rubbing the inside of your arm a bit. Overall, a great choice!

Perfect for NYE or Holiday Party I wore this dress to my company Holiday Party. It was so fun and glamorous. I love the cut for a work function very subdued. Some of the sequins were loose on the dress, but otherwise everything was perfect.

The dress was so amazing the bride even loved it! The dress was amazing and every single person commented on the fabulousness of it! It was a little heavy especially since the wedding was in New Orleans and made walking in it hot but otherwise no complaints!

Wore to a fraternity formal and was announced as their sweetheart! Unforgettable night in this dress Was looking for something fun, yet classy for a New Orleans formal. This dress was perfect for that. Was a little roomy in the waist and in general, so I would order a size down. Also very flaunt-y if you are on the larger chest side of the scale (which is perfect if that's what you're going for!)

Love the sparkle and the color! This dress was a little on the short side for me at 6ft tall, but I got so many compliments on it that is was worth not being able to bend over all night.  LOL  The top of the dress is quite low cut, so be prepared to let the girls free.  :)

Rockin' NYE! This was my first RTR and I LOVED it. I waited too long to order before NYE, so they didn't have my back up size, but the 10 fit great. I have slope-y shoulders, so I did have to pin the straps or they'd fall off. Otherwise it was perfect - I got a ton of compliments.

Loved this dress. Got tons of compliments. Perfect length and perfect for pear shape. Loved this dress. Received tons of compliments. Only down side is the bust is large. I had to be very cautious about my girls falling out while sitting. Otherwise, loved the dress!

Fabulously Glittery for a Bachelorette Party!  I ordered this dress to wear to my bachelorette party which had an "old Hollywood" theme. I received both the 10 and the 12 and neither was completely perfect fit. The 10 was too tight in the bust and the 12 was a little loose in the bust so I compromised and used the 12 with a safety pin! 

Everyone complimented me on the dress and how great it looked. I especially loved how it added curves in all of the right places. I would definitely recommend this dress looking for a little flair for their next event.

I needed a dress for an outdoor fall wedding and this was perfect! The color and style of this dress made it perfect for a fall "rustic-chic" wedding.  This was my first time ordering, so I was a little unsure of what size was going to fit me.  Unfortunately, all they had was a size 8, so I crossed my fingers and hoped for the best - and it fit perfectly!  The color was absolutely beautiful and I was super excited I could dress it down a little with a cardigan and cowboy boots to fit the theme of the wedding.  My only complaint was that the lace along the neckline didn't lay flat and kept rolling (which didn't bother me much since I had the cardigan).  It is also more low-cut than I'm used to, but with a little creativity, it worked great. Thanks for such an easy experience, RTR!

The dress was fantastic!! I was sad to send it back!! Amazing night and an amazing dress! The only con with this was that it was a little short, and a lot sexier than I predicted from the photo of the model. It hugs curves nicely, without showing underwear/bra lines. If you have a larger chest, this may show a little too much cleavage. I don't, so it was just right. I accessorized with some vintagey soft gold jewelry which really were a nice accent to the lace dress since it has a vintage look about it. I would definitely rent this one again, and recommend it to anyone! Sorry my picture doesn't show it off more! I wish I had a better one!
I received a lot of compliments.   I would rent this again.

Fall Wedding I got an unbelievable amount of compliments on this dress and I loved how I looked in it! I should have definitely skipped the salt the week before the wedding because it really is form-fitting, but the lace is high-quality so it didn't show the details of any of my body's imperfections.
Perfect for Valentine's Day Wedding Perfect for a winter wedding. Fit was great, color was lovely. I received lots of compliments!
everyone complimented the dress all night long usually wear a 6 but wore the 8 and was perfect.

Beautiful dress, get 2 sizes Positives: Beautiful color and a perfect style for the bar mitzvah I attended. I felt very glamorous.

Negatives: This dress was much shorter on me than the model pictured, and fairly low cut. I paired it with dark tights to make it a bit more conservative, which helped, but I'd suggest getting a size up for your backup size. I'm a fairly standard Size 6 and I could have used the 8.

Being beautiful in purple Overall the dress is beautiful. One thing to keep in mind is that it does tend to ride up so most of the time it's shorter than the length on the model. The v-neck is REALLY deep; I was afraid my bra would show. The bottom half of the dress fit me really beautifully but the top half felt a little loose (possibly due to the large v-neck). Otherwise, great dress.
Very sexy look!  I felt great in it! Sexy cleavage, short hemline, and lace! Bright plum purple color.

Wore this for a wedding and got tons of compliments. I normally wear a 6, but the 6 in this dress had too much extra room up top. I'm short-waisted and this is a common problem for me.  My backup size (4) was a nice tight fit up top & I never felt like I'd fall out or was over-exposed.   Unfortunately, the smaller size was at least 4 inches shorter in length! I'm 5'7" and mostly leg, so I kept tugging at the bottom all night. Nonetheless, I got nonstop compliments on this dress and it really is gorgeous and quite comfortable.
Everyone loved the dress Got tons of compliments, beautiful color. Was a little too much cleavage for my moms wedding. Wouldn't recommend if you want something conservative and have a larger bust

I absolutely loved this dress. I got so many compliments on it! Great for a winter wedding. There was a tear in the lace, but since it was lace it was forgiving and unnoticeable. The dress was comfortable for dancing and sitting through the ceremony.

Beautiful dress for a fall event. I ordered my usual size 6 and an 8 as backup, it seemed very true to size. I had plenty of room for dinner and drinks. The length was appropriate for a wedding and dancing, Showed a little bit of leg but I was never concerned it was too short. The color was beautiful and the lace was forgiving. The only problem I had with the dress, as previous renters have mentioned, the neckline is very low cut. It wasn't enough to keep me from wearing the dress, but it was enough to make me a little uncomfortable. I considered wearing the 8 because of this but it didn't make a difference in the neckline, only a little extra room in the waist area. I would suggest ordering down a size as backup, especially if not busty. Overall, it was a beautiful dress and I got lots of compliments while wearing it.

I received so many compliments that I actually decided to purchase it! Dress fit perfectly.  It was low cut and I'm pretty big in the chest so when we really started dancing hard (jumping etc) I felt like the girls might slip out., but that happens to me in most dresses  There are clasps to attach your bra strap to the dress so they don't show.  I appreciate whenever I can wear a real bra in any dress!  I'm also always concerned that with my shape, tight dresses make my hips look really big but the angled lines of the lace helped mitigate that.

LOVED this dress.  I wore this for a Christmas party and let me tell you I did not want to send it back! The purple is so pretty in person and everyone loved the dress too.  Thank you for making my night so special
This was such a classy and sexy dress! I SUPER comfortable too! Fits true to size, very comfortable and in excellent condition!

Loved this dress I loved this dress. The fit was great, I ordered the 6 and the 8 and ended up wearing the 8 because due to my height the 6 was a little too short. I ordered the earrings that RTR suggested and they really completed the look as well.
Perfect for my sorority formal! Loooooved the dress online, got it and loved it even more! Buuuut thank god they send you two sizes. I'm usually a size 4 but i ended up being a size 6 in this dress.

Loved this dress! The dress was absolutely amazing, I received so many compliments on it! The color is a rich, deep purple, the length was perfect, wasn't too revealing, and was super comfortable! The only bummer was I could have probably rented the size 6 because it was pretty loose in the stomach area but wasn't horrible - I was the only one that noticed it and it didn't really bother me too much. I rented the 8 and 10 but should have done the 6 and 8 - I went a little bigger though because I personally think it is better to be a little bigger than too small - better safe than sorry! This dress was very flattering and I wish I could have kept it!

Classy and Elegant!!! This dress is definitely classy, elegant and modern!!! It fits true to it's size.  It does give you a bit of a cleavage which adds a special touch of sex appeal.  Gotta love that!!! I loved the fit of this dress. It hugs your body appropriately allowing you to look sexy and elegant all at once.  I received tons of compliments throughout the night! The color is a beautiful eggplant purple with very subtle lacy details throughout the dress.  It's just perfect for those Fall/Winter events!!! This is definitely a great rental for your next event!!!

The dress looked elegant and sexy, all at once! The dress fir beautifully, and I loved that I could wear a normal bra with it.  The lace was a beautiful touch, and I also loved how much movement there was - perfect for an event with dancing!  I will definitely be renting this again!

I had an awesome night celebrating an award from Forbes magazine. Dress is slightly stretchy so its comfortable. It hugs your curves well and the lace looks beautiful. I got many compliments on the dress. The chest is a bit tight so I did not need to wear a bra and not sure there is room for a bra anyway. It is the perfect dress for a cocktail party in the fall. It looks great with black heels and some black tights. This is the second time I have rented it and would rent it again!

Really cute, conservative, yet sexy.  I rented this dress using the overnight try on deal RTR had going on. This was not the dress I ultimately decided to rent for my upcoming event. 

It's definitely a cute dress. Really forgiving and conservative. I really liked the sleeves. Good length for a shorty like me - my only gripe is the neckline.. I'm a really busty girl and I found the neckline to be really wide. The front was tight but the part where the neckline met the shoulders bunched up on me. That would have made me self-conscious all night so I'm glad I got a chance to try this on first.

Perfect Plum Color for Fall !! I loved wearing this dress !  It was definitely form fitting, but the material type and thickness smoothed out any imperfections that might normally show.  It was very figure flattering, and the lace details are gorgeous.  Be prepared to show a little cleavage.  It is a beautiful deep purple color that was perfect for a fall wedding.   I would definitely recommend this dress.

Great fit and I felt very comfortable and confident! I ordered this dress for my first RTR rental. Unfortunately, there were no backup sizes available, so I just ordered the 4 and hoped it would fit. It was snug but very comfortable and form fitting. I was comfortable with the deep V of the dress because I don't have too much up top. I received so many compliments and had a great time in the dress!

Perfect for a fall wedding! Comfortable to dance and classic look. This was my second RTR dress and it was much more comfortable than the last. It was very comfortable, breathable, and easy to dance in. It was long enough to look classy but not too long even on my short legs. The neck/shoulders open really wide and really low so big chested girls might have a problem with how much it can reveal. Make sure to use the bra strap retrains that I didn't realize were there until the end of the night. The neckline is wider than a usual bras straps. 

Overall, runs true to size or a little larger - the color is AMAZING (much better than on the model)... and will go with almost any accessories or shoes. 

Great pick!
Great dress, worked well for the event.  It is a little low cut as previously mentioned The 2 is way longer than the 0 (by several inches).  Otherwise I thought they were true to size.

Received a lot of compliments on the dress.  The color was beautiful for fall. Length was perfect.  The material was comfortable.  Only con was it was very low cut in the front, not ideal for busty women.  The pictures aren't great but you can see the details and the length in one picture.

Great color, tons of compliments!  I liked this dress more in photos than I did in person but it still looked great. I probably would have liked it more if I was able to wear the size that fit like a glove. I unfortunately couldn't wear the size 6 that was sent to me & fit like a glove due to a defect however the back up size worked out. The back up size was a bit too big overall & especially in the bust when I sat down...the bra strap holders built into the dress really helped! I received many compliments on the dress so overall I liked it.

The dress was beautiful and comfortable. I was so happy to have something special to wear to a family wedding.  This dress was great.
