It fit well, moved well, and was tight only in the right places.  I would give it 5 stars except for 2 things.  First, there were a few places where the lace was a bit worn.  I don't think anyone but me could notice it though.  Second, while this fit true to size, the cut of the bust completely minimized my bust with or without a bra.  I had to go shopping to get a new push up bra just for this dress.

I felt beautiful in this dress Dress was exactly what I thought it would be. I wore it to a wedding.  It fit true to size.  Though I wore the 10 because I liked the way it covered my bust, I actually liked the way the 8 fit a little better. Would recommend a demi type bra with this dress.  I absolutely loved the color and received many compliments all evening.  I would recommend this dress to anyone in a heartbeat.  Loved it.

Great Dress I wore this dress for a dinner date with my boyfriend. I wanted to look sexy but not too sexy. I really loved the lace and the length of the dress. However, the neckline is revealing, just be aware of that. For my occasion the dress was perfect! I would also recommend sizing up, especially if you are taller like I am.
Amazing color. Classy but sexy.  Wore this for Grammy Awards weekend and got a lot of compliments.  Amazing color and hugged my curves perfectly.  I wore a body slimmer under as always!

Couldn't have chose a classier dress! Fits perfect, very true to size. I wore this for my birthday dinner at a nice Italian restaurant and I kept getting looks! It's a little short when you sit down, but other than that-extremely comfortable!
Holiday Christmas party Fit very well, form fitting but not too tight. Great dress!!

Love the color, the fit is slim but overall a gorgeous gown.  I  wore this  dress to a fall wedding. Must say the color is the best color for any fall or evening wear event. I normally wear a size 4 or a size 6 when the 4 runs small. I found that although this dress was a size 8 that I had read many reviews that the dress would fit because it has a body con fit and it would be a snug dress regardless of the size. This dress was comfortable and gorgeous. The 8 ended up working, with a little wiggle room :) and very flattering fit!

Pretty dress for a winter wedding I got the 8 and the 10 and both fit but I decided to wear the 10 to give myself some extra breathing room since it is a snug fitting dress. I felt really pretty in it and it was comfortable throughout the night. I had a little more cleavage then I would normally be comfortable with but I am also bigger on top.

Always a great experience This is my second time renting from RTR and it was amazing, just like the first time. 
I ordered a 6 and an 8. I ended up wearing the 8 because I felt like a sausage in the 6.  The color is brighter than in the picture and I was a little leery about the sleeves being tight but the fabric had a little stretch to it, so they fit great.  LOVED that it had little snaps for your bra straps so they don't fall down/show.
Got so many compliments and can't wait to rent again.

Sexy, but a little TOO sexy! I rented this for a Chamber of Commerce holiday party, thinking it would strike that balance between flirty and professional. Nope! I wore the larger of the two sizes I ordered, and still felt I was showing way too much leg and way too much cleavage for the venue. Although - I felt SEXY!! I definitely had the attention of every guy in the room. Which would have been great, had it not been a work event! ;-)
This dress is beautiful and I received many compliments wearing it! The color, the lace details, the overall fit - I would definitely recommend this dress!
Great dress! Really comfortable and got a lot of compliments.  Fit well and true to size, a bit baggy in the armpits but otherwise great!
the dress fit perfectly! this dress was great.  it fit perfectly, it was dressy enough for a black tie-optional wedding and i got a ton of compliments!
Didn't end up wearing it since it was not flattering.  Tight, body-hugging fit. Would recommend going up a size if you have curves.

Excellent Dress Loved this dress!  I was about half way through my pregnancy and it had enough stretch to fit my growing belly, but still fit the other parts of my body that hadn't really gained any weight.  It was also extremely comfortable.  The color is beautiful as well.
Halloween wedding Loved the color of the dress but the arms were a bit tight. I have a larger bust and this dress did not work well with that because it is very low cut.
Adore this dress Wore this for my October engagement party. It fit like a glove and was the right mix of sexy and elegant. LOVE it.

Beautiful dress for a fall wedding I really loved this dress for the color and fabric. Unfortunately the dress was a little too low-cut for my bust size, perhaps going a size up might have mitigated the problem. The dress was very pretty, but I had to slip away to adjust every 30 minutes or so. That said, I got a million compliments the day of the wedding. To anyone with a C-cup or smaller, I would highly recommend.

I wore it to a friends wedding I was in, pretty lace! The dress has the same look as it does on the model pictured but does run large compared to things I've bought in stores. I am 5'4 and felt like it was definitely made for a taller girl, but I did like the dress, just didn't love... It wasn't one of my favorites I've worn, but I had to wear a purple gown & it did the trick. Elegant, safe choice.

Fun night in Atlantic City Wore this dress for an overnight stay in Atlantic City and I thought I wanted to get a little dressed up for a nice dinner and drinks.  I know from ordering dresses in the past, that my "regular" size is not usually the rental size I wear, so I always order a bigger size.
This dress fit perfectly and was both sexy and classy at the same time.  The color was beautiful also.  I would rent this dress again.  When we walked into Buddakahn, the person showing us the table immediately said, "I love your dress"!  I get that all the time when I rent; people always say, no one will see the difference of a designer dress, but I always find that to be wrong, people always notice!

BEAUTIFUL! I always wear black to weddings but I wanted to try something different. This was dark enough to hide body flaws but looked great and really stood out in a good way. I was able to wear a regular bra with it which I love because I have a larger top area. I would definitely recommend this!!!!
Loved this dress!  Very comfortable. Was a little shorter than expected but the fit was perfect. Got lots of compliments on the color too.

Received tons of compliments about how well it fit and the color! The 6 fit well but the dress is a little low cut in the front so I went with the 8 since this was a more formal wedding. Fits very true to size.
I wished I had two events to go to for the weekend!  Great snug fit. It looked amazing on. I'd recommend this simply for an evening out at dinner or on the town. I want to buy it!

The dress was perfect!  I received so many compliments and from people that I didn't even know.  The dress fit in all the right places and was comfortable to be in all night.  However, if you are busty be prepared for some cleavage.
I received many compliments on this dress. The color in person is a beautiful purple color.  It is classy yet sexy at the same time. Perfect fit and great experience yet again from RTR.

Beautiful dress! Very sexy, but still classy.  I usually wear a size 8, but the material is stretchy and the 6 looked better. Overall the dress is very flattering and comfortable. The color is a lot more purple in person than it appears in pictures. The cut is low and I found myself having to adjust often to hid my bra, but it wasn't too risque.

Perfect for date night I absolutely loved the color. The dress fit really well and I loved the bra strap holders. I didn't feel it was really 'busty' as others reviewed. The fit and length were appropriate for a nice restaurant. My husband loved it.

Beautiful lace dress! I wore this dress for a wedding weekend welcome dinner and it was the perfect level of formality for the event. The color is more purple than burgundy, which is why I deducted  a star. In terms of fit, I typically wear a 2-4 in dresses but since this was a backup I went with the 4. The fit in the chest is very large with the low-cut V neck and lots of extra space in the armpit area. Women with a larger bust might have less trouble here, but I was surprised by how loose the top was since I have an athletic build with broad shoulders and muscular arms. The waist and hips also loose. The dress hits just above the knee, which was almost too long for a 5'2.5" girl. Overall,  I think the 2 would have been a better fit.

Flattering and comfortable, but not suited for busty women I really liked the dress but ended up not wearing it because the fabric was curling around the neck line. If you are flat chested, the dress will not be a problem, but if you have cleavage (really anything above an A cup), you might run into the same problem I did. Too bad because otherwise, it is a great dress.

Comfortable, stretchy and flattering I rented this dress for my daughters engagement party. It was a great dress. I am busty and this dress was very low cut. It was comfortable, but I was self conscience. The photo shows how I am standing a bit hunched, to hide the chest...

Loved the navy blue dress, but too small on top. I rented the dress in both the 14 and the 16, and I wore the 14.  I am smaller on top than through my hips, and standing up this dress was fine. However, when I sat down, it was gaping on top. Even after two safety pins to keep the top from gaping and my bra from hanging out, I still couldn't get it to lay right. I did get rave reviews wearing the dress, and it is very forgiving through the hips. I recommend it, but if ladies are more pear-shaped like I am, I would try a different style.

Fun party dress! I wore this dress to a wedding on NYE and was very happy with it.  The top fit is a bit large in proportion to the bottom, the sleeves were falling off my shoulders slightly once I hit the dance floor.  Very comfortable and photographs great!

Very Comfortable while still flattering.  Got lots of compliments!  The pleating around the hips allows for a curvier -- I had a baby 4 months ago and am still carrying weight in that area. Was a perfect dress that I would have worn before baby too!

I felt like a model. I had such a great time and looked great in the dress. The dress was true to size. I had a size 10 and 12, i fit both, but chose to wear the 12. It was roomy and very forgiving. I was able to dance and party the New Years in without worry. I did have a bit of trouble with the zipper being stuck though.

Absolutely fabulous dress!!!! I had sooo many compliments all night long!!!  A little low cut. Definitely comfy in the hips. So many sequins- and they catch on things! Sequins made it a little hard to zip up. But definitely a great dress!!

Perfect for the Red Carpet! The fit was great, and the dress was really comfortable to wear.  The neckline was a bit deeper than I thought it would be, but nothing to worry about.  The dress photographed wonderfully!  Lots of compliments.

First time renting the runway was a success! I had a lot of anxiety about renting a dress for the first time but everything went so well!!   The dress was so comfortable and forgiving i didn't even need spans to look good in it.  I'm short and the dress length was as if it was tailored for me, the compliments were plentiful and i just felt pretty wearing this beautiful dress.   I had a bit of anxiety at work on Friday evening while waiting for the dress to arrive via courier ( I work in NYC) but the tracker said the dress would arrive at 6:30 and so it did!
i also rented a purse, and accessories and they were all neatly packaged and in great condition, the only thing i would say is that the return UPS pouch was slightly small to fit all the boxes and 2 dresses in it and i felt kind of bad stuffing them all in there.   Overall, a great experience and i can't wait for the next big event and another pretty dress!

Absolutely perfect for my role as chair of a charity gala! This dress was perfect for a pear-shaped woman like me. You might want to make sure you have another person around to help you get dressed--the zipper is pretty hard to do on your own. I didn't find it to be as low cut as some others have said, but I don't really have a large chest. Also, turns out this dress is pretty popular--two other woman showed up in the same dress but in different colors! (I'm the one in navy blue.)
Gorgeous dress, lots of compliments It's great if you're curvy, but it does tend to hug your butt and gap a little funny.
All the compliments I received.  Beautiful color; can wear a normal bra; not to form fitted allowing you to move. Only downside is that the dress is a bit heavy.

Nice dress but super long. I rented this for a new years eve party along with another dress. I took pictures in this one but decided to wear the other one. This one is very long. It went well past my knee and the bust area was very open and large. However the dress it cute and the colour is great. I just pinned it up for pictures and it did look nice. But I could see the sequins getting itchy after a while.
Amazing dress Absolutely love the dress. I'm very very busty and short so few things fit me well (too tight on top, too loose everywhere else) and this had a great balance to it.

Showstopping dress for a wedding! I really felt great in this dress.  I ordered it in gold in a size 14 and it was too tight in the bust.  (And the blush gold color didn't look good with my pale skin).  This midnight blue color was perfect for a formal wedding.
My only complaint would be that the sequins scratched my arms after dancing in it all night.  Overall I felt really glamorous and would definitely recommend this dress.  It does show a lot of cleavage, but thankfully RTR sent some boob tape along with the dress!

I was definitely appropriately glammed up for a black-tie affair and looked fashionable enough to stand next to my husband in his brand-new tux. (Remember when men rented their tuxes and women bought their dresses? Apparently RTR has reversed that trend!) This dress was an easy and straightforward way to look polished and glamorous for a black-tie wedding at a Michelin-starred New York City restaurant. The fit is extremely forgiving and I didn't worry about my curves at all, even though I had twins last year. On the other hand, it felt a little bit matronly at times because it really accents instead of minimizing the hips.

I'm not especially busty (34C), but this dress would look more amazing on someone with a fuller chest. I wore a normal (but plunging) bra and I did have to use a lot of fashion tape to secure it.
Just ok A bit slouchy and not nearly as classic as I had hoped
Fun party dress, I felt pretty! The dress was a bit big up top and pretty low cut. It was flattering and very comfortable. I recommend this dress.
Show-stopper! Fab dress - perfect for curvy ladies with a winter party coming up...

Beautiful Dress! This dress was wonderful. I wore it for my company holiday party and I couldn't have been happier. It was very comfortable and the fit was perfect. I ordered the 4 and the 6 and ended up wearing the 4. There was plenty of room in the hips and it was comfortable for dancing. I received many compliments and I would recommend this dress and the earrings the stylist sent as well. They were beautiful!

Just the perfect day from beginning to end.
 Stunning dress!  It did run a bit big on top but that was easily solved with a safety pin.  Got tons of compliments and felt awesome all day.  Easy to dance in also.  Thanks so much - I will definitely be renting from RTR again and again!
I was sparkling in blue in a sea of black.  This was perfect for an east coast summer wedding.   I'm a 34 D and curvy.  This was true to size and very flattering.

A beautiful dress and perfect for a dress required, but formal optional evening. I found this dress to be extremely flattering. I ordered an 8 and a 10 and the 8 fit really well. The hem was a good length and the dress fit well at the waist (snug, but not tight). My only issue was with the bodice which was a touch large and, because the dress is a bit low cut, gapped open when I bent over. This was rectified with the fashion tape RTR so generously sent along, and it didn't end up being a big deal.
I actually saw another girl wearing the same dress at my event. I noticed that her bust was significantly larger than mine and it seemed to turn the dress from having a nice hint of décolletage to being overly revealing for my taste. But each to their own
In short, this is a flattering and versatile dress and I enjoyed my time wearing it. It was also my first rental from RTR and I will certainly rent from this organisation.

Stunning, flattering dress I wore the long gown of this dress a few weeks ago and absolutely loved it!  I am very full busted and it fit perfectly.  I went without a bra, but you could definitely wear one.  I received so many compliments on this dress and was so comfortable in it all night!  I do wish I had worn some double-sided fashion tape up top, but other than that it was fine.  Great dress that can be dressed up or down.  I would definitely order your usual dress size and a size down.  I could have worn the 12, but the front closure was broken and made it too revealing.

Great dress - flattering for all body types Got tons of compliments on this dress. The 6 was my backup but the 4 had some zipper issues.  Only complaint with overall fit is that the straps are a little bit too long for the dress. I'm a full bust - 32 FF and it was not too flashy or too revealing as long as you wear the right bra.  The dress came with a couple of free samples and some fashion tape which was a really nice touch. I wore this to a black tie optional wedding and it was perfect for the occasion. I'd definitley recommend this dress to anybody.

Classy, elegant and comfortable Loved the way this dress fit and looked on.  Only frustration was that it was very difficult to zip. Not a function of size as both of the dresses were very difficult to zip. Overall, felt great and would highly recommend RTR.

I rented this dress for a wedding.  This dress was very comfortable. I felt glamorous and received a lot of compliments!! My only cons were the zipper was a bit sticky and the bust was really lose. I wore a push-up bra to create a fuller bust, other than that, this dress was amazing!! This was my first time using RTR and I was very pleased. I will be using their services again!! RTR definitely exceed my expectations.

Beautiful dress but the front "V" was too low. I'm a size 12 and the dress was beautiful.  Beautiful quality, gorgeous color but the cut in the front was too low.  This is my first rental so now I know a little better what to look for.

Awesome fit, perfect for a glamorous event or in this case a wedding.  Loved how it was fitted in back, and less snug in the front. However, if you are chesty like me, definitely invest in some double sided tape.
Fantastic for a New Years Eve party! Fit perfectly

Amazing dress! I loved this dress, Non-irritating to the underarms, this is something i was concerned about.
I struggled with the zippers getting stuck on both sizes. 
I got so many compliments on this dress!

What a fun dress! This was the perfect dress for a formal business affair I attended. The navy sparkle made it stand out amongst a sea of black dresses...but it was not too flashy. The material has a bit of stretch which makes it a great dress for many body types. My only challenge is that I was on a business trip by myself and had difficulty with the zipper. I ended up pulling the zipped dress over my head (thankfully that worked!). I received compliments all night and would definitely wear this dress again.

Great dress for a downtown Chicago wedding! I absolutely loved this dress! It was so pretty, but so comfortable at the same time. I danced all night long and never once worried about any slips. You can wear a regular bra, as long as it dips low in the front. My shoulder area is extremely broad, but this dress helped minimize that - I would recommend this dress to anyone of any shape.

Flashy, yet classy! The fit was terrific, the dress covered up a bra really well, and it was just the right amount of flashy.  It was a little uncomfortable under the arms from the sequins, but nothing terrible.  I would definitely recommend this dress.

Add Some Sparkle to Your Next Event Opting out of a floor length gown, I rented this for a friend's black tie wedding.  It was a good choice and I still felt very dressy and festive among the floor length gowns.  The dress was very comfortable and the pleating in the front is very forgiving.  I wore it with nude shoes to keep the focus on the dress and minimal jewelry.  The dress says it all -- no need to overdo it.

The only negatives about the dress is that the zipper in the back was really hard to pull up and I needed help getting it on and off.  The dress is also very revealing in the front and you will have to pin it.

Sexy dress, great for curves! I loved this dress and I received so many compliments. I'm really curvy and it hugged all the right places. I'm in between sizes and still felt like a had a little room at the waist. It was a bit low on top so i had to add a stitch so my bra wouldn't show but it was still a sexy low V. I'd love to get this dress in another color for another event.
LOVE IT!! This fit perfectly. Good for a curvy girl!

Baby Got Back? Choose Another Dress! I rented this dress for a fundraiser gala and it was a beautiful color, sparkly, and flattering in the FRONT. It draped nicely and covered my mommy tummy. However, I ultimately did not wear this dress because of how it fit in the back. It was tight, and apparently my butt is large because it pulled the length of the dress up significantly in the back, and I felt that it was too short to wear. I wish the back was as pretty and draped as the front because it was lovely and would have been perfect for the event.

Beautiful dress! Loved wearing this dress to a couple of fundraisers. Beautiful color and sparkle. Pretty comfortable for sequinned fabric, and nice thick draping hid any lumps. Did need to pin the cross to keep it from pulling open, and tape down the straps. I liked being able to wear a normal bra.  The tightest part of the dress is under the bustline, I'd size down if you're an hourglass.

Perfect for Cocktail Party I ordered this dress for a formal work Christmas party, and it was perfect. It was flattering and very pretty. The bust was a bit loose, and my bra peeped out a few times, but I do have a small chest. I was quite happy that I could wear a standard bra. The fabric was also less scratchy than I was fearing. Overall beautiful dress!
The dress fit so well I didn't have to worry about it. Fit perfectly.  Was very comfortable and I felt great in it.

So comfortable and I received so many complements! The dress was true to size.  I ended up wearing the 8, and it was perfect.  The material was slightly itchy, but it wasn't a big deal.  Just be sure to wear a good push up bra if you aren't very full in the chest.  I had so many people complement me and ask where I got the dress.  Would definitely recommend to anyone.

Loved this dress! Got SO many compliments! The sparkles were perfect for the holidays :)  This dress was true to size - maybe a tiny bit loose in some areas but I have a larger chest, so it fit perfectly.  I loved the length of this dress, the top was a little lower cut than I would normally wear and I felt a bit uncomfortable as it was for a work event (but this is mainly because I never wear low cut shirts anyways).  The entire party everyone was complimenting the dress and the fit of it - absolutely would recommend this dress for any formal party and it would make a wonderful NYE dress!

Very flattering dress! I actually didn't wear this ... I rented more than one dress because I was travelling and I am the most indecisive person ever.  I didn't wear it because it was a family wedding and it was a little more low cut than I would like to wear around them!  Also it was slightly tight around the upper rib cage--not a lot of give.  I would definitely rent this one again though!

Made me feel like the "belle of the ball" at my husbands Christmas party Super easy to wear...elegant, comfy and beautiful!  I did tack the front so the "girls" weren't too exposed, but I was able to wear a regular bra with no problem.

Beautiful Dress! I wore this dress to a formal NYE party, and it was a hit! I received so many compliments and it is very flattering. For a large chested girl like myself, I felt secure in it and didn't feel that the cleavage was too much.

In the midst of Sandy, my dress arrived a day early! This was my third rental experience so I was familiar with the easy rental process. It was also the second time I rented this dress- the other time I rented it in the other color. So, I knew "what, how and when". I was prepared for a very smooth transaction and didn't worry about when I would get the dress until...."super storm Sandy" blew into town! 

I  couldn't believe when I received the notice that my dress had been shipped on Saturday before the requested arrival day of Thursday. I immediately knew that RTR was working double-time to ensure that my rental would be terrific even though they were facing a tragic situation. I watched with great anticipation as I had reconciled myself to the fact that I wouldn't get the dress. I did have a quick email chat with a consultant right before the storm hit who assured me that they would do everything possible to make sure I got the dress (and, quite honestly when I was watching the tragedy unfold I was not all that worried about my dress). RTR didn't see it that way, they not only got me the dress on time, I got it a day early and have received a few promotional offers because of the storm. I just can't say enough about this kind of service. I am now an even more loyal RTR (if that was possible!)

Beautiful show stopper dress This dress was gorgeous on and had comfortable lining! I didn't end up wearing it because I felt like I would stand out too much for the occasion (high school reunion) and ended up wearing a more muted toned dress instead. I took reviewer's advice and sized down, but I should have stayed true to size. The 4 fit snugly and I didn't even try for the 2. I am usually a 4 or a 6. I'll know for next time and the perfect occasion to wear a dress like this!
Nice and conservative. This is good for hiding a tummy. Flattering top and to the knee on my 5'6" frame. The sequins didnt bother me.

This dress fit beautifully, and was great for my event. The zipper stuck quite a bit on the size 0, and even with help, it was hard to get it zipped and un zipped.  Other than that, I loved it.  I got so many compliment, I will definitely use RTR again!
Loved the dress!!! got so many compliments! The dress is very figure flattering and forgiving. Felt amazing in the dress!

I rented this dress for New Years and it was perfect! I loved the fit and it was very comfortable!  I had to pin the top a little just to feel more comfortable about it but other than that it was great!

Great party dress that makes a classy impression. Already knew it ran big so was comfortable ordering the 10 even though I am a 12. Fit great. Normal bra and panties. 

Long enough to not be tacky, could sit and dance without worry, but was cautious when entering and exiting vehicles.  Sequins didn't bother arms at all.

Many complements, but saw 6 other ladies in this dress (in the gold color) so glad I picked the blue! (It was an event of 8,000 ladies though ;) )
Beautiful dress  This was a back up - loved it on but did not end up wearing this one but will for sure order now that I know it's a great one

Everyone loved the dress. I felt wonderful wearing this dress!  I wore this dress for my friends pageant. The dress was very comfortable and looked amazing. I had to wear a size up due to my butt being a bit large. I got so many compliments on the dress. I cannot wait for the next time I can rent another dress!

Perfect NYE dress! Received tons of compliments on it.  The dress was very flattering and showed just the right amount of cleavage. The only con was that the dress was hard to zip up, not due to the size, but to the zipper.
The dress fit beautifully and comfortably.  I think it is flattering on most body types, especially curvy.  It was comfortable to dance in and could be dressed up or down for the event.
The dress is very comfortable. I got several compliments. I wore size 2, and its very comfy. I love the glittering style.
IT was so comfortable and stood out without being overwhelming! It was beautiful in person.  I received so many compliments.  I was able to wear this thing dancing all night without any problems!

For Halloween I was a Millionaire and this dress made me feel like a million bucks! It fit perfect and highlighted all the right things and hid all the right things. My husband said I looked like I did in college! The dress was super comfortable. I am very large chested and it was almost too big on top for me though....may be a bad pick for a smaller chest. Other than that I recommend this dress to everyone!

I didn't end up wearing it (it was my unneeded backup) but will be renting it for my friends wedding I got this dress as my backup for my work auction.  My first choice was stunning and so I went with it. This dress is equally stunning and fits wonderfully! 

I usually wear a 12, but the hips looked weird, so I would wear the 14 which fits perfectly. I love the sparkles and the cut-I wasn't sure if the skirt drapyness would look ok, but it does! 

Even though I didn't wear it last night, I'll be getting it to wear for my friend's wedding in December. Can't wait to wear it out!!

Lovely but large on top Other reviewers mentioned the top gaping but I didn't have this issue. My dress had a small stitch in the bodice that held everything together nicely. The straps however were a bit large and required some adjusting through the evening.

The color is beautiful and like some other reviewers noted, the sequins did irritate the underside of my arms towards the end of the evening. The zipper required two people, it's tough going at the top and there was a wrinkle in the zipper that irritated me throughout the evening. This was for an opera and I was seated leaning against it most of the night, this might not be an issue when not seated.

I liked the length and overall look of the gown. I would recommend it and would rent from this site again.
Great dress, great price Very comfortable dress, and extremely flattering! Would rent again if I was with a different group of people!

Perfect sparkly dress for a winter formal! I have a full chest, and this dress was so perfect! I had to pin the front so it wasn't showing too much skin, but otherwise it was perfect, and I could wear a normal bra with it! I really loved the dress!

Staple LBD A perfect LBD. I wore the 10 so that it hung loose (work event, didn't want curve hugging) but the 8 fit well too. I probably could have even squeezed in a 6, though I didn't try one on. Overall it runs a little large so size down if you're seeking a vavavoom fit. Since I chose the larger size I had to use fashion tape to keep the bust area in place (I didn't fill it out)...it's a perfect dress for ladies with a full chest! Incredibly comfortable and I didn't notice any scratching from the sequins, as others said, but perhaps it's because I wore a loose fit. Would rent again...loved it.

I had lots of compliments The dress is really pretty.  Perfect length for me- just above the knee.  Perfect cleavage as it was lowcut but possible to wear a good bra!  It was pretty tight around my ribcage, but I have a barrel chest.  Also, it had bulky straps that hid my best feature-  clavicle.   In my unique case, I really pushed my limits on the dancefloor and by the end of the night the sequins had rubbed the back of my arms to be uncomfortable!

Cocktail party & dancing with friends in a great dress! The dress wasn't my first pick but a backup option that was over-nighted to me.  The 6 fit very well.  A few times during the night the straps did fall off my shoulders.  I also used fashion tape to ensure that the deep v-neckline didn't get too risque during dancing.  The sequins weren't annoying like I thought they would be (no arm chafing).  It was great, I got many compliments and friends said they liked this better than the original dress.  So WIN!
Fun Dress for NYE I loved wearing this dress. I decided to size up because of my large bra cup size- 36F. I just pinned the dress in the front with a safety pin and it was a perfect fit.

Gorgeous NYE wedding - the perfect place for this dress! Dress was perfect! I could have probably fit the smaller size I ordered but the 14 was super comfortable. the only thing that was kind of a pain was getting the zipper over the seams/fabric at the waist. I'm pretty sure size doesn't matter at all - it still took 2 people. I would have been way more worried about the zipper if other reviewers hadn't mentioned it too!
Rented for a bachelorette party, didnt end up wearing b/c the bride liked it more than hers Great fit, beautiful dress. Would rent again!

Gorgeous AND comfortable! A perfect combination. Pros:
True to size
Perfect length (it hit right above the knee)
Sexy without being too revealing (at least, for smaller-chested ladies like myself)

Cons:
The zipper gets caught in the fabric, if you're not careful

The simple dress worked well with my accessories for a 1920s wedding. It's a very flattering fit Flattering, easy fit.  The one I got was already pinned in the bust, unlike the one I tried in the store- which is useful it can be a bit low cut.  It's also a bit low cut in the back- I was able to wear a regular bra but needed to select one with a thiner back band.

Felt like a million bucks Loved having people ask me "Where did you get that dress?!?"  I wore this dress to a black-tie optional fundraising event.  The dress fit well and highlighted my curves nicely.  I did use a safety pin to close the cleavage just a little bit more given the nature of the event, but there was plenty of fabric to do this without detracting from the overall dress appearance.  My only misgiving about the dress is that it is longer in the front than in the back--I think it may be the extra draped material in the front.  I was told it was not as noticeable as it felt. Although I am a size 14, I do not carry my weight in my stomach so maybe that is why it draped longer in the front.  Overall though, loved wearing the dress and have already recommended it to friends!!!

Super sparkly This dress is pretty - very sparkly and fun (as my husband said). I didn't end up wearing it because I felt it made my butt look big (my husband also said that). I know a lot of people say this is a flattering cut on most body types, I have to disagree. It gave me serious junk in the trunk!!

Great classy look with flattering details fit was great.  was able to go to the smaller size and have it look very tailored.  Sequins are large and sort of hurt by the end of the night.  And fabric near zipper makes it a little tough to secure.  Overall great fit, perfect length, very classy and timeless.

Loved the dress! This was my first RTR experience and it was great!  I was so nervous because I always feel like I have to try on a million things just to find one.  This dress was great - the fit was comfortable.  The straps and top were a little loose/ low-cut and since this was for a work event, I used a few pieces of double-sided tape.  The only problem was the zipper!  It was awful - the dress was not too tight at all, but I couldn't zip it myself and it took one of my girlfriends 10 minutes to zip it up and she even got a blister on her finger - no exaggeration.

Super fun and flattering! I really loved this dress. I wore it for a Bachlorette party and it I got compliments all night! I was worried the sequins would be scratchy but it wasn't at all. the dress was very comfortable and flattering. I could also wear a bra with it which was nice. I would definitely rent this again.

A little black dress with flare. I loved this dress! I ended up not wearing this one because I wanted to wear another one I rented, but I rented a 12 and 14 and tried on the 12 first. That was slightly big in the top, but fit nicely around my hips so I didn't try on the 14. A little double sided tape would have solved the the top problem. I'm always worried about dresses being too tight on my hips, but I didn't feel self conscious in this dress at all. I would definitely rent this dress again.

. Dress fit below the rib cage but fell off the shoulder. I'm narrow shouldered but there was just way too much room up top. I'd ordered a 4 as well and it wouldn't zip. I tacked the top so that I could wear and it was fine for the few hours I had it on. I was comfortable and felt pretty. Glad to have had the dress but was pretty scared I couldn't wear at first.

Fast and easy! Fit was a tad snug in the waste on the 14, but the top on the 16 was waaaayyy too big. I got lots of compliments throughout the night! The sequins were a tad uncomfortable, but nothing I couldn't handle! Overall very happy with my first RTR experience.

Star power I had the best dress at the event, a few girlfriends wanted to borrow it!  So I sent them invitations to join!  The fit was perfect, it is very comfortable and easy to wear!  It is a classic cut.  I carry my weight in my breast and butt areas and this dress made both areas look good.

This dress is not comfortable! The sequins were scratching  my underarms all night.  Unless your arms are stick thin, they will rub against the dress and it hurts! my underarms were red and scratched up for days.

Great dress for 20's party! Love the waist and fit. Like others have mentioned, the cut in the front was too low for me. I used a safety pin and that worked great. I added accessories to make it fit for a 20's party. The zipper in the back did snag about half way up, but once I held in my rib cage (with my hands), it zipped up no problem. Would definitely recommend this dress!!
Did not fit a 36d! I was so disappointed in the dress I would not get the chest to zip. I am only a 36d and it literally wouldn't zip around my bust. So sad!

Wore this to a black tie masquerade!  I was really surprised at the quality of this dress. Not a single snag or loose glitter falling out anywhere! 

It was perfect style for my event, but I did not love the dress. I have super broad shoulders, so my ribs are a bit wider than the average girl. The dress happened to hit me in the exact wrong spot and made breathing a bit difficult. Also, the shoulder straps were about an inch too long on the top, and I kept having to pull them up (double-sided tape might have helped here). Overall, it was okay, but I would have preferred something else. Girls with broad shoulders/ribs - I'd look into another dress before renting this one.

Stunning!!!!   Fit great...loved the front of the dress how it gathered around the tummy area.  Amazing dress!!!  RTR is awesome....the whole process was so easy.  I will be a return customer!!  Thanks RTR for such a great night.

The perfect dress! Rented this for a wedding and loved it!  Got compliments on the dress all night.  Runs true to size.  I have fuller hips/butt so it was a little shorter in the back than in the front, but still a great fit.  Also not super tight through the tummy area, so I was free to have a piece of cake :)
Was a great cocktail dress - not too dressy, but sparkly enough to wear to a nighttime event Gorgeous dress. Definitely runs large, so size down.

The process was simple and the returning of the dress was simple.  The dress was beautiful. This dress was perfect for the occasion.  I love that I do not have to make room in my closet to store the dress.  I have many formal events to attend and I find that having to store long formal gowns and semi formal dresses a bit challenging after awhile.

Great dress  Rented this for a wedding. Great dress, great fit (runs a tiny bit large - thought I'd be a 4 but ended up wearing the 2 and it was a little loose), I'm 5'6" 125lbs and the hem was right at my knee, a little conservative if you're looking for a vegas party dress but perfect for a more serious event. The sequin makes the dress stand out a lot, I kind of felt like a disco ball but maybe that's because everyone was dressed conservatively. Overall great experience with RTR!
Classic dress with a comfortable fit Fit was true to size.  Flattering cut.

I didn't get to wear it :-( Dress is beautiful.  It runs small in the bust.  The dress does pucker a bit at the waist making it appear as though you have a baby bump.  I would recommend for those in their early pregnancy.  Unfortunately I didn't wear the dress - for my event it was way too small.

Great party dress This dress is fun and appropriately sexy without being too "look at me".  As long as you get it right in the bust line you can wear it without being at all self conscious (regular bra, not tight in the stomach).  The zipper has become very, very stiff.

Everyone loved this dress! I received so many compliments! I don't know if it was the holiday binging or that the dress just runs small. For the sake of my ego, let's say it runs small..... 

I found the sequins to be uncomfortable under my arms after a bit of dancing. It helps to wear some sort of sweater or bolero. 

I also found the deep neck to be too revealing for me (I'm very busty) so I tacked it up another inch for the night. 

Overall I liked the look and feel of the dress and everyone else really loved it.
It was a hit. I was worried about my hips at first. Once I fixed my hair and had the right shoes, I was set to go.

Very well made and comfortable dress! I was impressed on how comfortable a sequins dress could be! Pros: quality, style
Cons: zipper was a little difficult to zip
felt like a movie star! very comfortable dress, sequins are gorgeous! i was told i looked like a supermodel by several other guests!

loved it!  comfortable and dressy all at the same time I usually wear a size 8.  I rented both 8 and the ten and ended up wearing the size 10 because it was very tight in the rib cage.  The top straps ended up being slightly loose, but not uncomfortable.  Dress was easy to move in.  Gathered slightly in the front, hid my midsection that desperately needed hiding due to the party season.

Very comfortable!  The dress is beautiful. It was also very comfortable and easy to move in. I received lots of compliments on how fun and sparkly it is. It is cold where I live so I put a little black leather jacket over it and it worked perfect.
Fun Dress! Great dress for our 1950's themed party!

Great fit but not the most comfortable. I had recently rented this dress in the navy color. While I still loved the dress and the fit, I liked the navy much better than the black version. However, they are both great dresses and I would rent again. The sequins can be a little scratchy but it is super fun and funky!

I did not wear this dress because 1) it didn't fit, and 2) it was too low cut, short, and tight. I wasn't satisfied with this dress for a company Christmas party.  On the model, the length looks appropriate as well as the cut, but neither were true.  I hate to say it, but this dress is definitely geared toward more petite women than myself (I'm a size 10-12).

Sparkly! Got this dress for a Vegas bachelorette party, it was perfect! The dress was extremely comfortable, it hung nicely, didn't bunch up at all, and fit like a glove. The dress was a great length, not too short but still made me feel sexy. All around I was very very pleased with the process. Word to the wise, I used the UPS store at the Flamingo to send the dress home, they charge an 8$ hotel service fee!

This dress is just as comfortable as it is beautiful!  I rented this for a birthday party in Vegas and it did not dissappoint! The dress is beautifully lined and fits like a dream. I was both comfortable AND pretty all night long. <-- an unusual combination!

This dress helped me feel extra special for my husband's Award Banquet.  I love the silhouette of the dress but it can add to the width of your own silhouette. Also, I added a camisole underneath due to the low cut v neck. Other than that, the dress was comfortable, flattering, and lightweight! I had many compliments!!

Not for tall women! The dress arrived in great shape, and I was looking forward to showing off some leg, but I am 5'9" and have a long torso.  This dress's waist was cut too high, landing somewhere mid-ribcage and the back was cut for a woman whose butt is 5 inches higher than where mine is (and not just due to gravity).  The pleats in the front could be a benefit to women who have a pooch they want to conceal, but for those girls with a flat stomach (or really good Spanx) it adds volume where there isn't any. Not for me.

The perfect dress for a sparkly night out on the town! The dress is possibly the most comfortable dress I've ever worn. The length was perfect for dancing and it had plenty of give to hide any pre dancing meals! The only con was that the sequins were a little itchy in the underarm area, but I only felt them a few times throughout the night.

This dress was Great Gatsby party perfect The fit was on point. The waist line hits in just the right spot under your chest to be very flattering. I had some difficulty getting the zipper up - two of my gals had to help. It wasn't that it was too small, it just had a difference in fabric at the waistline that was making it really tricky. Other than that it was perfect. I am glad I had someone home when I got back as there is no way I could have unzipped it myself.

Received tons of compliments and felt comfortable all night, even on the dance floor! The dress fit perfectly thanks to the stretch in the fabric.  It appears to be structured but under the sequins it has some give so it moves with your body really well.  The bust line was a little low, but I was able to pin it to a more appropriate level and you couldn't tell at all.  The only con was how stubborn the zipper was.  If you've got a slightly broader than average rib cage/back, you'll definitely need a second set of hands to get this dress zipped up all the way! Paired with some sparkly earrings, bangles, a bold lip, and simple black shoes similar to those on the model.

Summer Wedding in Cincinnati I loved this dress for many reasons. I'm 5'4", and the dress fell almost exactly at my knees, which is much longer than the stock photo shows. As a person with a bra size of 32DDD I knew that renting this dress might be a bit of a challenge, but this dress worked wonderfully for me! I noticed that the straps were loose, as some of the other people said, but they did not fall down once for me. The dress might work better on someone with a little bit of a belly to hide - I think the cut actually made my small waist look a little bit bigger, but the dress was still super flattering. I received a lot of compliments, and one person asked me to send her the link so she could rent it soon too. FYI you will need someone to help you zip the dress due to the thick fabric. I would rent this dress again, maybe just not when it's 90 degrees out, lol.

Beautiful dress that's flattering and comfortable. The dress does run large, and I appreciate the other reviews that suggested ordering the second dress a size smaller, as that's the one I wore.  The dress is surprisingly comfortable, with the bonus of a normal bra working with it .  Assistance is required with the zipper - it's sticky getting it past the seam, and you need somebody who's not afraid to give a good tug. Definitely recommend this dress for a cocktail attire type event!
it was beautiful, flattering, and classy. the sequins snagged on the zipper a bit, but other than that, it was so unbelievably perfect.

LOVE! The dress was amazing! I was almost 20 weeks pregnant with my second child when I wore this dress and it was very flattering.  Doesn't show too much cleavage and a lot of room at the midsection. pre pregnancy I was a 10 but I wore a 12 and I would say it probably runs pretty true to size but maybe a little large. It's a little scratchy from the sequins but all around I loved it!

This dress fir perfectly! I was unsure how long this dress would be because I am 6'0" but it came almost to my knees and was perfect! I love that it could be worn with a regular bra. I got several compliments on how well the dress fit. True to size, the 0 was perfect.

Glittery for a night on the town I wore this for my friend's bachlorette party. This for sure runs big. I normally wear a size 12, but the chest was massive. Be prepared for some gaping issues and the need for pinning or fashion tape. I would say this runs a full size big and would suggest ordering down for your back up size.I felt like there was sufficent room in the waist for us hippy girls and would also look great on someone with a larger chest (D or larger)  I wanted to wear something black to put the attention on the bride to be, but still wanted to look great. I felt there was a lot of room in the stomach area which could be great for concealing for those that need it, but for me, I think it made me look larger than I reall was.  I think this was a little "classier" and "glamorous" for our romp around the town at various bars and nightclubs but it worked for me. This dress would be great for a Christmas party, roaring 20s theme event or any type of nightime fundraiser.

I wore this dress to a black tie/formal dinner event.  This dress was wonderful! I ordered the 14 and 16 and wound up wearing the 14. It is true to sit and fits snugs around the hips, but there is still room for movement. The top is very open and I wound up having to safety pin it together to make sure everything was covered. The sequins are on it perfect! They are not too flashy but still have enough pizzazz to make the dress stand out. I got so many compliments on this dress! This is my second RTR rental and I will continue to order!

Gorgeous glamourous dress. I ended up wearing a different dress for my friend's wedding, but would definitely rent this for a more glamourous event - New Year's, Holiday Party, movie premier. The size 4 fit perfect, but I usually wear a size 6. Recommend going a size down, especially if you have a small bust.

Perfect cocktail dress! Gorgeous, flattering, and comfortable - can't ask for much more from a dress. The zipper can be difficult to work with, especially over the banded waist, so don't even think of trying to get into this without a helper. But the material has some give and was a perfect garment for a night of dancing at a wedding.

This dress fit like a glove and was perfect for showing off my curves. I wore this dress to a formal fundraising gala.  I got plenty of compliments for this dress.  It showed off my figure and accentuated my waist.  It has plenty of stretch to accommodate my curvy hips and chest.  This dress is fully lined and VERY comfortable.  The sequins and front ruching disguised my tummy well.  The downside was that the zipper was a bit bulky and was ever prevented the dress from laying smooth along the back. I would most definitely wear this dress again!

The black made it understated, but the sparkle made me shine! This dress was very comfortable for my long evening - there was some stretch in the tummy area, but I didn't mind since my night included a 4-course dinner! The dress was a bit heavy, but since the straps were thick it was okay (and it helped from the dress riding up on my thighs). My biggest complaint was how exposed by bosom was -- I am pretty well endowed (D-cup) and I had to pin it in a few places so I wasn't over-exposed!

I wore this dress to a black tie event, I got more compliments then I've ever received on a dress!! I actually wore the same dress {but in rose gold} to the same Ball last year and after receiving so many compliments on the dress and feeling completely comfortable in it {and being completely in love with it & not wanting to take it off}, I decided to wear the same dress! The 16 fit perfect, the only 2 con's that I had going for this dress were the fact that I have a true hourglass figure, my chest is actually a DD, the stitch holding the two chest pieces together felt like it was going to pop and the fact that I have got a booty. Other then those two things, I did not want to take the dress off at the end of the night!!! I would absolutely recommend this dress to anybody that is going to any sort of formal event and wants to receive compliments all night! I'm normally a 12 in jeans and 12/14 in dresses, depending on the fit and designer, but knowing my body type and the fit of this dress, I decided to go up a size to a 16 and boy am I glad I did, it fit like a glove!
Flattering and hides problem areas Low enough V to be sexy and loose enough on the bottom to hide problem areas so no need to worry about wearing spanx w this dress.  Loved it.

This dress was stunning and I felt like a princess all night! I loved the flowy material and the way the dress moved. It fit perfectly and I wish I could own it! I'm 5'5" and was able to wearing 3.5" heels with the dress just barely touching the ground. The zipper was difficult but I was able to do it on my own. I tried to get away with wearing a regular bra but my straps kept sliding out so I recommend taking others' suggestions and wearing either a racerback or no bra at all. I got compliments on this dress all night and would rent again if the opportunity present's itself!
My son's wedding!  The dress was perfect! I loved it! I received so many compliments. Thank you so much RTR!

Such a comfortable dress and I loved the vibrant blue!  The dress was true to size in the chest and waist, but the regular was long - I had to wear higher heels than usual. As I said, the dress was comfortable, didn't rub under the arms, and flowed so elegantly as I walked. I would definitely rent this dress again!

Easy to move (and breathe) in, FABULOUS color, and I stood out among a sea of LBDs! I wore this dress to my choir's annual auction (it was Alice In Wonderland themed, so the blue was perfect). I ordered the 12R & 10L, but the 12R fit like a GLOVE! Despite the larger size winning out, I felt amazing in this dress! Everyone kept complimenting me on the dress; I didn't want to take it off when the night was over! The length was fine; I wore flats and the hem just skimmed the floor. I wore a strapless bra; the only reason I wore Spanx underneath was because it was a little chilly outside. I highly recommend this dress if you're looking for an elegant, comfortable, and beautiful gown!!
Wore for work formal dinner, got plenty of compliments! Accentuates the waist and hides hips well.

Great fit, absolutely what I was looking for! This dress was so comfortable, I can hardly ever find a dress that fit as well as this one. Length, bust area and overall fit were great.
Want to rent the same one in flowered fabric for a wedding this summer.

Loved this dress!!! I loved this dress. It fit well, wasn't too form fitting but still flattering, and I got several compliments at a very small wedding. I loved this dress enough to purchase it if RTR ever went that route. I will be renting this again!

Gorgeous, vibrant gown! This was a gorgeous dress.  My event was black tie, and I was getting compliments all night.  The cut was classic, and the 6L fit very well.  I have a larger bust, and while the 4L fit better through the waist, with my strapless bra it was too tight in the chest.  The 6L was the perfect length, just brushing the floor; in my heels, I stood about 5'7".  Fabulous first experience with RTR, and I was telling everyone about it all night.

Aaaaaaaack, this dress is amazing!  Beautiful blue, long, flowing gorgeousness! So RTR came through like a champ.  I originally ordered the 2L with a 4L alternate size.  The 2 was a bit big in the arms and chest, so I opted for a 0L at the last minute.  Thank God I called in time for the same day shipment which arrived save and sound the next afternoon.  The 0L was wonderful.  It's very fitted at the too with a wonderfully flowing skirt that is still slimming.  I received many compliments throughout the night and felt sexy and classic all at the same time.

Love the color and fits so comfortably! LOVE this dress!! Such a beautiful color and is so comfortable to dance in - I got so many compliments all night! I'm 5'6 and wore 3" heels and the regular length fit perfectly.
Wore for prom junior year. Beautiful color and material was incredible.  The top fits a little tight.
Best dressed! Photographed great.  This dress fit perfectly. It was very comfortable and the color was beautiful.
Perfect for a black tie wedding.  Dress was a little long but heels took care of that. Color was beautiful and got was good overall

So simple to rent and fit perfectly This dress is beautiful and was perfect for the wedding I attended - formal but fits my simple style. I'm 5'6 and with 3 inch heels the regular length was perfect. The only thing I have to say is that I have a wider chest and muscular shoulders so it was a little tight in the neck so keep that in mind if you're a bit more top heavy. Overall great dress!

I got so many compliments on the dress and how beautiful it was. The dress fit true to size. The one con about it was the zipper getting stuck in some places. The whole process of returning the dress was very simple and well thought out. I got so many compliments on this dress. I got a size 14R and ended up wearing the back-up 16R I requested due to my belly and breasts. The dress was very comfortable, seeing as I had it on for around 11 hours for a Military Ball. Overall, I would recommend this dress to anyone.

Lovely color and comfort After a little help from the hubby, I was able to get this zipped up and wear it all night long with no problems.  The dress is fairly light-weight and would be good for a spring or summer event.  I am 5'8" and wore the long version with flats; the dress just hit the floor.

Everything about the dress from the fit to the condition was perfect.  I ordered the 2R and the 4R but the 2R fit perfectly so I never tried on the 4R. I was a little worried about the length since I'm 5'4" but with 3 inch heels it fell perfectly. The other comments people made about it flowing nicely when walking were very true, making it even more glamorous than the pictures make it seem. I would recommend this dress for any formal event!

My first time renting a dress, definitely not the last ... Great experience overall  I loved this dress!! Gorgeous color, flattering fit ( although it would probably look even better on someone who's not an A cup)...I received a lot of compliments all night. I rented it for a very formal wedding, definitely felt well dressed for the occasion. My experience with Rent the Runway has been very positive, I had a little issue with the other dress which  I rented just in case ( the zipper got stuck),but it was resolved by their customer service team in a timely and professional manner. Awesome dress and awesome customer service.

Great fit - lots of length! This was my backup dress and I didn't end up wearing, but I loved the fit and color. It's a simple style but very flattering and easy to wear. The top fit perfectly, but the bottom was much longer than I expected. 3-4" heels would have been mandatory.

Lucky it Fit!  Rented this dress as a Bridesmaid's dress for my best friend's wedding.  Was very lucky that it fit on the top... I had just lost about 20 lbs but with a large chest (38DD) I was lucky that I was able to zip up the back of the dress. 

Due to my larger chest, and the fact that I'm 6'1", the dress itself was a little shorter than all the other girls, which wasn't really a problem because I wasn't tripping on my like they were. 

At the end of the day it was a great dress to dance in, nice and flowy, and if there had been a 16L available it probably would have fit me like a glove on the top.

Paired with the recommended Kate Spade necklace, this was a dream of an ensemble! Perfect fit, extremely comfortable, graceful flow to the dress, and the Kate Spade necklace was the icing on the cake!  The jewelry distinguished me from the OTHER woman who was wearing the same gown, same color.....in fact, there were 4 of us wearing this gown:  2 in sapphire, 1 in red, and 1 in emerald.  What great taste we have!  Would have been fun to post a photo of the 4 of us in our R-T-R gowns.  Excellent option, can't wait for my next occasion to shop R-T-R!

This dress was so comfortable and the color is amazing! I loved the way it moved when dancing! I wore this dress for a black tie optional wedding and reception. It fit like a glove! The length was perfect for my height and with a 4" heel. I felt fantastic in it and will definitely rent again!

I got so many compliments on this dress.  I am 5'7 and ordered the long as I didn't want it to be short. I wore 3 inch heels and the dress was dragging a little on the floor. I would suggest wearing flats with the regular length dress or wedges with the long dress, and the material got caught on my heel once.
I loved the dress! It fit great and was flateering. I got a lot of compliments.

Beautiful dress! Color is esp. great for blondes! I wore this dress to a black-tie event and loved it. It was comfortable and easy to wear. I rented the jewelry that goes with it and loved that, too, especially the earrings. The zipper around the ruching at the waist is difficult; a second person is definitely needed for it. I am 5'7" tall and rented the 'long' dress and it was quite long. I would've been better off in the 12 regular.

Beautiful color and fabric! The dress was beautiful and the color was vibrant. It has a purple tone online, but in person I would say it's more true blue. In terms of length, the 2P worked well with 3 inch wedges. My only complaint is that the top has a lot of fabric. For smaller girls I think it would swallow you and make you look bulkier on top.

The dress was gorgeous, just what I was expecting. I received so many compliments about this dress. The color is divine. I wish I could have kept this dress, seriously. I did not want to take it off.
I ordered an 8 and a 6. They both fit well, but I chose to wear the 6 for the event. I wore 3-4" heels and my shoes were a bit visible. The zipper catches a bit at the waistband. I am a bit curvy at the hips, but the dress is very slimming and I felt like a princess.

gorgeous color, gorgeous fit, very flattering I had to switch out for this dress when my original pick was too small in the shoulders, so I thought this dress might work.  It was fabulous - and the Rent the Runway team was great getting me a replacement to arrive the day of my event.  Wish I could keep it!

Was asked if I wore heels - I did, approx. 3".  Hit just where the model's dress hits and they worked great.  It is a really great dress on tall women.

I felt beautiful! The fit was great. However, I needed a different bra. The cut of the shoulders was further in and I couldn't hid my bra straps like I wanted. I kept adjusting and fixing all night. My husband was on watch too. It was a beautiful blue and the material was elegant. I was actually extremely nervous about RTR. I have issues shopping because I don't like how anything fits. This shocked me and I will totally use for my next event!!

I also rented the bangles shown in the RTR dress rental. They were a great add; especially for someone that doesn't like jewelry. I only used half the bangles sent and it was perfect! I tied it in with some silver heels from White House Black Market and was ready to go!

A Beautiful Dress  I absolutely love this dress. I wish I could buy it! I've rented it 3 times now, for a work party, and two weddings. It is an extremely beautiful and well made dress. I receive tons of compliments every time I wear it, my husband loves it too. He even said it was okay to buy it retail which is $700+, this is unheard of from a husband who thinks more than $50 for a pair of jeans is too much.  I love that you can wear a regular bra with it giving tons of support.  The skirt portion has a beautiful flow when dancing.  Overall a solid rental that's easy to pair with gold or silver accessories.

I find that if you have a full bust this dress makes you look fat. I rented two different dresses for this occasion and did not wear this one.  It's pretty but would look better on someone with a smaller bust.  I'm a 34C and it made me look fat.

Super comfortable, loved the flowing skirt. I rented this as my back-up dress for a black tie wedding, and while I didn't wear it, I LOVED it! It was a little loose in the arms, and a touch long with my three-inch heels, but it was so comfortable and the flowing skirt felt magical! To accommodate my 34 DDDs, I was worried it would look too top heavy or blousey on the top, but it fit beautifully! That said, I'm glad it was my back-up dress, because another woman at the wedding was wearing it!!

Gorgeous, classy  I really wish this dress was available in a 0P - I wore a 2R and while it still worked just fine, having it be tigher on the top would have been more flattering.  It is definitely not ideal to dance in due to the overall length but I received a million compliments and my boyfriend told me multiple times how great the color was on me, especially with my blonde hair. It's a knockout dress and I will gladly rent again.

B-E-A-Uuuuuuu-tiful!!! This dress is AMAZING! The color is beautiful and perfectly bold! The material is high quality and the movement you get in this dress is goddess like! Compliments galore…I paired this dress with chandelier earrings and wide bracelets on both arms.
I chose the 12L in the end because of the fit…I knew I was going to be standing over 3 hours at a 5.5 hour long event and comfort was my number 2 goal. WEAR proper undergarments with this dress. If the light catches you just right someone would be able to see right through…thank goodness I tested that out before I left the house. Hitting the dance floor in this dress could have proved to be embarrassing!!!
My husband is 6'6" and I normally wear 5" or higher heels but this dress didn't allow for that at all. For my personal taste I wish it would have been longer but I ended up wearing a 3.5" heel and the dress looked perfect! I am looking at getting this dress again in the future just in one of the different colors…red or green.
Tight in Ribs I'm usually a size 4 in most dresses, however I wasn't able to zip the size 4 when it got to my upper rib area.

Elegant dress in a great color.  This dress fit perfectly and looked great. I attended a formal wedding. The blue stood out from the run of the mill black dresses there, but was still classy and elegant. I definitely recommend buying this dress.

Amazing!  The dress fit true to size. It made my waistline look fabulous and even made me look like I had a chest (which I do not really haha). I received compliments all night on how elegant it looked. I recommend people with tan skin go for this color because several people told me just how nice my skin looked with the blue color. It was very soft and comfortable fabric, not too tight on the waist, and it doesn't pinch the shoulder/under arm area like some dresses. This dress is highly recommended for any formal affair!

This dress made my prom! Okay. So here is the story about this dress. I ordered a 2P and a 4P banking on wearing the 2P. The day before my order was supposed to ship I get an email explaining that the 2P was "damaged beyond repair" and would not be available. Upon communicating with the RTR non-stop for about 12 hours since they had offered me any other dress to replace the 2P for them to send along with the 4P. The stylists( who were astoundingly accommodating)  and I decided to have a 2R shipped with some hem tape along with my 4P. I ended up wearing the 4P which was a little big on the arms (as seen above). The 2P would have been perfect as the 2R fit perfect in the bodice, and the 4P was the right length. Anyways, despite the drama my prom went on. I got compliments all throughout the night and even all throughout the following weeks of school- even strangers stopped me! To this day people still ask me about my dress and I happily respond that i got to rent the most beautiful designer gown for prom for only $80. 

I wore this with a padded, clear strapped, nude body suit ( and I am a 32D) and even wore track shorts underneath. 
I am 5'0'' and wore the petite length with 4'' shoes and it skimmed the floor and needed to be held when walking up and down stairs.
I did slightly tear the edges and got a little bit of my drink spilt on the dress and that was all covered by the $5 insurance!

My FIRST RTR rental and it was beyond PERFECT!  I wore this dress for a formal affair and it was honestly the perfect dress for the event. I loved everything about the dress, from the color of the dress to the way the dress flowed. I did feel like a princess in this drew. The dress runs a little large though. I usually wear a size 6, but had to wear my backup size for the event. The dress is long, too. I wore my 5 inch heels, and you still couldn't see my heels in that dress. I would rent this dress again in a heartbeat!

Simple and Elegant This dress was perfect for the formal wedding that I attended. It was simple enough that it didn't demand too much attention, but got many many comments on how beautiful it was. I am 5'8" and wore small 2" heels and it was the perfect length. In this picture it looks a little too long because we were standing in grass but on the hard floor it was perfect. I ordered both the 4L and the 6L for backup but the 4L definitely fit better in the waist and flattered my figure. The only part that could have fit better was the armholes which were slightly tight but I think I can attribute that to my broad shoulders. Altogether GREAT rental!

Simply amazing.  This dress is absolutely stunning!  The cut, color, twirl-ability, and comfort were all top-notch.  The fit was true to size.  This dress was a backup for a formal wedding- thanks to a panicked chat with a RTR stylist after the other dresses I ordered arrived and did not fit well.  This dress arrived on time to save the day.  I received several compliments on the dress throughout the night- people I didn't even know were seeking me out to compliment me!  Overall, it was a huge hit.  So fun and comfortable to dance in.

Husband's boss's daughter's wedding. Dress was beautiful and I was looking forward to wearing it but it didn't fit.  It was too tight in the neck, arms, and waist.  Considering I had tried on at least 20 dresses at Macy's so I would have backup in case the rentals didn't fit and very few of them fit, I was not surprised this didn't fit.

Dress was perfect for my formal dinner and was really comfortable. I usually wear an 8 but went up a size due to my chest size. I the dress was comfortable and light weight. I was very happy over all with the fit and length.

Comfortable with confidence! Fit was perfect - I needed a dress for my larger bust and one that hid my mid section well. This dress did the job!
I did wear a bra (racer back) and ordered the long length. The dress hit the floor perfectly with the 4" heels I wore. The only negative was the zipper (as you have probably already read). I tried to zip the dress myself and failed many times. You will DEFINITELY need another person to help you zip the dress up and down.
This was my first RTR and look forward to the next. This dress did not let me down!

Beautiful and High Quality! This dress was very beautiful and high quality. Material was very flowy and I felt like the belle of the ball. I purchased this after my original dress did not fit and I was not disappointed at all! Dress runs true to size . I ordered my normal size and length and it fell perfectly. I did not have to carry the dress except to step into the car.

Wore it to a black tie wedding and I felt so great and comfortable in this dress!  It was true to size, I had a full bust (triple d) and the 8R fit me perfectly. I am 5'4, wore 4inch heels and the floor length was perfect. The color is great and received so many compliments! This was my first rental and I will definitely rent again!

Beautiful color This dress was beautiful! The color is gorgeous and it was also very comfortable -- danced the night away in it! I'm 5'3" and the Regular length was perfect with 3.5" heels. Only downside was that the dress smelled a bit, but it was okay after airing out for a day.

Twirling in the DC metro station Loved this dress!! Fit how I expected for a designer. I'm normally between an 8 and a 10 and the 10 fit perfectly. I ordered the long and it was just the right length (I'm 5'9 and wore 5 inch heels). Definitely think about your shoes before you choose regular/long.
LOVED THIS DRESS!! Fit true to the size! Length was perfect! Loved the color too!

I wore this to my friend's wedding and knew that there would be many well-dressed people attending!  The color of this dress is amazing.  Also, if you need to wear a bra or if wearing one just makes things much more comfortable, this dress allows that (racerback).

I wore this dress to the Young Leadership Council Role Model Gala. This dress was perfect. I'm 5'6" and 125 lbs. The 2R was a great length, just skimming the floor, with a pair of 4" heels. The color is beautiful, and the fabric flows elegantly. You can't help but feel confident while wearing this dress.

This absolutely stunning dress made me feel elegant with it's flattering design and gorgeous color! I wore the dress for an evening wedding up north. I absolutely LOVED this dress for it's beautiful blue color (the pictures don't even bring out the true blue of the dress) and the flattering design.I received so many compliments on how elegant it was and how they loved the color. The dress is super comfortable. All I had to wear underneath was a bra that clips into a halter due to the neck and shoulder line of the dress. That is it! The flowing bottom half of the dress is great for curvier shapes and you don't need to wear Spanx!  The only issue I had was that the dress was about two inches too long (I am 5'5 and i was wearing 4inch plus heels!) So, when i walked up and down steps, I had to hike up the dress a bit and it was a little annoying when dancing. I would definitely recommend this dress for any woman regardless of size or shape for it's look and it's comfort. I wore silver heels and silver jewelry with it. It could also have a small pin or something for the waist or upper shoulder area if you want to dress it up a bit more.

So many complements! It was easy to wear and move around in. Perfect for climbing cliffs & dancing! Not stretchy fabric. The zipper in the middle gets really stuck where the fabric bunches. Enlist help when getting dressed!

The dress fit perfectly and I received a lot of compliments.  First, I have to say that this dress was my "second choice" for the evening. Both dresses I ordered looked great but I just knew this was "the one" when I put it on. I hugged my body in all of the right places. I have curvy hips so I always am trying to ensure that I accentuate the top part of my body rather than my bottom half. This dress did exactly that. I was extremely pleased with the length (a standard pair of heels worked nicely). The fabric was comfortable and flowed in a beautiful way. Great dress!

Awesome time with friends who are basically family. This dress fit great and looked great! I am a 34DDD and even though I had to wear a strapless bra, I didn't feel completely squished into this dress. Although other reviews claimed it was cool and good for an outdoor wedding, they definitely weren't referring to Houston, TX in early September. It was pretty warm, but overall got tons of compliments and loved the dress! Would definitely wear again for an indoor wedding. :)

The color was gorgeous and I got complements on it all night long!  I wore this for my junior prom. I was nervous about it being to long, I am 5'3 and wore 4 and 1/2 inch heels and it worked very well! The only thing that was a little big on me was the arms and boobs because I am a size B and it seemed to better suited for a C.

Perfect for a Fall Wedding! Love this dress. The blue is even better in person, so vibrant! The material is gorgeous and flowy. It's a high neck so I wore a statement necklace over it. I wore the 10 to the event because the waist was a better fit so that the top didn't blouse too much (I don't need anything more going on up there than there already is!) but after eating I think I could have gotten away with the 12 :) I ordered the regular but wore 4" heels, which was perfect, it just skimmed the floor. With flats or smaller heels though it would have been way too long so just a warning to petite ladies! No complaints though, loved it and would wear again.

Perfect Black Tie Wedding Outfit! I absolutely LOVED this dress! I always wear a short(er) dress to weddings, but when I found out this particular wedding was Black Tie, I decided it was the best excuse to go out of my comfort zone and wear a long gown. The dress fit like a glove, the color was beautiful, and I felt great all night. I wore 4 inch heels, which was perfect - the dress did not drag on the floor at all. I would highly recommend this dress!

Wore this to a Military Ball and it matched my date's dress blues perfectly! This dress was phenomenal!  It fit me like a glove and I usually have a hard time finding dresses that fit because I'm smaller than most people.  I wore 4" heels and the dress did not drag on the floor but it covered my shoes perfectly.  I was comfortable all night and did not need to adjust anything at all.  I got so many compliments on it as well and made the night that much more special.

This was the perfect dress for our Christmas Party. Turned out to be my engagement dress too! The dress fit perfect. I was a little concerned about the length after reading the other reviews, but didn't have a problem with it. I received tons of compliments through out the evening on the dress, and would highly recommend it for any one that is interested in it.

Beautiful gown!  Elegant and perfect fit! I was worried about finding a dress long enough to wear with 4" heels but this dress fit perfectly and was a great length!  I'm 5'7 without heels and just under 6' with heels so the 2L was just right.  For comparison for a size, I'm 5'7", 125 lbs., 32DD.
beautiful color!! I am 5'5" and with 4 inch heels I should have got the long length because it is a bit short otherwise a great dress!

Beautiful gown! It's beautiful but very fitted! If you are not in near perfect shape, make sure you have some spanx or something similar! It is a very pretty deep red though, and has some beautiful draping in the way it is made. I ended up going with my other choice, but would've liked this one also, just wouldn't have been as comfortable.
