Beautiful color and dress. You will look like a model!  I rented the 0P and 2P after reading all the reviews below. I'm 5.3', 110 lbs and I wore the size 0P. I have small breasts (32-34B) so even the 0P was big on me. The dress around the waist was very comfortable and the length was perfect with 3" heels. My two cons are that it was big on my breast, so I was really uncomfortable all night pulling the dress up. And my second con is that the dress had a hole in one of its side. But RTR took care of it. Good customer service.

Simple, sexy, and comfy! This was my first rental from RTR, and I could not have had a better experience.  The gown was absolutely stunning, and I felt like a million bucks when I wore it.  I ended up wearing the back-up size that I ordered, because my usual size was small in the bust area.  If you have an average to large bust, you may want to take this into consideration when renting.  I have worn tons of gowns over the years, but I do not think I have ever worn one as comfortable as this piece, especially given that it's strapless.  If you are looking for timeless beauty and elegance, this is your piece.

The dress was flattering, elegant and comfortable to move and dance in, I received many compliments. This dress fit perfectly, was very forgiving and comfortable.  The red color stood out against everyone else's black dresses and the style was classic enough to look very elegant for a black tie wedding.  I wore 3 inch heels with it and the regular was the perfect length. I tried on the 2L but it was slightly too long (even with taller heels) and just slightly too tight in the chest area.

Loved it, great fit!  This dress was great! I can bounce btwn size 8/10 but I am a perfect size 8 in Badgley so I knew it would fit. This dress hugs the body, and was super flattering and comfortable. It was a BIT short, I am 5'10 and had on 3inch heels, you could see my feet a little but nothing bad/tacky. I always end up in flats once I hit the dancefloor anyway :)  I did some old Hollywood h/m and got SO many compliments all night. Kept the jewelry simple with just a pair of diamond studs and diamond bracelets. Loved this dress... Would rent again in a diff color if they had it.

Glamorous dress! Pairs great with RTR jewelry!  The only reason I would say this dress runs a tad small is because of the chest. I am a full B, occasionally small C and I could not zip the size zero with my bra on. I wanted to wear a bra, so I ended up wearing the size 2 which was then a tiny big in the waist but perfect in the chest. I had rented other dresses by this designer and never had this problem. If you are large chested I would suggest renting a size up. 

The "regular length" dress was a tiny bit long even with my heels, but I am only 5'3'' so I wasn't too shocked this happen. My heels were 4.5 inches (I actually measured them with a ruler) and I would say that the dress was definitely still about an inch or two too long. If you are short, do NOT order the "long" dress!

Overall I loved the dress! Just prepare yourself to try and work on your posture and suck in all night!

The color and fit are fantastic. I was red carpet ready for our annual Oscar party!  This dress is simple yet glamorous. The fit is form fitting where it should be and swishes fantastically around your feet, making you look and feel like a star. It helps to have a second set of hands to handle the side zipper, and I certainly suggest a great necklace to compliment the understated neckline. 
On a side note: ups messed up my order, and RTR overnighted a second set of dresses so I wouldn't miss my entrance. Thanks so much.

Didn't wear this but it was beautiful! This was really pretty but way way too long, there was a lot of fabric on the ground (way too much) even with 5 inch heels for me (and the other R length dresses were fine)... Really beautiful though and something different... A bit tight in the bust so if you are at all chesty I'd recommend renting a size up as a backup!  It's a beautiful color red and will definitely stand out in a crowd!

It fit great, very classy It fit everywhere, except it was too long on me. I used the no sew hem tape and it worked all night. I danced for 3 hours too.  Was worried about it being strapless and coming down, but maybe only pulled it up couple of times. The boning fit body perfectly and very comfortable. It was our 10 year anniversary party and felt like a movie star. Will use RTR again!

Stunning!!! This dress is amazing!  Extremely flattering and comfortable!  You wont be disappointed!
I paired this dress with the Lee Angel Tie up in Crystal Necklace.  It was perfect.
stunner! Beautiful quality, pretty tight but hugs curves well. 100% recommend!
Beautiful dress. Hugs in all the right places The dress looked beautiful but one of the wires on the bodice was coming out and was poking me a little.
Tons of compliments on the dress!!  It really catches the eye with the great color. Felt it fit true to size and was flattering.  I bought spanx but did not need to use it with the ruching :)
A friend told me I looked ready for the Red Carpet! This dress looked better on than I had even expected! The shape is very flattering. Another great rental experience!

Beauty in a Bottle saves the day! I ordered this dress because another one I ordered did not fit. Customer service was great about sending it quickly and on time. I typically wear a size 12 in a dress but apparently I wear a 14 in formal dresses. The dress fit great! I wore the Long because the Regular showed too much of my shoes and I hate that. There was , however, a slight drag in the back which was not an issue as it made the dress look even more elegant.  Im small in the bust so the fact that the top was super fitted worked out great. I did not have to keep pulling it up like I do most strapless gowns. My mid-section is a little fluffy so the bunching helped a lot with that. I would recommend getting a size up as your backup dress. Overall I loved the dress and felt great in it. :)
This dress is very classy and I enjoyed the event even more because I was comfortable! this dress was very comfortable and its made of a thick material which was perfect for a november occasion!
danced the night away, can definitely get low in this dress! it rubbed under the arms a little, not good for big boobs, perfect length, great material, wish it was more mermaid
Winter red dress I didn't end up wearing this dress, because the color was more of a winter red than a summer. Fit nicely though and was pretty.

Flattering fit! Great dress! Flattering fit. The color is a darker red; still eye catching but not as bright as you may expect. Would look great with a big glam necklace or earrings. Smaller around the bust area which worked for my smaller bust.

I love this dress! The bust was very tight ( I'm a C ) so I would advise getting a size larger. Just the tight bust, length was perfect, color was great and easy to match with lipstick ( perfect match is viva glam from Mac)
It was broken! Zipper of 6 was broken, I fixed it! Clip of 4 is still broken.

Amazing Dress!!! This dress is really amazing!  It fit fantastic which made it so easy to wear and be comfortable.  I wore it to the Grammys and it turns out Red was the color on the red carpet that night (who knew I was so trendy) - score!  I wish this came in a rainbow of colors because I would rent it again and again.  I was expecting the dress to be short (being 6 ft and all) but it fit just right.  I found a pair of jeweled, flat thong sandals to wear and rocked the happy feet look all night!
A lot of compliments on this dress! I am 5' 4" and 118 lbs.  Fit was a little tight around the bust.   I could not zip it all the way up comfortably.
i rented this dress for prom and absolutely loved it and it fit my curves all in the right place  it was just a little big on top but other then that it was absolutely perfect

Emmy's Show Stopper I initially rented a different dress but I am so GLAD that the first dress didn't work and I was forced out of my comfort zone into this one. I LOVED it. I received so many compliments all night, but I think what I loved more was the looks that I received from my husband. He literally could not stop staring at me! I felt stunning, from my hair to my toes I felt like the star of the show. I was proud to be his date for the Emmy's, this was a perfect dress for the occasion. NOW, onto fit. I wore a size 14R which was a size up for my normal size but it was perfect. I didn't have to wear a bra because the boning structure in the dress held it up perfectly for me. The length was great for me but probably a little short for anyone much taller than 5'6". I wore two inch heels and the dress dusted over the top of my feet. The necklace I wore put all the pieces together, it was a perfect blend of classy and trendy. The zipper was HARD, but RTR sent me a new dress overnight and while the zipper was hard it was much easier than the first one. Hips, I don't really have hips but this dress made me look all kinds of curvy! I do not have a flat stomach so the bunching in the dress was perfect to hide my imperfections. RENT THIS DRESS TODAY, I promise you will love it.

This dress was just as beautiful in person as in pictures! I loved this dress, and it worked out so well for my event. The color is bright and vibrant in person and is really beautiful. It did run a little long, but that was nothing some platform pumps couldn't fix. I ordered it in petite sizes but I did not see any indication of petite sizing on the dress itself, so I assume it was a regular size. 
The one downfall of this dress is that I had a ton of trouble with the zippers - I could not dress myself without the help of another person no matter how hard I tried. I encountered the issue with both the 2 and the 4 that I ordered, which led me to believe it is the design and not the way they fit me. In the end, with help I was able to wear the dresses comfortably. I ended up wearing the 2 because it fit a lot more snugly than the 4 and looked better on me.

I LOVED The Shape !!! At first i was really skeptical about this dress because i thought it looked very stiff. Once i tried it on though i fell inlove !! I wore this to my Junior Prom and had so much fun ! I looked very classy and complimented my curves at the same time !  I'd like it better with a slit or something more "va-va-voom" but it did a great job !
Elegant I received a ton of compliments on this  dress.  The color and the fit were both beautiful.  I felt classy, elegant and sexy all at the same time.

Elegant and comfortable dress for a black tie wedding I was looking for a figure-flattering gown that wasn't too long and would let me comfortably eat and dance all night. This dress fit the bill perfectly. The shape is simple, but highlights your curves, and the ruching at the waist/stomach helps to conceal any lumps/bumps in that area. Most importantly, the dress was incredibly comfortable. The material is somewhat thick but light enough for a summer wedding and the boning at the bodice helps to keep the dress snugly in place. I wore a 0P and with 3.5 inch heels, the dress just grazed the floor. Highly recommend!

Stunning and Red HOT! I rented this dress for a white tie charity event and could have not been more happier with my choice. The only thing I will point out is this dress does run slightly smaller overall. I am normally a 2 and even sometimes 0, and this dress was slightly tight around the rib cage, but I think the 4 would have been too big. The color is stunning and the material was a great quality. Also, they were out of the P, so I had to rent the R, which was a little long, but I pinned one side up (see in picture) and was able to still walk fine in 4 inch heels. Overall rent this dress!! I received soooooooo many compliments the entire night!

Beauty in a Bottle is right! This dress made me feel amazing.  I wore this dress with flat shoes and still had extra length. Im 5'11" and wore the 2L, but probably could have gotten away with the regular length which is rare! I usually vary between a 4 and a 2, so i ordered both in long. The 4 was loose around my waist but fit perfectly everywhere else. The 2 was very snug around the ribs, probably because of my bust (32D), but was more flattering due to the snug fit. The dress has boning to help emphasize your curves and give you support so I did not need a bra with this dress at all. However, by the end of the night the boning was really starting to dig onto my side and become uncomfortable. Overall, this dress was amazing and flattering on the bridal party! We all got so many compliments throughout the night.

Gorgeous dress! Great for formal events where you want to stand out. I wore this dress to an Eyes Wide Shut-themed New Year's Eve party. I loved this dress! If it had been the correct length, I would have given it 5 stars. I read the reviews from other RTRers who were my height and they seemed to do fine with the Regular length, however I would have been better off with the Petite length. I had to wear 4" platform heels and I still had to pick up the dress a bit to walk. The boning and fit through the hips was very flattering on my figure. I'd recommend this dress for anyone who's looking for a special gown that will make them feel like a million bucks (and stand out in a sea of black).
Beautiful dress! Loved the dress.  Rich color.  Fit was true to size except for the length. I ordered 4 petite, but dress was very long for a petite. Needed 5 inch heels to make it work.

This dress was a marvelous color, fit super snugly and hugged all my curves! I loved it.  This dress fit perfectly. I am usually a 4P, and this dress fit true to size. I am 5'2 and wore 4.5 inch heels, and the dress barely brushed my toes in the front. The color was unmistakable, and I was the only one wearing red at the wedding, which made this an unforgettable dress! It was very comfortable to dance in. This dress fit snugly in the bust, waist, and hips. As I get a tad bloated after eating/drinking, this dress did show this by the end of the night. So I would not recommend to someone trying to hide the belly. I did not wear a bra nor spanx with the dress, as the material is very sensitive in the rear, and would have shown the spanx outline, so I decided to take them off. There is built in wiring/lining in the waist and bust. 
Customer service was extremely helpful. My first choice dress was damaged, so I could choose another dress, and when that one did not fit, they overnighted me this dress.

This was my first time renting through RTR and i had an amazing experience!!  The dress runs true to size, the bust was a bit too tight, I didn't need to wear a bra and I didn't have to constantly pull it up. The material is thick and the quality is impeccable.  The dress fits like a glove, hugs the right curves and if your problem area is the abdomen, the ruffles will take care of that.  The length was just right, a bit longer in the back. I had high heels (I think 4 in) and it was the perfect length. The color is also a beautiful red, very classy! I only wore earrings,didn't feel the need to accessorize much, the dress is enough!  I felt like a princess the whole night and I received ton of compliments! Will definitely recommend this dress!

Once a year black tie company event.  Loved the whole evening. Pros:  this is a beautiful color and the 8L was just right.  Easy to wear this dress all night.  Form fitting and I received many compliments.
Cons:  I have rented many many times from RTR so this is unusual.  The dress was worn, more worn then I have experienced before.  It was tired.  The last person to rent it wore a very heavy perfume that lingered. Ladies be kind don't do that.  Otherwise definitely would recommend this dress.

Stunning dress! Beautiful dress.  Tons of compliments.  Very classic yet sexy too.  2R fit very nicely with 4" heels.  I am 5'4,  125lbs and a 32DD.  Only problem it was very hard to zip up.  But once it was on, I felt fabulous!  Easy and comfortable to wear all night.  Fabric was very nice and there was no need to wear a bra.  Very flattering in the midsection as well.  Thankful I didn't need to wear spanxs!!

I received so many compliments!!!! The fit was incredible & even at 5'1" the  2R was GREAT!  Perfect fit, 0 cons, all pros! Amazing dress! At first was nervous because it's my first time with RTR, but I will continue to use this website for future events!

Beautiful night supporting JDRF. Loved this dress. It does fit very snug in the bust, and I am a 34B. Otherwise, it is a true size 2.  The side zipper does seem to be getting a bit worn out...it would catch about midway up when I was putting it on.  The color is a perfect true, deep red and not orange at all. I was incredibly comfortable eating, sitting, and dancing in this gown and hated to take it off at the end of the evening. My first RTR experience and I can't wait to rent again.

Lady in Red. It fit beautifully.  I am larger busted (34DD) and I had kind of a hard time getting it zipped over the girls.  Once I did it was a perfect fit.  The ruching in the mid section kind of added a few lbs. in pictures.  I loved the red color.  It was more of a blue hued red, not orangy at all.

This dress was perfect, glad I got the two sizes!!  Earrings too!! Wonderful experience. Love it!! Easy process, no confusion,  made the event so much less stressful knowing the dress was coming to ME not me trying to find it out there.  Fabulous.  Don't hesitate, use RTR!!

Red Carpet Ready The dress itself is beautiful, rich color and flowing material and it is definitely an eye catcher. I usually shy away from strapless gowns but I took a chance on this one. With one of the  style secret bras from victoria secret, I managed to avoid the C-Cup nightmare of going braless or pulling your dress up every five minutes. I wasn't 100% in love with the gown on me personally but overall it's clearly a beautiful little number (especially for taller girls!) The necklace the model wears looks great with this dress FYI, people loved it as much as they did the dress.

First Barrister's Ball I frantically had to find another dress since the one I initially ordered looked terrible on.  This dress was a life saver and beautiful choice! The fabric was forgiving and a pretty color, rushing was extremely flattering as was the cut.  The draping of the lower skirt also made it easy to move in, since the top was tight. It looked gorgeous on and I received so many compliments on my dress. It is a solid staple for any formal event.
gorgeous dress.  true to size and the length was perfect. just stunning.

Beautiful Dress and compliments all night long for formal wedding.
 I'm 5'5, 110 lbs & 32DD 
Fit like a glove but was very comfortable and was not tugging it up over the ladies all night. 
Would wear again if it wasn't such a memorable dress - folks would notice :-)
Stunning color, very flattering Beautiful, easy-to-wear shade of red. Hugs your curves in all the right places with just the right amount of draping over the midriff to hide any flaws.

Beautiful dress for a black tie wedding  Dress was beautiful. Material was stretchy and forgiving. I fluctuate between an 8 and 10 and the 10 fit perfectly. I am 5'7" and wore the long, but it was too long. Wish I had gotten the regular. The dress was a hit and I got compliments all night. Color was a stand out and I felt beautiful and confident all night.

Fit like a glove!  Stunning & Very Flattering I wore this dress to the Petroleum Club Ball .  I have had trouble with finding the right fit with Rent the Runway in the past.  But I decided to try one more time & this dress fit perfectly.  It was stunning & I felt so lovely wearing it.   The dress fit perfectly.  I wore flats and the length on the 12L was perfect.  Top was tight enough that the dress did not slip or need adjusting all night. The ruched sides and trumpet skirt are extremely forgiving & flattering.  This dress does not disappoint!

The dress fit like a glove and was gorgeous!  The dress is very fitted.  I ordered the 4L and the 6L.  I fit into both, but the 6L had a little bit more room to eat and breathe.  I am 5'9" and with the long I could still wear my 3" heels.  Loved the dress!  It was simple yet elegant and was very easy to play up with some jewelry!  Wish I got to keep it!

Flattering on, kind of plain This was my first choice but upon receipt of the dresses I chose my back up.  Its gorgeous but a little plain for what I wanted it for.  The cut is EXTREMELY flattering.  I ordered the 4R and 2L and unfortunately the 2L didnt come because someone had returned it damaged.  I typically would wear between a 2-4 and the 4R was a little loose.  The 2L would have been perfect.  I am 5'4" and had on 4" heels.  This dress would be great if your "problem area" is the middle as the ruching is so flattering and gives the illusion of the sexiest curves.  Great for bustier women, would likely need spanks as the back is pretty smooth and may show every mark/crease.

Received numerous compliments at the wedding on the gown. Beautiful, classic red dress. Boning at the top poked out a little bit, but overall the quality and material was great. I recommend a necklace to spruce it up.
Loved this gown! This was my first Rent The Runway!  I was so nervous, because I am very picky about clothes and how they fit.  This dress fit beautifully!  I will definitely be using RTR again!

Didn't end up wearing the dress.... I actually did not end up wearing this dress to the event I rented it for. It was not a good fit and was very heavy on the bottom. Would have been uncomfortable wearing it to the event.

Eye-catching color, great fit Great dress- fit is great for hourglass figures! Chest area was a bit large so a strapless bra was worn. My backup size was too big and wish I had also gotten the 0R to check for length. The 0L was totally fine to walk in, but would have been difficult without 4" heels. For reference: height- 5'7", weight- 112, bust- 32C, body type- hourglass.

Stunning! This was not one of my choices, it was sent to replace my first choice that could be sent due to damage.  I was skeptical, because I didn't know if I'd be comfortable in a strapless dress.  Well, this dress was perfect!  It was tight enough on top so that I didn't feel like it was going to fall down and I didn't need to tug or pull it up at all.  I am only 5'3", so the length was a bit too long to wear with the shorter heels I prefer.  With 3 inch heels, the length was just right.  I got many compliments on the dress and am happy I wore it!

Amazing dress.  Fit perfectly and very flattering.  Got compliments from everyone.  Even strangers.  Only con was that the clasp was broken and kept poking me.  Great strapless.  Hardly fell down.  Fit my large chest very nicely.
The dress was very flattering and I didn't have to worry about how I looked all night. Has a good stretch for a variety of figures and the color is very flattering to many skin tones.

Such a flattering dress! When I rented this dress I wasn't too excited about it--c'mon, a red strapless dress? Not too exciting. But it was so flattering on that I instantly fell in love with it!  I am not a curvy girl, so the ruching gave me more of a shape. I didn't end up wearing it to the 1930s Hollywood glamour/red carpet wedding, but it was a good thing as the bridesmaids were wearing the same shape dress. I would rent this dress again--so I can actually wear it!

Great quality and shimmer! Top was slightly tight, but overall true to size.  Great short fun length and the shimmer on the dress is fun.  You can hardly tell in the picture, but there is a faint cheetah print on the dress.

This dress is beautiful! I loved the fabric - Very high quality. It fit me perfectly around my waist. Since it flared out, I didn't have to worry about it being too tight around my hips (which happens a lot with size 2 dresses). It was very comfortable.

Lots of compliments! Runs true-to-size My size was unavailable for the weekend, so I went up a size. It was slightly too big for me, as I typically wear a 4, but not too large that I couldn't wear it.  I got a lot of compliments on the dress and felt very sophisticated.  Another great experience with Rent the Runway - I definitely recommend this dress!

Fun print and a beautiful shape! This dress was lovely and really flattering. I thought the print was subtle enough to be classic but still a whole lot of fun and I got lot's of compliments. I rented this for a July wedding and I was cool and comfortable the whole time. The fit was also really comfortable through the bodice and bust, (which can be an issue for me) but still defined my waist. I would definitely recommend this dress for a wedding or formal event.

Matched my school colors and mascot for Graduation! I wore this for my college graduation in December. Our school mascot is the Golden Panther and our school colors are blue and gold so I thought this dress would be fitting. I got a million compliments. It really is beautiful and I just wanted to take my cap and gown off so everyone could see it.  I ordered a size 8 and a 10 and ended up wearing the 8. Styled it with nude pumps and Lee Angel - Tie Up in Crystal Necklace, as seen on the model.

Great dress!  Beautiful dress.I wore it to a June wedding and I received tons of compliments. However, the dress runs small. I squeezed into it for the ceremony, but changed into a more comfortable dress for the reception. I'm 127 lbs 36C and wore the size 6. I called to see if they could overnight the size 8, but it wasn't available. 

This really is a classy dress.

Beautiful colors! Very comfortable! The 2 fit better, the main difference was under the arms. The print on the navy fabric is black, I wasn't sure before it arrived. Black shoes looked great. I received many compliments at the wedding. I was comfortable and it was easy to dance in.

This is a super cute and very fun/unique dress! I rented this dress for an evening garden wedding and it was perfect.  I paired it with a grey blazer because it was unseasonably cold that evening.  The top is a bit small and this dress does not have any stretch, so for that reason, I can't say it was the most comfortable for me because I have a large bust.  The flair of the skirt is perfect and the length was great for my height (5"4').

Great dress! The shiny material made it "pop"  This was my first RRT experience and I loved everything about it. The size 10 fit perfectly. A few reviewers said this was tight in the bust but I didn't have that problem. I normally wear a size 10 dress in White House Black Market and this 10 was perfect. The shiny material was so nice on a sunny day. I paired it with gold strapped sandals. Definitely add a necklace to brighten up the neckline.
The perfect dress for a semi-formal event. I received a ton of compliments on this dress. It was comfortable and not too short. I definitely recommend it.

This dress is a little different and perfect for a Saturday night wedding. Fits true to size. The rib-cage is a little tight but not uncomfortable. The fabric is very flattering. Great pattern. I received lots of compliments and felt great in the dress. I highly recommend.

Bar Mitzvah This was my first RTR experience and I will definitely rent again! The dress arrived on time, in perfect "brand new" condition.  The 2 fit perfectly so I never even tried on the 4. The dress is a great color, the picture doesn't do it justice.  I'm 5'2" so the dress fell to right above my knee.  Very comfortable to wear and dance in it.

Beautiful, elegant venue for a wedding. This dress was very comfortable and classy! Fit was great! I have short legs so was worried about the length being long, however with some heels, it was a very classy length! I got the jewelry that the model wore in the picture and it really completed the look! Highly recommend!
Was an option for a photo shoot for holidays.  Very difficult to zip up over the hem in the middle of the back. Need an extra set of hands to help zip up.

unique & classy! This dress was absolutely perfect for my best friend's wedding (who's wedding colors included light pinks, yellows, and navy accents). It ran a tad small for me, so I wore a size up from normal only for comfort. I got plenty of compliments and it captured beautifully in photos.

Classy and unique. A bit large in the chest. This dress was exactly what I expected and was a lot of fun. Very classic/classy looking, but the metallic floral combined with the faux animal print made it unique. It was a bit loose in the chest but fit nicely everywhere else. I am a B cup, so this might be a good choice for someone with slightly a larger chest / skinnier waist, so long as they aren't too well endowed as the fabric doesn't give much.

Very comfortable and structured! I love wearing dresses that don't require a special bra and aren't clingy, so this dress was perfect! It was true to size thankfully because the size 4 they provided as my back-up had an uneven seem and did not sit properly. It was more structured than on the model and fit kind of like a ball gown, possibly because I am pear-shaped. It's also heavy enough that it won't move much in wind, so it's perfect for an outdoor wedding.

OMG - LOVED THIS DRESS. Would absolutely rent it again! Got compliments from 10+ men AND women! I rented this dress for a cocktail party and honestly felt that I had the best dress of anyone there. I hope anyone who rents it feels the same! It fit perfectly. I usually wear a size 8 since I have a sizable rear and am small up top so I figured I'd be an 8. Ended up wearing the 6. This dress works really well for tall girls too - I am 5'8" and most of the reviewers are shorter than me so I was definitely worried! This dress is incredible. I was so skeptical since it's not a style I naturally gravitate towards - I usually go for very understated dresses but I figured I would go out of my comfort zone. SO GLAD I DID - women AND men complimented me on my dress all night and I would totally rent it again. Flattering for every body type. I wore it with black patent leather pumps (kind of boring but it worked). The cheetah print looks even better in person too :)
Perfect for an outdoor summer wedding! Lots of compliments. The dress fit very well, breathable for a HOT night outside. The pattern is more noticeable in person.

Unfortunately, the dress did not work for me. I was not a fan of the fit of this dress and ended up not wearing it - I usually wear a 4 but the 4 was much too large all throughout. I didn't have the 2 backup size but I still feel like it would have been too large in the hips. The dress also flared out a great deal at the hips in a very unflattering way (I felt like a cupcake!). Beautiful fabric but fit was not right for me.

For a zoo and conservation fundraiser, this dress was elegant, cute and had just enough animal print I rented the necklace pictured too and was glad that I did because it really helped finish off the look.

dress arrived in time  Dress was perfect for a wedding. The 6 I got as a backup fit better but the hem of the dress was messed up so I wore the 4 but it wasn't extremely uncomfortable. Dress shows up very well in pictures.
subtle but very feminine very beautiful silhouette
Birthday Party i ended up wearing a 6 although it was tight on the chest because the 8 is too loose and didn't like the way it looked. the dress is very classy and comfortable. good material

This dress was incredible! It fit well, was a beautiful fabric, and was very unique! This dress fit true to size for me and flattered my hourglass figure. I tend to carry my weight in my hips and be small on top and this dress really evened me out and flattered my figure. The color of the fabric is a brighter blue than in the website pictures, but it is absolutely gorgeous. This was a comfortable dress and easy to wear for the 12 hours that had to.

Beautiful colors, get ready for lots of compliments! This was my first RTR experience and I was super pleased. I rented this dress for an evening cocktail wedding and received lots of compliments. I normally wear a size 6 and ordered an 8 as back up but the 6 fit just fine. The colors are even more beautiful in person and paired nicely with nude shoes and fun necklace. The only thing that could have made this dress better would have been pockets.
Outdoor summer wedding in the city  Wore this to an outdoor, summer black-tie wedding and it was perfect! Fit perfectly and was quite elegant.

Excellent customer service. This was dress was so great! I wore it for party in my honor and felt like the prettiest person there in this dress. It is a perfect party dress and the fit is true. I am considering buying it. I just wish I had a good picture to share.

Great night The cheetah print doesn't show well in photos but is definitely there. The flower shapes on the bottom are silver/gray, not gold as they seem to show in the pictures. The dress was comfortable and fit true to size.
I loved my dress! Definitely runs true to size, dress was super comfy!

Comfy Dress with a Fun Pattern. The dress can be tight in the chest area and waist so I had to use my back up size (14). I love that the dress can be dressed up or down. I'm not good at accessorizing so it was perfect for me. I ended up wearing nice flats/sneakers. Wore it for an outdoor evening wedding.

Wore to an evening wedding at a wine bar over Memorial Day Weekend.  I am pear-shaped and typically wear size 6-8 dresses. Size 6 fit perfectly. The black cheetah print and the gold flowers on the bottom make this dress very unique. Wore with closed-toed black high heels and a gold necklace that I own. Excellent for hitting the dance floor (sans heels, of course). Got compliments on the dress, and so I got to share my love of RTR!

Amazing Dress - not for large busted women I had a work event for oaks and this was such a great dress and I loved the design. The dress was extremely tight in the bust region. They did not have a backup size in for the time frame I needed the dress. It worked and I received a ton of compliments on the dress but it is not a dress for big busted women.
Fun dress with the right amount of serious for a formal wedding shower Right length on a short person (i'm 5'2")- the 6 was just right around the fitted waist

Loved this dress! I felt super confident and got so many compliments! This dress was super cute and generally very comfortable. I felt like it looked high end and the only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was I found it a little tight in the waist while a little big in the bust and the zipper kept getting stuck when trying to close it. Overall I was super happy with this dress and am thinking of renting it again for another wedding I have to go to.
Perfect! So perfect for my graduate school graduation. Very comfortable and much prettier in person!

I lost track of the number of compliments I received!!! I rented this dress for my college graduation and could not have been happier. It fit like a glove and was in perfect condition. Everyone told me how much they loved the dress (including strangers on the street). I didn't want to send it back, but of course I had to. I would definitely rent this dress again!

Loved the color and the fit. It was such a unique design!  Fit was perfect for me. I wouldn't recommend the necklace though because it kept getting lost under the dress. I got many compliments on the dress which was perfect for this fall wedding. My usual size is a 6 and this fit just fine.

Beautiful dress! Great for a more formal occasion.   The 6 fit perfectly - I'm usually a 6-8.  It was great to wear a normal bra!  Wish it had pockets since the skirt was so full.  Very pretty, happy with the rental!

Super fun and SO many compliments! I wore this dress for a rehearsal and rehearsal dinner.  This is one of my favorite dresses ever!  The size 12 fit much better than the backup size 14.  My bra showed the tiniest amount in the arm holes, but it wasn't noticeable enough to be an issue.  I definitely needed a bra in this dress.  The colors are beautiful, and the pattern is so fun and unique.  I got compliments all night long!  The cut really accentuated my hourglass figure.  The dress was very comfortable all night long (and it was a late night).  Definitely recommend this dress!!

Easy to choose a great dress, and affordable too! This was a great dress to wear to a wedding-- not too flashy, but still unique and flattering.  The combination of leopard and floral patterns was especially unique.  It fit me pretty well but was a bit baggy in the bust (not bad enough to not wear it, though). I think it would fit a C cup the best (I'm a B).  There's no stretch to the dress.
Very comfortable and received a lot of compliments! Wish it had pockets! Since the neckline was a little high, I wasn't sure what type of necklace to wear.

Fun and flirty! This dress was so much fun to wear. It is fitted through the bust and torso, and then flairs at the waist. I received so many compliments on this dress, both the night of the event and now, a week later! The size 6 fit like a glove--I'm 5'3" with an athletic build. The metallic in the skirt is more bronze, so accessories can be silver or gold.

Loved the colors a little tight up top! I loved the print and colors and got complements all night.  The only downfall, was that it was a little tight on the bust.  It was like that for both the six and the eight.
It's classy beautiful dress. I received a ton of complements. Love it <3 It's true size, perfect fit.
Didn't make it to the event... ...but oh my GOSH this dress was so beautiful Luxurious fabric and perfect, classic fit, I so did not want to take this off, and was broken-hearted to send it back.
Wore this for a NYE cocktail party Fit true to size. Loved that the animal print was subtle, but still noticeable. A friend of mine liked it so much she rented it for her work event a month later!

I am a teacher and I wore this to our school Gala and Silent Auction at a winery. Dress fit well. I am often between a 4 and 6 and the 4 fit perfect! I wore it with black heels. I got many compliments on the dress and was comfortable all night.

I received so many compliments on this dress. It was just perfect for my cousin's wedding. It fit perfectly. The fuller skirt didn't fit skin tight, like so many other dresses do. Perfect for those of us concerned about our fuller thighs. It had just enough sparkle.
SO many compliments on this dress! This dress fit like a glove!  Tight fitting at waist but not too tight.

Loved the Full Skirt This was a back-up dress. I don't normally like animal prints, but for this dress, I'd overlook it. It cinches at the waist and is very full in the skirt, which makes it very fun. It hit about mid-thigh for me (5'2) so be mindful if you're really tall. I wish I had the Size 2 or 4, because with the holiday weight, I wasn't able to comfortably stay in the Size 0.

High quality, beautiful colors I received a ton of compliments int his dress. This dress was fitted at the top and waist, and had a full skirt. It was beautiful! The patterns and colors were gorgeous and I definitely felt confident. I paired it with some nude heels. I would definitely rent this dress again!
The dress is comfortable and fits to size. Being petite and athletic with a size C bust - I had no problem with the original size 4 ordered.

Lovely, lovely dress! I wore it to a corporate dinner party, and really looked great! This is a dress that looks GREAT on pear shapes!  It was fitted at the bust, but flowed out at the bottom.  There is a gorgeous sheen to this dress.  Highly recommended, I almost wish I owned it!

Great dress style for a modern wedding Great dress, and such a fun print for any event without being too over-the-top. I think it helps that the cheetah spots aren't immediately noticeable. But it is a heavier dress, I wouldn't recommend for hot weather. Also, the fit is great and I think would really flatter any shape, but go a size up. My normal size did not fit, and I had to go up a size, it was tight in the chest area. I can't wait to rent this again.

Classy and full of detail! I wore this dress for a wedding. It was very classy and beautiful. I received multiple compliments and would love to wear this dress again. I typically wear a size 2 and that is the size I wore in this dress. I ordered a 4 for backup, but it was too big. When I tried it on the zipper was sticking a bit around the hem and it made me nervous that it would stick on the day of the wedding and not come up all of the way. I sent an email to RTR just casually mentioning it. They responded right away and said they would over night me the same dress but a new one so prevent the zipper issue. I told them I was out of town, and they over nighted it to my hotel by 10:00am the next day. I was so amazed by their wonderful service and quick responses!

Fun, flirty dress Great dress. A little tight in the chest for a moderate/small chested person, so you may need to order up a size with a large chest. Dress was comfortable otherwise and was great for dancing. I got lots of compliments.

A++ Loved the fit! was worried from previous comments but the 6 fit me perfect! not to tight in the bust or waist! depending on your body type the full bottom could give you more shape. Got many compliments! My first Rent the Runway experience was definitely a success!

Adorable daytime dress This dress is definitely not my usual style, but I kept coming back to it when browsing for something to wear to a wedding, so I rented it as a backup.  The dress arrived brand new, with tags still on.  At first, I wasn't sure about wearing it.  The skirt is definitely very full and poofy, much more so than it appears on the RTR model.  But the length was perfect and the style was adorable, so I ended up wearing it to the ceremony and having a great time.  I definitely recommend it, even if it's not what you might "normally" wear.

Great color, silver sparkle, subtle RAWR This is a beautiful dress -- lovely navy blue color with really subtle cheetah print and gorgeous silver detail on the bottom. I rented sizes 6 and 8 and it turns out I was in between sizes. The 8 was too baggy on top and the arm holes were too large, so I went with the 6 which was very tight across the bust and created an unfortunate "uni-boob" effect. Ultimately, tighter looked better than baggier. In any case, the dress was still beautiful, I still got TONS of compliments, the length was great (I'm 5'2") and it was a fun party dress. The fabric is really high quality. The skirt has a fair amount of "foof out," which I liked, but it might be too "foofy" for some. Great dress for lots of occasions. I also rented the Nicole Miller silver "Southern Plantation" earrings to go with it and they were the perfect compliment.

Really beautiful dress! This dress was absolutely beautiful, I received so many compliments on it. The fit was great and pretty true to size. It is a very comfortable dress as well. I am short, so (very) high heels were needed. The only negative I have about the dress is that, the fabric surrounding the zipper isn't very tailored. I could tell that it was probably a sample dress of some sort but, since the zipper runs down your side, your arm covers it and no one else can really notice. Other then that, I would definitely rent this dress again!

Great dress! I got compliments on it all night. Use accessories to make it even more elegant.  Fit great.  Not too tight and not too loose.  I would suggest a short heal for those tall girls who get this dress in long.

Wore to a black tie ball for the Junior League of Dallas.  Lovely/Flattering Dress! I received a ton of compliments on this dress and would recommend it to any woman with tummy issues (apple shape) as I felt is concealed my problem area well.  I was disappointed in the color of the dress when it arrived.  On the website it was a more vibrant blue and in person (and photos) looked black.  Also, there was very strange puckering down the side on the zipper.  I thought is may have just been this dress but when I tried on the back-up size it was the same on that dress.  This was my first time using RTR and the process of renting and receiving the dress was great and I will definitely be using RTR in the future!
Beautiful gown Fit my curves like a glove, and the regular length was perfect for me (I'm 5'2").

Beautiful and comfortable - I received so many compliments!! I ordered this dress for a black tie event for the charity I work for. I received this dress  in a 6r and 8r, since the reviews said it ran large and I hoped to be able to wear flats or low heels. The 6 fit perfectly and the 8 was way too big. Beware -- the dress is significantly shorter in the front than the back ( you could see my ankles!) so I called RTR in the hopes they would have a 6L they could swap for me.  They had one and sent it and it was perfect!  It did stretch a little at the top and by the end of the night was less snug but I was happy with my purchase!

This is a beautiful navy blue dress with classic lines and is very comfortable to wear. This dress fit perfectly! The length was just right with 3 inch heels.  The dress came in perfect condition.  I was on my feet a lot during the event and am glad I did not go with the long length.  I would definitely rent another dress by this designer.
Stunning dress! So easy to wear, and glamorous! Runs slightly large, I normally wear a 4R, and the 2R was a perfect fit. This dress is simple elegance, it is a statement all on it's own.

Best idea ever - never buying a formal dress again! Like the previous reviewers said, the dress runs large and long.  I ended up wearing the 8, although I may have been able to go a size smaller.  The dress was gorgeous and both arrived in mint condition.  I usually have problems in the chest department, but it fit perfectly there!  I will say the side zipper bubbled a bit on both sizes, due to the weight of the fabric, but I was told no one else would notice it.  I wore 3" heals and the dress skimmed the floor nicely.  All in all a great process - the mail return bag doesn't fit in all mail slots well ( I ended up jamming up our box so the post office may not be too happy with me).

Emmy Night Elegance This dress was absolutely beautiful. The flow of the material and the small train were elegant and just what I was looking for. A few notes:

* I agree with the other reviews that this dress runs large (I typically wear a 6 but ended up using the 4).  
* I highly recommend getting a belt to accentuate the waist.  Before the belt I added, the dress gave me no shape, but the belt added the definition I needed. 
* As others have said, the color is more of a navy than a vibrant blue.

I would absolutely recommend this gown to others. Classic elegance!

Great choice - elegant and understated This is a great choice for a black tie optional wedding. The color is deeper than pictured - a true navy, and is less expected than black. I normally wear a 14, but after having a baby I have no idea what is "normal" anymore, so I ordered a 12R and a 16R (the 14 was unavailable). The 16 was way too big, but the perfect length for me (I'm barely 5'7). The 12 fit great - the top was very slightly snug, but it was very short. I wore 3.5 inch heels, and I had to embrace really showing my shoes. The dress is cut pretty straight through the top and waist, which can create a bit of puckering along the side zipper if you have a larger bust, but I attribute this to the fact that I probably would have fit the 14 a bit better. I was worried about returns on Sunday, but the return was SO easy - just pop the dresses back in the enclosed bags and drop them in the blue USPS post boxes. I will definitely rent again!

That I felt stunning and even more beautiful than I have ever felt in a long time. It was a perfect dress and I wish I could buy it!!!  I absolutely love this dress. To the point I need to buy it. I received SOO many compliments it felt like my wedding day. I used one of my grandmom's vintage belt to break up the color and add a bit of pop. It runs big because usually I am a 4 and I chose the 2 over the 0 because I wanted it to move more and flow while I danced.

It was very beautiful in person. Darker than I had expected, almost black.  The arm hole is very tight and was a little uncomfortable to move around. It is also very heavy, I would recommend for  colder weather events. I ended up wearing my extra dress because this one made me pretty warm. I got the regular and long, the regular ( with four inch heels ) was about two inches too short. The long went to the floor, I had to be careful not to trip.

The Samuel Heyman Service to America Medals in Washington, DC. AkA "the Oscars of the Government." I wore this for a formal event my organization puts on every year. I needed something that was classy, yet versatile as throughout the night I was mixing with the guests, ensuring they had what the needed, and also doing some light setup and tear down. I loved how this dress looked in the pictures, and the elegance of it, however it ran very large and long. I am a very full busted woman, and I had to pin up the dress around my bust. All through the night I felt like it was falling down (and I also had to hold it whenever I walked for fear of tripping on it - and i had about 1 1/2 inch heels). It was a gorgeous dress, and I received many compliments on it, but I wished it had fit a bit better. Alas there were no 10s when I ordered it.  I would easily say to go a size down on this one.
Rented as back-up since black was not available in 8R.  Didn't try dress on so not sure on sizing. Color is not nearly as bright as pictured.  It's navy.
Beautiful Dress Great dress, perfect fit!  The front runs slightly shorter than the back but it was just long enough.

Flattering and wonderful dress, runs large I rented this dress for a black-tie wedding I attended in January. I am always nervous to order a size down but did based on the other reviews. I ended up wearing the smaller size and I probably could have even worn the next size down but the 6 fit pretty well. I would recommend this dress to anyone. It is a great material, thicker so it was nice for the winter when i wore a shawl for my shoulders but I would definitely wear this dress in the spring/summer as well. I would rent it again in a heartbeat!

A mix of Elegance and Beauty!  I rented the dress for a black tie wedding. I cannot describe the way this dress flows and hughs your body and at the same time you are able to move around and dance. I do agree and thank the preview girls that posted the reviews saying the dress runs a tad bigger because it does, that's the reason i went for a size smaller as my second option and I'm glad i did!! The items were delivered and wrapped carefully and the delivery date  was exactly on time. The return indications were very simple as well. I also rented the accesories from the site!! Unfortunetely, i could only rely on my friends pictures and they do not make justice to the dress, but trust me "If you want to dress to impress... then this is your dress!"

Stunning, Flattering, Classy I absolutely loved this dress. Although it looks like a relatively bright blue in photos with a flash, the dress is actually a deep navy. The fabric was comfortable, not too heavy or light, and was very flattering. I felt it was slightly tight under the arms, but that could just be a personal problem. The long length was perfect with a two inch dress sandal, and I am glad I did not order the regular length. Overall, I said it runs large because I am typically a 6, but the 6 did not stay up on top, a problem I never have. I would definitely rent this again if I had more formal occasions and if there weren't so many other fabulous dresses I wanted to try on here!

So classy! I described the fit as true to size but - the hips run big and the bust is small. Go figure. I had a ton of room in the belly (which never happens with my shape) and hips but my poor boobs were kinda squished. The darts in the bust seemed oddly positioned to me.
But, this dress was lovely. I think the color is darker than it looks on the model which worked perfectly for my event. The fabric is heavy and draped really well. I got compliments all night without feeling like I was drawing attention - if that makes sense.
Some people had commented on the length but that was not an issue for me. I actually wore lower heels than planned since it wasn't as long as I expected.  
Very happy with this dress choice!

Perfect for black tie wedding I rented this dress for a black tie wedding and got so many compliments.  It fit perfect - not clingy at all, very comfortable and was very flattering.  I added a thin gold belt to define my waist and wore 2.5 " heels, perfect height for the length.  Would definitely rent again!
I felt glamorous! Heavy fabric with a nice volume to make you look like you are on the catwalk as you glide across the room!

Comfortable and Classic - perfect fit all around! Loved this dress!  I was hesitant about the fit (especially the arm hole) based on other renters' reviews, but it fit like a glove.  I generally wear a size 6, but ended up wearing the 4R to the event, so it ran just a little large. It was comfortable, didn't restrict movement, and the length was perfect with 2 1/2 inch heels.  I wore the dress to a black tie benefit, pairing it with metallic strappy heels and oversized studded earrings.  It had just a little bit of a train in the back that made it a touch more elegant.  The color looked brighter in the model picture, but in real life it was a truer navy.  Also, the shoulder ruffles seemed very structured in the model picture, but they had much more movement to them in person.  I would definitely recommend this dress to other RTR members.  All around it was comfortable, classic, and figure flattering!

A black tie gala for a wonderful cause. The dress and color were beautiful. My only complaint was that I wished the waist was more fitted. There seemed to be a lot of extra fabric in that area and my waist isn't overly thin. Because of that, I didn't feel like the dress was very slimming. Also, the arm hole for the side with a strap was pretty tight in my arm pit, so I probably wouldn't have been able to fit in a smaller size. I was happy with the way I looked that night, but it's not a dress I would buy due to the fit. The whole experience with RTR was a very positive one and I will definitely be renting again.

This dress was absolutely stunning, I received compliments all night! I ordered the dress in a size 6 and also the size 4.  I wore the size 4, and it was more than comfortable.  The dress fit nicely in the bust area, a little loose in the midsection, but the perfect length.  I would absolutely rent this dress again.

Glamorous Gown Perfect for Awards Season! I rented this dress for an evening of Oscar parties and I loved it. The 6R was a little short so my shoes showed but the 6L wasn't that much longer and was only available in black so I went with the 6R and loved the Navy blue color. It was very comfortable and flattering, I wore it for over 12 hours and it was never too tight or itchy. I would love to rent again in another color!!
This dress stood out and looked very slimming. This dress was for an outdoor wedding and reception.  The fabric wasn't too heavy for a Florida/May wedding.  It fit perfectly! I'd rent this one again.

A perfect formal dress Best dress I've ever rented on RTR. Comfortable, beautiful fabric, conservative enough for a donor event but still made me feel beautiful. I wore this with big drop earrings and it was perfect. I can't handle bracelets but it if you're into those, that one would have been perfect.

Great for black tie event I wore the dress for a black tie event and it was comfortable to wear all evening (the material was not too heavy). I only wore inch and a half heels and the dress was just touching the floor (I am 5'5"). There isn't much "stretch" to the body part of the dress - that said, I didn't need to wear Spanx and it looked just fine.

Beautiful, deep navy gown. Very comfortable and easy to wear.  The shoulder makes the gown! It runs very large so keep that in mind when ordering (I am usually a 12 in all designer gowns/dresses but the 10R was perfect in this one and the 12R way too large). Length was great for me (5'7") with low heels. If you're tall or like to wear heels over 2" I would suggest getting the extra length. It was a very comfortable, easy gown to wear. I received several compliments on the gown.

Classic Elegance I wore this dress to a formal business function.  From the moment I put it on I didn’t want to take it off.  The fabric hung beautifully and the dress was so comfortable I felt tall and elegant all evening without needing to fuss with it at all.  I ordered a 4L and a 2R.  I definitely needed the long – I am 5’9” and the regular was too short.  This dress is the embodiment of classic elegance – I hope to have another occasion to wear it again!  (In terms of body type I am tall and thin, but I do have hips and the dress worked perfectly.)
Very comfortable, but short! It worked just fine, but it was big in the waist, and just short enough that 4inch heels made it fall at a weird length.

first time ever to wear a formal and attend a formal event this was my first time ordering from rtr. wanted an elegant, no glitter dress for a formal military ball, this dress was perfect. husband said i looked gorgeous. ordered the size 14 with 12 (i am normally a size 14 in dresses) as the backup. wore the 12. probably could have worn a 10 in the top, but i tend to be a little bottom heavy and didn't want to have the skirt be too tight. this dress was exactly like the the reviews said. will rent again!

All the many compliments I received and how comfortable the dress was.  Fit is true to size. I’m 5’5”, 145 lbs athletic build. This dress fit in all the right places. The length was perfect, as I wore 2.5-3in heels. The dress is much darker than in the original photo, but I still received many compliments. If you’re going for an elegant look, this dress definitely will work for you!

Great dress for a black tie event. Like others have said - this dress is NOT blue as it appears in the photo. It is a very dark navy. In reading the reviews, it sounded like I could go down a size, so I rented a 4 and a 6. But, because I have a larger bust, I couldn't get the 4 to hook and zip all the way up. So I would suggest going down a size only if you have a smaller bust! For the length, regular was fine with my 3 inch heels. But if they were any higher, I would have needed a long.

I was in the receiving line at the event and one of the wives, looked at me and said, I love your dress, I'm not just saying that... I LOVE your dress!  I ordered this dress in both the red and the navy thinking I would be a size 6, which is what I wear in pretty much everything. The Red version was my first choice but unfortunately I had ordered the red in the 6 and 8, then the navy in 4 and 6. The 4 in this dress fit perfectly and was just the right length with a 3 inch heel. I am 5 3'. The dress was in perfect condition and is definitely a high quality gown. It moved really well, and was very easy to wear. The whole RTR experience was wonderful. The customer service was incredible as always!

Pretty dress, flattering fit I ordered this dress as a back up for a formal event and didn't end up wearing it out. The color was a very deep blue, I liked the detail on the one shoulder, the lines of the dress were very flattering. The gown was a bit loose all over, especially in the waist and I had ordered one size down. I am 5'8 and ordered a 10R and the dress barely hit the floor with no shoes on so it does run on the short size as well. Overall it is a very pretty and flattering gown.
so great for second trimester at a formal event comfortable material and forgiving for a maternity dress alternative
Rented as a back up for a Military Ball Wayy too big.
Perfect solution for bridesmaid dresses! Love love LOVED wearing this dress as the maid of honor in my sisters wedding.  I felt like a goddess.
Perfectly comfortable  Pro. Fits true to size. Fabric was  free flowing which made a perfect fit
I wore this dress to my engagement party. It fit really well.  The size down actually fit me better so I wore a 6 instead of an 8.

Lovely dress but a little big First I want to emphasize two things other customers said that are really very very true: 1. This is dress is so dark blue it really does almost look black in pictures and 2. The inner hanging strap on the side without the shoulder tends to pop out all the time so make sure to tape or pin it or something so it isn't bothersome. I am normally a 0, with varying success, and this dress was very large on me - enough where I could pull out the side and have over 1-2 inches of free space. That being said, the material is not very stretchy so don't overestimate that when sizing either. I think another factor for me was that the strap was a little long on my short torso. However, I wore it anyway and overall it was a good experience. I even recommended RTR to a stranger who asked where my dress was from. ;)

The dress is absolutely divine! I really could not be any happier! Fit - I made the mistake of ordering two different lengths instead of two different sizes. I ordered a 2R and a 2L, when instead I should have rented a 2R and a 0R. But all in all, with the help of (a lot of) fashion tape, the fit was wonderful! However, I will continue on the thread that the dress is a bit airy around the torso, but personally, that didn't bother me at all.
Pros - The dress is absolutely divine! I really could not be any happier! This dress is one of those very subtle but sophisticated and classy dresses. The one-shouldered ruffle is wonderful as well -- just the right amount of dramatic and not at all obnoxious. The color is also darker than the model picture, but the dark navy really plays to the sophisticated and classy side of the dress.
Cons - The only downside to this dress, and I will also continue on the other thread, is that the dress is longer in the back. Seeing as how I wore this dress to my prom, I did run into the occasional problem of having the train of the dress stepped on (both my other people and by myself). Though this problem could be remedied with taller heels.
Highlights - I really just felt so sophisticated and classy. I loved walking in this dress and receiving the second glances and compliments from people.  And specifically pertaining to my prom, I really felt like I stood out because whereas other girls would be bedazzled or in sequins or layers, I felt like this dress really stood out in its subtly; and you can easily play it up or down. Really, just sososo satisfied and happy with the way this dress helped me define my prom night!

Elegant dress that was perfect for a black tie event! A ton of complements! The dress is perfect!  The dress does run bigger in the waist and top - the arm hole or one shoulder part is true to size so it doesn't fall down or slip off.  The waist is cut a little bigger than usual.

Beautiful holiday ball with a elegant dress.  The 12 fit my bottom half perfectly. I was comfortable all night. It was a little big on my top half but not a big issue. Nice material and length was great!

Stunning! Such a classic dress - a flattering fit!  The color is darker than the photo, but is still a beautiful navy blue.  The fabric is fairly heavy, but still wearable.  The length is appropriate and the ruffle isn't at all overwhelming like I was worried it would be.  I am 5' 4" and wore ~3" heels... the shoes would only poke out when I would walk.

Lovely dress, but didn't fit like I would have liked it too. It's a gorgeous dress. I usually wear a size 8 regular, but there were no dresses of my size for the date I needed it by so I rented the 6L and 10R. Both fit me but not in the way I would have liked it too. The dress is very forgiving meaning that it will hide things you want it to hide but for me it was too loose. I wanted something a little tighter. I would have wore it if I didn't have another dress. The other thing was that the back is longer than the front so you have to be careful with stepping on the back. It is darker than it looks in the picture but it's really elegant.

I loved this dress and received many compliments! The dress was perfect for the occasion, although a little bit big in the waist.  it was extremely comfortable and was just the right length.  People also appreciated that it was Navy blue rather than traditional black.  I considered wearing red acessories but, due to procrastination, was not able to purchase what I was looking for so I ended up wearing gold, which worked veru well also!

Fit well and looked good on me. The color is A LOT darker than in the picture, that was a huge disappointment because the color really mattered to me. It looks more black than anything and I was hoping for the blue in the picture!!

Excellent service and smooth delivery.   This is a great staple dress for a formal work event or "bridesmaid esque" dress for a wedding.  I'm tall and slender, not too curvy, so i looked a bit plain jane in it. It looked more conservative on than i thought it would.  i think it could be great for those with more curves (or trying to hide some curves), but for me it just didn't have much sex appeal.
The dress was comfortable and ingot a lot of compliments! Fit perfectly and was easy to dance in.
It's a good quality dress I liked the dress, it was just too big for me. It was my backup dress anyway.

I wore this dress to the Ballet Ball here in Nashville and overall it was a subtle choice. Overall the dress fit the bill as I was invited last minute to the Ballet Ball and as I hadn't gone to the event before, I didn't want anything too over the top.  The simple streamlined 'Calvin Klein' esque nature of this dress appealed to me.  I ordered both a size 4R & 6R; I wish I had ordered a 2R instead as overall the dress seemed a bit looser than I expected.  Also, the dress was more of a true dark navy instead of the more royal blue color shown in the image, which made the dress feel a bit more 'blah'.  Overall, I would wear this dress again if I ordered it in a smaller size and had the proper amount of 'bling' to contrast the very quiet nature of the dress.  One last note, I remember the dress feeling a tad short with the 4 inch heels I wore that night, and I am roughly 5'7.

Simple, gorgeous and comfortable! I normally shy away from strapless/one-shoulder dresses, but once I put this dress on, I couldn't say no. It runs quite large (even the 8R was a bit large on me in places), but overall, the fit was great. I received so many compliments throughout the night and the fabric was perfect for a chilly fall evening. I'm 5'2 and wore 3.5 inch heels, though wish I had gone with 4+ inches, as I had to keep picking up the dress so I wouldn't trip.
I was interview on the event red carpet. The dress was very understated but stunning.  No cons. it fit very well.

This dress makes you feel like a million bucks! It's a must buy for any formal occasion. I usually fit into a 6, but I easily fit into a 4 with a bit of room in the waist. It runs big, so keep that in mind. I am 5'9", and wore a two inch heel, and the dress just grazed the ground ever so beautifully. It was extremely comfortable and it was in pristine condition. The only thing that took me off guard was the color; it was not cobalt blue, but a very dark navy blue. Just keep that in mind. Perfect in every other way!

Pretty Dress I rented several options for a gala I had to attend, and this was a backup dress. I didn't end up wearing it. I am very petite, and the length actually worked great with 4-5" heels, but the dress itself was too loose. The bust area wasn't really fitted, or the body, and the zipper kind of jutted out from the side awkwardly. It just wasn't very flattering and I decided to wear a different dress. I wouldn't recommend the dress for someone who is petite, but it is a beautiful gown, and I loved the color!

Wore this to a formal wedding and felt great in it! I usually wear a size 6 sometimes a size 8 because of my hips, so I ordered a size a 6R and a 8R for back up. I wish I would have ordered a 6R and the 4R for backup. While the 6 fit well, I think the top was just a little loose.  However, the elegance, weight of the fabric and cut of the silhouette more than made up for it! If you don't have a large chest I suggest sizing down or ordering the the smaller backup. Loved the dress and have already considered ordering it again!

I loved this dress. Got tons of complements! Like many others, I ordered this as my back-up dress. The other dress I ordered was pretty too. This one just looked more elegant and I loved the solid navy color of it (much darker than the photo shown). My two complaints were that the zipper was kind of stretched out when I got it and I thought it was just a little big in the waist. But it worked as I sometimes have a hard time finding a dress that fits in the bust. The dress is lined so it is nice and warm for the fall/winter month events. I am 5'8 and I wore 3" heels and it was still a tad long in the back. But nearly perfect for my height. Overall this dress was great. I got tons of complements and I felt comfortable all night in the cool weather. I will definitely use RTR again in the future and recommend it to anyone who is looking for a nice rental.

The dress was perfect!  The fit was just as described and very flattering. I'm short with an hourglass figure and it looked great! It was a little long, but my heels were only 2.5 inches and I'm on the shorter side. The material was thicker than I expected which made it hotter than I'd want for a spring/summer or outside wedding.  If you're busty and don't want to show a lot of cleavage, it's a perfect dress for you!

Overall a pretty dress & my fiance thought i looked beautiful :-) but wasn't crazy about the fit Got a 6 for the back up size but was too tight in the hips- the 8 was a little big in the top which made the bra situation a little rough.  Not my favorite rental but overall it was nice esp if you're going for a classy look!  Definitely a pretty bright blue compared to how it looks in the picture.

The color was so rich, perfect for a fall wedding in Napa, I Felt stunning in this dress.   I had a  bit of trouble with finding a bra for my girls to be completely comfortable.  But I forgot to do that before I got to my event, so my bad.  It was great! Loved it! I did size up and wear the 14 just so I could dance and eat a bit more ;-)

Cute dress, great fit, but the lace is getting worn. I love this dress.  It's beautiful.  I'm tall so the length was great for me.  The opening in the back is a great touch.  My only issue was that the lace is getting frayed.  I'm sure a lot of people rented this and it's just getting worn.  It was also hanging in the back at the neck where it probably should have been a little more fitted.  The overall fit was great though.

Overall great dress!  I got lot's of compliments on it.   I am normally a size 6 and the dress was pretty true to fit.  You can't wear a bra with it because the back goes too low, but I really didn't have a problem with it.  If you are a little bigger busted, I could see that maybe causing an issue.  I got the dress in 2 sizes, and this one looked A LOT newer than the other one.  The one I didn't wear definitely looked like it had been through a lot, so I was really happy that this is the one that ended up fitting.  Overall I think it's a pretty slimming dress, and very pretty color.  It worked really well for me!  Kinda wish I could keep it!

Fantastic for a Formal Event This dress was sent to me as a replacement for another dress for a formal event.  Even though I did not receive it in time, I wore it out to dinner that night.  The color in the photos do not do it justice - it is a GORGEOUS blue!  the cut out in the back is just the right amount, as I was worried too much would be exposed.  Highly recommend!!

Royal! Very classy and beautiful! I wore it to my own rehearsal dinner and it was perfect. Only downside was that the lining hem does fall below the lace, and it would be cuter if the lace detail was the hem. I bought fashion tape to tape the lining up since I read that happened in other reviews but then we were running late and I couldn't! It wasn't a bit deal in the pictures though and didn't ruin my night for sure :)

Wore this to a wedding, it was perfect for the event.  The fit is snug through the waist and hips but it was a very flattering style. The top on the 6 was a little big but not too bad. There were some small tears on the lace in the back when I received it but they were too small for anyone to notice.

Really great dress for a semi-formal outdoor wedding! Beautiful color and great fit. The lace is paired with a thicker fabric over the body to really hold everything together. The low back prevents a bra without showing the band, so I went without and felt fine. The lace looked a little used, but I'm sure no one noticed from a reasonable distance. I usually wear an 8, but went with my back up size of 10 as it was just a lot more comfortable. Loved the back detail!

PERFECT!!! Color really pops, great fit, everyone loved it. Came out great in pictures. PROS- Great color, comfortable.
CONS- My top hook was almost coming off the dress so I really had to rely on the bottom. Other than that, was a great dress to wear!

This dress is a BEAUTIFUL color and very flattering. The fit is a bit snug...sitting down for a few hours at the wedding was slightly uncomfortable, but I got compliments all day and night-- the slight tightness was SO worth it. Bonus: I didn't have to wear a bra, so that was one less solution I had to come up with! 

Love this dress.

This dress was perfect for a Charleston spring wedding I ordered the 0 and the 2 because other reviews talked about the top portion being a bit tight in the ribcage and I'm usually between either size. The 0 fit perfectly, the only size issue I had was the skirt was a bit tight for my liking since it's a pencil skirt. The top part with the eye hook closures does have a tendency to undo here and there so I had to keep my eye on that too.

Beautiful dress/Not such a flattering length I wore this dress to a work Christmas party.  The dress itself was so pretty, but the length was alittle to long.  It looked great in person not i didnt like it in pictures.  In pictures in made me look heavy.  This makes me even more happier that this website is available because i would have been upset paying almost $400 for it and not wearing again.  If the dress was shorter, i think it would have been more flattering for my body.

I loved the lace. I loved the color. I loved how the back looked.  The length went to my knees. I was able to wear it without a bra without any issues. The dress (in terms of width) fit well- not too loose, not too snug.

The dress is gorgeous and it does run true to size,  The color looks great in photos.  Its a bit over worn, you can see pulls, etc but its not that noticeable. I got a lot of compliments on the dress. Its a great find for what I had to attend.

Stunning Color I was so happy I chose this dress for a friend's wedding. It was definitely a standout because of the bright blue color and I felt great. I couldn't wear a bra with this, which would ordinarily be a problem for me, but the dress fit so well that it wasn't a problem even with a larger chest. 

I felt great and got a ton of compliments and I was comfortable all night on the dance floor. 

One thing I have to mention that another reviewer commented on is that the colors vary based on dress size. The size 6 was definitely a brighter (and prettier) blue than the size 8 backup I ordered. I would have been a little disappointed with the color if I had had to size up. Luckily it wasn't an issue for me.

Sharing in my college roommate's special day! This was a beautiful dress and from the moment I put it on, I knew I had made the right choice in selecting it for an outdoor June wedding! I had debated getting this dress in red but decided the blue would be more appropriate for a wedding. It was a beautiful color and the overall shape fit my body well. I received many compliments throughout the night! This was my first RTR experience and as such I was worried that the dress would be ill-fitted as I never buy clothing without first trying it on. However, I pored over the reviews and based on what I read, decided to rent the dress in a 4 and 6. I ended up wearing the 4 and I couldn't be happier with my decision.
Pros:
-I wore this dress on a 85 degree day for an outdoor wedding and worried that I would be overly hot in it but it was surprisingly comfortable.
-Vibrant color.
-Even though it was fitted, it was comfortable enough to dance around in.

Cons:
-As stated in some prior reviews, the slip on my particular dress did peak out from under the lace and needed to be pinned up.
-Although some reviewers ended up stating that they went braless, I was not comfortable doing so. I did wear a strapless bra and was fidgeting with it quite a bit throughout the night and wish I had pinned the dress in place with safety pins.

Gorgeous dress - 100% recommend it! Beautiful color, amazing fit and was truly stunning on me! I got worried last minute that the dress might run small, changed my order from a 2 and 4 to a 4 and 6. definitely could have kept the original order and worn the size 2. the color was amazing with my dark hair and green eyes.
you must rent this!

Love  this dress! Super classy and the back is awesome! Received a lot of compliments on it!  Both the 6 and 8 fit but I was more comfortable in the 8. Wore a backless bra but didn’t really need one. Lace on the dress was worn and looked stretched so I had to do some work on it before I wore it but it turned out ok.

Great fit and very comfortable The dress has a snug fit through the waist and hips, but the material gives to make it very comfortable. I love the bright blue color of this dress and the back is just gorgeous. Perfect for an evening wedding.

Stunning color! This was a second choice Monique Lhuiller dress for me since my original choice was not available. I ordered a Size 4 and a Size 6. The color and lace were beautiful and elegant.  The Size 4 fit but it was too tight on the back opening and it was a struggle to zip up. The Size 6 fit ok but it was a little discolored and looked worn. RTR was wonderful as usual and sent me another Size 6 overnight that worked out fine! Overwll it was comfortable and conservative which was what I was looking for this wedding. It photographed very nicely as well.

Show stopper! Amazing dress. Fit true to size - the 10 fit like a glove. The only reason I gave it 4 stars vs 5, was because there was some ware and fading on the dress but nothing anyone else could notice. I am a 36D and did not have to wear a bra and felt supported - which is great! Would recommend this dress to all. I will be renting it in red very soon. Also, the customer service is outstanding. Very accommodating.

All the complaints I received for the dress
