 So I typically where a size 12, however I wore the 14 because I was self conscious about how the 12 fit on the bottom. I'm a pear shape, so my booty is always issues for clothing. The 12 fit fine, I just felt more comfortable in the 14, although the top was too big.

I got so many compliments! Comfortable & classy. Dance floor approved! The fit was great. I am on the shorter side so the heels were a must or else it would not have looked as flattering. I am 5'3" and the dress came below my knees. I loved the fitted, almost corset feel around the waist. This was very flattering. 

The back cut was absolutely beautiful. I recommend putting your hair up so that you can show off your back! Very elegant. It definitely makes a lot of heads turn :)

The bust did not have as much support as I would have liked. I am a 34D so I would have liked both more support and coverage. However, the lace covering the chest added a nice, classy touch. I think the bust did not have as much support because of previous wear. It seemed a little overstretched and looser than it should have been.

The material of the dress was of delicate lace. Again, because of previous wear, it looked quite worn. The bright color of the dress made up for it partially. 

Great dress! I recommend it!!

The compliments just kept on coming! I normally wear a size 2, but can sometimes squeeze into a 0, so i ordered both sizes. I wound up wearing the 0 only because I felt like it gave more definition to my butt and hugged my curves a little better. I also was unable to wear a bra with the 0 which was okay because the dress has some boning in it which really offered great support. The color is more electric blue than navy as pictured. It definitely is a show stopper, guests remembered me the next day as "the girl in that pretty blue dress." Great first time rent, and happy customer!

I loved this dress! I got many compliments about the color and the style. Wish I could have kept it! The fit was great overall. If I was bigger in the chest region I think it would have been a little tight. I had to be careful with the material because I could tell that it easily would snag. The bottom of the dress has very little stretch so I would size up if you have a bigger bottom half.
Amazing dress! Complements from many at the party! Amazing fit. Classic look.

Elegant & Fun Vibrant color, soft fabric (not itchy at all!), nicely lined. Fits well, a little large in the bust (I'm 32B). Comfortable to wear, form fitting, so I needed help getting into/out of a low seated car.
My favorite RTR dress! I loved this dress! The color was a gorgeous cobalt blue and the fit was very flattering. I received many compliments on this dress and would definitely rent it again!
Great dress!  Comfortable, and very cute.  Lots of compliments all night! :) fit true to size

Very pretty, color vibrant.  Ordered 6 and 8. 6 was a little snug, 8 was a little loose however hemline on the 8 was not smooth and did not look right. Called RTR and they sent 2 size 8 dresses; 1 in red, 1 in navy. After trying on all 3 options, I ended up going with the 6 because of the tighter fit. The 8 was just too big in the chest for me. I had to wear shapewear under the 6, but it looked good and I got tons of compliments. It really is a beautiful dress. Thanks, RTR!

Great night, great dress! This dress is awesome! My boyfriend said it was the best dress I've worn, like ever. I figured out I'd rented the long navy blue version of this for a wedding previously, but I like the short version much better. The bright blue color, too, was great.  So comfortable and so flattering with the thicker lining.

I had to put together a bra that would work for this keyhole back dress, since I have a DD+ cup size, and do not rock bra-less well.  I did a strapless convertible, moving the back straps far forward so they would rap around my arms close to my armpits, and with a low back bra converter that wrapped around my stomach. The fabric on the dress is thick, so you couldn't see the bra at all. I received a bunch of compliments on this dress and would definitely want to own something like this for any event!

Great dress, bright color! Great dress.  Fits true to size- perfect size around the top and didn't need to wear a bra.
The lining showed a bit at the bottom.

I am thrilled that I saved $250 this year renting instead of purchasing my Chamber dinner gown. The fit was perfect though I am probably a half size so there was a slight wrinkle around my hips that nobody noticed.  I felt completely comfortable in the dress and glad Rent the Runway provided both a Size 10 and a Size 12.  Both would've fit and it was nice to have the option.

Classic, beautiful dress a beautiful open back.  This dress is more conservative, but balanced by being very form fitting, and having an open back. It is a beautiful royal blue color that looks good in every kind of lighting. It is true to size, flirty and fun. Highly recommend! Only note: Because it is so form fitting, get a size up for the 2nd size in case it's too tight around the stomach area.

It was a wonderful evening The dress was awesome! I loved the color. The edges were a little frayed but not a big deal. I have larger hips/thighs so it was definitely snug in that area but I was able to dance and enjoy myself!
So flattering! This dress was amazing. The color was so bold and the fit was flattering!

got compliments on this dress all night long. the blue lace is beautiful! tight across the chest, on the longer side and hits at the knee. the color doesn't do the blue justice. its an absolutely amazing dress!!

Unbelievable dress! I have never received so many compliments! I wore this dress to my little brothers rehearsal dinner and it was perfect!  It was my back up and the other just didn't work but this dress made up for it.  It is beyond gorgeous!  The color is breathtaking and the intricate details of the lace are delicate and lovely.  I normally wear a 8-10 but went with the 10 because of other peoples reviews.  It was a little loose in the hip area, and I'm curvy, but I was the only one who noticed. It hit just above my knee and I'm 5'9 so it might be too long for someone short.  All in all, I highly recommend this dress.  I might need to find a reason to rent it again so I can wear it one more time!
Love the new return bags! Great fit, perfect length and beautiful color!
This was perfect for  my sister's rehearsal dinner! This fit perfectly and was so gorgeous.  I received so many compliments.  I wish I had a picture of the back, that was definitely the best part.

Love it! The color and lace is absolutely gorgeous. I really could have worn a 4. I didn't see much difference between the 6 and 8. I did wear the 6, however, the top was a little big. I ironed the lace around the neckline so it would stand up better and pinned the front hem since it looked a little longer than the lace. This dress fits tight through the waist and hips.

Beautiful Color! The dress is beautiful and the lace is soft, not itchy at all.  I had to remember to stand with good posture or the top gaped.  I was able to wear my strapless bra but I had to pull it down in the back.  Then I had to remember to be careful when sitting down so as not to pull the dress down and expose the bra.  The dress was beautiful but not exactly comfortable.  Between the spanx and the strapless bra it probably wasn't a dress I could have worn all night.  Luckily this was an event where I could be there standing and perching for a few hours and then go home to change.  I felt gorgeous in the dress but because of the fiddlyness I don't think I would rent it again.  It also was not my best look ever.  But I did love the back!

Beautiful color, but a little worn out... While the fit was flattering (I'm always self-conscious about my tummy), the dress itself runs very small.  I had to squeeze myself into a 6 when I normally wear a 4.  Also, the lace on the dress was very worn, to the point of almost embarrassing. The one I wore was probably ready for retirement.  The color was beautiful and the cut out in the back was sexy but not trashy and allowed me to wear a strapless bra.

Couldn't have asked for a better experience!! The dress was beautiful. The color is incredible (see second picture). Fit perfectly and was complimented all night long! A little wear throughout the dress but nothing noticeable. I have a smaller chest and opted for no bra. The dress is thick enough that i didn't need tape or anything else. This dress was perfect for a winter wedding and I will absolutely be renting again.

Evening wedding in Battery Park, NYC...gorgeous! Dress fit perfectly, looked in very good condition, and I got a LOT of compliments on it! I rented sizes 8 and 10, and wore the 8, but I might have been able to wear a 6, the back clasps were a little loose.
Really striking color.  Tight at the waist.  One dress had poor seam at the hem so could only wear one that arrived.  Great customer service though!

Classy dress for a work event or wedding This dress worked out well for an art show I attended for work.  I got a ton of compliments on the color.  I could see this dress working well for a wedding too.  Classy and conservative, but the cut out in the back keeps it updated and just the right about of sexy.  The lace around the top and the back cut out is delicate and therefore had some fraying, but nothing anyone will notice in my opinion.

Successful first rental! I don't really know if this dress runs true to size, I've recently lost a lot of weight and had not tried on dresses since before the diet.  The dress fit me with a little room in the hips, so it was very comfortable for my event, since I had a lot of sitting and standing.  I had to wear a nu-bra, but the dress did all the work.  Even though the dress does not have a low neckline, (the lace fills in) there was still really noticeable cleavage.  I was nervous that it might not be appropriate but it was my husband's business function and he didn't think it was too much.  I gave the dress only 4 stars because it is absolutely impossible to finish dressing by yourself.   My husband had to be at the event hours before me, so I had to struggle into the dress myself.  I had to turn it around back to front to zip it and hook the lower hook.  I could reach the upper hooks (there are three) but I couldn't get them to stay hooked when doing it myself.  After I got the top one and started on the second, the top one came undone.   I ended up going to the event only partly hooked up and wore my coat until I was able to enlist some help to hook me up.   After that, the dress was great, and I received several compliments.

I was very impressed by the delivery of the dresses. They came on time, in my sizes and clean. I rented this dress for a wedding and received tons of compliments!! The picture on the model doesn't do the dress justice. The royal blue color is gorgeous and brought out my blue eyes. My ONLY complaint is the dress was a little long...maybe just longer than I'm used to wearing for being short (5'4''). Overall, I loved the fit and color. The open back is flattering as well. I wasn't able to wear a bra, but the dress was fitted enough it still looked good.

Compliments galore and beautiful color! I received so many compliments on this dress.  Strangers were even coming up to me asking me where I got it.  The color is gorgeous and I loved the way it fit.  I had no issues dancing the night away in the dress, either.  It was a little larger on the top for me (I have a petite/athletic build so have a smaller bust and larger, muscular, thighs), but I had no issues with the hooks coming undone.  TIP - If you are of similar build to me, you can fold the fabric over at the top and hook the hooks to the fabric since it's lace.  It stayed perfect all night.  This was my first experience with Rent the Runway and I'll be back.  Great dress!
The blue color and the lace  It was a little large in the bust but not anything really noticeable

Wasn't crazy about it I rented this for a work event and didn't end up wearing it. It was no doubt beautifully made and in a lovely color, but with the royal blue color, all over lace, and longer hemline, I did not feel like myself in it and felt instead like a politician's wife. Beautiful, but just not my style.

Gorgeous color and very elegant.  I ordered the 6 and 8 as I have a large bust.  The 6 was tight through the chest which created the dreaded back fat.  I opted for the 8 which was in better condition and it was perfect. It downsized the look of my chest (yay!) and the lace on the capped sleeves made my arms appear thinner (double yay!)  The length is nice for professional occasions.

Wore this to an outdoor Nashville wedding and it was perfect ... Received many compliments!!  The neck did droop a little bit when I would lean forward but everything else fit great ... I was going to wear the 12 but it was a snug fit and I had my 2 year old with me so the 14 was better for me to bend over and pick him up. Other than that it was a beautiful dress and I would rent it again!!!

Worn to Spring Rehearsal Dinner I loved this dress! My picture doesn't capture the color very well--it was a lot more vibrant. I wore it to a rehearsal dinner and got a lot of compliments on the color, and dress in general. I was not able to wear a bra (34D) and still be able to zip the back, but the dress was structured enough that it worked. My only other complaint was that the lining kept "rolling out" below the lace overlay, so I had to tug the lace down kind of a lot (like every time I stood). Overall, the dress was more comfortable than I was expecting, while still managing to hold to hold my stomach in at dinner :)  I definitely recommend this one.
The dress fit very well.  I received many compliments on the dress. It fit like a glove

Vibrant blue lace. I'm 5'6 and 137 lbs and the size 4 fit me great. It was comfortable, not clingy and still showed off my shape. The inner lining of the dress must have been stretched over time (I see that this is a really popular rental) because it came down lower than the lace. So instead of a pretty scalloped lace hem, it was straight across. I did a really light hem on it to bring the lace up, so I'm glad I tried it on as soon as I got it so I had time to do a little sewing. Of course, I removed the hem before I returned the dress. It has a low back so remember to get a bra converter. I just picked up the Braza that RTR recommended. It worked out great and I'll be able to use that again. I loved the dress and I felt very pretty and elegant in it.

Gorgeous!  Loved this dress! Everyone commented on how gorgeous the dress was with many people asking where I got it! The length was perfect (not too short), the color was great (tastefully standing out) and the lace added just the right amount elegance. Would not hesitate to rent!

Flattering and great color! The color was gorgeous and was perfect for a wedding. I wore a sticky bra since it was an open back.  Be aware of the length. I'm 5'7 and it hit just below my knee. Would love to rent again!
Scene stealer! Great fit, amazing color and comfortable!
Tons of compliments, although it is tight at the top around the waist! Awesome dress! So many compliments I couldn't even count. Although the band is very tight, not too uncomfortable though.

Beautiful colors, flowing fabric This dress was gorgeous. It's 2 layers - the outer one being a chiffon. Snug at natural waist but then lots of comfy room for hips/butt. I am 5'6" and wore flats and it was perfect length.

Beautiful, vibrant, fun This dress is beautiful! The colors are vibrant and the fabric flows and lays so well. It's very easy to wear and I got lots of compliments.  Great dress! I think it does run a little small; I can usually wear a 10 and I couldn't even get the 10 on but the 12 was great.

Amazing Dress!!! I have rented a bunch of dresses and this has by far been one of my most FAVORITE EVER!!! It flowed, the colors were even more amazing in person! 
The material was thicker than I thought but the wedding was in August, and I did not feel like it was too heavy at all!! I wish that I had rented the Long size (it wasn't available) but overall it wasn't too short either!

The colors of this dress made the PERFECT summer wedding ensemble! This dress was SUCH a hit + I received endless compliments! It was such a fun and unique dress to wear and really stood out for a summer wedding. I usually wear a size 8 and am glad they only had a 10 to send, because it was a perfect fit! The 8 would have been snug on the rib cage/chest (36D). I hated sending this dress back!

Dress was AMAZING!  I received compliments all night long, one of my favorite dresses worn to date! Colors of dress are definitely more vibrant than as shown on the website!  One thing to note is that the top/shoulder area is a bit tighter than you would expect, but the dress fit perfectly and was so comfortable otherwise.  The 4R is perfect for flats/sandals, any longer and a low heel/wedge would have been necessary.
Amazing fit. Brighter than expected!!! Elongating look!!! Amazing fit. Brighter than expected!!! Elongating look!!! Great for any size boobs.

Too small :(  Unfortunately the dress didn't fit - would not zip over my chest but fit great everywhere else.  I am an F cup.  I would say anyone with a slightly large chest should be fine and consider it true to size.

Gorgeous dress!!! If you're looking for elegant but beachy, this is it. The waist is extremely narrow.  I should have gone up 2 sizes from what I normally wear. I ordered a 2 and needed a 6 for it to fit.

I got more compliments than I could count on my gorgeous dress! The fit was true to size. The true waist gathering was great for my body type and concealing my tummy, but accenting my bust. I loved the way the skirt flowed, I felt absolutely beautiful!
Such a beautiful dress! The dress is beautiful. The colors are bright and fun. I got so many compliments. It was the perfect statement dress to wear to a very formal spring wedding!
Comfortable, flowy, eye-catching This pettie dress was slightly too long for me in 5 inch heels, and the regular just does not work.  Very comfortable and pretty dress for a summer wedding.
beautiful pattern The fabric of this dress was beautiful and the fit was flattering and on the conservative side.  I ended up picking another dress for the event but would rent this one again.
Colors were so stunning Perfect dress for an outdoor lakeside wedding.
So flowy and fun! Got a lot of compliments. Fit was great. Plenty of support up top and super fun to dance in!

Gorgeous summer wedding dress! I wore this dress to a wedding at a winery and it was perfect!  The fit was great.  At 5'7'' the regular size was perfect with flats.  The colors of the dress are even better in person.

Pretty and comfortable I enjoyed wearing this dress - it is light, you can wear a regular bra, and over all is very comfortable for formal attire. The 6R was maybe a little short with heels (I'm 5'6"), but worked out just fine.

I got so many compliments and it fit right in with the beautiful outside wedding !!!!  Fits true to size. The only problem I had was being short,I had to keep lifting it up when I walked,I wore kitten heels. It can take a 3 inch heel,no problem. Otherwise than that, it's a great dress,nice and flow y! I have another wedding in October,definitely will order from here again.....
The colors, the cut… everything about the dress was perfect.  I was very nervous about the length because I read so many varied reviews. I did need to wear substantial heels and I'm 5'6''.
Amazing.  I got endless compliments on this. It was long since I wore the Regular and I'm only 5'5" but I just wore 4 inch heels and they worked.
Felt like a princess! The zipper is tricky. But the dress is absolutely gorgeous, the fabric is incredible. The dress is a lot more blue than it looks in the picture. But it is stunning.

Vivid Colors! I wore this for a fashion show at my church. Each year we have our  annual Valentines Day Banquet. I orderd the 12R which is the one that I wore because the lengthen was perfect. My backup size was a 14P but it did not allow me to wear my heels and I hate flats even though the waist felt great.  The waist is a bit snug in the 12 but I made it work. You can dress this  up or down. If you are on the fence about it  I say just do it! Everyone loved it on me.

Beautiful dress! I wore this dress for my brother's outdoor summer wedding.  The dress is gorgeous! I received lots of compliments.  It is also extremely comfortable.  I am 5'10" and the long length was great with 4" heels.  I rented the Anton Heunis Lotus Pendant Earrings and the Av Max gold bangles and they went perfectly.  Would definitely rent this dress again!

This dress was a hit! I got so many compliments. This was my first RTR dress and it won't be my last The colors are beautiful for a spring/summer outdoor wedding. The fabric flowed and felt amazing. I am 5'5 and I had on 2.5 inch heels. I did have to pick up the bottom of the dress. This would have been perfect with 3.5 inch heels.

Gorgeous colors, a little tight in the band... First of all, the colors of the dress were stunning and perfect for the garden wedding I went to. The skirt was perfectly flowy and fun to walk and dance in. The top of it was loose enough and gathered enough that I was able to wear it without a bra (thank God lol).

My only complaint, and this is something that is just typical with dresses of this style, is that the band of fabric that goes around your ribcage did seem a little tight to me and you will probably need someone to help you zip it. I'm usually an 8 or a 10 but if I'd gone with a 12, I might have been able to zip it on my own (that wasn't one of the sizes I rented though). Also, I'm about 5'4" and I wore wedges with it that were probably about 3" and he dress just barely rested on the ground.

But all in all, I loved the dress, everyone else loved the dress, and I wish I could have kept it!

Oh, also, I would have rated it 5 stars but for some reason the app would only let me give a max of 4 stars.

Best rental ever!!! This dress is AMAZING! I originally rented a 4L and a 6R as my backup (6L wasn't available).  The 4L ended up being returned damaged and was no longer available for my rental dates but RTR is awesome and they still sent my backup size along with another dress.  I'm so happy that my backup size worked!!! The colors of this dress are incredible, I was so sad that I had to send it back.  The 4L probably would've been a bit better length wise, I am 5'7" and the regular length was about 1/2" shorter than I would have preferred (I wore flats with the dress). If you are taller than 5'7" or if you want to wear heels you will definitely need a long!

Gorgeous, comfortable, feminine floral! I'm not usually one to do florals but I loved the colour palette and the reviews seemed enthusiastic so I took the plunge - and I'm so glad I did! This dress was crazy comfortable, flowy, really fun to dance in, and a pretty good length! I'm 5'6 and in that picture wearing about 2 1/2 inch heels. Sometimes the heel would catch on the hem for a second which was nerve wracking, but I wouldn't have had it any other length. When I took my shoes off at the venue the dress grazed the floor - so if you're looking for a dress length that covers your feet I think 5'6 is probably the tallest you could go for the regular. Also, this dress came with the tags on, so I was the first one to wear it! So awesome!

This dress is the perfect spring dress for a black tie wedding!   The color of the dress is very soft, more on the pastel side.  It's a little snug around the rib cage but other than that, fit true to size.  I am 5'11'', 155, and wore the 10L, it was the PERFECT length.  I received many compliments on it and felt very festive!

Outdoor wedding with fireworks galore! The dress is a good go-to for outdoor wedding.  The dress cuts a little tight in the back of the arms around the shoulder blades and is a bit too long (I'm 5'4 and wore 4 inch heels and I still found myself holding up the dress whenever I walked).  Otherwise, it's a pretty basic, safe bet for wedding.

so many compliment I word this dress for my cousins wedding in July, I was a little concerned about renting again because the last dress I rented I had to return without wearing, the fit was all wrong.  I'm pear shaped about 5'3", D bust, this dress fit so well, given that I'm short I chose to order petite and I'm really glad I did, even with the petite length I was still able to wear a low heel.  I will definitely be renting again!
This dress was beautiful! The colors were gorgeous and it flowed so nicely. I'd buy it if I could :) It feels slightly heavy in the back, but it was very comfortable.

The perfect dress for a steeple chase! I ordered this dress to wear to Point to Point, a formal steeple chase. It's similar to the Kentucky Derby and everyone dresses up in pretty dresses and big hats. This dress was perfect for it! The colors in this dress are very bright and perfect for the spring/summer. It was a hot day when I wore it but I didn't feel too hot even though the dress was long because it is lightweight and sleeveless. I have a large chest but I was very comfortable in this dress, it had plenty of room in the top. The only issue I had was getting the zipper over the band in the middle. Size wasn't the issue, but the zipper is pretty small and has a hard time adjusting to the difference in the fabric over the band. But I had a friend help me and it was fine, I was even able to do it by myself when I tried it on the first time by spinning it around to the front. I'm 5'3" and I ordered the petite size and it was the perfect length, I think it also would have been fine if I wore heels with it. I would love to own this dress if I had more reasons to wear it!

This was a beautiful dress!  Great for a black tie, colors are vivid and much more bright in person! I didn't end up wearing this dress because it was too formal for my engagement party but I would definitely wear this to a summer wedding!

Flowy dress with beautiful colors... got compliments all night long! My dress size varies between an 8-12 depending on the brand. Since others said it ran large, I ordered a size 8L and 10L. The 8L was just a bit too tight around my ribcage and bust area to fit comfortably, so I went with the 10L. Even at 5'10", the 10L was EXTREMELY long. I ended up wearing 4 inch wedges and the dress still touched the ground a bit. I would definitely order again!

the perfect dress to dance in! I fell in love with dress because of the print. I felt fantastic in this dress all night. I rented it for an outdoor wedding in hilton head and received so many compliments on the gorgeous colors in the print and it was so much fun to twirl in on the dance floor. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Beautiful Dress! As this was my first RTR I did not know what to expect.  The 6R originally ordered was not available so I ended up trying the 4R and it fit great.  I loved it and received soo many compliments.  Super easy to wear and comfortable.  Sad I have to send it back!

You'll feel like a million bucks in this dress! I LOVED this dress!!!  I was sorry that I only wore it for one event.  It's so much more gorgeous in person than in the main photo, and it fits like a glove (yet is very comfortable to wear).  I would highly recommend renting this dress!!  Note: my dress was rather long and even in 5 inch heels, I still had to lift the dress a few inches at times.

So many compliments! This dress was such a hit! Absolutely stunning and so comfortable. This was my first time doing RTR and I was nervous because I'm so short (5'1") but with the 2 petite I didn't even need heels! For anyone not vertically challenged like me this could be a problem. The 0R fit well but was about a foot too long so the 2P was perfect. I will definitely be using RTR again and probably getting this dress in another color. 
My only complaint was that the dress didn't arrive until 8pm the night before the wedding! This was fine because it was a local wedding and the dress fit great, but if we had been leaving after work it could have been a disaster!

Loved this dress! Perfect for a southern gal wanting to wear some color to a formal wedding in NYC. This dress is lovely. Being the only southern gal at a formal wedding in NYC I knew I had to wear some color. I was the only not in navy or black and received compliments all evening. I'm 5'7 and the description says rent the long version. I rented the 0L and 2L and am so happy RTR accidentally sent me a 2R instead because the long was way too long. There was little to no difference in the 0 and 2 in terms of sizing but a huge difference between the regular and the long. Unless you are 5'10 or plan to wear 5" heels no need to rent the long. I wore normal Cole Haan pumps (3 inches) and the regular length was perfect.

Gorgeous dress  This dress is so much more beautiful in person.  I did not end up wearing it to the wedding.  The zipper was a real pain on this dress -  I could not get the zipper passed the seam. I  would recommend sizing up so that you have the room to really work the zipper if you need to.  Even so, I'd rent this again (and next time get a 6).

I received SO many compliments on this dress!!! Loved this dress!! The colors were perfect for a summer wedding. The fit was not too tight and the below the ribs was so flowy that it covered everything! No need for spanks. I have long legs and a short torso so I thought I would wear the long size of the dress but I ended up wearing the regular one with a low heel and the length was perfect. Would recommend!

Lots of compliments on this dress.  Would buy if I could!  Super flowy and beautiful! Fit great!  The neck was a little tight, but not a big deal.  I went to a beach wedding so I didn't wear shoes.  The regular worked perfect for that.  Would get a long if I was going to wear heels.

Such a fun dress for a summer formal wedding! I absolutely loved this dress! I was worried about the fit, and ordered the 4R and 2P based on others' reviews and the size chart. The 4R fit like a glove through the bodice, although it was a little long even with heels. I didn't even try on the 2P but it fit my friend perfectly and she joked about crashing the wedding in the same dress as me. Someone else at the same wedding wore the same dress but in green, but the two of us and our dates were the only ones to notice (we think!).

Gorgeous spring gown! I rented this for an awards show in June and it was perfect. The long is definitely long and even with heels it dragged the ground a bit but I liked that look. It felt more expensive on the red carpet being long and there were already a lot of trains there. But if you will be running around a lot or dancing and you're under 5'8" I'd go with the regular. If you have a small waist and bigger hips this dress is perfect. Also it has plenty of room for a bigger bust (which I don't have but there was more room there lol) And the fabric is to die for, such gorgeous vibrant colors and moved like a dream. I paired it with bright earrings from RTR and got so many compliments. Color was definitely the fashion theme of the night and this dress fit right in. I would rent it again but it was so memorable the first time this one may be hard to pull off again ;)

It was right by the beach The waist was not as tight as I thought it would be in light of other reviews, given my apple shape!  did wear spanx, and had to pull my bra straps toward the middle plus pin them to the shoulders of the dress.  I loved the dress, I wore It to a black tie event in Florida and it could have been dressed up or down.  I am 5'4'' and wore it with flat sandals and it just brushed the floor.  I wanted to keep it afterwards!
The coastal setting! I am 5'6" and even with 4" heels the dress was too long.
B.E.A.U.T.I.F.U.L Was so easy to wear aside from a slight tripping hazard. Colors are vibrant and gorgeous. Tons of compliments.

Worn for an outside summer wedding.  I received a lot of compliments, the dress was stunning! The dress fit perfectly.  The staff at Rent the Runway were so helpful and I will definitely be a repeat customer.

Perfection I wore this dress to my bridal shower and the compliments did not stop. It is very flattering with the waist definition but still so comfortable. And the colors are just gorgeous. I wore the 2R and decided to go with flats so it just dusted the floor (I'm 5'8") but could have also worn a 2" heel with it. I did not want to send this one back.

This dress was a hit. I got a million compliments and I felt so beautiful in it.  I absolutely loved this dress, and I will rent it again! I have a very large bust, so it took a little effort to get "the girls" in there, but otherwise it was perfect in every way. My dress was the hit of the wedding! (After the bride, of course!)

Didn't end up wearing This was a backup style for me, and I didn't end up wearing it. It was a bit smaller than a standard 12. I LOVED the dress though, and would absolutely rent it for another event just making sure to get the right size this time.
My favorite renttherunway dress yet! This dress was perfect for a formal beach wedding. The pattern is unique and the fit is true to size. I got so many compliments all night!

The colors of this dress are incredible!  The model photo doesn't do it justice! The fit was slightly snug around the rib cage but layed beautifully across the chest and shoulders.  I felt beautiful in it.  Perfect for a beach wedding!
It was so comfortable, true to size and gorgeous color.  Received too many compliments to count! It fit perfectly.  I'm 5'7, wore tall heels and R was the correct length.

Great dress for a formal affair! This dress was may favorite rental this far! I received so many compliments and it fit like a dream. Though the length was a little long, I was still able to wear flat sandals so I was comfortable dancing all night. Would definitely rent again!

Such a beautiful, amazing gown! I wore this for a beach wedding in Florida in October.  Although the event was casual (guys didn't even wear suit jackets), I didn't feel overdressed because of the colors and fabric. I am 5'6" and 118 pounds so I wore the 2R with about 2 1/2inch heels and the dress just touched the ground. I was careful on stairs, but it flowed so beautifully when you walked. I got compliments all night on it and my family still comments when they look at pictures from the wedding!  I have another wedding this July (a totally different group) and I hope it's still available so I can rent it again!

The Perfect Gown for a Manhattan Wedding! I ordered this gown to wear to a New York wedding and my goodness, it was truly lovely!  In fact, the gown was so lovely it seems I never got around to taking a full picture! ;]

I ordered a size 2L and the 4R as my back up yet somehow the 2L ended up being just a bit shorter than the 4R. I contacted the Customer Service Department and to this day, I'm still in awe with how wonderful this process has been. My order was corrected with a new gown being shipped to our hotel - The process was seamless and stress-free! I'm truly thankful as our flight out to New York was a whirlwind within itself!

Although I ended up wearing the 4R, I couldn't have asked for more! It was a bit loose in the waist; however, the length was just about perfect! I'd say the overall fit is pretty true to size and it's a gown you'll absolutely love wearing! Just be ready for all the kind compliments you'll begin receiving!

AMAZING. Never have I ever received so many compliments on a dress. I wore this dress for a late-afternoon-into-evening wedding. The fit was great. It was slightly tight around the rib cage but not at all uncomfortable. The length was also really good. I'm average in height (just under 5'4") but typically find that floor-length or maxi dresses are still too long. I wore this with 3" heels and it was the perfect length. The colors are also incredibly vibrant in person. I would absolutely recommend this dress to others.

love this dress!  it fit PERFECTLY! i went with the regular instead of the long because i didnt want to wear heels, and it just hit the ground and didnt drag or look awkward. you also dont have to wear a strapless bra-  i wore a regular one and used a strap perfect to hide the straps in the back. this was my first time using rent the runway and i will definitely be using it again!

Incredible Dress! This dress was bright, colorful and comfortable! I LOVED the way it felt on and got a ton of compliments on it. It truly is a stunning dress. I got the long but still ended up wearing flats (I'm 5'8") because it just wouldn't have hit the ground otherwise. 
I was pregnant at the time and it had the perfect break in the dress to accommodate my bump!

First RTR experience was a success! Elegant and comfortable! The perfect dress! This was my first RTR experience.  I wore this dress to my work's holiday party. I thought the fit and style were very flattering, the color was vibrant and gorgeous and it was so comfortable.   This rental made me an instant fan of RTR!

The color was perfect and it was ideal for dancing at a formal wedding. I wore this to a black-tie wedding and it couldn't have been more perfect. This dress fit true to size, and the pictures just don't do justice to the color; I got a million compliments throughout the night about how beautiful the green was. The dress is also really light; I ordered the Curves for Days style as a backup, and in retrospect I was so glad that I picked this one since I didn't need to worry about pulling it up or overheating while dancing. Love love loved this dress.

Gorgeous dress, but a little long This dress was gorgeous! I felt incredible in it, and got so many compliments. My only regret is that it was a little long. I'm 5'2" and have very short legs. I wore 4" heels, and there was still about 2-3" of material on the ground. I was worried I would be stepping on it all night, but I got the hang of walking in it after a while (the trick is to "kick-walk" - kick the dress out a little before you take a step). 

I rented the 2 (my usual size) and a 0 because the reviews said it was open in the hips and butt. My butt is a size 4-6, while my upper half is 0-2, so I sized down for my back up. I tried on the size 2 first and didn't bother with the 0 because the 2 fit like a glove. I'd say this dress definitely fits true to size, and is tight all the way to your natural waist, or slightly below, if you have a shorter torso. 

Overall, this was a fabulous dress. The color was gorgeous. Pictures do not do it justice. The fabric felt very high quality. It was perfect. I'm not the type to wear the same dress to a formal event twice, but I'd make an exception for this. I loved it!

Amazing dress! Loved how it flowed and the way it hugged my waist.  The fit was perfect and I'm so glad I got this dress! At first I was hesitant about the color, since it's something I don't usually go for... but it was beautiful! I got the 4r as my back-up size and that fit pretty good as well, but I'm only 5'2 so the length was a little much so I stuck to my original size 6p which fit perfectly! Although it was petite I was still able to wear 4 inch heels and still not be able to see my shoes which I loved.  It does get snug around the waist, but it's nothing to be too concerned about. It's an amazing dress and will make you feel beautiful when you wear it!

LOVED this dress, sent as a backup b/c the previous dress was too small. Got tons of compliments!  Pro- true to size, lots of layers
Con- a little long and hard to dance in

We traveled to Napa Valley for an event and this dress made the night perfect! Oh this dress! It was so gorgeous. I got many compliments through the night and still have people asking about it. It fits true to size, but the is not much give in the chest/rib area. I am large in the bust area and it fit me snug, but comfortable. Length was perfect with 4 inch heels. I wore a regular strapless bra. The way the dress moves when you walk is stunning. I would 100% rent again! Thanks, RTR!

Nice fit.  I am 5'7" and wore 3-3.5 inch heels. The Long size was too long for me, even with the 3 1/2 inch heels, but the 6R was too short and looked awkward. I opted for the long even though I had to be very careful not to trip on it or get it caught in my heels. The dress is a good fit for curvier girls (I have rather large hips). I was surprised at how well it fit considering that I never tried it on before.

Great color and dress for a more formal wedding!  Overall I was very happy with the dress! I am usually a 12, mostly because of my large bust, but had to go with the 14 on this. There was not much give to the fabric, so to zip it up over my chest, I needed the extra space that the 14 had. It was a little short, I probably could have rented the L but, it still worked. I received many compliments on the color! It was mostly comfortable and forgiving b/c of the fabric!
It was nice having a colorful dress in a sea of black dresses! Perfect fit.  The other reviews were spot on.

The dress was very comfortable and flowy.  The color was not quite as pictured. I thought it would be a lighter emerald when in actuality it was more of a kelly green. 

I ordered a petite but received a regular length:-( It was a bit long but I pulled it off with higher heels.

Comfy, appropriate & flattering dress I loved this dress. Super comfy & flattering.  The only issue that came up with it, is that that zipper was a little hard to zip up past the middle belt-ish section. Other than that, great dress!
very comfortable fit well, true emerald green color

So fun to dance in this dress & received a lot of compliments!  The fit was spot on for the size, and unfortunately I could've used a little extra room in the banded mid-section/arm area; simply for more comfort, but it was not unbearable by any means. I loved this dress, and it hit the floor perfectly with a 2" heel. The customer service was exceptional when I discovered my other option dress was almost identical in color to the bridesmaids gowns!! (talk about awkward). I went with the Emerald dress anyway, and would do it again. RTR is the best!

Perfect for a black-tie awards ceremony our company was in...and we won!  Had zipper issues and had to have two people zip me into the dress. Very snug around the bust so if you're big in that area I would look for another dress (or order up a couple sizes). Flows beautifully when you walk and I got many compliments. My coworker wore the blue version (we didn't plan it) and we each loved the dress!
Great color! I ordered the 6R and 8R and the 8R fit great! A little small in the arms, but that was expected. Color looks great too!

Beautiful color - I felt gorgeous! As a nursing mom traveling with Baby for the first time I wanted not only to look glamorous but feel comfortable and wear something that would allow me to nurse easily. We attended an Indian wedding and this dress, paired with purple and silver accessories, held its own against all of the gorgeous colors - I got several compliments all evening! The dress was roomy enough for my post-baby body but fitted enough that I didn't feel like I was wearing a specially made post-pregnancy dress. The zipper was the only tricky part, as mentioned in other reviews. I couldn't zip myself up, and my poor husband's fingers became a little sore trying to maneuver such a small zipper. In all, though, I'm happy I rented this dress, and we got a great family photo!

This dress was Green Goddess perfection, with a healthy dose of Angelina Jolie red-carpet elegance. The dress fit perfectly. I absolutely LOVED the way the fabric moved when you walked, channeling Grace Kelly in a flowing chiffon number from "To Catch A Thief."   The Emerald green was truly stunning and I was overwhelmed with compliments all night.  If I could change one thing, it would have been to select one of the statement necklaces instead of the crystal peacock earrings, as the beautiful earrings were mostly hidden by my hair and didn't get the air time they deserved!  This dress is a winner and will make you feel like an A-List celebrity.

Sorority formal dress! This dress fit perfectly!  I was worried it would still be too short but I wore 3 inch heels with it and it was the perfect length!  I even took my shoes off for a bit and it wasn't too long.  I was worried because this was my first rental but it was great...all that needs to fit is the top part because it is a very flowy, flattering dress.  Got tons of compliments on it.  It is classy and elegant! Overall, perfect fit and the color is beautiful!

This dress was gorgeous! Got so many compliments on the color :)   I opted for the L because of my height and was able to wear 2.5 inch heels and it still swept the floor. It is very flattering. I have nothing but positives raves for this dress.  I am tall and on the curvy side. Probably could have gotten away with the smaller size, but this one made me comfortable all night long.

Dress fit great. Perfect for the occasion (black tie wedding).  Perfect length to wear with ~2 inch heels. My bra did show a tiny bit under the arm but that was my only complaint. Really comfortable. Great fit. Lots of compliments.
Such a simple, elegant dress. Loved the way this dress moved when I wore it. I didn't want to return it the next day!

This dress color is simply delightful. I wore this dress for a wedding, and felt like a goddess all evening. I received plenty of compliments and praises. I think that the color is really nice on blonds.

Not for the busty I rented this as a back up dress so it arrived last minute.  I tried it on and was not able to zip it past my bust (36DD).  Had to improvise and make it a keyhole back utilizing the hook/eye closure at the top and zipping it to the top of the fabric waistband.  It was certainly not ideal but I didn't have any options.  The dress itself was a beautiful color and actually, another girl at the wedding was wearing the same one in blue...looked amazing on her.  It is just not meant to fit ladies with large busts..even with the rigged up back, the cut made me look very top heavy/broad shouldered.  All that being said, RTW customer service is beyond spectacular and I will 100% be renting again in the future!!!

Great dress for a formal wedding! Very comfortable fit and soft fabric. The green is a fantastic color. I was worried it would be too long but it was the perfect length with heels. I loved wearing this dress and would rent it again in another color for a future event!

I got a ton of compliments on it all night long. Even one from the bride!  Dress fit perfectly. Also ordered the 4R and that was just a tad too small in the bust, but the 6R fit exactly. The color is how it appears on the screen. The dress draped and moved amazingly. I got a ton of compliments on it all night long. Even one from the bride!

I felt beautiful and comfortable in this dress. It fit great for me, being petite I am always worried something will drag on the ground, but it was perfect with a small heel. I felt very comfortable all night. I was very pleased with the customer service at RTR as well. I did not originally request this dress, but when I was unable to get the one I wanted, they were very caring and helped me find something that would work for me.

Georgeous color and flow I normally wear and 8, so I sized up from reading the reviews. I have a large chest. The 10 was still a little tight in the chest and waist. Could have probably been a little more comfortable in a 12. Great with my coloring. Hate to send this one back. It's stunning and I got compliments all night!!

The green was a perfect pop of color in a sea of mostly black dresses. The dress fit very well.  It was a little bit longer than I expected but I wore 4 inch heels which kept it off of the ground.  I got so many compliments on the color and look of the dress! It was very comfortable.

Looked great, wish it fit!!! This was my first sizing choice, my second was a 14L - I have a large ribcage and large bust, so the 12L fit perfectly everywhere except in the bust, and there is absolutely NO give in the fabric... If the 14 was available, I believe this dress would've fit perfectly, it was a gorgeous dress!

This gown made me feel so elegant and was perfect for the occasion! I attended my boyfriend's end of the year Military banquet and this dress was perfect for the occasion. It fit perfectly from the waist up and I absolutely loved the style. Unfortunately it was a little too long and I was holding it up most of the time to make sure I didn't step on it, but luckily we were sitting for most of the event. I highly recommend this dress!!! Very simple but you can really dress it up with jewelry and accessories!

Unfortunate I had picked this dress out in november and just wore it feb. 1st to my sorority gala. I received an email at 8pm the night before it was supposed to ship saying the 6L i needed was damaged and they couldn't send it to me. I had ordered my backup size as a 6R so that is what is pictured. I am 5'9 and the 6 Regular perfectly skimmed the floor without shoes. With 4in heels they were noticeable (see pic) the long with heels would have been perfect but slightly long without. I ended up not wearing this dress, not only because it was short on me, but because i thought it made me look a lot wider than i actually am. Also, there were MAJOR zipper issues. Ive read comments about people struggling and boy is it a struggle- it was even difficult zipping it on the hanger. It fit perfectly so its not that it was too tight to zip, but the zipper itself was an issue. The dress photographs a green blue color but its a more vibrant green like the model picture in real life.
Great color and dress! Length was perfect with my 3 inch heels.  I've worn this dress before in a different color...both were awesome!

Gorgeous color, and the heavy fabric was perfect for an outdoor evening wedding. The length on this dress was great -- I wore it with 1/2 inch - 1 inch sandals, and I'm a bit on the tall side. The bust fit nicely and the waist was snug but comfortable. I tried the 10 as well, but the 8 just looked better.

Second perfect experience with RTR.   This dress was breathtaking and I received so many compliments at my high school prom!  I wore it with the Nicole Miller Star Light Star Bright necklace also from RTR.  The length was perfect with my very high heels - it just reached the floor.
I wore this to officiate a black tie wedding - it was perfect! Great color, and incredibly flattering.  A bit tight around the bust, but I'm a 34C/D and it fit well.

amazing color and style for black tie!  I am typically a size 6, but have a full bust and often get too snug. I ordered the 6R and the 8R. the 8R was too long though it fit so much better, so I went with the 6R even though it was quite snug. I wish I had just worn the 8R and held it up a bit more since my event was mostly seated anyway. the snugness of the 6R made my arms and back "smush" out a bit... but overall got so many complements, especially on the style and color. It did make me feel quite princess-like.
This dress fit perfectly and was stunning on.  Simple but elegant.   Perfect on me.

Gorgeous color, beautiful fit! So hard to send this one back! This dress was absolutely beautiful and perfect for the spring wedding I attended. The shape and movement of the dress were incredibly flattering and it was so much fun to dance in. The color was rich and vibrant and I got so many compliments on it. I would say that it was tight around the ribs, so if you have a wider ribcage you might want to go a size larger. Other than that it fit perfectly. I wore 3" heals and the length was perfect. Highly recommend with the Ashley necklace to give it some sparkle!

I wore this dress for my senior prom and it was absolutely perfect for the occasion! I got so many compliments on the color of this dress, the green is seriously gorgeous! It was really light weight and pretty comfortable to wear, and was true to size. With 5 inch pumps, the dress just brushed the ground and it was the perfect length for me. I'm pretty small chested, but the dress was still very flattering on top, and also the cut of the dress was perfect to cover up my racer-back tan lines from my track uniform, which was super convenient!! Definitely loved this dress.

Very flattering and comfortable! Fit was perfect.  I typically fluctuate between a size 8 and 10, but ordered the 10R after reading the fit details regarding the dress possibly being fitted/tighter in the bust area.  The size was perfect as well as the length (I wore slightly platformed heals).

Easy Elegance I attended an outdoor wedding and wanted to be comfortable, but still formal. This dress was perfect! A few things to call out. I had to wear a strapless bra with this dress. A regular bra would of shown straps, but you could probably get away with wearing a racerback bra. Secondly, I'm tall and I was wearing the 12L with flat sandals. I did try the dress with heels and the bottom of the dress swept the floor, which is how this type of dress should be worn. I wore flats, because the wedding was outdoors. Overall the fit was true to size. Size 10L would over been a better fit for me, but they didn't have the size at the time, so the 12L was a little large on top. I suggest wearing a statement necklace with this dress and the color was great as well. Overall I would rent again!
Wore this to a black tie wedding, and it was perfect - easy to dress up.  Dress was comfortable, and beautiful.  Received many compliments, especially on the color.

AMAZEBALLS AMAZEBALLS
AMAZING AMAZING. Do it. I give you 4, RTR, not because you're the most amazing website in the world, but my zipper was broken,   My girlfriends had to.zip it up pliers and tight jeans style.  Finally we had no choice and we left it as a large keyhole back which was TOTALLY A PLUS bc it was hot and everyone told me how awesome the dress was!!   The men were swarming!  The dress is, shhhhhh, magical. 

FUN FACt:  sorry I forgot to take pics. I got drunk the second I stepped into the hotel.  Whooooops!!

This dress was perfect for the formal event I had to attend!  A beautiful color! This dress runs small, I normally wear a size 10 in dresses, but had to go to the 14 in the dress.  However, it was SO comfortable!  It was a beautiful color, the fabric was flowy and disguised those pesky problem areas beautifully!  I would highly recommend it!

The fabric flows beautifully. The color is even more beautiful than pictures show.  I wore an 8R which fit perfectly.  I am a true pear-shape and I didn't have to worry about this dress being tight on the hips at all.  It was snug, but comfortable at the waist, measuring just under 31" around (the high waist).  At 5'6 I only needed to wear a 2 inch heel, the length was perfect.  Received many compliments and remained comfortable all night.

Great customer service, they sent me back up options because my back up size wasn't available.       Dress was beautiful color, but had some signs of wear. Like the zipper had difficulty moving. Tight right below the bust for me. I still wore it but eventually changed to other RTR dress for comfort. Dress made me feel like a Greek goodness.

I wore this dress to a black tie NYE wedding. I'm pear shaped, so styles like this dress that are fitted at the top and flowy at the bottom are perfect for me.  I got the 6 and 8, but I wish I had gotten the 6 and 4 to see how the 4 fit.  The top was a little loose, so I had to add some "help."  I got lots of compliments on the gorgeous green color...I loved standing out in a sea of black dresses!

Beautiful color- flattering fit. Perfect dress for a formal event. I am 5'7 1/2 and did not wear heels and the dress fell perfectly to the ground with the 8R. If I had worn heels, I would've needed to go with the 8L. The fit around my waist was perfect and this dress was extremely flattering and comfortable. I would definitely encourage wearing a necklace with this dress, as it looked too plain without one. The fabric was beautiful and felt light but expensive. I gave this dress four stars instead of five because there was a stain at the bottom of it. Overall, I was very happy with the dress; it was modest but very beautiful. The cut around the shoulders flattered my arms and my waist looked tiny. I could move in it and felt comfortable sitting and standing and did not have to wear a bra. It was the perfect dress for this occasion.
The rich metal stood out in  a sea of black. It fit like a glove.  I'm 5'7" and wore the long cut so that I could wear heels and still have the dress meet the floor.

Absolutely stunning dress but runs extremely small in the rib-cage.  Loved the dress. The material was thicker than I expected. But it ran so small in the rib-cage/ bust area that I couldn't end up wearing the dress. I am normally a 6. Even the 8 didn't fit comfortably. Ended up borrowing another RTR dress from a girl who's dress ran bigger than expected (wore that dress in a size 4 and it was absolutely magnificent).

Everyone said this dress was stunning. The first dress RTR had a ripped hem, so they sent another overnight. The first dress had been a 12R, and since it hit the floor when I was barefoot, I had them send a 12L for the second dress, as I didn't want it to be too short once I put heels on. I wore 3" heels and the dress puddled a little tiny bit - it was perfect. I am 5'6.5". The dress was gorgeous. The zipper on both dresses was very hard to pull up when it got to the waist part - the dress wasn't too small, it's just something weird about the zipper.

Beautiful dress! I really felt like a goddess in this beautiful dress! Wore it for to dinner to celebrate our anniversary, and received a few complements from strangers. The color is gorgeous. I typically wear size 8-10 pants, but due to tightness across the rib cage ended up wearing the 12R dress, which fit comfortably. I think of my belly as my problem area, and this dress hid it well.  I'm 5'7" and wore flats; it definitely would have been too short with heels, but I was happy to wear sandals!

Felt beautiful all night This dress fit the way I expected. I'm 5'5" and I was still able to wear 3 inch heels with the regular length. I did have to be careful about sitting and scooting my chair in because the skirt is fuller than it looks. I would definitely pick a style like this again. Also, I was really happy that i picked a statement necklace to wear with the dress because it made it extra glamorous.

I felt so confident in this dress! Beautiful color and design! I LOVE this dress. I'm 5' 3"--I wore 4" wedges but they weren't quite tall enough. Next time I would go for a 4P instead of R because I stepped all over my dress while dancing. I'm 125 pounds, size 36C, so it was slightly tight in the chest and waste, but not too uncomfortable. In spite of the length and tightness, I would 100% rent this dress again, so many compliments!
This dress is pure elegance and the color is amazing.  True to size.

SO bummed!  I bought it for a formal event-when I put it on it didn't look like anything. Wish I could've wore it, I ended up borrowing a dress from my friend that was a simple black dress.  THe fit was nice but the dress didn't ahve a WOW factor and that was what I was looking for.

The color is AMAZING! I typically wear a 6/8 in dresses.  I ordered a 6R with the 8R as a back-up.  They were both much too small in the bust (I couldn't even get the fabric to meet).  I called RTR and the stylist was very helpful.  She sent me a 10R and 12R to try.  The 10 was also too small.  The 12R fit great and that's what I ended up wearing.  I'm glad I gave myself an extra day to try everything on because I never would have guessed I'd take a size 12.  I got tons of compliments all night on this dress - I felt awesome in it!  I would highly recommend this dress if you're going to a formal event - the color alone makes it a knockout!

A few things to note: there is no give in the fabric, so if you're busty, order a size up.  Also, give yourself extra time with the rental window in case you need the next size.  Regarding length, I am 5'3" and wore 3 inch heels.  The dress dragged a bit but was manageable.  The zipper is a little tough to zip, but I was eventually able to do it on my own.

Bottom line:  Rent this dress.  I loved it!!
Felt like a princess! The fit was perfect! The compliments I received that night made it even more beautiful. Felt like a complete princess!

Formal Dinner Event Dress was beautiful, elegant, and comfortable. I received a ton of compliments on the color and style! I wore 4 inch heals (with 1 inch platform) so the dress was just the right length - it you wear shorter heals than the dress might be a too long for shorter girls. I requested both size 0 and size 2 but the 0 was a perfect fit - my waist is about 26-27inches so the piece around the middle was snug but just right - could be a little tight if your waist is a little bigger. This was my first time using the service and I loved it and have already rented my dress for my next event in a few weeks!
Great fitting, comfortable dress!  True to size and able to dance all night!
This was actually my backup dress, and it was absolutely perfect! Fit wonderfully, wish I had ordered the petite.

OK, color great, fit not so much This dress fit extremely large.  I did not choose to wear it as it was just too big to be flattering.  Order a size down and it may be a different story with a more form fitting shape, but on me was just unflattering sack.  The color was great.

Gala fun I rented this dress for a formal affair for my husbands company.  It ran a bit larger so I was glad that I had ordered two dresses and had a back up.  It was very pretty though, just a bit big.

My husbands first Emmy nominations and I couldn't have felt and looked better! This dress is PERFECT This dress was every women's dream come true. I couldn't pass by someone without them saying "I LOVE YOUR DRESS!" I wore this to the Mid American Emmy's - my husband was nominated... twice :) This hugged my curves beautifully, fits true to size, slimmed me down, wasn't too tight on my hips (and I have very very wide hips), didn't have to wear a special bra, didn't have to wear a shaper, no tape required, length was PERFECT (I'm 5'4") with just a little train in the back. I can't say enough good things about this dress. PROBLEM; I WANT TO KEEP IT!! Don't think about it, rent it. You won't be sorry.
Gorgeous I loved this dress and looked fabulous.  In a sea of black dresses, this one makes you stand out.  The fabric is thick and the dress is well made.  You will feel like a star!

I felt like Miss America in this dress.  It was stunning and so so elegant. I went into the store so had to take the sizes they had (which was a 6L).  I'm usually a 6, but this 6 was definitely big on me. I'm 5'8'' and wore 4 in heels and the dress dragged a little bit (not terribly!) as it was a Long. I HIGHLY recommend!

SO many compliments!! This dress was beautiful for a 7:00 winter wedding!  The fit was definitely true to size, but I wish I had ordered a 2 instead of the 4R and 4L.  The 4L was SO long.  The 4R was perfect in length but was big in the chest and torso/stomach area.  I loved this color and style so much though and it was really flattering!
Makes a Statement! Gorgeous dress. Makes a huge statement without the need for much more in the way of jewlery. Loved it.

I wore the 2R!! This dress is amazing. I wore the 2R by the way but the system isn't showing htat as a size right now for some reason. Anyway, it fit absolutely perfectly. It might have been a smidgen long and I was wearing 5 inch heels, but was ok. The fabric is gorgeous and the dress is lined and very well made. Super comfortable. Danced the whole night. Tons of compliments and I really felt I could hold my own with all the ladies there with designers gowns running in the $thousands of dollars.

Beautiful dress and material. Received many compliments.  I am 5'2" and wore 3" heels and the dress was still a little long. I normally range from an 8 to a 12 in dress size (small hips and waste but broad shoulders and large bust) and in this case, I would have been better off with an 8 because there is a lot of room in the bust and shoulder area. I wish I had hips because this dress would have been best for wider hips/smaller waist!
Length is a bit short. I'm 5'5" and needed the 4L with heels.  Overall, beautiful dress!

Perfect dress for Prom! I loved this dress - I'm 5"1 and I wore the dress with 3" heels, and it fell perfectly. Not too short/long! It does show curves- I wore Spanx underneath to give a flat tummy look.

It's a beautiful red dress, everyone will notice you! Comfortable and easy to wear. I ordered both the 2R and 4R thinking they would be long enough for me, but they were both short. I ended up wearing the 4R because it was a tad longer than the 2R, even though the 2R fit me better. I had to wear flats which was fine, but it would have been better to order the L. Great dress, I loved it and loved wearing it all night. Very comfortable!

Great quality.  I wore it to my winter formal and was getting compliments all night! I wore a 2L due to the 0L not being available after bad weather delayed the shipping.  The 2 fit fine, but the 0 probably would have fit better - the two was a little loose.  I wore 3.5 inch heels and it was about an inch too long, but nothing that got in the way too much.  Customer service was GREAT. We had 12 inches of snow and UPS delayed the shipment, however we were able to track the fact that the dress was not going to be here in time.  We immediately contacted a go-to girl, who was not hesitant to overnight us not only the 2L of the original dress, but also two sizes of a similar back up dress.
This  dress was stunning, very comfortable on, material was sturdy and elegant. True to size, very comfortable fit, looked great on, tons of compliments
Way too big This dress is beautiful, but it literally sagged on me. Order this dress two sizes down.

Definitely stood out in a RED dress among black and white...  My friend and I were the only two in Red at a Fire and Ice party!  It was awesome to be in such a gorgeous red carpet type dress. I wore this dress for a black tie New Year's Eve party and it was fantastic.  So many compliments.  It was a little big through the waist/hips, but not too noticeable... made it very comfortable, but I think I would have preferred a smaller size, but the 6 wasn't available for me...  The picture shows a small train in the back, but I didn't really have a train... it is longer in the back, but just slightly.  I had 4 inch heels on and the front hem showed my toes, and the back hem didn't touch the floor.  So I am not sure how the train appeared...  Absolutely gorgeous dress and you will feel like royalty wearing.  Lined in a red satin and feels great on.

The color is amazing! It caught everyone's eye! I made channel 7 news & people thought I was a model the dress is a tad heavy but it slides on your body easily. I always shop for dresses that are made of polyester. I like it so much I was going to get the blue dress this year. I put on 10 lbs and was still able to make this dress look fab!

I need to dig up a pic.
This dress made me feel like a Hollywood superstar.  I never wanted to take it off, it fit like a dream.

BEST CUSTOMER SERVICE EVER! I promise!  Dress was a beautiful red color.  Fabric was amazing quality and fit very nicely. I ended up wearing my 2nd rental dress option to the wedding because this dress is quite loose around the stomach area for me.  I was looking for a more fitted look around my waist, and the other nicole miller dress i rented did just that.  If you prefer a dress with a littleee bit more room around the stomach/waist area, this is the one! you'll love it!

Pretty dress, but fit was odd Dress was great color and really stood out - especially with the great shoulder detailing. I was happy with the quality; the fabric was nice and thick. That said, the fit was very odd. First of all, it definitely fits large (I wore 1 size smaller than usual and it was still loose in waist). Secondly, it is definitely made for someone who is either apple or straight up and down. The 4 was tight in the boobs and shoulders, but I was swimming in it around the waist and butt. Lastly, the dress is really short. I am 5'2" and it was almost too short for me in 3-4 inch heels. My shoes were definitely showing. If you're any taller and are planning to wear heels - try the long length!

Wow factor and head turner! Rented this for an evening wedding we attended and LOVED it. I was the only one wearing red and the floor-length really made the dress that much more unique. In a sea of short black dresses, this made me stand out. I wore 4" heels and it was just touching the floor, so for those that are petite, consider a high(er) heel. I would totally rent this again for the right occassion.

very fun to dance in and was comfortable for the whole night  I loved this dress. It complimented my hair and skin tone well (brown and olive). Wear with red lipstick. The material is softer than the picture makes it out to be, but was still very pretty. It was a little big, but overall fit pretty well. A string of pearls and gold shoes give it an old Hollywood look
Beautiful Dress!!! Received lots of compliments...an Oscar worthy gown!  :)  The double-sided tape works wonders for the top of the dress.

The PERFECT dress for a formal affair! I wore it to a gala on Derby eve & got so many compliments! It fit perfectly. I wore a 2 Long, and it wasn't too tight. I normally wear a size 2. It was long, but was  perfect with 2-inch heels. I am 5'8"...and this was perfect for me! I couldn't be any happier with this dress!
Amazing dress! I wore it to my military ball and I got so many compliments.  RUNS LARGE. I probably wear a size 8-10 dress and I wore the 6 in this.
Beautiful! This dress was everything I had hoped for and more! It's comfortable, flattering, and it photographs wonderfully! I loved it!

Knowing I didn't have to run out to the mall and spend a whole day or two looking and trying on dresses and getting a much higher quality dress for the same price I would have spent at a department store. I only wear my dresses once anyways why not look unforgetable! I have never had so many complements in my life!! I wore this to a military ball and people we didn't even know wanted to shake my hand and take a picture of me in my dress. There were a few men that about knocked my date over trying to shake my hand. I felt so incredibly beautiful! 

I was nervous it wasn't going to fit length wise because I had to order the Regular as the long was not in...I am 5.5 and wore a 3 inch heel and it was perfect! Also I am a size 4 on top and a 6 on bottom with a hourglass shape...the 6 would have been way too big on my waist.

I felt like a million dollars and received numerous compliments!! I was very worried about this dress being too form-fitting and not working with my hips, but it fit beautifully.  It was a little big up top but not so much that I couldn't wear it.  It was a little long for me too, but I am short.  I might try the petite next time.  LOVED this dress!!!

Great dress!!  Fabric hung perfectly... Dress was great! I'm 5'5" and with 4 in heels, the dress was a perfect length to just graze the floor.  Lots of compliments... the fabric is nice and heavy with a little stretch so it hangs nicely and doesn't hug any lumps

Show stopper! Great color, heavier fabric. 
Size 2 was rather big around my waist and hips, but really tight around the chest. 
Im 35-25-38
Length was perfect for 5'9 plus 4inch heels.

This dress made me feel wonderful. 😊 I loved this dress. It was a perfect match to go with my spouses dress blues. It was comfortable and awesome. I ordered a 10 and 12 and they both fit but with my height I went with the 12 cause it give me a little more length. I got so many compliments.

Perfect Holiday dress! This is a very figure-flattering dress because of the fabric (it doesn't cling too much), and the way it gently flares our below the waist. The color is a deeper, more jewel-toned red, which I absolutely loved; it was the perfect shade for a Holiday party. I have a larger rib cage and was worried about zipping the dress up (it's a side zip), but had no difficulty with the 2P. The dress was a little short because I wore 4" heels, but I think the 2R may have been too long, and I didn't want to risk stepping on the skirt when dancing. Felt like a star all night long, and received many compliments!
Bold for the ball! The dress was beautiful, but isn't forgiving. Wear spanx if you have any trouble spots that you want to conceal.
Compliments all night! When I ordered this replacement dress, I was suppose to get a 10r and 12r... I got two 12r's. The dress is beautiful, but the 10 would have fit just fine.

super classy i got this one and a green one and enved up wearing the green, this was too big but for someone who would fit in it it would look amazing, super classy and comfortable, youd think the shoulder ruffle would get in the way but it really doesnt

Amazing color! This was the first time I rented from RTR. I ordered a 4L and a 6L as a backup. The 6 was way too big, and the 4 was a little bigger than I wanted it. They overnighted me a 2L which fit perfectly, other than being a little tight under the arms which was not noticeable to anyone else. Definitely order a backup in a size smaller than you typically wear. The dress was a huge hit and the color was beautiful. Rent this dress for any black tie event!

Best dress I've ever worn!! I wore this for a military ball (I'm in and we got to wear dresses which is why he is not in uniform) and honestly could not be happier with this dress. It was so beautiful and I got so many compliments throughout the night. I was a little worried because the dress I had originally ordered was ruined and they couldn't ship it, but RTR was amazing and called me to have me pick out a new dress with no extra cost (which is how I landed on this gem) 

Dress was amazing and I will definitely be coming back to RTR for future occasions!!

Gorgeous!  People still comment to me 1 year later about this dress- stunner! I am 5'10" and wore 3inch heels and it was still long.  It has a slight train- so not good if you are outside as it could damage the dress.  Heavy quality fabric- not overly fitted but still shows your shape.  Everyone turned to look when I walked in the room.  Looooove this dress!
Beautiful Dress! Fit perfectly.  Fits to size.
Beautiful and elegant dress! I received so many compliments of people I didn't even know. From the color intensity to the elegant yet simple style, it is a perfect dress.

This dress was bold in color yet classy in style. I got plenty of compliments. I felt perfect!  The dress absolutely fit my body type (hour glass) although may not be as forgiving on the gut. So I wore spanx which made a huge amount of difference.

Elegant, stunning, stylish, and comfortable! Perfect dress for a wedding or other formal event.  Loved this stunning dress! It was very comfortable while still form-fitting and elegant. The material traveled well and I absolutely loved the shoulder styling. No complaints at all and fit was great, though as others have noted it was a hair short and my shoes showed. I didn't mind that as I'd rather see shoes than be worried about tripping on it all night. Highly recommend this dress.
Wonderful This dress looks great on all body types, runs true to size. Tons of compliments. Highly reccomend.

Received a lot of compliments on my dress! I decided to visit the boutique on 5th ave at Henri Bendel so I could have a better idea of the dresses and the fit since it would be my first time ever using RTR. RTR is on the third floor and it's a cute little closet-like feel that has all the dresses hanging up. There were couches that you could sit on and all the jewelry were displayed very nicely.  I expected that I could try on dresses that I wanted to try on in MY size but they only had about 1 or 2 sizes of each dress in all the colors that each came in. I was looking at this dress particularly and once I tried it on I fell in love immediately. Now when I tried  this dress on I tried a size 12 (since it was the only size they had for this dress) and the girl who was helping me (Shoutout to Mounia for great service!) thought I'd be a size 6 (prior I had tried on other dresses and there was one dress in a size 6 that fit me perfectly). So, my package came 2 days earlier and unfortunately the size 6R was too big. Luckily, I emailed RTR and they were more then happy to send me a 4R on the following day. The size 4R fit! So I definitely say this dress fits TRUE TO SIZE. I wore this for my prom and received A LOT of compliments!! :) I will be using RTR again in the near future!

I LOVED this dress! I got many compliments at the party I was at and afterwards from the pictures! Oddly, I ordered the 6L and the 8L and the 6L felt bigger in the top. Not sure if it was from previous wear but anyway, I went for the 8L. I'm usually an 8 or a 10 depending on where the dress is fitted (bust or hips). The dress is very flattering for many figures. One warning is there is a bit of a train so if you're going to be walking around / up and down stairs a lot it's something to think about.

beautiful, elegant, well-made dress!! I rented this for a charity ball and it was beautiful - everyone loved it! Great thick fabric, fully lined, well constructed dress. I usually wear a 0 or a 2 and the 0 in this dress fit but was a little loose, so definitely go down a size for your back up. The fit of this dress is great, glides over your curves without clinging and the thick fabric is perfect for winter events. The length was good - I'm 5'4 and ordered regular length and wore 4 inch heels and it barely touched the floor in the front and had a tiny train in the back. Beautiful dress, I highly recommend it!

Great customer service, last minute over nighted for the marine corps ball! I'm glad the dress I ordered ran small, I would have missed out wearing this great dress! Fit amazing, great not too thin material. I felt so comfortable in it all night. I used a stick on bra for support, felt like a million bucks. Perfect for the birthday ball.

People stopped me just to ask about this dress! I LOVE the material of this dress. Not too light so it doesn't show every flaw! I am fairly tall so i ordered the long and it was the perfect length with heels. Great night made even better by a great dress!

Fun evening in a beautiful, eye-catching dress! Stunning and very flattering on an hourglass figure. Form fitting but not tight. If you have stilettos you plan to wear for this dress, get the Long size. otherwise, wear the regular. This dress runs a little large, so probably a good idea to get your second dress in a next size down. Also it does have a bit of a train in the back. Great dress!

The many compliments I received Probably my favorite dress ever. The material was nice and heavy and hung perfect. Loved the way it felt when I walked.
