Very flattering, but I could see if you had features you want to hide might not be a good pick. I am 5'10 and the length was good. Wore with 4" heels and you could only see a little of my toes.
Looked and felt beautiful and photographed well. I wore this for an industry event and it was super comfortable, hung beautifully and I got so many compliments!

I was told by more than 1 person that i was wearing the best dress at the wedding! Dress is fully lined and made of heavy fabric, so it lays really nicely. There is a slight train so i was a little worried about dragging it on the floor the entire night, but it was otherwise fantastic.  This was my back up dress, so i only had one size and it ran a little big, especially through the middle, but it still looked great.

Pretty! Got this dress as a backup incase the other RTR dress did not fit. The first dress did fit so I did not end up wearing this one but it is very pretty and fit great! It was very flattering for my fair complexion. I normally wear a 0 but this 2 fit me well. I don't usually care for fitted dresses so the 2 was perfect (the 0 would probably fit but once again, don't care for it to be body-conesc). My mom even tried it on and she is normally a 2 or a 4 and this fit her well!

Great glamorous color! A little long for me at 5'2 but heels helped. The shorter length would have worked better. There was some awkward gaping by the side zipper, but I was able to hide it. Not the best fit for me but pretty and comfortable.

Absolutely gorgeous. The dress is just fantastic. Fits perfectly and has a great impact. Go for it! You need to be in great shape in order to really look good: the solution was a spandex! I used a high waisted boyshort in order to have no lines but a defined waist, a butt lift and NO muffin tops. Worked perfectly. I order a Long size but need to do a front hem not to step on the dress but the final result was awsome as I made only 1/2 hem (front) and the overall effect was a longer "tail". The fabric is fantastic and has a superb finishing. I used for a very fancy gala in a upper scale club in NYC. As the dress has a gorgeous shoulder detail, better to make an updo if you have a long hair to show the greatness of this dress. No need to use many jewlery. A nice bracelet or cuff is enough. The only problem I had was to return the dress. The enveloppe was too tide to fit the 3 dresses+clutch in the box.
GORGEOUS dress for a black tie event. The fit was a little big but no one noticed except me.  Additionally, the dress is not very forgiving interms of underwear lines/a full stomach.

Overrated? I selected a 4R and 2L as my backup size after reading reviews from women with height and weight similar to mine. I had been expecting a dress that was great for an hourglass shape as advertised. I would strongly disagree with that assessment - and probably why the fit issue (I am fine-boned but have boobs and a butt). The waist is not nipped-in at all on this dress - and it runs HUGE! I probably would have been happier in the 0.

The material is fine, but I thought it was rather wrinkly and nothing spectacular. The lining is heavy and smooth which I think generates all the favorable comments.

Hope this helps someone else!

didn't fit right dress was disappointing.  it's a beautiful color and a great heavy material, but it probably looks better on straighter body types than curvier body types.  it was tight under the arms, but the rest of it was kind of too loose, and didn't show a waist.  no wonder everyone in the picture put their hands on their waists - otherwise, you don't see a waist!  RTR was great about sending another dress, which i loved.  good service, disappointing dress.
It was okay for me. Not sure if I'd do it again  The fit was bigger...couldn't wear the 14 because the side of the dress where the zipper was bunched up :( super comfy

I looked like I was ready for the red carpet thanks to RTR! Every dress fits my body differently, so I was extremely happy that I was able to pick two sizes. First time renting a dress! The fit of this dress is nice and snug, but the material is stretchy and comfortable. I am short, so was worried about length, but it was perfect with my heels. Many compliments when I wore this dress! Highly recommend it for a black tie event.

Great backup Ordered this as a backup for the Vera Wang Want and Wonder Gown, which worked better. That being said, this gown was lovely, a rich purple color with a great neckline and ruching that was appropriate. I would absolutely rent this dress again, knowing it fit well!

Great night with great friends Loved the dress...fit like a glove.. The dress was beautiful. 
Funny, or not so funny story...wore dress for a Mardi Gras ball....look one table away and see a person with the SAME dress...we are actually a guest of the same person. What are the odds....??????
That aside, I would definitely order from RTR again!

Glitter! Glamour! Gorgeous! I've never felt this glamourous before! The dress itself is stunning!  I received many compliments on the dress--especially the top and the back.  It was simple, yet had that extra kick to it.  

My shoulders were not as broad, so the top was a bit loose, but you can easily pin it together a bit more closely.  I could have worn higher heels for height, but heels were about 2 inches, and it ran slightly longer.  However, it really didn't matter. 

I'm glad there was RTR as an option--it was definitely a moment for a lady to dazzle! The best part was that my friend and I both rented dresses from RTR and definitely shined brightly! It was an evening to remember :)

Forever in love with this gown... While not the most comfortable garment to wear, you will look like a million dollars in this gown, so I guess it was worth it.  Sequins do cause chafing/redness (especially in the underarm area) as other posters have mentioned.  Other than that, this was my first rental (ordered this for my 10th Anniversary bash) and I adored the dress from beginning to end.  I am super tall and was concerned about the length, but it was actually perfect, even with 2" heels.  Also it fit perfectly and was true to size.  Purple is also my favorite color and the shine on this number was incredible.  Would definitely recommend, just remember that there could be some irritation when you wear this gown.  Well worth it for my special night.  Will remember this dress forever...

As the host and Friend put this dress is a show stopper.   I was nervous about fitting a 12 since I am between a 12 and 14 right now.  However the dress fit perfectly especially over my hips which tend to be my problem area when sizing a dress.  The ruching on the waist and stretch to the materiel is very forgiving.  Loved the tops and how it fastened  - it was the first time in a long time felt like I didn't have to worry about adjusting straps all night long.

I felt absolutely stunning in this dress. It was elegantly simple and unique. So lovely! This dress fit like a glove. It accentuated all the ideal places while securing my stomach in place after a colossal steak dinner and sugary confections. Body hugging, as mentioned earlier, while enabling easy movement for walking. I could use my normal stride. I wore 5 inch heals which allowed the dress to perfectly hover at the appropriate height. My only complains are that when I received the dress there was a thread hanging, which I smoothly snipped away from existence, and the sequins irritated my arms as I walked. Actually, by the end of the night, my arms were aching from the sequins. I received a multitude of compliments by strangers while strolling through the Palazzo. In fact, my dress was singled out to be praised by strangers among other prom dresses. I felt as if all eyes fell on me whenever I entered a room.

The dress was really sparkly and stood out in the crowd This was my first time ordering from RTR. Originally I ordered the Badgley Mischka Award Winner Gown and I had my eyes set on that for my pageant. Although I wasn't able to get it due to the damages of the gown a few days prior to the event, I was able to get another one just in time. This purple gown was actually the first one that I tried on when I was at the showroom and was already my second choice in case my first choice wasn't available. The sequins made the dress sparkle a lot when in the light and the color of the dress complimented my skin well. My only problem with the dress was the zipper. I had trouble with the zipper on both the 0R and the 2R dresses that I got. I was able to fit into both of the dresses; the only difference is the length. I choose 0R because of its shorter length and I didn't want to worry about tripping on stage. It was a little tight, can't say it was super comfortable, but I got used to it and it wasn't like I couldn't breathe. Compared to the size 0 of the Award Winner Gown, this one was tighter/smaller. Either that or I probably gained some weight in between. I really liked how I was able to show off all of the curves I have. I wish I knew about RTR sooner because I'll be renting from here a lot more from now on! Thank you!

Commandant's USMC Ball at the Gaylord so it was a blast!  Being 5'8 the size 6L was long enough but the 4L (not long enough for even 3 inch heels) fit much better up top. I opted to go with the size 6 though because it looked best with the heels I got. It was a bit stressful getting it to sit and stay exactly where I wanted but double sided tape is a god send. I got compliments all night long and ended up really loving how I looked in the dress. I would absolutely recommend it, but if you plan on doing a lot of hard dancing which I typically do, be warned that your arms will be incredibly raw due to the sequins. Overall gorgeous dress, color and super flattering. It's much more purple than I had originally anticipated but I was glad it was!

Amazing night for a 100th anniversary #MakeItBig gala and walking the purple carpet Dress fit like a glove, but was very comfortable. The deep purple sequins were spectacular for a night time event and fit with the theme of the gala. The dress was such a hit I had so many compliments and was happy to wear a designer with Philly ties. (P.S. I wore this with a purple fur shrug and it was fabulous!)

Customer Service helped me change my size order so quickly and free from stress!  I first ordered a 4L because I was originally going to wear these 6 inch heels. Instead I switched the order to a 4R and just wore 3 inch heels, which worked out much better because it was more comfortable. I'm 5'4 and I still caught my heel in the train of the dress a few times. I received loads of compliments and I couldn't be happier. The straps were a little loose on me but it wasn't a big deal. Overall this dress was perfect for my prom and I'll definately be renting more dresses from Rent the Runway :)

Perfect for a Mardi Gras Ball! Wore it to a Mardi Gras Ball and it was fantastic! The dress was very comfortable and easy to work with. The sequins look beautiful on camera. However, the dress was too short for my 4 inch heels and sequins tend to rub under the arm for a while. Other than that, it was perfect!

Stunning dress with a few hiccups!  This dress is drop dead gorgeous, and will turn heads!  Get ready to take compliments ALL night!  I did not have any problems with the sequins rubbing under my arms.  I did, however, have major problems with the lining coming up at the top of the dress.  I didn't realize it would do this until after I left for the event, if I had to do it over I would have remedied that small problem with fashion tape.  I found myself constantly worried about the liner showing all night! I thought I was going to need a 0, but ended up going with the 2 (my backup) when I couldn't zip the 0.  RTR is THE way to go!!

So sparkly!! This dress is beautiful. The picture does not do the color justice. It is more purple that this shows, but not so purple that you look like the purple people eating monster. It is just stunning. I wore it to a black tie event. I received another dress that just didn't fit me right. I called to replace it and got this last minute. My expectations were low, but it fit me like a glove. I wear a size 8 90% of the time. It has an extremely forgiving fabric that moves nicely. The ONLY con is that the sequins are scratchy under your arms. It isn't so bad that it will hurt you, but the next day, you'll notice it.

My dress dazzled at my college homecoming ball which was also my 22nd bday! The dress made the night The dress fit perfectly but was a little scratchy to wear longer than an hour because of the sequins. The dress actually fit well on my bust but was extremely long even with heels which amazed me for my height. All in all I loved the dress and it was an instant classic eye-catcher!

All eyes on this dress! The dress was amazing! All  eyes turned to me as I walked in, haha. I had a gala to attend and this was perfect. It does run big so get a smaller size. It  will fit perfectly if you do. Yes I knew it might bother my underarms because of the material, but I was fine with that for looking amazing.

I wore this dress to a gala and someone told me that the gala should be held in honor of my dress!! This dress was perfect. The zipper was a little bit sticky and required some help from a friend, but other than that it fit like a glove and I was so happy. The sequins are sharp but whatever, it looks great. It's so flattering and very forgiving.

Perfect fit! "Stunning" and "beautiful" were the 2 primary compliments :) This dress fit very true to size for me, and it was comfortable and even stretched a little.  And thankfully the 6L fit because the 8L was about 4 inches shorter than the 6L and would have never worked! Other women commented that the sequins rubbed their arms but I did not experience that at all.  I will definitely be getting more dresses from RTR in the future!

Beautiful dress! Loved this dress, it fit perfectly with no surprises. I was really worried about the length because I am 5'11 but the gown touched the floor even with heals on! I will definitely be using rent the runway often. Some other revues talked about the sequins under the arms itching and causing discomfort but I never had a problem.

This dress was a hit! I felt very glamorous! The dress was a perfect fit, and the length was great with 3in heels.  The dress has a bit of stretch which provides a little forgiveness.  As with any sequence dresses, your biceps will scrape a little against the dress - but it's a small price to pay for how you will feel in this dress.  I wore a backless bra, so the opening in the back was easy.  The purple is a dark, elegant color - such a welcome change to the usual black!  Love Love Love this dress and all the compliments that came with it.

Pretty sparkles that photograph well Itchy sequins in armpit area. High quality design sequins did not fall off. Tight in bust area, had to take size 4 instead of ordered size of 2. 5'7'' wore the regular length with flats and people stepped on the back of the dress often.

Gorgeous dress, tons of compliments, but... I should have heeded the warnings of previous reviewers regarding the lining popping up at the chest.  It happened all night long.  I tried double sided tape in various placements but it did not work!   Other than that ..beautiful dress! Unfortunately my pics are too big to upload!
Dancing The tall size would have fit better and allowed for heels but the dress was gorgeous and I was comfortable all night! Highly recommended.

sparkly and elegant! I wore the size 2, and it fit me pretty well overall! It was a little long, however I was wearing 6 inch heels so that helped. I loved the color, style, and fit! I recommend this dress! and I wish I owned it!

Absolutely loved this dress! I wore it for my senior prom, and I felt like a princess.  It was a little big on the top. I wear a 32B bra, so I had to double up my bras and it was still a little loose with the sleeves. I wore a 4L, but also fit in the 2L. I am about 5'10" and I wore about 3in heels. The length was perfect.

This dress stood apart from everyone else's.  Definitely unforgettable! This dress is BEYOND perfect.  I wore it to my junior prom and everyone loved it just as much as I did! The dress fit perfectly! I do have to say that I was a little scared that it wasn't going to be long enough because I'm 5'11, but it just reached the floor (no heels worn).  The dress wasn't as itchy as I was expecting it to be so that was a plus.  And it hugged my curves in all the right places.  I was also worried about either spilling out of the dress or not having enough cleavage, but it was tight enough to give me a perfect lift! I would recommend it to anyone who is looking to stand out on the dance floor!

I loved this dress.  Very comfortable and easy to move in.  Highly recommend! Great formal dress!!!  The dress was a smidge tight but the underlayer/lining makes it easy to move in.  I would definitely rent again!

Rented gown for contemporary glamour portrait session. I'm a boudoir and contemporary glamour portrait photographer located in Central PA and I rented this stunning gown for my client's session. She wore the size 8 and it fit her perfectly, and that color looked amazing on her! She usually wears only black but I was able to get her to trust me on this dress and she was thrilled how she looked. The fabric had just enough stretch and had a luxurious feel to it. She didn't wear a bra with it but we did place cutlets in to give her just a bit more of a boost. 

http://shannonhemauerphotography.com/
beautiful dress Had someone with the same gown on, but it was a beautiful dress.  Loved it and felt beautiful

I didn't want to send the dress back, the perfect senior Prom gown.    Like other reviewers, the only problems I had were the loose shoulders and a minor rash from the sequins underneath my arms.  I ordered both the 2R and 4R because I generally wear a 4.  Although the dress information says to order the size up I decided to go down instead based on some other reviews.  I ended up wearing the 2R, it worked really well and accentuated my curves.  I am curious to see whether the 0R would have maybe even fit a bit better.  I wore a strapless (very padded) push up bra which help tighten up the loose arms, if I had time to get one of the sticky push up bras I would have because that probably would have worked much better.  I am 5'3" and with 4" heels the length worked really well, it dragged a bit but I would prefer that to it being too short.  Overall, the dress was absolutely perfect for the occasion and I received enormous amounts of compliments. My Rent The Runway experience went so smoothly that I can't wait to use them again!
Oscar party 2014 The lining on the neckline kept rolling up and showing, and the sequins were scratchy but other than that it was awesome.

I adored this dress!  The fit of the dress is perfect for curvy women. I am usually a size 10 in dresses, but the eight fit my curves the way that I like, with enough rough to stuff my face with hors d'ouvres. My husband, a self-professed sequin hater, was blown away when I walked into the ballroom at the wedding we were attending. He was in the wedding and wearing a lavender-esque vest and bowtie and this dress complimented it beautifully. I chose to wear the Long version because of my 5 inch heels and I could still see the shoes below the hemline. If you are taller than 5'3", I suggest wearing the long and a MUCH shorter heel.
Perfect dress for prom. Recieved  lots of complements  Perfect fit and length.
Received many many complements on this dress. Fit wonderful!!! Not stiff or tight, just right.

Eye catching dress! This dress has a very nice fit.  The fabric is stretchy, so I suggest going a size down.  I ordered the 2 and the 4 based on other reviews and ended up wearing the 2.  

 I'm 5'0 and the length was not an issue with 3" heels.  

The shoulders were a little big, but that was easily fixed with a safety pin.

Beautiful dress Hard to zip up. I am regularly a size 6. I went to the storefront and tried the dress on. The size 0 (to my surprise) fit perfectly. The dress I got had not been stretched out and it was tough to zip. Once on, however, it was beautiful and I had no problem at all. Love it!

I was the birthday girl and turned heads at my Mardi Gras masquerade birthday party! The dress fit perfect. I tried on other dresses with RTR and they actually did not fit. The color really stands out.

Mardi gras barbie! I ordered a 4 and 6 long and the 6 fit well, but the 4 looked even better!  I read reviews that said the sequins rubbed under arm really bad, but i had no problems!  I danced, ate, walked around in the dress all evening and never had any problems or felt uncomfortable. I loved this gown!

No one else had a dress quite like it - the color was beautiful and unique, and fit was beautiful. It does fall down a little bit in the front and reveal a strapless bra if you're wearing one. I had to hike the top up throughout the night - however, I am very busty (30G) so that experience will only likely replicate itself if you're similarly busty. It was a beautiful, beautiful dress.

Absolutely loved this dress!  This was my first time renting from RTR & was bit nervous. One of the reasons b/c I am so short I worried about the length, but w/ 4 inch heels the dress was it perfect.  The 4 fit perfect everywhere except the sleeves; they were probably needed to be taken in about a 1/2 inch. The good thing is they didn't slide down & stayed put, so wearing the dress wasn't uncomfortable.  I wore this dress to a gala & received tons of compliments on it. It was perfect for an evening of glitz & glam. Overall I would wear this dress again in a heartbeat & will be renting again for a wedding.

Perfect dress for Junior Prom! It fit perfectly and was gorgeous. Everyone loved it! The sequins started to scratch my arms after a little while, but it wasn't bad. I am 5 feet tall and wore 4.25 inch heels and the length was perfect. I was very nervous about the length because when I tried it on in a size 4 at the store it was really long, but 2 sizes smaller and it was perfect.

Regular is short This was a back-up dress for a formal wedding and I ended up not wearing it because it was too short.  I'm 5 foot 4 and I couldn't wear heels with it.  Otherwise, this is an amazing dress.  I would say this runs true to size and maybe just a hair on the small side for my taste.  I

LOVE IT!!! I wore this dress for my nieces sweet 16... it was very comfortable ... no complains. I fit into a 4R but i am a 36D so the top was a bit tight and chose the 6R the length was PERFECT as well - LOVED LOVED

Breath Of Life Gala in SF, supporting the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation I rented this dress to wear to a fundraiser supporting the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation. Our 2.5 year old was born with CF. (Please learn more at cff.org) Purple is the color of the CF Awareness ribbon.

The shoulder straps of the dress were very loose on me. There was one to two inches of fabric that I had to safety pin up in the back to keep the dress up and avoid a wardrobe malfunction. The sticky tape that RTR sent with my order did not help as it just stuck to the inner lining and made the lining show. This could be due to the fact that I have virtually no boobs from breastfeeding two kids. But it is worth noting that it did not fit on top. I do agree with the sequins being very scratchy! I would not recommend this dress to ladies with my figure, with nothing to put in the top of the dress. Also, the alternate size 8L was so big that it would have shown my whole chest area had I worn it. Just noting that also. The rest of the dress fit great, very flattering

Wish it fit better! This is a gorgeous dress- the color is lovely and it sparkles beautifully!  However, the fit wasn't right for me so I didn't wear it.  The fabric is quite stretchy everywhere but the bust, so it was easy to sit down but "the girls" were not comfortable!  On me, the straps were a little loose so I would have been tugging on them all night long, and the sequins were starting to bug me after half an hour, so I think  it would have been miserable to wear all night.  I ordered the 6 long, but it didn't seem like it was very long at all, as it just barely draped when I was flat-footed.  I'm bummed I couldn't wear it, though- it is beautiful!

The dress fit like a glove - I got compliments all night.  The dress has great elasticity so it's form-fitting while being super easy to dance in. It did cause a rash on my underarm from abrasion on the sequins - totally fine though because it's such a killer gown.
Perfect dress for Mardi Gras!  The dress fit true to size and was comfortable.  I received so many compliments!

Received a lot of compliments on the dress.  The dress fit perfectly. It is very flattering on the body. The only con is that the sequins are scratchy and can be a little painful when it rubs against your skin.

First off, the service was so easy and fun to shop. Second, my dress got so many compliments! Perfect length for someone of my height w heels. The sequins under my arms really didn't scratch. My skin as bad as some of the other reviews lead me to think it would. The length of the straps in the front were a little long for me, but I just shifted the length to the back and it worked out fine. Super comfortable, super easy to wear.  Loved it!

Finally got to play dress up with my husband again!  The 6L fit great except I thought that it might have been a little longer.  Then again the model is bending her knees so it looks longer.  I ended up wearing my flats but they still showed which was kind of annoying.  But overall the dress was pretty and I got lots of compliments.

This was the PERFECT Jr. Prom dress!  A special dress for a special night! The dress was even more beautiful in person! It fit like a glove and was comfortable - an added plus!  The neckline was stunning and can be worn by any size bust.  The back was beautiful making the dress stand out whether I was coming or going!
The dress had a timeless feel that made me feel elegant all night.

I received sooooo many compliments on this dress for the Viennese Ball!! It's absolutely stunning!!! The dress is actually the slightest bit stretchy, but is still true to size. The typical problem with sequin dresses is scratching, but that didn't happen with this dress! Highly recommend this dress if you want to stand out in a crowd!

This was a backup dress that I didn't actually end up wearing.  I usually wear a 2 or a 4, and the 2 fit like a glove. I didn't end up wearing the dress, it was a backup order. I would caution anyone ordering it with a larger bust, the chest was pretty snug on me and I have a smaller chest.

The one thing I wasn't thrilled with was that the dress is more "purple" than the picture presents. The picture to me looks like a dark purple, with the sequins blending in. The dress itself wasn't a darker purple, and the sequins were on the larger side and did stand out.

This dress made me feel absolutely AMAZING! This dress was a last-minute replacement for the dress I had ordered, but it was absolutely perfect for our Gala.  I received so many compliments and could move and dance all night. I wish it came in a 14 as the 12 was really quite tight across my bust, but then again, my bust is not small. Spanx were a must, as well. The regular length was perfect for wearing comfortably short heals and later going barefoot on the dance floor. I definitely recommend a shawl or bolero jacket as the sequins under the arms did rub a bit.

A fraternity gala Typically, I have concerns with dresses fitting over my hips. With this dress I didn't have any issues with that. I did have issues zipping the dress past my rib cage. I probably should have ordered the next size up instead of the next size down. I felt like the dress was too tight but as you can tell in the pictures it really wasn't that tight. I didn't have any issues enjoying the event. I received lots of compliments on the dress.

Beautiful color and style, fit fabulously! I received this dress and a second one, and I ended up wearing the other dress to the ball (USMC Birthday). I'm still carrying an extra 10-15lbs from pregnancy, and I thought the other gown was a little more slimming in the mid section and hid some of my flaws/bulges. Overall, though, this gown fit great! The fabric is stretchy, so it fit nicely and comfortably all around. The bustline is sexy without giving it all away. The sequins were a little itchy, but nothing like I've experienced in the past with formal gowns. Then again I have yet to find a gown that doesn't itch a little somewhere! The color is muted - think eggplant or plum - and is not as purple as it is in some of the photos from other wearers. I wished I had a second function to attend that weekend so I could have worn this dress, too.

Compliments all night long! I'm very petite and was a little nervous about how the length would work. But, this dress was perfect! Fit like a glove, and since my husband is tall...and I'm very short...I can get away with wearing some pretty tall heels. I wore 4" heels and the dress just hit the floor.  I received so many compliments, and didn't feel at all uncomfortable the entire night. For my first rental, I was very very pleased!

Purple, Sparkly, Beautiful, what more could a girl ask for? This dress was perfect for me and for my event! I rented this for a formal event I had to work at. It's beautiful, comfortable, and did I mention beautiful? Even though it's skin tight, it was very flattering. I wore the regular length, which was perfect for flats and added 6 in the long would have made very high heels necessary so glad I went with the shorter while I was working. I didn't wear a bra at all and felt supported, but could have used a little push-up to fully fill out the bust. Overall, I felt beautiful and comfortable! Would definitely recommend
All the compliments. This is an eye catcher!  I wore 5 inch heels and the dress looked amazing, it was floor length and easy to walk in.

Did not get to wear it to my event...see details below. The dress was really tight and an awkward length (short). Just from trying the dress on, I had scratches from the sequins. I ordered a size up and it was still really tight. Not flattering in the chest area. I unfortunately had to return it without wearing it to my event.

n/a I loved this dress! This was my first RTR experience and it was perfect! I am normally a 8L but since I was 4 months pregnant when wearing it I opted for a 10L with the 8L as back up. The 8L was a little too tight to zip but the 10L was perfect. The length showed the peeps of my toes with 3 inch heels but I still held it when going up and down stairs so I did not trip over it. I wore this dress for a formal NYE party and received many compliments! My babe bump at the time was not huge but the dress flattered it perfectly so I did not just look like I ate too much. In regards to the arms being tight, they were fine, you definitely have to do some extra pulling to get them on but they were not too tight in either size.
This is the first time I ever use RTR, best decision I've ever made GREAT DRESS. It fit perfectly, loved it.

NYE Sparkle! I rented this dress for New Year's Eve.  I didn't want a long gown, but by the time I started looking on the site most everything I liked better was already rented.  I decided I would go with this one as it was one of only a few left with sequins and it would likely be warmer on what was forecast to be a horribly frigid NYE.  It was pretty comfortable, however lifting my arms up was pretty much not an option.  It fit well, but was too short to be as slimming as I'd hoped.  I ended up wearing kitten heels with it to make it less noticeable, which was nice in the end because I was able to stand and dance for longer periods of time.   I only got one compliment from a girl in the line for the restroom.   Overall, it was okay.

Wonderful first Rent the Runway experience! I rented this gown for my company's holiday party. The dress was delivered perfectly on time. I rented the 12 and the 14. Both dresses fit, but the 12 was just a bit snug on my arms and chest, although I am fairly top heavy so I was not surprised. I ended up wearing the 14 to the party and felt so glamorous! I love the way the dress fit, it was sexy but not revealing and hid any problem areas. I wore 4" heels which were the perfect height for the small train in the back. I got so many compliments too! I will definitely rent again!
Great dress  This dress was perfect it fit great and I received compliments all night long. My only complaint about this dress is the zipper it was hard to zip.
Could not wear this The fit of this is incredibly small, especially in the sleeves. The midsection of the dress does nothing for a curvy figure. Overall, much better for a short, petite, figure.

Felt very elegant! This is the second dress I rented and just love, love the whole experience. So I was picked as one of the best dressed woman of the night at my husband's black tie even and I attribute it to this beautiful dress. We ended up winning the "couple of the night":) It was very comfortable, even though the length was a little too long... despite my 3.5 inch heels. I can't wait for the next event to go to  so I can rent again!!

I received more compliments on this dress than in anything I've ever worn to a formal occasion.  The fabric was comfortable and was form fitting everywhere I wanted it to be. I am a 34C and the bust fit perfectly with lots of give. I'm 5'2", wore 3 inch heels and the length was perfect.

I got compliments all night long! This dress fit beautifully and looked amazing!  It was very comfortable and only a tiny bit itchy around the edges where the lining rolled under and pulled the sequins with it.  Girls from my school kept complimenting me and according to multiple people I had the best dress of the night!  I didn't have trouble with the zipper like other people had mentioned, but it's helpful to have somebody help with the hook on the back.  This is a gorgeous dress and I highly recommend it to anybody who wants to rent!!

Definitely my dress  I was nervous as I had never done this everything went very well the size 12 was perfect.
beautiful dress I recommend.

easy delivery and return Fit well. 4L fit better, except it was too tight around the arms and I couldn't lift them up very far so had to wear the 6L. The arms are restricted due to the design, but you get used to it & it looks great/ unique. Long enough!

Overall happy and will use the website again

Dress arrived on time, perfect condition.  Loved this dress.  Easy to wear, comfortable and beautiful   Great fit -- it runs true to size/ a bit large.  I ordered my size (4) and one size up -- next time would do my size and one size down  Think a 2, if it would have zipped up over my back/shoulders would have given a better fit over waist/stomach  The long was perfect length with 4 inch heels - and I'm just shy of 5'7".  Very flattering!  Highly recommend.

I felt stunning! The dress was beautiful but ran a little big.  I should have selected a smaller size.  The dress does have give, so I would suggest getting a size smaller.  I had no problems with the sequins or itchiness that some other customers described.  The dress did not feel heavy either.  The length was perfect for three inch heels.  I would recommend renting this gown!

BEAUTIFUL DRESS I wore this to a masquerade ball and the dress was a hit - we won most elegant couple!  I'm only 5.2 so I did use some hem tape to shorten the front.  I wore the 12, but could have worn the 10 - I just like loser clothing, and I'm an apple.  The fabric was very stretchy and comfortable.  I also received a gift with my order that included some hair care and skin products to try - THANK YOU RTR.

Love the dress for a black tie affair. Got lots of compliments. Will definitely use runway again! Ordered a 10R, the dress is heavy, fit true to size, snug the way I wanted, but was not long enough because I have a lot of junk in my trunk which raised the back of it. I'm 5'2 and wore 3inch heels and it barely hit the floor and the train was nonexistent. Also, the 10 had a funny odor to it, almost made me nauseous, so I decided to wear the 12R. Had no odor, it fit looser but was a little longer and had a little train.  If you have hips and/or a plump derriere, I would suggest getting the long. There was another lady at the event with the same dress on but there was enough people there where we didn't run into each other again.
LOVE IT! ITS A COMBINATION OF ELEGANCE AND VINTAGE. IT GIVES A VERY NICE SHAPE TO YOUR BODY. I'M 5.2, 2P WAS TOO SHORT. I DECIDED TO WEAR 0R WITH HIGH HEELS.

Many, many compliments on the dress! I felt like a very sexy rock-star! I typically wear a size 14, however I ordered last minute and 16 was the only available size. The 16 actually fit nicely, however the upper back hung off A LOT but I was able to pin it and it looked perfect.
The event. I really needed a size 16, however, I pulled it off with the 14.

THE DRESS!  Really amazing dress! It fit like a glove but didn't show every nuk and cranny of my body, which was AWESOME. Wore the dress for NYE and it was a showstopper! Very easy to get on and off and the train was super cute, nice touch. The inside of the dress had wires in it almost like a bra underwire, and it kept the dresses form when I had it on, had maybe 5 or 6 wires going vertical at the top of the dress BUT it was poking me a bit on the inside, so I had to sit kind of upright at all times so I wouldn't get poked. The dress could have been longer, had to hold it up when I walked or my heels would have gotten caught, but that was the only one available when I ordered it, so I know for next time. The heels were about 4 inches and I'm about 5'6 with no shoes on, so keep that in consideration when renting. Overall really loved the dress, and so did many other people, loads of compliments!! Will definitely rent this again.

Ultimately returned this one - low mobility in arms and not flattering through midsection. This dress photographs super well and outshines others on the website because of the sequins and off-the-shoulder sleeves, but was not as impressive in person.  The structure of it (ruching through the midsection and boning around the chest) did not make for a flattering fit, in fact, I felt like a sausage in it.  The sleeves were adhered to the body in such a way that limited arm movement and would make for awkward dancing, and the sequins under the arms chafed a bit.  When this dress arrived I was pretty bummed out about having to wear it to my event because I didn't feel beautiful or chic.  I wanted to feel like a sexy Jessica Rabbit (the model looks great in it!), but I felt like a chubby Vegas lounge singer (sorry I don't have photo evidence).  Thankfully I was able to swap this dress out for another one in time.  Phew!  Thanks for rescuing me, RTR!
Gorgeouse The fit was true to size , sexy and, I moveD in it with ease and elegence

I never had so many compliments on a dress. It fit perfect and was very flattering!!!  Fit perfect!!!! The cut is perfect to keep your arms warm and covered. Ideal length! You don't even need to wear Spanx with this one!
Was too small for me to wear.  After I tried it on, the snap broke. I decided it was too risky to try and wear it.

I received tons of compliments on the dress. It was great fun to be so dressed up.  I ordered two sizes – 10 and 12. Upon receipt, I tried on the 10 first. It would not begin to zip. I had a moment of panic thinking the 12 would be too small as well. There isn't a lot of difference between two sizes....The 12 was perfect with a little extra room. Just for fun, my 15-year-old daughter tried on the 10. She is slim and wears a size 0 or 2....the 10 fit her without it being "too big." I'm wondering if the 10 is sized small?

LOVE it, but go up a size or two! I wore this for a mommy and me photoshoot and felt great. I wore a Badgley Mischka sequin gown for my wedding and wanted to keep the sequin theme. The off the shoulder felt sexy but mature. I was under the impression that it would be a little bit looser in the tummy but it is fitted. My post baby belly fought me some, but otherwise I loved it. Defiantly upsize and get the long, unless you're very short. Love this dress and the confidence it gave me. Will rent again

I had to buy a dress instead. The dress was gorgeous and fit well through the waist and hips.  The length was also good.  Unfortunately, one would have to be very well endowed for the top to fit.  It was hopeless on me.  I had to return it.
Perfect packaging and you just can't beat convenience. The only down side was you have to be creative and tuck in the hanger straps so they don't keep popping out.

True to size a little tight in the arms but still fit. I was actually almost 4 months pregnant when i rented this dress. Because all the reviews said it was strechy and forgiving i took a chance and it still fit great. I got so many compliments that night. It was comfortable. My husband had to zip me up because it was too hard to do alone.

Beautiful, but not my style I love the sparkle and glamour of this dress, but it was not for me (I did wear the same style in navy, also available on RtR). The long was not available and might have had a better fit, but this was tighter than the non-sequin dress and had less "give." I'm so glad I was able to rent two dresses for a wonderful price.
meeting the royals kate and william! great fit, perfect choice for a gala event. elegant and classy and held my own next to the princess!

It fit well i love that the top part which felt like a corset top. made me feel good  The cons of the dress i wish it is tighter in on the sides but overall it was great i looked good plenty of room ob bottom , very easy to move.  The zipper was really hard to zip but it zipped.  Made my boobs look good to so very healthy.
Loved this dress! So comfortable and stunning Can't wait to rent the runway again.
This was a beautiful dress, elegant and impactful.  It drapes beautifully It does flatten your breasts a bit, I ended up buying a corset to push everything up a bit.

GORGEOUS, GORGEOUS, GORGEOUS! I did wear a strapless bra but all things considered (I'm a 36H) I had NO problems.  The sequins hide any 'lumps and bumps' and the boning kept the dress in place all night through cocktails, dining, awards and some major dancing.  Perfect length.

Worn at the Black and White Masquerade Ball at the Ocean House , Watch Hill, RI  February 2013 The gown came  on Thursday nicely packaged.  I couldn't wait to try it on.   The 8 fit perfectly and the hem was right with 3.5 " heels.   I loved wearing the gown I received alot of compliments.  RTR  was easy, fun and fits a busy lifestyle.   I'm renting all my special occasion dresses.  Can't wait till the next time!!!

This dress made me feel like a celebrity. Perfect for my special day! I felt like this dress was true to size however for you taller ladies I would suggest getting the long if you plan on wearing heels. I am 4'11" and wore flats and it draped on the floor perfectly. Be prepared to have someone assist you with zip up in the back (for you ladies that did that independently good for you!! LOL)  Amazing dress, amazing fit. I will definitely be back for more. The service is wonderful. Great company!
Stunning dress.  Size 2 would have been a better fit for me. overall, the dress looked beautiful and I had many compliments.
Comfortable dress that hides any flaws It was a nice dress that hid my arms and stomach.. but I wore the 6L with 4 inch heels and the train made it difficult to walk in.

Confused.  Inconsistent I love love love rent the runway but not this dress.  As others stated this dress is inconsistent.  I am almost 5'8" so I ordered a 6 and 8 long.  The 8L was smaller and way shorter than the 6 L.  The 6L was still a little short so I opted for another dress I selected which I absolutely loved.  I'm a 6 pants but a large 36D bust.  The 6 puckered at my hips in the front although it zipped fine.  I felt the 6 was a little tight in the arms BUT  it's also one of my weaker areas so I'd say that's more about me than the dress.  So in summary this dress is great for petite's and I would recommend sizing up and getting the free extra size just to be on the safe side.

Was anxious, as this was my first experience with RtR, however, the dress was exceptional and I had a great evening!!! Wore this to (yet another) USMC ball. The way the dress is cut, it is very forgiving and I recieved a ton of compliments!!! I will never buy another ball gown again...RtR is definitely the way to go!!!!

Nice dress, good length, but too tight in the shoulders The sleeves were okay but when it came to zipping up the dress the shoulder area was much tighter than the rest of the dress. Unless I pulled my shoulders way back and pushed out my chest, there was no way it would zip. Spending an evening with my shoulder blades touching was not something I wanted to do. In the end I did not actually wear the dress.
how comfortable the gown was! Mardi Gras

I received tons of compliments. I very much felt glamorous and put together.  The photos don't do the dress justice for how expensive and how glamorous it looked and how much it sparkled. Some people complained about the length so I got the long which was a little long, given the mini train but the only way to go if you are hippy like me. My shoes, which added another 3 inches of height, making me 5’6 didn’t show underneath the dress. I had to hold the dress while dancing and while walking down steps. The dress was very comfortable and I danced all night! It wasn't itchy. I wore it to a summer wedding in New York City which tends to be humid and it was tolerable. Moments in the sun were hot but once I got into AC I was grateful for the extra warmth of the dress. This dress can be worn in all seasons. I wanted a dress to hide my arms without looking like I was trying to hide and this did the trick as the arms hid the most troublesome part without looking like an intentional camouflage. (Sure beats a shawl for a young woman).  The dress itself looked ageless meaning appropriate for pretty much anyone between 25-85. The dress had a nice stretch which helped in making it so comfortable but the arms aren't as stretchy as the rest of the dress so it takes some maneuvering to set it in its right place. I wore a normal strapless bra and spanx. The bust of the dress is reinforced with girdle like material and boning so I guess you could get away with nothing but it could itch.  I would totally rent the same dress again.  (PS- my mother in the picture wore the Calvin Klein Fairest of them All gown.)  There were some issues with the upkeep of that gown but she wore it anyway and looked beautiful.  The material of that dress was thick and sturdy (as jersey-esque materials go). They really aren’t kidding when they say anything above a ‘C’ doesn’t really work.  The keyhole fabric underlay is a bit cumbersome and awkward and is only exacerbated with a larger chest.

The wonderful gifts for the children. This was not a dress that I chose for myself. A stylist recommended it when the dress that I wanted was not available. First of all, KUDOS to the stylist. The dress was gorgeous and fit me perfectly. I received plenty of positive feedback. There was enough stretch material so that I could breathe, and it was really comfortable.
Felt beautiful in this gown..  Very form fitting, but not tight.    Fit was great.  I wore low (1 1/2" heels), so dress was a little long, probably should have ordered 8R.
I received many compliments on the dress, it was very beautiful.   The fit on the dress itself was nice the arms seemed a bit small.

Bridesmaids Dresses! I had an issue with the seamstress that was going to make my bridesmaids dresses less than 4 months before my wedding. I wanted to keep my plan of sequins gowns for my girls. One of my bridesmaids & I came up with the idea & it worked out perfectly! My only complaint is that there wasn't a 0P or 2P for one of my girls who is small & short, otherwise they looked great. They photograph really well & it was a hit with everyone! We ended up being featured on a few wedding blogs & a bridal magazine. Thank for saving the day RTR!

Dress was elegant, flattering, forgiving, comfortable, and basically perfect! I am pear-shaped, a tall-ish 5'8", and typically wear 14 on top and 16 on bottom.  I ordered a 14WL and 16, and the fits were very comparable in the chest, arms, midsection, and hips, but I DEFINITELY felt like I needed the extra length of the 14WL, so I went with that one. I would go with 16XL if I could do it again.  
Both were fitted enough on top that my size 14 shoulders / 37C chest fit  fine, and my wider hips did not have any issues with either size either.  So I'd say the sizes are very accomodating and would recommend trying two different lengths with your backup size.  Barefooted, the regular 16 was about 2" off the floor in the front, and the 14WL was 1" off the floor in the front.  With 1.5" heel shoes, I still felt it was stretchy enough to pull it down and the length looked fine all night. There is a slight train in the back, so length there was not an issue with either one.   I did have to hold up the back of the dress to walk at all times in my heels because they'd get caught in the train if I didn't....so keep that in mind if you need mobility with heels for dancing or whatever.  With my shoes off, I could've practically worked out in the dress it was so comfortable :)  I didn't notice any discomfort from the boning that some reviewers mentioned.  Some reviewers mentioned that no bra was necessary.  I tried it both ways, but felt like it looked and felt much better with a strapless bra.
All in all, I felt lovely at my event, got many complements, and would definitely wear this dress again.
One more thing, I was a little concerned they they had sent the wrong sizes when the two tags clearly read only "14" and "16" (not 14WL), but the dresses had obviously been tailored to the W and L as ordered.
A truly stunning dress! I really enjoyed wearing this dress. It was incredibly comfortable and beautifully sparkly.
Unflattering The fabric was pretty thick and the dress just didn't hug my curves right. Was pretty disappointed and ended up wearing another dress.
perfect for a night out on the town in NYC great dress!

When I put it on the first time, my husband got tears in his eyes and told me how beautiful I looked Having lost 70 pounds in the last year, with 30 more to go, (long story, bad injury, long recovery) this was my first time feeling the confidence to wear something beautiful. I don't think I have ever felt so glamorous, sexy and ladylike all at the same time! It fit beautifully, and the little train was magical. I am tall and most of my weight is in my belly still and the cut of the dress and the ruching helped to camouflage this very well. The length was perfect, I wore 3 inch heels, but could have gone up or down. I started getting compliments on the elevator and they didn't stop all night long. It had been a long time since people have looked at me like this! Jaws dropped....friends who hadn't seen me since last year were amazed and best of all, I was completely comfortable all night long. I didn't want to take it off. To make the evening even better, it was my 45th birthday and far and away, my best birthday ever. RTR made it so easy, and I told everyone about it, (it was funny how the fact that it was a designer gown seemed to make it stand out from all the other dresses - if I could afford to buy couture, it is worth every penny!) Bottom line, it is a stunning gown, comfortable, elegant, just sexy enough and the fact that it was such an easy process made it even better. I will absolutely be renting again in February for an event in Las Vegas - hopefully I will be down another size by then too!

Thank you very much for making my debut as an almost skinny again person unforgettable!

Just about perfect! A very forgiving, well made gown that looks ever so red carpet! I wore this 3 times in one weekend for a part I played (MC on the red carpet interviewing 'stars') in a play. I am 44D and thought I would not get the zipper past my mid-back (everything fit find till I got to stuffing all that into the top!), but with a little work......the length was a bit long because I only had on 3" heels and anything higher would have worked fine. Had to apply a little WD-40 to the zipper as it didn't work well to begin with, let alone having to stuff a keilbasa into a hot dog casing! The sleeves were a bit tight at the top, but not too uncomfortable. Not one sequin fell off, that's how well made it is. Such an easy way to look really good for any event!

The customer service and everything about the whole experience was wonderful!   The dress was absolutely beautiful and I got so many compliments!  Thanks Rent The Runway for being a big part of making my NYE one to remember.  :-)

Paired with matching pumps and clutch, sparkling head to toe.  Stretchy - lots of give.  Very long, as you can see from picture. The petite version was not available. 
Glamorous. I did need a strapless bra and a little shape wear as it was stretchy material.  No issue on the arms - the gown did not fall down at all, even when crazy dancing.
Beautiful dress I loved how the dress fit and stayed up.  It didn't slip down so I didn't have to worry about it falling down.   Dancing was a little hard in the dress but I felt beautiful

A Literal Show Stopper! I selected this outfit after receiving a call from Rent The Runway that the dress that I originally chose was returned "damaged beyond repair". I wanted to cry (the call came 2 days before my dress was due) but they informed me right away that they would upgrade my order and let me select another dress, no matter the price.

It must have been meant to be because this one was amazing. Compliments came at me all night--had a number of people I didn't even know giving them out too!  The dress runs true to size but because I have such a large bust (38G) I wore the size 16 rather than my usual size 14.  This resulted in a great fit at the top but a lot of room in the rest of the dress. It wasn't anything that was really noticeable, however. I thought that the sleeves would impede my movement but they didn't. At all.  And the dress itself was SUPER comfortable. Another fantastic rental from RTR!
Super comfortable, looks great.  Easy to walk and dance in.  No need to hoik.   Definitely wear with shapewear (unless you're 21!).  It helps to have a friend to do the zipper.
Even the bride complimented me on this dress! Stunning dress! Great fit all around. Needed help with the zipper but otherwise flawless gown.
Received compliments! This dress was very comfortable and flattering.  I loved it!

This dress made me feel like a princess! I rented this dress for a Black Tie Event - it was a literal head turner!  It was comfortable and I never wanted to take it off.  I felt great in it!  It's modest, but sexy with a dramatic slit up the side.  There is little to NO give in the bodice so if you are debating between two sizes, go with the larger size.  I'm 5'8"ish and wore a 3" heel and the dress still brushed the ground.   I can't recommend this dress enough!
Great dress Fits well, lots of compliments and super comfortable

Being able to talk with a fit specialist to ensure I chose the right sizes was great.  Also, my dress came 2 days earlier that expected, which allowed me to make sure everything came together nicely. This gown really is beautiful!  It has some weight to it, but it's not bothersome.  I ordered the 2R as my first choice and the 0R as my back-up and ended up wearing the 0R.  You don't have to wear a bra with it, but for smaller breasted women, such as myself, it fills in the top if you do.  I chose to wear flats because I knew we'd be walking around the city afterwards, but I easily could have worn 2 inch heels and still had the gown drag on the floor.  Wearing flats allowed for the dress to drag on the floor quite a bit so I had to pick up the front of the dress when I walked or I would have stepped on it.  I did receive many compliments, though, and so many of the people couldn't believe a dress rental place exists!  Overall, it was a great dress.

LOVE this dress! Such a perfect option for a formal affair! This dress was so simple but also very classy and sexy at the same time. I am 6 feet tall and wore 21/2-3 inch heels and this dress still hit the floor (which is normally IMPOSSIBLE to find!!). I am also a 34D and the dress fit perfectly in my bust without being baggy anywhere else. It does run a bit small so I would suggest going up just one size. You can't go wrong!
This was my backup dress - it fit beautifully. You definitely have to accessorize this one!  The fit was perfect and the only negative is that I didn't get to wear it
2012-2013 Miss UNCF Huston-Tillotson University  The dress fit me a little big at the top.

This dress is amazing! I agree with the other reviews that the "long" is actually long (which is not always the case). I wore 3 inch heels and the length was perfect. I ordered a 10L and could have probably gotten away with an 8L as I ended up having to pin the top because it was a bit loose. All in all a perfect dress!

Gorgeous and unforgettable gown! This dress was amazing, glamorous and forgiving.  Had a huge slit in it that I didn't realize was there and I lived it. Runs a bit long so wear your highest heels. Did not need a bra and rocked the side cleavage! Loved this dress and didn't want send it back!
I got this dress for my girlfriend.  I wanted her to look good.  In that dress, she wowed me more. The dress fit great.

Great Dress! Comfortable and fun to dance in. I wore this dress to a formal gala. It was my backup dress, and I loved it so much when I tried it on, that I ended up wearing it instead of the one I had originally planned to wear. It has a sizable, yet discreet slit and is very comfortable. I was able to wear it without a bra (rare, since I'm larger up top), and it was fun to dance and twirl in. I received several compliments on the dress throughout the night, and I felt fabulous. I wore 4 inch wedge heels with it - it still hit the floor, and paired it with sparkly, long earrings and a matching bracelet. I would definitely rent with RTR again! The dress arrived in plenty of time and in excellent condition.

Perfect for my black tie work event! I needed a dress that was stunning and functional and this dress certainly fit the bill.  Ran a little long with moderate heels, but definitely wearable without tripping all night.  The overall fit was very comfortable; I was able to move freely to work the event and still feel beautiful.  Highly recommended!

Beautiful Dress I rented the size 4R with a 6R back up.  The 6 was a little big on top for me, but the 4 fit perfectly on top!  The only problem I had was length.  I'm only 5'4" and the dress was a bit long even with 4" heels on.  Overall I was very happy with this dress and received several compliments!
Simply elegant! Perfect fit except for the length...I'm 5'5" and I had to wear 4" heels and I still had to lift the gown while walking...otherwise a beautiful-fabulous dress...
Comfortable and I felt beautiful Great for a wedding and comfortable for dancing. I felt great in this dress, dimple but a little sexy with the slit that was unexpected.

The dress looked great on and was simple and comfortable! The size two fit me perfectly, being 5 3" I was worried it would be way to long but with heels it fit perfectly. The dress flows wonderfully and you could really tell it was a designer dress! The night was full of compliments.
it was too tight on the side , bust line  Beautiful gown, i just wish it had fit me
I loved this dress.  It fit perfectly!  It fit true to size.

Military formal affair Gorgeous dress.  I wish I could have kept it.  Definitely runs a bit small.  I normally wear a size 0 in practically everything but I couldn't even get the 0R zippered because it was so narrow in the chest.  The 2R fit almost perfectly and, as a result, I felt so comfortable the entire evening.  The length was perfect with 2 1/2 inch heels.  This dress has a bit of weight to it so it was great for a cool weather affair.
I loved the dress! It was very elegant and fit perfect! The fit was very accurate and the 2L fit perfectly with me wearing 2 inch heels. I wish I could have kept this dress because it was gorgeous!

I felt glamorous!  The dress is lovely.  It fits very well.  My only caution is that it runs a little long.  I'm 5'8" and had to wear 3" heels. so I wouldn't trip on the hem.  When I walked it had a wonderful way of billowing out so I didn't step on the hem.

My only real complaint with the dress would be the zipper.  Invisible zippers have a tendency to get stuck, and this was no exception.

If you aren't planning on wearing tall heels, I suggest getting the regular length.

Beautiful on top but too much on the bottom The dress fits true to size & the top is beautiful. I read a bunch of reviews so I knew the dress was long before deciding to rent this dress & sadly it didn't work out -- however, I didn't realize that there was just so much fabric on the bottom that the dress dragged all around me even with 5" heels on (I'm 5' 3"). I desperately wanted to like this dress but not at the cost of having to worry about tripping/tearing the dress during my whole evening so I ended up returning the dress & RTR was able to overnight me a different dress in time.

Military Ball I wore this dress to an Army ball.  It was a perfect combination of conservative but elegant. The only con is that this dress IS LONG. I am 5'4" and had to wear 4" heels to move comfortably in the dress, but I still had to hike it up for stairs, getting up from my chair, etc. If the petite had been available I think it might have been a better option for my height.

My fiance totally loved this dress on me! He must have complimented it 20+ times that night. The dress fit great, but was pretty long --- I'm 5' 8" and was wearing 4" heels and it was still a tad too long. When I switched to flats, I was basically just carrying it around all night. 

I think the 6 (backup size) would have fit too, but it was missing the hook and eye on the top of the zipper, and the zipper got stuck, too. It's pretty tough to zip up through the bodice just because there's so much fabric there.

It was super comfortable! Worked well with my figure (pear shaped), and overall was very pretty. I would wear it again!

Gorgeous Gown!! I rented this dress for a formal event and it was absolutely perfect.  I just had a baby a month earlier and so I was concerned that it wouldn't fit. I usually wear a size 10 but I got it in a size 10 and 12 just in case.  I'm so glad I did as the 12 fit perfectly (as I was a few inches larger in the bust area).  The dress fits true to size.  The best part is that you only need a good strapless bra underneath as the dress is long and flowing which is rather forgiving in the hip and bottom area. I would definitely recommend RTR to others and will be renting from you again and again!
I loved how flowy the bottom of the dress was and the slit really adds flare.  I loved this dress! The zipper is a challenge if you're fuller on top.  Once zipped though, the dress is fine.

I rented this dress for the 500th Night banquet at West Point. I received so many compliments! This dress was an amazing fit. I have a bigger chest and it fit just right. This would be a flattering gown on almost any body type. I love the slit, just the right amount of sexy for a more conservative formal affair.

Military Ball for ROTC
 Good fabric that flows nicely. If you're short definitely try to get the petite dress. Bust runs a little small, I'm a D and had to size up.
Felt So Beautiful! Attended a black tie gala. I had so many compliments throughout the night! Perfect for the occasion.

A perfect dress for a deb ball! Ran slightly small in the bust, but otherwise perfect. I took a size regular and had to wear 4" heels so it definitely runs long. I accessorized with long earrings and no necklace is needed. Another great rent from RTR!
Great fit. High slit in the leg - and tight bustier.

The skirt flows so beautifully. The dress fit perfectly. I read a lot of reviews that said the top was a little snug, but it was just perfect for me (probably because I have a small bust). The zipper is a little tricky to work, but besides that it was great. The slit in the dress doesn't show on the website, but it definitely makes the dress sexier. I wore the dress for my engagement photoshoot and my photographer was absolutely in love with the dress. As this was my first RTR purchase, I was beyond satisfied. I've already been recommending it to my friends.

Came as a backup dress, but LOVED IT!!! Looks better in person than on the model!!! This dress is SO much fun. It's simple, but the slit makes the dress. On my frame, the slit came up to midthigh and the dress was a bit long, but I ended wearing 5 inch heels which made it just above touching the floor. It was very fitted through the top and didn't leave much wiggle room, but it fit great on me, was very slimming and was not uncomfortable. Such a great dress because you can play it up with any kind of jewelry and you feel super hot strutting around in it. Would HIGHLY recommend for to anyone but specifically someone who wants a classy look.
Beautiful dress! I wore this dress for a formal awards banquet and it was perfect!  The dress has amazing flow and bounce when you walk.  I felt stylish all night!
Perfect fit Fitted to just above the waist, then an ample flow all the way down.   Slit isn't too high either.

This dress was fantastic. Very comfortable, and super appropriate for my spouse's annual work gala. I wore the 4L with 3 inch heels, and it still skimmed the floor. Only problem with this dress was sitting, and trying to avoid all the layers getting chair legs on them. As other reviewers mention, it's very fitted in the bust, and may work better for smaller chests.
I loved the elegance of this dress a lot more than I thought I would It was pretty long, so I had to wear really high shoes to compensate.
Fit like a dream! Dress was true to size but the 'Long' was a little long for someone who is 5'7. That can be fixed with tall shoes!

It was such a beautiful dress and I got so many compliments!  I ordered the "long" size because of my height and it turned out almost a little too long but with my heels it ended up working out perfectly! It was a beautiful dress and fit me perfectly. I would highly recommend this dress! I was comfortable the whole event, and i got so many compliments on it. The dresses material was very flowy and soft and elegant.

I received so many compliments about this dress! This was the first time I rented a dress for any reason and I will be doing it again. It was such an amazing experience. I got so many compliments on how great I looked I was beaming all night. The original size I ordered fit perfectly. It was a little long (I'm 5'2 and 3/4 and wore 4 inch heels) and with the flow-y fabric I did trip myself up a few times but the effect it made when I walked was awesome! The previous reviews of the dress helped so much for making a decision on a style and choosing a size. I wore nude colored heels, black pearl earrings and a purple stoned and white pearl necklace. Definitely want to make sure your hair is pulled back and up in some way so people can take in the full effect of the dress. Rent the Runway has made a life customer out of me
Gorgeous! This dress was beautiful and a really rich fabric that made it feel expensive. Paired it with a pair of chandelier earrings and it was perfect.

This was my first experience with RTR, and it don't think it will be the last! Great site! The dress was truly beautiful on, but it does run small on top. I am a true 8, with a 36B chest and the 8 was snug. I ended up wearing the second size, 10P, which was more comfortable up top, but ended up being too long wearing 3 1/2 inch heels.

Not for my body type. I'm around 130lbs and 5' 6'' but with E cups. These dress was NOT flattering on my bust. Kinda made my mid-section look squished and uncomfortable. Pretty dress, and I wish I could've worn it, but for ladies with smaller busts!

Great night - felt very Greek goddess in this flowy dress.   Fit and quality were great.   The fit was great.  Very fitted through waist.  Slit was nice but not too high.  Length was perfect.  I wore big dangle earrings and big cuff bracelet.   
Very Greek goddess!

wore to my boyfriend's commencement ball I ordered a 2L and a 4L originally, but then changed to a 2R and 4R after reading other reviews about the length of the dress. I'm about 5'8" and wore flats with the dress and it skimmed the ground perfectly! not so much that the bottom got all gross and people were stepping on it, but enough to cover my feet and lightly dust the ground. I'm normally a size 2, but wore the 4 because it was much more comfortable. I'm very thin but have wide hips and a tiny waist that  I'm normally very self conscious about, but this dress looked absolutely stunning and i felt so beautiful, i didn't want to take it off!

Beautiful, comfortable, classy - a go-to dress This was my back-up dress (but I ended up wearing this to the event).  I felt that this dress with the full skirt could be a safe bet for fit.  The 4R fit perfectly - I could see how this might not be a good choice for bustier gals - the bodice is fairly small.  The length with 2.5" heels was perfect.  I thought that the material was beautiful and flowy; the dress floats as you walk.  This dress is conservative and classy, but the one-shoulder and slit give it a little pizzazz.  An added bonus: it was very comfortable - no spanx required!  Maybe not the most exciting dress I've ever worn, but I would definitely rent again (especially as a solid back-up choice).
This dress was perfect for my black tie work event. The dress fit so well! The slit was perfection - just enough leg to up the sexy factor.

absolutely perfect dress for inaugural ball! elegant, simple and stunning! all the other reviews were spot on! this does fit snugly in the chest area, but the support is nice. it DOES run long, but the small drape on the floor was elegant and beautiful, you just have to be careful not to trip over it sometimes (i wore 6 inch platform heels and still got a bit of a drape. found the torso to run long so had to do some creative pinning, but no biggie. overall an incredibly positive experience.

Pretty, simple, black gown. I wore this to a formal event over Thanksgiving. The top was very tight fitting, I did not have to wear a bra and this typically cannot occur. It was pretty long, so heels are a must. It was classic, elegant, suited the event.

Formal with Flair! Formal with flair!
I wore this to a black tie military benefit.  I paired this dress with the Nicole Miller Simply Yours Bracelet and the Alexis Bitter Simply Orbit Earrings.  The room was full of designer apparel yet my RTR ensemble stood out in the crowd. Overall I was very happy with the dress, drawbacks were the length - too long for my height and the fit was a little loose.  I'm a petite 5'2" with a full bust (32DD) I wore the 6R because the 4R was a little snug, in hindsight I should have wore the 4R.
Awesome formal gown  This dresswas soooo beatiful and flowy for a black tie even that I attended i felt like was constanlty gliding across the room.
Loved it !! I usually wear an 8 but im a bit busty so the 10 was the size for me. The dress is sophisticated , sexy and timeless.
Beautiful dress.  Fit great, moved great for dancing and was comfy. perfect

Classy | Simple | Perfect I feared the length would be too long because of other reviews but with 4 inch heels - it was perfect.  It's a gorgeous dress and not one you will have to be wiggling and tugging at all night.  Perfect dress for a formal ball!

Beautiful, Gorgeous, & Classy This was my backup dress and I am so glad I ordered it! My first choice was the Badgley Mischka screen siren dress that has many high ratings but did not work well with my body. The first time I tried on this dress I was not feeling it and I was really disappointed in the dresses I ordered. My event was the next day and I was freaking out because I did not know what to do.. Do not let this dress fool you though because it can easily look amazing with the right accessories. I thought it was so plain compared to my first choice so I didn't give it the proper chance! I got so many compliments on it throughout the night and the slit makes you feel so sexy. I wore it to a military ball and the colonel said I was best dressed :) I paired it with gold bangles, a studded belt, over-sized clutch, and snakeskin pumps. I'm 5'2 and a 36c. Runs a little small so be sure to get a bigger backup size. It is really long but I tucked some of the fabric under the top part and secured it with my belt. Worked perfectly and I was able to walk across the ballroom and up a stage without tripping when my boyfriend was announced.

P.S. There are no pockets. The picture fooled me!

loved this dress really simple but super pretty loved the dress i was scared i got too small i ordered a 2 and a 0 but i actually ended up wearing the 0 because the 2 was too big on the top. in my opinion the dress runs kinda short it got here on a Wednesday and my prom was on friday and i had to have them send me a 0 long that thursday because even with short heels it felt too short so defiantly if your over 5'3 go with long just incase because you can always get higher heels. I was lucky they had a 0 long in stock but if not i would've had to have an awkwardly short dress all night. one of the best part was defiantly how comfy it was for eating since it was loose at bottom but the top was well fitting that it stopped from looking bloated. and the slit looked incredible when i walked it was by far my favorite thing about the dress

Lovely, elegant dress. This dress was a great choice.  I felt beautiful and received many compliments on the dress, which was very comfortable and easy to wear.  I was disappointed, though, that it did not have pockets, as it appears to in the photo on RTR.  I wore the 4L, which was a tiny bit snug; I think the 6L would have been too big, but I'd chosen the 4L as my backup, so I can't be sure.  Overall I would definitely recommend it if you're looking for something simple and elegant with a very current feel.

I wore this gown to a ROTC military ball and it was perfect for the occasion! Very classy. I ordered a 4L and a 6R, usually I can fit a 4 on top when the bottom is loose but it was just a bit uncomfortable when zipped. The 6 was a tad bit too loose but with a heavily padded bra I ended up wearing it because it was more comfortable. It made me wish there was a size in between! (It may have just been the dress I received was worn and stretched a little.) I'm 5'9 and had to resort to a smaller heel than I wanted because the dress was just too short with 5 inch heels, if you're tall I recommend getting the long if you're planning on heels taller than 3 inches even though the other reviews say the dress runs long. Overall my rent the runway experience was great! I loved this dress and I couldn't have chosen a better dress for the occasion. Flows great, lightweight and modestly beautiful.

Loved this dress!  Wore this to a black tie wedding and it was my favorite gown I have ever worn! It emphasized my waist and hid my wider hips. It was classy but still sexy with the high slit. I got compliments all night long. It was just tight enough in the top to be comfortable and not feel like I needed to worry about it falling at all, and no need for a bra with it but you could wear a strapless if you wanted. Wish I could buy this dress!!

Elegant gown with just enough to wow! This was my first RTR rental. The wedding was a formal black tie and I was a little hesitant about wearing this gown with the slit to a wedding but it ended up not being a problem! The slit is tasteful and the gown fits so comfortably. My only snafu is that the 4 fit perfectly and the 2 was a little snug but the zipper on the 4 sent to me was broken. I unzipped it to try it on and it had a little bit of a hard time going down but when I put it on, the zipper wouldn't go back up! (And there was ample room, it wasn't a size thing). So my husband ended up helping me into the 2 simply because it was my only option but I ended up liking it better because the length was perfect for 2 in heels. Great rental and I'll DEFINItELy rent again!!

Gorgeous dress! Fit and moves beautifully, I felt like I was floating across the floor!  This dress is beautiful; it takes the simple black dress up a notch! The neckline and length are conservative, but the slit (which is the perfect height- not too high but still sexy) and the way the dress moves when you walk make it stand out amazingly. I am usually between a 2 and a 4, but I read reviews that said the dress ran small, so I ordered a 4 Long and a 6 Regular (the 4R was unavailable). There wasn't a whole lot of difference between the 4 and the 6, I could have worn either, but went with the 4L because it fit like a glove. I am 5'6" and wore 4.5" heels and the dress was the perfect length- just like the model in the picture, the dress barely skimmed the ground which made it move so pretty when walking. I read other reviews saying the zipper was tough, but I didn't have an issue with that at all. I was so impressed with the dress I already ordered it in red for a black tie wedding in December! Thanks RTR!

Fabulous dress for a formal affair! I absolutely loved this dress! I wore it to to an Emmy awards gala - definitely a swanky affair! It was a perfect fit and I got so many compliments! It was a bit long, even with 4-inch heels, so I had to pick it up frequently to avoid being stepped on or from stepping on it myself. But it was super comfortable - I would definitely recommend it for a formal event!

When I came out in the dress and my husband said, "wow!" Fabric is flattering and has stretch to it, so the smaller of the two sizes fit better. It was super comfortable for the first couple of hours, but after some dancing, the wire on the top of teh dress dug into my side a bit. Overall, I felt awesome in the dress and recommend it.

Felt like a million bucks! I wore this to a black tie wedding this weekend and I felt so glamorous and got compliments all night! The dress was easy to wear, stayed up all night with no tugging or pulling and made me feel great (by hiding some of my bumps and lumps).  The only things to note are that the sequins along the underarms are kind of itchy and you always need to keep an eye on the little train when dancing so that it doesn't get caught. If you're on the fence, you should totally rent this dress!

How it glistened on the stage and it was true to size! I am usually a size 2 but the 4 fit perfectly. I enjoyed wearing the dress. Everyone on stage loved it and me in it. It wowed the crowd while I was on stage. I had a really successful pageant.
