Gorgeous & fun! I rented this dress for a monte carlo/masquerade themed party.  I picked this dress as it was the perfect complement to my rather ornate mask.  The dress is very pretty & very comfortable to wear. Its a very flattering dress and the rouching does provide for disguising for any "trouble spots" you may have.
Great Dress!! Great dress. Fits very well and hugs you in the right places.

The shipping was great and the dress was great quality. I really liked how the dress fit, but the boning in the sides was bent kind of weird. It may have been just the dress that I got, but it wasn't very noticeable, just a little square looking if I moved in a certain way. It was a little annoying because i could feel it in my side. Other than that, I loved how it fit and looked.

Stunning My husband's jaw dropped when I put this on.  It was a little long so I had to wear 4 inch heels to pull it off.  I got the 0 and 2 and actually thought they may have been mislabeled as the 2 seemed smaller than the 0.
This was my first designer dress ever! The fit was great and I was very happy with the condition of the dress.

Marine Corp Birthday Ball  When I first opened up the box I was a bit disappointed, as I had already taken a risk renting a heavily sequined dress (something I usually wouldn't get), however when I tried it on I loved it! I felt very elegant yet sexy. I got a 0P since I didn't want to wear super high heels, the petite size worked perfect for kitten heels at my height. The only problem I had with the dress was the built in bra. I have a short torso (longer legs) and small bust, so the built in bra reach down to the beginning of my hips. So whereas the dress is suppose to give you a hourglass shape, since its tight everywhere, there was an awkward bump above my hips. Other than that, I loved the dress.

Beautiful Wedding with family. Fits and looks great but the wires under you armpits are a little bended towards outside I tried to keep it to my skin with take and it did not work. The good thing is that it wasn't noticetable.

Stunning dress; better for skinny figure? The petite dress was too short to wear with heels, so I did not use it.  It was a very pretty dress, and incredibly comfortable to try on.  However, the fit combined with the sequins was not terribly flattering for those of us who are carrying around excess baby weight.  (Which is not the fault of the dress, which was very pretty!)  If ordering again, I would order the regular, rather than the petite.

Super glam, super stretchy, super comfortable!  Loved it! The dress was a bit too big -- I ordered larger sizes because I was worried about it zipping over my bust, but the fabric is very stretchy, so I would actually recommend sizing down.  The dress was too long on me (the petite wasn't available) but I loved it anyways.  Because the fabric is so stretchy, this would work well on a lot of body types.  I got a ton of compliments and would definitely rent again!

The dress was nice but a little blah.  Next time I think I'll go for something more daring! Fit was a bit large-- I ordered my usual size (6L) and a size down and ended up (4L).  I'm a taller gal so I could have gotten away with kitten heels, but the 3.5" I wore did well too!

Ultimately, I give this dress 6/10.  Good but not great.

I got sooo many compliments on this dress. I felt amazing in it all night long! I am 5 ' 8.5" and the long was LONG. I am not a huge high heel wearer so I wore mid-high heels and just walked carefully all night. It didnt look "too" long because of the train but I had to be careful. I also had to be careful not to get "stuck" to anyone with the sequins. 

This dress was smooth, light and fit great. It didnt feel "heavy" like other sequin dresses I tried on. Most sequin dresses you see in the stores look "cheaply" made. This did not at all. I wore minimal jewelry and let the dress do the talking. 

Returning it by noon the next day was easy... but I was sad to see it go. I will definitely RTR again!
great dress!! lost of compliments and overall fantastic fit!! fabulous fit especially on the top didnt find myself pulling the dress up all night major plus!! loved it!!

Very beautiful dress, felt like a movie star! I rented this dress as my backup choice...and even though I ended up not wearing it in favor of another that matched the event better, this dress fit incredibly well and looked gorgeous. The ribbing didn't bother me at all, but if I'd worn it for a long night of sitting, standing and eating, it may have. The fabric has a good stretch to it. It was definitely long for my 5'3" height, but all in all, this is a gorgeous dress and I would def rent it for another event!!!

Great quality, stunning dress!! I rented this for a Mardi Gras Ball. It was gorgeous and fit great. It was too long though. I am 5'3" and wore 4" heels and it was still about 4" too long. Not a big deal though, I am short so I figured I'd have this issue. Otherwise great dress!!
Beautiful gown, received many compliments about the style. Beyond satisfied on the look just ran a bit large in bust so occasionally had to be pulled up.

Stunning dress The dress looked amazing. It fit snug but did not feel snug. I thought it would feel heavy, but it did not. I gave only 4 stars because the sparkles were very irritating on the under side of my arms. I have a rash after a night of dancing.  I ended up using the fashion tape to temporarily add a satin ribbon to the top of the dress under my arms. That helped a lot. No one really noticed. 
I was VERY happy with how I looked!

LOVE!!! So many compliments!! Love, Love, Love this dress! BM dresses tend to run a bit small and sometimes the top doesn't quite match the bottom size. The same holds true with this dress. I typically wear a 2, but the top on the dress was way too tight with the 2. RTR was fabulous and overnighted me a size 4. So glad it was available and I was able to wear this dress to the opening of a movie studio. I received TONS of compliments.

I felt like a princess! I wore this dress to prom and I loved it!!  I ordered the 0R with a 2R as back up. The 0R fit great everywhere except the length. When I put on 3 inch heels the shoes showed and the front of the dress didn't touch the ground (which is what I wanted). So I tried the 2R, the length was perfect but the bust was way too big (even with 2 bras on) and the boning gave it a funny shape. So I chose to go with the 0R and wear glitzy sandals, with that the length was perfect! I never had to worry about pulling up the top or readjusting during the night, it fit amazingly and I received compliments all night......would definitely rent again!
I loved everything about this dress! The sequins were very itchy, but only when you rubbed up against the dress. For me, it was a little long but i am only five foot one itch.

Comfortable and was event appropriate I usually wear a 4/6 but rented this dress in a 12R bc I was 8 months pregnant.  I attended a black tie wedding and wanted something form fitted instead of A-line.  This dress fit the bill.  Based on reviews that said it had a lot of stretch to the fabric, I originally rented an 8 and 10 but after receiving them, the 10 was still a smidge too small.  I could have worn it but the 12 gave me a little more room in the belly.  All in all, I'm glad I picked this dress and I received a ton of compliments.

MOST AMAZING DRESS I felt like a princess in this dress! I was told over and over how beautiful I looked and how flattering the dress is. The ONLY complaint I had is the boning dug into my ribs all night, but I would deal with that anyday to wear this again. Rented the silver as my back up too but the Black was just stunning.

Stunning gown, fits like a glove! This dress was gorgeous!  The ruching under the sequins and the stretchy material make it fit like a glove.  The 4 and the 2 both fit, but I went for the more snug fit.  The sequins did cause a little irritation under my arms, and I didn't even dance.  I don't think I could have done much dancing in the dress between the irritation and the weight of the dress.  But boy, did it look great!

Love!!!!! I wish I could wear this dress all of the time!  This dress was amazing. I ordered it as a back up in case the other dress I got was too "risky." Once I put this on, I could not take it off. I got so many compliments. It was just amazing. I was even feeling bad bad about how I look in dresses that morning and then put it on and magically felt great! Its amazing what a great dress can do! Since it was my back up, I only had one size and was worried about whether my hips would fit, since its fitted. The fabric is nice and stretchy though and it fit perfectly.
Flattering but... I ordered this as my first choice to wear at prom. I loved it but the wire in the built in bra was coming out and it hurt as it would scratch my skin.

Such a flattering gown! I'm 5'7" so the fit guide suggested that I wear a long, but it ended up being TOO long.  People kept stepping on my train and it was just dragging behind me.  However, the overall look was amazing and I received so many compliments on my dress!  One guest even decided to rent the same dress!

This glamorous dress was perfect for a formal holiday ball.  The fit of this dress was spot on! I always worry about length but this was just right on my 5', 2" frame. The overall fit was perfect, too, though I did need a hand getting the zipper up. The dress has a bit of stretch so it is very comfortable. The sequins weren't scratchy either.

My husband loved this dress on me...which makes it even better.  The dress has a nice stretch to it sonit hugs just right but also because it's heavy material with a little rouching it lays well to cover a little tummy. The zipper was very difficult to zip not for the fit but for the fabric. You need extra hands to get it pulled up.

This dress was a definite head turner. I lit up the room & felt like a million bucks! Fit was true to size and despite other reviews, I was surprised to find that the dress wasn't that heavy considering all the sequins. It was comfortable and didn't rub under my arms. However, as you can see in my picture, some of the wiring stuck out under my armpit which kept poking my arm. That was the only complaint I had. 
I wore flats with this gown as I am 5'9. The regular length gown was perfect, maybe a little on the long side.

Stunning dress!!!  This was my first time renting from RTR. Boy was I happy! I needed a long gown as I have a boot on from foot surgery last month and the standard short LBD wouldnt work this year. I don't own anything long and glam, so that's why I decided to use RTR. The dress was perfect for hiding my boot as it was floor length. I felt glamorous and received compliments all night long. The dress was very comfortable and I didn't have any issues pulling it up all night as some strapless gowns do. It was a total success for me!! I usually wear an 8, but ended up wearing the 10 because I'm a DD and I felt the 10 gave me more room up top. I'm 5'7 and the dress just hit the floor without heals.

I guess I am a teeny girl! I rented this both in 0R and OP... The R wasn't that much different from the P except for the length as the R was a couple inches longer.  Due to that, I had to take the P.  
The dress was spectacular. The fit was great and I didn't have any issues with it other than the fact that, like all sequin dresses, after awhile it starts to jab at you.  I think had I been standing more it would not have been so bad, but because I was sitting for a couple hours my arm was rubbing against the sequins so after awhile it became uncomfortable.
Other than that, the dress was amazing.
Dress was fantastic but  the built in bustier was a little uncomfortable. I received a lot of complements.

Zipper sticks. First time using RTR and while this dress didn't work out because of a zipper issue and my backup dress didn't work out either, they sent me another two styles and thankfully one of them worked well.  Will definitely rent from RTR again and recommend it to anyone and everyone.

Perfect for my red-carpet event! The fit is perfect. The gown is heavy, but not too heavy when on you. The only thing that was rough was that the sequins right under my armpits rubbed against my skin and it hurt. Blerg. But aside from that, I adored this dress.

Couldn't have asked for anything better. People were still talking about my dress 3 months later. I rented this dress for my prom and it was just perfect. I ordered the 8 and the 10, but the 8 fit perfectly. Everyone told me I belonged on the red carpet or in an old hollywood film. It was exactly the look I was going for, so I was extremely happy. I wore it with about 5 inch heels. I have no complaints about anything with this dress. The fabric is pretty stretchy, so while I'm usually a 10, i ordered the 10 long and the 8 long. I ended up wearing the 8 and it fit perfectly. I think I could have fit into a 6 had I ordered one, but the 8 wasn't noticeably big or anything. The fabric and the cut is very forgiving. I was told all night how thin I looked. The sequins were heavier than expected, but that didn't stop me from dancing all night. I took my shoes off, so I ended up having to hold my dress up most of the dance, but it wasn't really that much of a problem. Would DEFINITELY recommend.

I always feel beautiful when I wear a RTR gown! For me this dress was very uncomfortable, the sequins rubbed against my underarms all night and became very irritating.  Also, the dress is incredibly heavy due to all of the sequins; and the "train" kept snagging against itself due to the sequins.  It looked beautiful on, but I will stay away from sequins in the future!

Gorgeous dress!  Great service!  I originally rented the screen siren gown but it was REALLY unflattering for my body.  In a panic I called rent the runway and the stylist was able to get me this beautiful black dress for no additional charge, and I love it, I'm so excited to rent again.

The dress was so flattering, it caught the light and stood out from other black dresses.  I feel like I could have gone with a 4 even because the material is stretchy and though it is tight it really hugs you nicely and accentuates your curves
I'm 5'5 and I got the Long to wear 4.5inch heels with and it was still super long!  

the only complaint I have is that the boning kind of dug into my ribs and hurt, and towards the end of the night the dress began to slip down a bit.

I wore a strapless bra, but I could have gone without one!  gorgeous dress!

GORGEOUS!!! Loved the dress. SHe looked stunning. Company is amazing to work with! EASY My daughters friend had me rent this dress and she wore it to The Marine Ball. She looked stunning in it. The fit was perfect. Your company is amazing. Y'all sent two dresses that came in a very timely manner, packing was superb, the dress was ready to be wore. Sending it back was just as easy, y"all took care of everything. All we had to do was drop it in the mail. You definitely have a return customer in me! I'd love to see a bigger selection of prom gowns!
The height was amazing! Height perfect with three inch heels, dress was very slimming and was perfect for a formal affair!

Gorgeous dress, but kept falling down! The sequined fabric of this dress is really a stunner in person- it moves beautifully and shimmers like crazy. I was definitely getting compliments on the dress all night. However, I found the 6L to be rather too long, even with 3" heels, and kept stepping on it, which compounded its tendency to shimmy down whenever I moved too much. Several hours into the night, when the dancing began and things got sweaty, the sequins started to itch a bit and the underwire started poking my ribs quite painfully. However, it looked gorgeous in photos (which, let's face it, is really the purpose of a prom dress), and was perfectly comfortable for the first four hours or so. Definitely a great choice for a more sedate night than a night of dancing.

Perfect for the Red Carpet! All the reviews and stylist pro tips were very helpful! Overall it was true to size...a little bunching in the back. I received so many compliments on the dress and of course my boyfriend was very please. It was perfect!

This dress is AMAZING for an hour glass figure!  It runs big and is a stretchy material so you could go a size smaller on this one.  I usually wear a size 4 and wore the 2R with this one.  The length was perfect.  It photographs well!  It looks better in person than in the pics with the model on this web site.  Just an over all classic gown!  The sequins didn't scratch.  It was comfortable.  I loved wearing it.
Classic was too large for me but the material is heavy and feels like a real gown on!
Pretty dress Did not wear dress, not very flattering on my body type

Gorgeous dress! Perfect fit, many compliments. Very flattering, and forgiving fit. Despite the abundant sequins, this dress was exceptionally comfortable, even after a long night of dancing. I ordered this in long, and was somewhat worried that it may not be long enough - not so! I am 5'9" and with 2.5" heels the dress was floor length. Amazing dress overall - I was only sad to part with it.
Beautiful but too long.. It was just way too long for me and I had 6" heels on ; (

This dress was sparkling and very eye catching. I got LOTS of compliments! I ordered a longer one and the regular and the regular was perfect! I wore very high heels and its a stretchy fabric so it didn't fall down or give me any problems! I really enjoyed my night in this dress :)
Beautiful dress felt like a movie star. Great fit.  I'm 5'5" 145lbs and it was perfect in the 8R

I chose this dress for my husband's Marine Corps Ball and it made me stand out among the rest! I ordered this dress in both a 12R and a 12L. I am 5'3" and I was planning on wearing 5 inch heels so I chose both options, not knowing which one would be the better fit lengthwise. I am usually a 10 in clothes but in dresses I wear a 12 because of my chest and this dress fit true to size. I went with the 12R because I did not want the dress to drag on the floor and wanted my shoes to show. This dress was beautifully unique and the sequins, although it covered the entire dress, was glamorously subtle. No one at the Marine Corps Ball wore anything close to this dress and many asked where I had purchased my dress. I told them I went with Rent the Runway and recommended others to use this site for future Marine Corps Balls!
Loved this dress, pure unadulterated glamour. The dress fit beautifully, I loved the way it moved. Perfect for the holidays.

If you want compliments, wear this! The dress is beautiful. Luckily is has a lot of stretch as it fit much more snug than I expected. My husband had to help me zip it up. I'm typically a 2 or a 4 and the 4 was tighter than I thought it would be, but luckily it fit. Once it was on, it was fine (and fairly comfortable) because of the stretch. It was nice to wear a luxury designer without breaking the bank!

You'll feel like a fox in this dress! I order the 10R and 12R in this dress. Both were beautiful. I chose the 12R to give me a little more length. I am usually a 12/14 and I fit in the 10 with no problem.There's built in wiring that helps give your lady lumps a little lift. I put a cushion in to cut down on the poking. I was very satisfied with this dress and felt stunning. I got tons of compliments. I would definitely rent this dress again.
Beautiful dress. This wasn't the original dress I ordered, but due to Sandy this is what I received. It was a beautiful dress though. It was a bit long for me though. ;-)

This dress was wonderfully sexy and slinky without making me look like a bowling pin!  Miraculous! I usually have to size up in Badgley Mischka, but the stretchiness of this dress made that unnecessary.  The 12R had seen a lot of love, and the hem was losing some sequins, but I only noticed the wear and tear AFTER I found sequins on the floor and worried.  Being 5'4", it was long without heels, but with my 3.5" heels it was perfect, even had a little train (long enough to follow me, short enough not to get stepped on).  The picture was taken at the end of the night (NYE) so the shoes are gone and my posture isn't the best, but that DRESS!!!

The dress offered me enough sparkle I didn't need to wear anything additional to shine! Even though it looked like I was sewn into it, it offered a lot of flexibility, was very comfortable for me to dance in all night1

Felt like a million bucks EXPERIENCE I ordered the 4P & 6P but were too short in 5.5in heels. Beware of a $35 overnight fee if your dresses dont fit and there isnt enough time to ship another one reg. shipping. They replaced the dresses for two 6R. Returning it is easy. I was really excited to keep the garment bag. I was supposed to receive a Lancome Lipstick for a special order but didnt. THE DRESS - The dress was absolutely stunning! The length was great 6R, I'm 5'2 and wore 5.5in heels (black peep toes) it swept the floor nicely and There was still a bit of room for me not to step on it as I walked. Its a little bit difficult to dance in, specially if you have to move backwards. It fit just a tiny bit big but nothing too bad. The rouching on the mid section is very flattering and Sequins camouflage less desirable areas. It has a tiny trail, which made it look so elegant. It was very uncomfortable all the way around the top edges since the sequins rub against your skin. I just ended up wearing a nice black cardigan most of the night and took it off a few times to show off the dress. I had put on some body glide on my underarms to help with the friction but it didnt really help much. I did have to wear a strapless bra. I absolutely loved wearing this dress; everyone kept saying how much they loved it. Def. felt like the best dressed! The pictures dont really do it justice. ADVISE - dont forget to factor in the height of your shoes if you want the dress to sweep the floor. It makes your silhouette look very nice. Make sure to order your dress way in advance as I struggled to find my size. Order your backup on a size down for a nice snug fit. The sequins make it heavy so it stretches a bit through the night. If you have sensitive skin this may not be a good choice if you don't want to wear a sweater most of the night. Wear a body suit it makes it very comfortable. Beware of grabbing the dress the wrong way, The sequins got under my nails and gave me a few painful cuts.

All-time favorite rental! I had so much fun in this dress, I only got one iPhone photo at the end of the night! I wore this combo to my company's holiday party at the Gansevoort Hotel. I dressed down the gown with a tee and Ash Cool Biz wedge sneakers (3 inches). Despite the sequins, this dress is easy to move in and light. A deep slit breaks up the skirt and the strapless top stayed in place through a night on the dance floor.

The necklace is amazing and I wore it all four days of my rental :) The ornate design gave my outfit an edgy feel and while still matching the glamour of the gown.

Boo hoo tiny arms. Sadly I didn't try this on until the day of the destination wedding we attended. My husband was in the wedding so I was dressing alone and the arms were so tight that I couldn't reach back to zip myself because the zipper was clunky and sticking. I struggled with this for a bit and then ended up wearing something else. The lace laid a little oddly - perhaps it needed to be pressed better because it was longer in the front than the back. I'm sure it's good if you have a friend to zip you up!

Perfect Fall Season Dress! I was part of 3 weddings this year, attending 5 in total, and all fell within 5 weeks of each other. I needed a dress for the last rehearsal dinner that I hadn't worn to any of the previous weddings or rehearsal dinners. The size 6 was perfect. It flattered my curves and was very comfortable all night long. Being a slightly busty girl for someone of my height I was afraid my chest wouldn't be comfortable in the crew neck cut neckline, but I was! I received so many compliments!

Fabulous night! This dress was so fun! The color is bright without being obnoxious and the fit was great! The only issue I had was that the sleeves were tight and had very little give. I ordered a size 8 and 10 and ended up wearing the 10 even though the 8 fit because the sleeves were a bit looser.  Overall, I had a great experience with this dress and would definitely rent it again. Days later, my fiance is still commenting on how much he liked the dress. :)

A fun Florida wedding in April. This was, quite possibly, the most comfortable dress I've worn in a long time. The inside is a silky material.  I included a photo to show what I am talking about.  I wore this in Florida in April and did not have any issues with being warm.  I received a ton of compliments on the dress.  The color is a magenta.  I described it was a pinkish-purple, but my husband said it was definitely more pink!  They did not have my backup size and so I only received the size 6.  It ended up fitting me perfectly.  I was a but nervous because I had a baby 4 months ago and my midsection isn't exactly what it used to be.  The dress hid that and fit great.  I was able to comfortably dance ALL NIGHT!

Super cute dress (with pockets!), sleeves run tight though. I rented this for a cocktail party for work and unfortunately, the sleeves were too snug.  The dress fit well everywhere else.  But ultimately I didn't wear because I was too uncomfortable in the sleeves.

Loved this dress! Received so many compliments! I rented this dress for an October wedding and it was perfect! I rented the 4 and 6 and went with my usual size 4. I did not think the sleeves were too tight and loved the fuller skirt lining.

Loved this dress.  Flirty but modest enough for a religious wedding.   The lace was frayed at the bottom. I doubt anyone else noticed, but I did. The dress is gorgeous, no complaints there, but the condition of the one I wore wasn't perfect.

Perfect dress? I received a ton of compliments on this dress! It is a great color and made me stand out from the typical LBDs. I felt fantastic in it. Favorite part- there were pockets!!! :) It was nice and snug but not too tight.

Perfect dress for the perfect day The fit was perfect except for the arms - you can't really lift your arms over your head in this dress but other than that this dress is perfect! The color is more grape than the picture suggests, but perfect for a fall wedding!

Absolutely gorgeous color and received so many compliments Dress for the most part runs true to size.  I have a large bust and waist so i felt like it was a bit snug there.  Additionally, the shoulders were actually a bit large.  It did not totally fit flush to my body, but it wasn't noticeable and was not really uncomfortable.  I'd recommend this dress to anyone for a formal affair, wedding, etc.  Additionally, it works for more casual events like a cocktail party or even a dinner party.  So worth it!
I wore this dress for a ballroom dancing event and everyone loved it!  Love the dress! Got many compliments!

Great color and fit! Loved, loved, loved this dress! The lace has a slightly stretchy, thick quality to is that is very flattering and forgiving. And the skirt flares out a bit when you turn, which makes dancing pretty fun.

My original choice for an evening work event. This was the first dress I ordered for my boyfriend's evening work event. The 4 fit true to size, but I ended up not keeping the dress because it somehow looked a little dowdy on me (maybe because I'm short; I don't think it looks dowdy on the model). The lining under the lace was also too yellow for my super fair skin and thus more noticeable than I would have liked.

Cute for fall or winter - tight sleeves This dress was really cute and flattering.  I didn't end up wearing it, because it seemed to "fall like" for an August wedding, but I think it will be great to rent again in a few months.  My only compliant was that the sleeves were pretty tight, like other reviewers have said.  I have bigger arms though, so this might not be a problem for others.  It ran true to size, and has pockets!

Not great for petite frames The size 0 dress fit, however it unfortunately is a little longer than the pictures shown. My guess is that it's just not good for petite frames (me). The top half of the dress fits just fine, but the bottom of the dress hit right at my knee. All the photos shown have the dress hitting at least 5 inches above the knee, making the look a lot cuter and the dress looks more like a cocktail dress. Unfortunately it wasn't flattering on my body and had to find a different dress for my event.

Gorgeous fall wedding on a working farm.  I wore this for a fall outdoor wedding. The layers of this dress are really heavy so it was ideal for the chilly weather. The arms and top fit really tight, so I would suggest ordering a size up. Overall loved the dress and got tons of compliments on it.

Very Pretty! Love the color! This color was great - it was a mix between a purple & deep fuchsia. Definitely brighter then the picture portrays. The fit was great too; the 10 could have been worn but it was just a little too tight in the arms. I got a lot of compliments and would rent again! Perfect for a Fall/Winter wedding because the fabric is very thick. Kept me warm all night, but didn't get too hot on the dance floor. I loved it!
Unique color and attention grabber! it's a bit tight around the arms and chest.

The little extras that RTR included in the package made me want to rent again! The zero wasn't available so I wore the 2, which ended up fitting perfectly in the arms and a little looser in the middle. The color really pops- it's perfect for a fall wedding.  It's also warmer than I expected because it is lined, so I didn't need a cardigan. I would definitely recommend the dress!
Loved it! Perfect for a fall wedding. Very comfortable, beautiful color.

Complimented all night! Fit true to size. Alittle tight across my chest but I have wide shoulders so that is normal for me. Was not uncomfortable at all. I still danced all night. The color was so rich in person and the shape and fit were amazing, actually gave me more curves and I adore a dress with pockets. My first rental and it will for sure not be my last.

This dress was the perfect mix of formality, playfulness while being very wearable Wore for an outdoor evening wedding in SF. With the fog coming in, the layers in this dress was perfect for the cold. Should have thought out a jacket, but this cardigan was ok in a pinch. The pockets were fantastic for storing my phone and lipstick, no purse needed. When we moved inside for dinner, it did get a bit warm. Was sad to see the dress leave my wardrobe.
LOVE this dress is amazing, its a great color, fits great and is just so stress free. No bra issues or anything. I highly recc for anyone...ill be renting this in diff colors for sure!
Got Compliments for Days I loved the color, the fit, and the fabric. The only con was the fact that the pockets would sometimes fare out on my hips.

The dress is gorgeous. It was flattering, bright, comfortable and I got many compliments.  The dress is a beautiful dress. The purple color is eye catching. The fit throughout the body was flattering (not too tight, not too loose,not too long, not too short). However, the fit around the arms and bust was a bit tight. I am a 36DD and was, at the time, nursing so it was definitely tighter. That being said it was still a comfortable dress to wear. I received many compliments on the dress and being only 3 months post partum it was a dress that helped hide or highlight the right areas.
Beautiful color.  Has pockets! Runs true to size.  Wasn't too tight in the arms and shoulders for me.  Was very comfortable.  Not too short for someone my height which is a great.

Lovely dress for date-night to see Hamilton.  Pros: Pockets <3 Lovely detail. 
Cons: It was a little long, and tight in the arms.
Overall, I was happy with the dress but I wasn't as stunned with its beauty as I had been with previous rentals.

Great color and perfect fall wedding dress! I'm 5'8, 155 lbs and three months post baby.  This was the perfect dress given the cut around the midsection and long arms. I paired with nude shoes. Runs a bit small and tighter in the arms.

Pretty Dress My original dress came up unavailable so I had to choose this one last minute.  I normally wear a size 6 but ended up wearing the 8 simply due to the tightness in the arms.  The rest of the dress fit true to size, and the length hit just above the knee.  Love the pockets and the color was beautiful!  I wore to a summer wedding and was really glad it happened to all be indoors because the dress fabric was pretty heavy.  Would definitely be better for a fall/winter wedding.  Overall, very pretty and flattering.
Gorgeous dress! Felt like a princess! Fits true to size. Arms were a little snug on my wide shoulders. But overall great dress!

Cute and comfy Love this dress! Dressed it down with a moto vest and booties. The pockets make it a bit fuller in the hip area but I patted it down and the vest covered it. But flattering A line and very cute.

Easy process 

 Lightweight and a bright color

The amazing quality of the dress and how  amazing I felt after putting the dress on.  The dress fit perfectly! I could not have been more pleased with my first time renting. The quality of the dress was more than I was expecting. The sleeves do not have much give to them, but after the initial moment of noticing it wasn't a problem. The dress hugged in all the right places and the pop of color us exactly what I needed to stand out.  People were coming up to me the whole night complementing me. One man even informed me I was "voted best dressed of the night!"

Beautiful Color and Style The arms are really tight and it was also tight in my bust. I am 5'4" and I thought the dress would be a little longer, but it was still about 2-3 inches above my knee. But overall the style is very flattering and the color/material is great. I received many compliments.

This was the perfect dress for a tea party themed baby shower! I wore this to my sister-in-law's baby shower which was a tea party theme. It fit perfect, and everyone said I looked just like Kate Middleton. The dress is rather thick which was perfect for November in Michigan, but may be too warm for summer events. The arms were a bit snug, but not bad. The lining on the arms did poke out a bit, but that was very minor.  I loved wearing this dress!

Beautifully colored lace This ran a bit small. I have started going down a size, so I ordered the 10/8R instead of 10/12R. The 10 fit perfectly; the 8 was just too skinny in the arms. I didn't realize how many layers this dress had, but it made it really fun. There were two thin layers, a tulle-esque layer and of course the lace overlay. Some people mentioned the need for a ribbon, but it was perfect without one. Just use it if you want to accessorize a little bit. I wore the Kate Spade black chandelier earrings.
Fun flattering dress - perfect for fall/winter wedding! Great dress, fun to wear and very flattering. The only issue is that I have muscular arms so the top was tight, but otherwise great dress!

Super comfortable and flattering! The dress was really comfortable for dancing at a wedding. The dress is a great choice for classy and fun at the same time!  I wouldn't wear to an outdoor wedding as wearing the long sleeves over Labor Day was borderline.

The color of the dress was amazing, I received so many compliments! It was a great dress but the sleeves were definitely small that is why I had to wear the larger size. It's a very comfortable dress but is heavy so I wouldn't wear it in warm weather. Great for dancing!
Love this dress! Very comfortable I love this dress! It fits great and was very comfortable. Great for fall weddings. The sleeves are a little tight so I ended up wearing the larger size.

beautiful dress for a summer wedding Dress was good, not too short on me (which is good because I'm almost 5'7"). Only con was that it was really tight in the arms. I don't have particularly big biceps but i found it was a struggle getting into the sleeves

Great flirty dress Pro: Color worked well with my skin-tone (olive complexion)
Con: It was a bit tight on the chest (didn't look bad, but something to be mindful of)

Gorgeous color. First RTR experience Fabulous color. Underneath lace is a gorgeous gold color that's a little hard to see in photos. Length is great not too short. Only complaint is that sleeves are a little tight. Size 4 fit great except I couldn't lift my arms. Size 6 fit great too.. Picture isn't great of the dress but shows gold color underneath.

This is, absolutely, the most amazing dress to exist!!! I loved it and I got so many compliments! Like other reviews said, it was tight on the arms.  I'm big through the chest so it also made it tight across the chest area too, but the dress fit like a glove everywhere else.  And it is unbelievably comfortable - I didn't want to take it off.  RTR - if you sell this dress, can I please buy it??

Love the color of this dress! I wore this dress for our engagement photo shoot and LOVED it! The color was a touch more vibrant than in the photo online, which was totally fine with me--it worked out great! After reading a lot of reviews, I noticed that some folks were saying to go a size down (instead of up, as recommended by the Stylist's Recommendations). I normally wear a 10, but I went up to a 12. I think a 10 would have been just right, as the 12 was a bit roomy... but it still worked out great in the long run!

It was very classy and my fiancee adored it.  I rented this for Valentine's Dinner.  It ran a little tight in the shoulders I definitely went with the 12. I think it would've looked great with a small belt but we were running a little late so I just forgot about it.

Pockets! This was heavier than I expected; I was a bit warm at an outdoor summer wedding.  However, I received some compliments and I loved the pockets (though they did make me look a bit "hippy").  It was a very comfortable dress once we got some air conditioning, the lace didn't itch at all, and the sleeves fit great (I have thicker-than-average arms and some sleeves are just too tight to be comfortable).  I wore a size 12 when I usually wear a 10 and had no problem dancing.  I paired it with nude heels and some sapphire drop earrings for fun and the combo was pretty awesome.
This dress is amazing. I got a ton of compliments. Like most people said the arms are a little snug but it didnt get in the way. The dress just fit beautifully.

Beautiful dress! More burgundy than maroon. The sleeves on this dress are no joke! Size up if you have not-skinny arms. The 8 fit the rest of my body well, but could not get it past my elbows! The 10 fit well - a little loose all over, but the arms were still tight. No stretch here, so be cautious.

Beautiful, but maybe too mature This dress was beautiful, but I did not end up wearing it because it made me feel a bit too matronly. The 4 fit great. The length was good, but the shirt was a little too full and made me feel hip-py. Such a bummer.
I Loved! the pockets. The fit was perfect - comfortable. I highly recommend this dress!

Perfect dress for the perfect day! I usually wear an 8/10, but saw from some of the reviews it could run a little small so decided to go with a 10 and 12 as a back up/. The 10 fit, but because of my bust the dress pulled tight across my chest and made it a little difficult to move my arms. Once I put the 12 on it was perfect! I wore it for my sister's surprise bridal shower and everyone loved it! I got so many compliments and people couldn't believe it was rented! I loved this dress and would definitely consider renting it again.

Perfect Fit!!! I LOVE this dress!!! I am a RTR Pro member and I used this as my birthday rental for going to dinner with my boyfriend. It fit perfectly. I thought it would maybe be bit too "frilly" with the full skirt and maybe make me look bottom-heavy but the fabric is heavy enough that it falls quite nicely and doesn't poof out too much. I wear a 36A bra and usually have problems with dresses being a bit too tight on my rib cage, but this fit so perfectly. It would probably fit fine if you have a smaller band size as long as you have a larger cup size as well, otherwise it might be a bit too loose (at least in a size 8). I rented the 8 and 6, tried the 8 on first, and it fit so perfectly I didnt even try on the 6!

Great dress for Outdoor Fall Wedding I wore this dress to a wedding outside in San Diego in October. I loved this dress so much, I wanted to keep it!  Fair Warning: the lining is THICK!! So I would not recommend this for any outdoor event when you know it will be warm. I tend to be between size 8 and 10. While the 8 fit, the 10 fit better, but it is pretty true to size.  It fit like a glove through the bust and the waist and flared out at just the right spot. The pockets were super helpful, too. Sleeves were a tiny bit tight, but  nothing uncomfortable. It was a great dress to dance in and I received complements on it all night long. Would definitely rent again.
The dress was just okay. It fit but I felt a like I was drowning in the dress just a little bit.

Perfect for fall! This is such a pretty dress! The color is even prettier in person. I wore it to an outdoor wedding in Virginia and it worked out perfectly. I ended up wearing the size 2 because the 0 was a little snug. The only downside I found was that due to the way the dress is made, you have restricted arm movement, which isn't the worst problem you could have. I just found it a little annoying at times. However, I really enjoyed the dress and it would be something I'd rent again.

I do not want to return this dress! This dress fit me like it was tailor made to my body. It hit right above the knees and was super comfy. I received compliments all night long and people loved the idea of renting a dress! I will definitely be renting again! I paired this with nude pumps and a floral clutch for a wedding in May.
Gorgeous dress but a tad but too long and I'm 5'6. Fit very well and material is beautiful. The color is stunning!

On the fence... I usually wear white and black so I decided to take a risk with this dress. The color is vivid and catches your attention but the pockets make your hips look larger. The print did not photograph well and made me look heavy and beware, there are 4 layers to this dress which makes it less than ideal for any summer event. The fit was rather small and will come down to your knees if you are short. I would recommend this for a fall/winter event to someone who is lean and average to tall in height.

RTR Gives Me Another Show-stopper  I absolutely love RTR and having said I have rented, by this time, too many times to count I have not been disappointed once. I rented this beautiful plum dress and the color was just perfect for me. I wore this over the summer when I was very tan (from working as a Lifeguard) and the color went perfect with my skin-tone. I also was very happily surprised to find out that this beauty had pockets, which I love! This dress was easy to dance in and wasn't uncomfortable at all. If you are bigger in the chest like I am make sure you get the extra size up because you might need it. I love this beautiful dress, the lace is to die for!

Amazing! This was my back up dress to a black tie event.  I am a 5'4", true size 4.  32B bra, 28in waist, and BOOOTY.  This dress hugged in all the right places.  I was going to wear it with 4in heals.  If felt I could have gone a bit longer in the dress because it came to my ankles so I wore the other dress I rented.  This dress is an understated beauty!  Great material, a bit heavier than I thought it would be...but it would not have been uncomfortable at all for a night out.  Defiantly wear spanks if you get this dress...but over all it would have been an AMAZING dress if I needed this for a back up.

Dress is as expected and in clean condition. Will try RTW again for special events. The dress is good for formal affairs. Conservative enough with a little design. Nothing super fancy but material is comfortable and stretch. Some of the beads on the shoulder faded a little but nothing very noticeable. Runs true to size but will recommend size up for a more conservative look. Overall good value for the price.
I wore it to the Army Military Ball and it was very suitable for the occasion!! runs true to size, the petit is really short.  i am 5'5 and needed to regular. it was a great dress!

Gorgeous, with Zipper Issues The dress is gorgeous. It does run short like everyone says. I am 5'2" and with platform heels the dress did not hit the floor. Be aware that the side with the zipper puckers noticeably, perhaps from too much dry cleaning. I rented this 2x but did not wear it because of the zipper issue.

subtle, stylish great dress.  didn't end up wearing it, but it was a great weight, fit, and style.  i'm tempted to rent it again for an upcoming event, but will probably steer clear of black because everyone wears it.  the subtle detail on the arm and the slight drape is super classy - if you have a black tie function, or a 'black and white ball' - do consider this one.

Great Dress, great fit, too short.  I didn't get the long and should have since I am 5'9"! Dress fit well, comfortable and got a lot of compliaments!  Way too short for me, but I should have known and rented the 6L
Classy Really liked how the dress looked on but I am 5 ft 4 and it was a little short in the front. I would recommend getting a 4L if you're my size or taller!
Very flattering great dress! very beautiful

This dress was gorgeous .... Loved how elegant I felt " The whole , rent the runway  experience was phenomenal . The drees come on time , fit great and the entire process was easy .... It was PERFECT !!!
RTR made it so easy and painless. Loved this gown!  Fit like a glove, perfect length, and so comfortable.  Received many compliments.

Perfect fit & comfortable too! Loved this dress for a black tie work event. Very tasteful and classy, but with enough flair to make a statement. Fit really well all over and was very comfortable to wear all night long.
Dress fit ok but was way too short This was my backup dress and the appearance of the dress was nice, not amazing because the fabric had some snags, but was above my ankles

I wore this dress for a family wedding. Everyone said I looked very glamorous! I wore 4 inch heels and the length was perfect. Dress is form fitting, but not tight and not constricting. I recommend you try on this dress with the exact undergarments you are planning to wear. I didn't and you can see from the photo where my underwear hit my waist.
New Years Eve  Absolutely Beautiful Dress, very classy and elegant!  Very beautiful on and received many many wonderful compliments!  Fit perfectly, absolutely will rent again!

Very beautiful dress that I wore to the Emmy's. Many compliments!!! Fit true to size. I am usually somewhere between a 4 and a 6. I wore the 4L and it fit perfectly and was very comfortable. I totally agree that you should order the long. I wore 3 inch heels and the dress just hit the floor. Had so much fun and everyone we were with thought the dress was great!!!
This was a backup that I did not wear. Fit perfectly, however a bit short on me. It was a beautiful gown. Just not for the event I was attending.

I absolutely LOVED this dress.   This gown was the most comfortable I've ever worn.  It fits snugly around the shoulder and the drape of it is very flattering.  The fabric does have a bit of give and is heavy enough that it does not hitch at the hips or on the sides.  

It is somewhat short, so if you plan on wearing heels make sure you order the long versus the regular.  

I wore this while assisting my husband, a photojournalist, at the Academy Awards.  I was required to move a lot, run up and down stairs and walk very quickly between the press room and the editing room.  It was an EXTREMELY easy dress to move about in and would be a great formal selection for an event that might include a lot of dancing.

I felt like a princess! I wore this dress to the Southern Curves Vodka launch party and got lots of compliments! I am a very petite and short woman and was actually afraid the smallest size would be too big for me. It fit like a glove and hugged in all the right places. I will definitely be using RTR again!

Bridesmaids dress I wore this as my bridesmaids dress for a black/white wedding.  It was stunning and fit perfectly.  I would definitely order the long if you are 5'7 or over so that it is not too short.  The crystal beadwork on the shoulder along with the material cascading over the shoulder made this a "belle of the ball" type dress. Would work for any formal affair, very sexy.

seeing my husband's face when I walked in the room... I wore this for a black tie event and got lots of compliments.  I normally don't have to wear long dresses being 5'6'', but after reading everyone's review I'm glad i got the long.  It fit perfectly. I will admit that the beading and sequins look a little cheap up close, but from far away it looks great, and photographs great too. This was my first RTR experience and I will defintely do it again! Too easy.

Lots of compliments! I wore this for a black tie affair for work & it was perfect - sexy without being slutty, just fun enough without being obnoxious.  I thought the jeweled shoulder might look tacky, but it was beautiful & the dress fit PERFECT.  It IS a little short, I am 5'4" 1/2, but I wore kitten heels & it hit the ground juuust right.  100% recommend for a formal event - Very satisfied! Thanks RTR!
This dress was perfect for our gala! The dress fit perfectly and was the right length for my 3 inch heels.

Beautiful dress that fit like a glove. This dress runs short.  I am 5'6" and the long was only about an inch too long with 2" heels.  I used the temporary hem tape (included with my order!) to hem it and that worked just fine.  The dress was lovely, and with a pair of spanx and a strapless bra underneath, it fit like a glove.  I got a lot of compliments on it being very classic looking and beautiful.

I was getting compliments all night and felt stunning! Beautiful dress. I heard this dress ran short so I ordered a 0L and a 2L, I tried on the 0L and it fit perfectly. It was the perfect length for me with 3 1/2 heels. The beading is kind of a darker silver and almost blue, which I loved. This was my first time renting from RtR so I was a bit nervous, but I was super impressed; my dress came a day early along with a goodie bag of various samples which was cool, and the dress fit me like a glove. I felt very glamorous in it at my senior prom.. I would recommend Rent the Runway and this dress to anyone!

Perfect fit if you're short! I'm five feet tall (zero inches) and was convinced that I'd be tripping over every gown from this site. I had five-inch heels at the ready and some hemming tape. Boy was I pleased when this dress fit perfectly with TWO inch heels! The stretchy fabric also made it easy to raise or lower the dress a good couple inches.

I do not recommend the matching bracelets from this photo if you're petite, however; they were pretty overwhelming and I chose not to wear them.

Sexy black dress The dress was just gorgeous! I wore it to a friend's wedding! I don't have pictures, but I loved the dress. Everyone loved the dress! The fabric is perfect because it withstands wrinkles. I had to drive with the dress on for 40 minutes to get to the wedding and it looked perfect when I got out of the car. I love dresses like these.

Comfortable Fabric But Too Short I am approximately 5' 4.5'' and the 0R was too short even without heels on.  Once I put heels on it was really too short.  The jeweled shoulder piece also felt quite tight under my arm, which was rather uncomfortable.  Other than that the fabric felt nice and it was just a long black dress.  I would not rent again.

Very comfortable dress! Wore this to my friend's black tie wedding. As many others say, spanks are a must! I'm very glad I had the full length undergarment (the one that goes from just above your knee to just below your bust) because this dress definitely hugs you and would show any kind of panty line. Also glad I ordered the long. I'm 5"7' and wore 2.5" heels and I would say the dress was about a quarter inch too short. Not enough care obviously. The dress was very comfortable and is made of a stretchy material so it packed very well in a suitcase. I thought the jewels looked more silvery online but there is a blue-ish and almost mauve color to some of them. It still looked very pretty, just different than what I thought it was going to be. All in all a great dress that I got tons of compliments on!

Too short for black tie event Overall this dress is nice and safe but way too short. I think it should be longer to cover the shoes. Considering I'm not tall at all (actually petite size at 5'3"), it wasn't the problem of my height but design itself. Beading was great but it could have more. Fabric wasn't the one what I expected either. I wanted to order 2L but it wasn't available. If you like the design, I strongly recommend to go with longer version.

Perfect for petite ladies! This dress was rented for prom. It looked beautiful. No spanx needed. It was elegant, extremely flattering and (best of all) comfortable. This was our first rental, so we were very nervous. The dress fit perfectly and my daughter got lots of compliments.
My sis wore it and it looked great and she felt comfortable . It fit great however  it needed double sided tape on the side that's off the shoulder.
Lovely gown.  Runs very short... Should have reserved the longer length. Fabric was stretchy and easy to wear. Received many compliments on it.

LOVE LOVE LOVE this dress! I may even have to rent it again for the next Military Ball! This dress was fabulous. It was snug but not tight. I just had a baby 9 months ago, so I was worried might be too tight but it was perfect. I definitely suggest getting some spanx because this dress emphasizes your lower abdomen. Also, if you're around 5'3 or 5'4 and going to wear 3 inch heels,  I'd suggest getting the long. The dress was just slightly short but I just like dresses that cover my feet and touch the floor. This did not but I still loved it and it didn't make that big of a difference. I highly recommend this dress! You will not be disappointed!!!!

Love that RTR has options for searching by bust size/body shape, etc.  Extremely helpful This dress was so comfortable and fit me like a glove.  It was short for some reason (shorter than the 10r).  It would have been perfect if it were the length in the photo.  But my full size bust requires a certain type of dress...36G ladies.  It's exhausting finding a dress to fit so I accepted the fact it was short..  And the stretch fabric allowed me to move freely, sit, etc!  

Everyone at the Ballet Masquerade Ball loved it!  Definitely rent this one.
This dress runs short! Got this dress as my backup dress for the Marine Corps Birthday Ball (formal event).  In a 6L, this dress didn't even come down to my ankles!  Tall girls, beware!

Safe dress for a first rental I rented this dress because everyone said it ran short and I'm barely 5'1". It's nearly impossible for me to shop for anything that doesn't have to be drastically altered.  It worked out well. I ordered the 8 and the 10. The 8 was the one that fit, but it had a problem with the side zipper popping outwards two to three inches directly at the hip which ruined the sleek silhouette of the dress.  I wasted a couple hours trying to see if I could get the zipper to lie flat but it appeared to be a problem with the way the zipper, lining and dress were sewn together at that spot (that particular dress should be taken out of circulation).  I gave up and ended up wearing the 10 which was not as flattering but at least the length was perfect.  What made the rental a winner was the jewelry I got to go with it. Even though the dress wasn't perfect, I still felt like the overall impression was quite good. The dress itself is forgiving and the fabric stretchy. A slightly tighter fit looks much better than a loose fit.

This dress was my "plan A" but didn't end up working out. Even though I ordered a long, this dress was too short for me - and I'm only 5'9". I also felt like the decorative shoulder part looked tarnished. I still had a great RTR experience though, my plan B dress was fabulous!

... This dress was amazing; however, like most reviews stated the length of the dress was short. I rented a 0R ( the long was not available), and a 2L for the back up. I ultimately wore the 2L because the length was just the way I wanted it. If you are small bust like myself, the size 2 may fit a little loose.

Great dress! Perfect for a black tie wedding. Runs a little short, barefoot it is floor length but with kitten heels it's a little short. Very comfortable dress and elegant! The shoulder detail adds the right amount of sparkle.

Beautiful dress that fit like a glove! This was my first RTR rental & I was very pleased! The dress was beautiful but I was a little surprised by how form fitting it was. I ordered a 6R & 8R. I ended up wearing the 8R but it did have some stretch so that helped. I got lots of compliments & my favorite part was the sequined shoulder!
The look I rented this dress for a Valentine Dance and loved it. The fit was perfect for me, the quality was great and the compliments kept coming.  Would definitely rent again.

nice dress This dress was very nice but it was a bit large.. I usually wear either a 6 or an 8 so I was surprised when the 6 fit loose on me.  It arrived the day before my event and ready to be worn.  I was very happy with it and got good reviews from friends at the event.

Perfect dress for any formal affair. Felt ready for a red carpet walk in fabulous couture that fit Fit perfectly. I'm short but wore a 4 inch heel that worked great. Not difficult to walk in despite the mermaid-esq fit. Material was a little heavier than I expected but it was chilly that night and thus worked out well. The material is also flattering.  Some sort of bra is needed.  I used the nude non-adhesive push up breast covers which worked fabulously. This dress is amazing and that's how I felt. Perfectly appropriate for a black-tie optional affair
Very comfortable! A little short but a great dress! Definitely order the Long. I am 5.7 and the 4L was still short for my liking. But the dress was very comfortable and looked great!

Gorgeous Gown I rented this to wear to a benefit and received many compliments.  The size 6 fit perfectly and was surprisingly comfortable.  It hit the floor without heels on.  With my very high heels, the dress hit right about mid-heel.  Still looked fabulous and I actually liked the fact I wasn't worried about tripping over it all night.

SO SHORT! Before renting this dress, I read the reviews and saw that it ran short, so I ordered the long. I didn't think it would be above my ankles!! I am tall, but even going up a size would not have helped. Beautiful dress, just very short.

Dresses came in on time, were very simple to return, and they were in beautiful condition. It runs a little short.  I usually wear a 2 and you could see my entire heel in the two, so I suggest going a size up! Other than that it's amazingly beautiful and very easy to move in! I danced all night!

Loved this dress! This dress was absolutely beautiful & the beadwork on the shoulder does not get any justice from these pictures! It was gorgeous!
I normally wear a size 12 but the 12R was very loose around the bust area and a little loose around the waist but extremely form fitting around the hips on down.  Spanx are a must!  
I did not wear this dress to my formal affair but did a dress change for the after party because it definitely runs very short. I wish I would have ordered a long as suggested because I am a curvy girl but didnt think I needed to because I had not planned on wearing 3" heels. I'm 5'5-1/2" and without any shoes on it did not cover my toes.  
Otherwise, it's a very beautiful & comfortable dress!

Great dress for a great evening.  The dress is really beautiful on and the drapey bit on the back is so elegant. This dress runs short! I am 5'2 and I needed the long to wear heels of any height. I ordered the 0L and the 2R. The 2R was more comfortable around the mid-section, but gaped open at the top (plus too short!). I went with the 0L and although I am pretty slim, I preferred to wear spanx to smooth everything out. I was super comfortable all night.
I went to the Marine Ball with my sisters and I had the time of my life. This dress is beautiful. The fit is amazing and it will make you feel like royalty....lol

Back up dress This dress was my back up and I didn't wear it. It fit really well all over, except it was several inches too short. It didn't hit the ground like in the picture. The train barely touched the ground and in front you could see my entire shoes. Also, some of the paint on the beading has worn off of this size.

Most innovative way to enjoy a special occasion stressfree, hasslefree. Where do I start....Unfortunately, I ordered incorrectly so there was a chance that I would receive my dress for the wedding late. I brought my back-up but I was still hopeful, after all, it was my fault. Customer service was so helpful and patient providing tracking numbers and kind words. My dress was delivered at 10:34am and due to the madness of the day I got my package at 4:30. How elated I was to receive my first runway box!! The packaging was everything I imagined a couture dress to be handled. I ordered 2 sizes just in case and the fit was AWESOME!! I loved it, I loved everything about this service. I'm hooked and I will use this service again.

Another woman had rented this same dress, noticed mine, and said she loved it on me! This was my first experience with Rent the Runway and I was very pleased with the process and the gown.  It fit beautifully, true to size, and I received compliments all evening.  I am 5'8" and ordered the 10L and it was perfect with my heels.
Could not be happier This dress fit perfectly, which is surprising given that I'm petite and curvy.  I received countless compliments on this amazing dress!

Flattering fabric, right amount of bling and one shoulder detail - compliments received all night I travelled to London for a 10year company anniversary celebration. Fabric of dress travelled perfectly. Fabric falls beautifully. Right amount of bling to make it eye catching. Went for L on recommendations from others on this website and glad I did.  R would have been too short with heels. Went for large green 'emerald' earrings and recommended bracelet. Glad I did as it added a little something extra. Red lips finished off the evening perfectly.

Flattering fit, good for a formal event. Runs short for tall women. Fit well, was comfortable and I was able to wear a strapless bra underneath for more support. However, even the long sizes do run a bit short on taller women wearing heels. Would have been perfect if it was just a little longer!
Beautiful dress! Ordered a 6L which is my regular size and dress fit perfect!  I'm 5'9" so even the long was a bit short, but it worked and felt great. Looking forward to my next event with RTR!

Fit like a glove! Loved everything about this dress. Fit perfectly, so comfortable, beautiful beading on the shoulder just amazing! I'm 5'7 and I was able to pull off 3" heels which was exciting because the last long dress I rented I should of worn flats!
Great I could have went a size smaller but the 4 was fine.  I felt very elegant.

I was so comfortable in this dress from 6:00 p.m. - 3:30 a.m.  What more could you want?   This dress was beautiful and perfect for a black tie event.  In addition, it's a dress that works for multiple ages and body types.  My only complaint is, like others have repeatedly mentioned, short.  I'm 5'7" and ordered the extra length.  Even still, I could not wear the shoes I originally intended and needed to drop down to a much lower heel.  This dress fit well in the waist/hips, but could have used another inch in the bust.  However, that is not an uncommon problem for me.
Fit like a glove. Got lots of compliments.  Subtle elegance. Classy navy, the lace was not too much.
Beautiful dress- received tons of compliments all night! Perfect dress for a formal event. Dress was true to size. Definitely reccomend!

I need to own this dress!  :) This was a perfect dress for a perfect evening. I wore it to an event where I was meeting a former first lady. I knew I wanted to look sexy, but still conservative... this dress was perfect. I received so many compliments on it throughout the evening. I felt fabulous. Paired the dress with teardrop gold/diamond earrings and a tennis bracelet. Wore berry colored lipstick and nails... they looked great. I would highly recommend this dress (and the RTR experience) to anyone.

I wore this dress to the 2013 Marine Corps ball. This dress was very comfortable and I was getting compliments all night.  I'm small on top, but even with the open back, this dress fit like a glove.  Wish I didn't have to send it back.

Didn't wear it. Dress was very snug....2L fit like a glove, but a little TOO long.  Dress was very pretty. Did not wear though. It was a little too tight and too long. Would have loved to have tried on a 2R and a 4R. Luckily, RTR overnighted me a back-up dress that I'd worn before to a totally different event with different people, so I knew it would fit.

I wore this dress to a Military Ranger Ball.  This dress was perfect. It hugged me in all the right places and fit like a glove. The dress was super comfortable and looked good the whole night. The size was true but the dress does run just a tad on the short side. I rented a 6L and an 8L. Both dresses fit but the 8 was a little longer so I wore that one. The dress stretched really nicely so it was easy to move in. The only sad part about this dress was when I had to send it back. The open back was super elegant and I wore a stick bra underneath it. The fabric of the dress is thick enough that you could go without a bra too, if you wanted.
Got so many compliments!! Super comfortable.  The 0 and 2 seemed similar-- could've worn either, but went for the 0

Timeless, elegant...it was the best night ever! Normally I wear a size 0. But, unfortunately the dress sent to me was stretched and didn't lay right. So, I used the size 2 instead, and it worked just fine. I literally had people coming up to me the entire night telling me how much they loved the dress! And, it was extremely comfortable! I wore 4 inch heels and the length was perfect
The wedding was gorgeous, and the gown was perfect for the event! Everyone kept commenting on how well the dress fit and how beautiful it was!

Stunning! I wore this dress for a ball, and it was perfect.  It's not only beautiful, but is actually comfortable!  I ordered a size 2R and 0R.  I ended up wearing the 2R - because it was longer and looked more like I was wearing the gown, rather than the gown wearing me.  I wore 4 in. heels, and the dress was just the right length.  The size 0R was significantly shorter.  The dress fit like a dream, and I received compliments all night long.  I was sad to send it back!  I originally thought this was a black dress when I ordered it, but it is a dark navy - either way, it's simply gorgeous!  This was my first RTR experience, and a great one.  I highly recommend this dress and RTR!

My daughter told me I looked beautiful! With many thanks to all those who reviewed this dress, I was confident that it was "the one", and it was in so many ways.  A bit long, but as it was an outdoor wedding, I wore wedges rhinestone sandals instead of heels.  Hair up to show of the fabulous back cut-out.  There was a woman wearing the most amazing dress - told her she looked amazing - she said it was from RTW!

Stunning dress but warm! I love love loved this dress!! It's quality was second to none and everyone commented on how beautiful it was.  It was incredibly flattering and I wish I owned it but heads up, it has several layers so your legs get warm!! Don't wear lotion or you'll end up like a sweaty mess like I did :) I would hands down rent it again.

Perfect fit This was my backup dress, but it was perfect for my black tie work event. Easy to move in, professional, while still glamorous. Wore 2 1/2 inch heels, and would have been perfect with 3 inch. First time with RTR and I will definitely rent again!

Absolutely loved this dress! This was my first RTR experience, and I already look forward to using it again! I was worried about ordering this fitted dress because of my wider hips, but this dress fit perfectly. It was very elegant and also really comfortable. I'm 5' 5.25", and the regular length was perfect with a pair of flats. Also, the navy lace is just gorgeous. I received many compliments on this dress, and I wish I could keep it! The front is conservative, and the back details are unique and beautiful. The boning in the dress was shaped perfectly to make me totally comfortable not wearing a bra as it wouldn't work with the open back. The entire RTR experience was incredibly easy and efficient, and I highly recommend it to everyone.
All my girfriends renting dresses from this website and all of us looking fabulous! The fit was true to size and was comfortable.
As comfortable as it is glamorous! This was my 2nd option dress for a black tie dinner and I ended up loving it MORE than my first option. The back is stunning and the dress is super comfortable.

Elegant and flattering lace gown The fit was perfect!  The navy blue lace is beautiful and the gown was so flattering.  The top had nice coverage and the dress was lined with a buttery silk that was so comfortable. It had a beautiful sway and flow to it while dancing.  I wore this to a black-tie wedding in Chicago in mid-winter and it was the perfect dress.  I wore a size 2 and it fit perfectly.  4 would have been too long and the 0 too tight.  2 fit like a glove.  My only regret is that I had to return it!

I tried this dress through the At-Home Try-on option. The process was so easy and seamless! This dress is beautiful!  the length was great and the fit very flattering, but the bodice was too long for my 5'3 frame - I had about an extra 4 inches of dress above my shoulders.

Best Dress Ever! This is to date the most favorite dress I've ever worn. The color was a dark navy blue and the dress fit perfectly on me.   Wore to a black tie wedding and received compliments galore.   Rent this dress, you won't regret it!

Beautiful for black tie wedding I rented a size 6 as the 4 was unavailable. Fit was slightly big on me so I would say this is a true size 6. Very comfortable to wear all night. I'm only 5'3" and wore the dress with 4" heels, leaving an inch clearance for the dress. I'm a 34D bust so I normally get concerned with a sticky bra but the boning held everything in place. If the 4 was available it would have been perfect. Great dress.

PERFECT This dress fit me perfectly. There was just enough extra fabric at the torso for my body to move (read: dance) easily. I had a backless bra on, but I could have gone without and it still would have been perfect. With three inch heels, the dress just brushed the ground when I walked. I felt elegant the entire night.

Beautiful dress for a formal xmas party The fit was true to size.  Like others I did not wear a bra with it because I didn't need it.  One thing (my fault) that I didn't notice was the picture looks black to me but the dress showed up and was navy.  It was an oversight on my part.  I received several compliments on the dress and I would most definitely rent this one again.  Very pleased.

The perfect dress! I wore this to an ROTC ball and I got compliments on this dress the entire night! I normally wear a size 4L dress, but the size 2L seemed to fit better.  It hugged all the right places and was the perfect length with 3 inch heels.  I highly recommend it!
Dress was incredibly flattering and comfortable. Loved it.  It was a tiny bit shorter than  would have liked, but otherwise, loved the fit, color and style.

beautiful dress, really enjoyed wearing it fit beautifully.  I thought i would have trouble trying to wear a sticky bra and I did, I hated it, but it turned out I didn't need anything b/c the dress is built with structure to hold everything in place!  It was super comfortable and I loved wearing it.  lots of compliments!

I wore it to a big gala & wanted something special. This dress was perfect for the occasion! I have too much black in my closet so loved the navy color of this dress! I wore a shorter heel so had to be careful not to step on the bottom hem. It's a stretchy, comfortable fabric.

Beautiful & comfortable Elegant, formal dress.  Extremely comfortable, runs fairly true to size.  Low back so you can't wear a bra.  It is a big fitted in the chest, and might have been a little tight with a very structured bra on.  I got endless compliments all night long at my cousins wedding!

"You have the best dress at the ball!" I was between this and another dress for the Marine Birthday Ball I was invited to, but once I tried this one on I knew it was perfect. It is close-fitted but completely classy, and made me feel so glamorous. The back is gorgeous and my boyfriend loved it. It does require a backless bra, but the result is amazing. The 2L was too long for me, even in four inch heels, so I did step on the hem a few times, but it was not a big deal at all. I would definitely rent this again, just as a 2R.
Perfect dress for a black tie wedding. Fits perfectly even for a small chested girl.

This dress was so different from a typical blinged-out prom dress, everyone loved it!!! This dress was so incredibly stunning when I first got it.  The 12L fit like a glove and emphasizes those good curves.  I received tons of compliments on the gown at my prom.  Even my super picky gay friend said I was styled the best heheheh.  I can't believe there could even be a con with this dress, but it's super minor.  The dress is a tad heavy to be dancing your booty off in.  Which wasn't a big deal at all, I wouldn't have traded this dress for anything.  PERFECTION.

Perfect Dress for an Urban, Black Tie Wedding I never wear evening gowns and felt super fancy in this. Was a little worried this gown might be too long, but it just grazed the floor (I wore 3-inch heels). Only trouble was the back, which was too big. I have a small frame, and the hook and eye closures between the shoulders would not hold, since they weren't pulled tight enough. I was able to layer one side over the other and have a friend secure them with safety pins. And I wore my hair down, so I don't think anyone noticed. Didn't wear a necklace but did borrow sapphire/diamond drop earrings, which were perfect.
Felt so elegant! It was the perfect length for my 2.5 inch heels, fit like a glove and was so comfortable!

Perfect for my son's wedding. I received so many compliments on this dress! The weather was unusually cold for November in Louisiana, so I wore my Rent The Runway Maribou Caplet along with the dress, which looked amazing. I am 5'6 and wore heels, If you are 5'5 or taller, I would recommend the long. I usually wear a 4 or 6, and the 6 fit better. It was a little loose in the shoulders, but that was not a problem. I wore a sticky strapless bra. You cannot wear a regular bra with this dress,  A small bust may need even need a bra.

Didn't wear this dress, but it was beautiful!  This dress fit perfectly in all the right places, but it was WAY to short!  I ended up wearing the backup that RTR sent me and I'm so glad they did! I'm 5'6", 125 lbs and the dress was up to the tops of my ankles with 3" heels on.
Beautiful and comfortable. Dark blue...almost black Im petite and the length is just right. Very comfortable  yet sexy and ellegant!

So Glamorous! Wore this for a black tie wedding and got SO MANY compliments. It was elegant and classy, but also super comfortable. IF YOU ARE TALL (over 5'7") OR WEARING HEELS, DEFINITELY GET THE LONG! They did not have a 6 so I wore an 8 and it fit fine, though a 6 would have probably been more curve-hugging and flattering. When it came in, some of the lace was bent in the wrong direction from being folded, but I used a hair straightener to clean up the edges no problem :) Would definitely rent again!

LOVED THIS DRESS! This dress is amazing!! I am usually a 2 or 4, they didn't have the 4L available so I ordered the 2L and 6L  - the 2L fit perfect! I wore 2.5 inch heels and the dress just skimmed the ground. I have never received so many compliments in my life, people kept coming up to me asking me where I got the dress! Rent this dress!!

Glamorous and comfortable! I rented this dress for a formal New Year's Eve function.  I ordered my normal size (4R) and 2R as a backup.  The 4R fit perfectly so I went with that one.  It dragged just a bit while barefoot so I probably should've tried a 4L but with 2 inch heels it still looked fine.  Pretty sure it was my pear shape that caused the dress to be a bit shorter on me.  Loved the way it hugged my curves and yet was so comfortable!  I wore it with a NuBra to help fill out the top.  Lots of compliments on this one!
Absolutely Perfect The dress came on time, and was perfect! Only thing is I have a very small bust and was loose at the top.

Classy, comfortable, formal dress This is a really lovely dress, but the dresses I received are clearly near the end of their rental lives - the lace seemed a bit worn and frayed, there were a few strings loose... it didn't look tattered, but just wasn't in as good of a condition as I expected. The length was perfect with some 2 or 3 inch heels, and I felt very classy and comfortable in it all evening.  Additionally, I have been a bit in-between sizes lately... I have worn some size 6 dresses in the past and wear size 4 pants; I ordered the 6R, which was clearly too big, and the 4R, which I wasn't swimming in, but expected to be a bit more fitted. Overall the fit was nice, and didn't feel excessively tight or loose in any areas, but I wonder if perhaps a 2R might have fit me better. Oh well! I still enjoyed wearing the dress and got lots of compliments on it at the formal wedding I attended.

Super comfortable with beautiful back  I wasn't sure about renting this dress, but had a last minute issue with one of the dresses I was supposed to receive so had to find something that could be delivered same day. I wasn't expecting much, but it was such a fabulous dress once I put it on. The tags were still on it when I received it! The boning made sure the dress fit the torso well and kept the nubra I wore in place! The dress was more comfortable than I expected and the lace had some give to it. I received a ton of compliments on it, especially when people saw the back of the dress. It was a perfect choice for a formal charity function I went to. The navy color makes it stand out against others in black dresses and it also has a slimming effect. I wore spanx tights and that was enough to smooth out my profile.
