I'm slightly shorter so I worried about the length, but the regular length with four inch Ferragamo's did the trick and I was able to dance without any issues. I would definitely recommend for those looking for a comfortable and classic dress.

The Lace detail on the back is to Die for! I needed a dress for a wedding and didn't want to Out Do the bride but still wanted to feel confident and sexy! This dress achieved all of the above! I received compliments all night from friends and strangers and most importantly my husband loved the dress too! It fit like a glove I'm 5'5 and wore a size 2r (normal size) with 4" heels! Another amazing experience with my Rent The Runway girls! Xoxo

I had an amazing time at Gala we went to last Saturday night and I felt great in this dress! The dress fit perfectly and was perfect for the event. It was elegant and classic and ALSO comfortable!  I usually wear black to a formal event but this navy was very complimentary and was just different enough without being too "out there".   I might have been able to get away with the long length given the height of my shoes but the regular length showed just a enough of my cute shoes without being too short.  I wore a black strapless bra and it didn't show at all.  I got tons of compliments during the evening.  Great dress!
RTR made it so easy! The dress fit like a glove!! This was my first RTR experience so I was a little nervous. I loved the dress and got so many compliments. Will definitely use RTR again!!

Felt amazing in this dress! My first RTR gown and it didn't disappoint!  I attended a gala at which I didn't know many people and I had strangers approaching me to tell me how gorgeous this dress was!  I did have to wear flats or else the dress would have been too short despite getting the longer length.  It was odd, but the 8L seemed longer to me.  I only wish I could've zipped up the smaller size (got it 3/4 of the way up) not only due to better length, but the top fit better too.  But, despite thinking the top was a little loose, it didn't bother me all night and I don't believe anyone else noticed.  I did have to wear a NuBra.  The lace seemed a little worn, especially around the edges, but I honestly think that helped to soften the gown!

Very elegant I rented this dress for a black tie wedding. It was very elegant and stylish but still conservative enough to wear in the church. I rented the 0R, if I were to rent again I would get the 0L because the 0R was a little short when I wore my heels. The dress is a little loose on top if you are small like me but did not prevent me from wearing the dress. The navy color is really beautiful and the style of the dress is very flattering, especially the cut out in the back. I highly recommend this dress if you are looking for a classic, elegant dress
Very pretty, classy dress. Lovely dress, I only didn't end up wearing it because I was 3 months pregnant at the time and it is very fitted at the midsection.

Wore to a Gala and felt great! This dress is very pretty!  Random people came up to me to tell me they loved my dress!  I think the fit is flattering.  I really liked the way my figure looked, with broad shoulders, I was a little concerned the top would make me look footballerish, but I didn't feel like that at all.  Plus, this dress worked well with my large bust.  I really liked  The length was great.  I'm 5'8" and wore 3.5" heels with no problems.  
However, the dress was not in new condition.  There was a small tear in the lace on one arm and the lace edging was not in great shape.  I had to trim it up because a handful of long strings had been pulled.  Nothing to make it unwearable, but not the quality I'm used to with RTR.  I think this dress doesn't stand up to lots of cleanings, so just something to consider.
The dress fit like a glove! Simply amazing and elegant.

Gorgeous dress! I absolutely LOVED this dress.  It was my first dress rental from RTR and I was definitely apprehensive about the sizing and length.  I decided to order a Regular and Long as back-up, since I am 5'6 and right at the cut-off.  I ended up wearing the Long, which was perfect with 4" heels.  The dress was amazing!  It fit perfectly and was so appropriate for the BTO event.  The double lining helped hide any problem areas and the dress was super comfortable to wear.  I got complements all night long and felt amazing!

A Wonderful Evening My first experience with Rent the Runway was a great one! I wore this dress for my churches 100th Centennial Gala. I felt very elegant and received many compliments. I will definitely be using this site in the future. The dress fit very nicely and I was comfortable the entire night. I am 5'7" and I am glad I got the long dress.

Gorgeous lace and cut Great fit. There wasn't that much difference between the 2 or 4. I went with the 4 because it was a tad looser and I was wearing it to a black tie work event. It was gorgeous and I felt really elegant and get a ton of compliments. I was glad I got the the long or it would have been short with heels

The most beautiful dress I have ever worn.  Super flattering and very elegant. My usual size 4R was not available.  Based on the reviews that the dress ran large, I sized down.  I was nervous that it wouldn't fit, but it was perfect.  I am only 5'3" so I had to wear 4" heels so that the dress didn't drag on the ground.  The dress is very flattering and super comfortable.  The cutout in the back is the best part because it is sexy while still being very formal and conservative.  I received many compliments and felt great in the dress.  I wore one of the stick on silicone bras because without it I would look very flat-chested, but the dress is well constructed and I could definitely see others not needing a bra.  The top was a tiny bit loose, but the rest fit perfectly.  It has a bit of stretch to it and is well-constructed which explains why this dress looks fabulous on so many different body types.  This is my first experience with RTR and I couldn't be happier.  I saved money and time, had tons of options, and got to wear a beautiful designer dress that I never would have been able to buy.  I will never buy a formal dress again!

Beautiful dress...truly! The dress was worn to a wedding, and i have to say, it fit beautifully...it hugged the right places!  i chose to wear a strapless bra, i am on the larger side up top...just worked for me...i received so many complements on this dress...I just fell in love with the back of it...I was sad sending it back!

Perfect as a bridesmaids dress in a religious wedding! Fit a little snug but that was the only problem. You can't wear a bra with it, but you don't need one. Besides that it's comfortable and a nice thick material. Perfect for a bridesmaid dress!

The highest ranking officer's wife approached me at the Military Ball and raved about the dress The dress fit like a glove. It didn't pull or gather in places I didn't want it to. Due to my lack in height, I did have to wear heels, but not any that were obnoxiously tall. My only con/regret is that I forgot to take a picture with my hair back to show off the beautiful detailing of the neckline.  The dress speaks for itself. I think I could've shown up with my hair on top of my head with no make-up on and people still would've said I looked beautiful. Rent this dress if you want to make a statement without having to use words.

This dress is Gorgeous!!  This dress was absolutely beautiful and fit like a glove. I have a large bust and not wearing a bra was not an issue in this dress. I received many compliments throughout the night and I felt amazing in it! Unfortunately I don't have any full body photos but you won't regret getting this dress!
Beautiful dress and great fit the 6l fit perfect, would rent again. loved this dress!!

No one else had this dress and I was so happy to have been the only one. Compliments all night!! The fit was good, it wouldve been fitter at the waist but the top part seemed to get all bunchy. But in the end i felt super elegant and classy and I will definately rent again!!

A beautiful wedding but wished I felt more comfortable in the dress. Had the fit been right I think this dress would have made me feel glamorous.  However, the stylist that I chatted with said that the dress ran small and suggested two sizes that I never wear (8 & 10) based on the measurements that I gave her,  so I ordered a 6R and an 8R.  The 6R could have been comfortably tighter in the hips and belly and was much too large on top. I suspect a 4L would have been right on.  I had to pin the back way over on the top and was paranoid the whole evening about it coming down.  Despite all this I still received many compliments on the dress and loved the way the skirt moved on the dance floor.
So beautiful and so comfortable! I got many complements on the dress)) I never regretted that I chose to wear it
Great dress!!  So many compliments all night long. Wore it to a black tie wedding and it was perfect True to size, great fit and great dress!

Stop debating renting a dress from RTR and do it. Best customer service experience I've ever had. This dress was an absolute dream. Beautiful fit, classic, and very figure flattering. 

I used the Badgely Mischka size chart on their website and ordered the 4 and the 6 as I was thought it might be tight on my hips and thighs. When they came I realized I would be better off with the 2.  RTR overnighted me the 2, with a necklace, for free!  Overall, I would say go for the smaller size than what you typically wear. The fabric is very forgiving and the peplum covers any issues you might have with your stomach. The dress is a little long but I found that the smaller size helped to eliminate the train. I wore this in Philly and did hike up the bottom of the dress when walking through the streets so it didn't get destroyed. 

Rent this dress. Seriously.

great dress for black tie charity event loved this dress, very comfortable. I had some trouble with the lengths though. I tried on a 4L at the showroom and I ordered the 4R, but it was still way too long. Luckily the 2R I ordered for backup fit me and was perfect length.

Great Dress! I loved this dress! I wore it to a black tie wedding and it was perfect. It was comfortable enough to wear for 7 hours and still feel elegant. The peplum part did not flare out as much as the model picture but other than that it was perfect and I received many compliments on it throughout the night!

Perfect for a formal evening  Con: the dress is a bit heavy... but that it
Pros: I'm 5'9 and I wore 5inch high heels and it was perfect.... it came all the way to the floor and it's slimming!

Nice flattering dress I probably could have went with the 2 R.  I'm 5'7" and wore 5" stillettos and this dress was still too long.   The zipper on this dress was absolutely ridiculous.  It was impossible for me to zip up by myself, so thank god for my husband.  That being said the dress is flattering and was great for my black tie event.

Lovely fabric, comfortable and forgiving Ordered a size 12R, but was unable to wear.  Im a 32 waist,  38B and typically wear a 12P in dresses. 12R fit well in all areas beside rib cage. sad trombone. Should fit those with a smaller a smaller bra size (less than 38). Other than this it was a lovely dress, quality fabric and forgiving with the peplum style.

Beautiful gown, runs small I love, love, loved this gown, but unfortunately, it was a little snug and the size I needed was not available.  I would recommend going 2 sizes up for a comfortable fit.  The peplum is great for disguising a tummy, but still offers a slimming silhouette.  I will look to rent this for another event.

Beautiful Dress!! This dress is absolutely gorgeous! I wore it to a formal wedding in Atlantic City and received countless compliments.  It takes some serious effort to zip it up but once it's on it's so comfortable! This was my first time ordering from RTR and it definitely won't be the last!  I wore the "Lulu Frost" Rococo necklace with it (also from RTR).  Loved the necklace as well!

Va va voom  Again this was another successful RTR dress and again I felt like Sofia Vergara. loved that this dress was boned because it just enhances your curves. I ordered a long because I am 5'7" and wore 4/5 inch heels and loved that the dress still touched the floor. This dress is a definite head turner.

There's just something about a black dress--add a bow and peplum, now you've an effortless winner. Beautiful, classic black gown with a peplum waist and a bow to add charm. The dress fit in the waist. However, it was a little large up top. A larger bra helped with this. Also, it ran a little a long. Although, I think that is how the dress is supposed to flow. I ordered a larger back-up size, but did not end up needing it. Finally, I got a lot of compliments and have no regrets!

Beautiful dress! Got lots of compliments. Fits true to size. A little tight around the hips if you have a bootie, but still very comfortable. I wore 3.5'' heels and the dress skimmed the floor just a little. Ended up having to hold it up when I was walking around.
I attended a black tie gala celebrating the career of a world-famous composer.  The chest area ran large for the waist size, but a slightly padded bra remedied the problem easily.

lovely dress
 This gown is beautiful. The length does run a bit long but I had 4.5 inch heels on and the regular length was perfect. I did not get to wear this dress because it did run a bit big in the bust area and I didnt feel like spending the extra money on a good push up bra. But I really could have worn it without one , It just wouldnt have looked as good. If youre on the smaller side up top, get a good bra. The material was great, layered well so you couldnt see anything as far as bulges or lines. The peplum detail falls right at the waist making for a beautiful shape. Rent this dress.

Elegant Dress Overall I was happy, the dress was sleek and elegant. I received multiple compliments.

I did have 2 problems. First, the dress was way too long! I ordered the 4R/6R and both were very long. I had to scramble last minute to buy 4 plus inch heels (I'm 5'4) and the dress was still a bit long. I had to hold up the dress practically the whole night, which was very much an inconvenience. Second, the 4 fit a bit too snug and the 6 too loose. Ultimately, i decided to go with comfort. Didnt feel the dresses were true to size.

Classy elegance. Perfect for a gala night. This dress was a bit of a risk for me because I wasn't sure if I would like the peplum but it turned out classy and elegant. I went with the regular length even though the recommended size was a 4L as many of the reviews here stated that the length was too long. I wore about 2.5" heels and the length was just right for me. The only fit issue I had was a that it was a little big at the bust which made me a little paranoid about slipping down, but I really had no issues with it slipping down or exposing my strapless. The dress fit perfectly at waist and hips. I felt very glamorous in the dress especially paired with my red lipstick. Super classy all the way. This dress will look great on anyone with an hourglass shape.

An Audrey Hepburn Moment Dress  This dress gives your body a stunning silhouette. The corset style top cinches in your waist and the bow embellishment is absolutely adorable. I loved how the train pooled at the bottom and how elegant i felt in this dress. This is THE perfect black tie affair dress.  I found that this dress ran a little snug up top. If you are larger chested, i would size up.

Beautiful, classy dress! I typically wear a size 4 and wore the 2L. I am 5'9" and this was really long.  I wanted to error on it being too long than too short though.  The bust was also way too big, but it wasn't very noticable.  Overall, it was perfect for a work black tie gala.  Very classy.

Soo comfortable! I didn't end up wearing this dress b/c my husband wasn't a huge fan (not sure why). If I ordered again, I might go with the 4 reg (even though I'm 5'11). However, I did think it was flattering and super comfortable.

This was a great dress although it ran small.  I didn't wear a bra with this dress, I felt way too much on display. The dress is awesome and I received tons of compliments. It hid everything I would normally be self conscious about. I added a halter ribbon to it to keep from messing with the strapless tug we all do.

All the compliments I got! Loved the dress! I got a 4 and 6 but ended up wearing the 4 because the 6 was a little loose on the bust area. The only problem was it was a little too long even though I got the regular (I just wore my highest heels to fix the problem). However, I kept getting compliments all night and definitely will rent again!
Gorgeous Fit great, really comfortable and super flattering.  It felt dramatic and expensive!
Loved it! Perfect dress! The bodice was a little large, but with a strapless bra it worked fine.
This was one of the most beautiful gowns I have ever worn and I would wear it again in a heartbeat! Very true to size and it fit like a glove. So happy with how it shaped my figure
The entire process was seamless- SO easy to order and send back! Love RTR! Such beautiful lines to this dress- it creates a stunning hourglass shape! Had other guests complimenting me all night!!
I could not wear the dress.  I am a true size 20.  This dress was extremely tight.   I am 5'5 and the dress seemed short on me.  I would recommend renting the long and opting for one size bigger.

Black tie event I was so excited by this dress but couldnt wear it unfortunately. My cup runneth over and I could not be seen at my work function like that. I will try again if it comes in a bigger size

This dress is so dang classy The chest was way too big for me so watch out for that if your one that isn't gifted in that area. I had to use ALOT of tape. But other than that it was great. It fit great everywhere else.

I wore this for our sorority formal in Atlanta at Turner Field The material was very comfortable and form fitting without feeling too tight. The dress was extremely flattering and I would definitely consider renting it again! An added bonus was that the 4R was the perfect length to wear with flats.

The dress fit like a glove! I got so many compliments  The dress was perfect! I'm short so it was about an inch too long, but with my heels on it was fine. I will most definitely use rent the runway again
Perfect for black tie wedding Got lots of compliments! Loved this dress.

Great fit, very flattering I just had a baby so I loved that it still gave me a shape but covered up the belly.  I have big boobs  so it was a little too booby for me but overall I was very happy with it.

The go-to-girls are fabulous!! This was my emergency backup.  I had a brief moment of panic when the shipping changed for delivery  for my original dress (same dress in red) to be the night of my event rather than the day before. One call and they had this over-nighted to me.  I was so thrilled when all four dresses showed up in time. Didn't even open the black back-ups!   This was my first time using RTR and I'm looking forward to my next event. (see my full review under the red version, but I loved this dress!!!)

Fantastic Dress I just had a baby three months ago.  I am still losing baby weight.  This dress really hid the baby belly!  It was very comfortable.  The long was perfect with 2-3" heels.  I am 5'8" with long legs.  My torso is short so the dress was a little long from the waist up.  The material is light and airy!  Nice lining.  There is a bit of a train on the dress.  I stepped on it a few times, as did others.  Over all, great dress!

Stunning dress and was complimented by strangers! I can't tell you how much I loved this dress!!! I wore it to a black tie wedding and was stopped in the hotel by a stranger to tell me how beautiful I looked in the dress. I hope to have an event to rent it again. It was very flattering for my post-baby body and super comfortable.

Had it fit, it would've been great! Unfortunately, this dress was too big for me to actually wear it, but if it had fit, it would've been great! the length with 3 inch heels was perfect for me and from what I could tell, the fit would've been flattering too. Hoping to get to try it in a smaller size at som point for another event.

Elegant dress I'm 5'6", 123 and 32B and the 0R fit perfectly.  I wore shoes with 3" heels and didn't step on it.  It is a very elegant and easy to wear dress.  I felt elegant, sexy and comfortable the whole night!  The dress was in very good condition without showing much wear and the material is substantial, quality dress!  I wish we had the option to buy the dresses that you like for a less than retail price.  I would have bought it!  :)
Didn't end up wearing it Didn't end up wearing it because it just seemed a little too cutesy for my style, but it is a flattering dress. A little too big in the bust for me.

I got so many compliments!  Perfect for a black tie wedding and flattering on the hips! So comfy too Definitely get the long length if you are 5'7 or taller. I am 5'9" and the 8R was at least 3 inches off the ground- I hadn't anticipated needing long so they overnight-ed me the 8L size and it was perfect with 2.5 inch heals. The back drags a little bit as it is longer than the front. Dress stayed up well and was very comfy for a long evening including a 2 hour commute to the wedding and back- it didn't wrinkle or anything. Very easy to wear! Did not need fashion tape.

Overall - amazing dress but it runs big! I wore this to a friend's black tie wedding in Napa, and it was a gorgeous dress. Got tons of compliments on it, and it's super flattering.  The peplum lets you eat as much as you want without feeling self conscious, and the skirt has a bit of a mermaid flare to it.  I'm tall, so at 5'8" I was worried that it would be too short on me.  It was JUST long enough - I wore 3.5" heels, and kind of wish they were 2.5-3" but it worked.  My only real complaint is that this dress runs big.  I read all the reviews over and over, and it says true to size, but I'm normally a size 6, and the size 4 had about 3 inches of extra fabric.  The size 2 would probably have been perfect, but my saving grace was that the fabric had some stretch to it, so it stayed up... just barely.  Thank god for strapless bras!

Overall, highly recommend - just size down by at LEAST one size, if not two.

The fabric has some stretch to it.

I received numerous compliments on this dress!   This dress fit really well. I would suggest getting a size larger than your normal size, however. I wore this for my sorority formal. It was very flattering and I was comfortable in it. It is an extremely well-made dress, and the peplum is so cute!

The dress came beautifully packaged. No wrinkles, and a beautiful dress that fit!




 This dress is as beautiful in person as it is in the picture! I ordered the long because I'm 5'9" and it still touched the ground with 3" heels on. The dress is comfortable. The fabric stretches a bit, which makes moving and sitting a breeze! The boning in the top helped to keep the dress in place. I would definitely rent this dress again!
the waist was incredibliy small, even in the larger size. the dress was small especially in the waist

The gown I ended up wearing. I selected this dress as my first choice but was unable to wear it because it would not zip over my bust (36DD).  The style was very flattering with the peplum, but my bust was totally deformed and spilling out over the top once zipped.  Although I am not tall, this dress seemed to run short and I would have only been able to wear a half-inch heel at most.  If I were to order again, I would need a 14L.  Beautiful gown!
A beautiful gown.  Was slim fitting, so was glad to have the next size up as a back-up. Received compliments all night long!

YES! I loved this dress... I felt amazing and gorgeous in this.  All the reviews are accurate and it fits really well. The fabric is a stretchy forgivable fabric with a built in corset. So it was amazing.. Love the peplum and how it hid my tummy, so it didn't have to sit straight at the dinner table all night. :) 

I have to say I'm 5'3" and the dress was crazy long. at least 2 inches too long in the OR size. I don't wear platform heels and just wore 3.5" heels and it still was 2" long. I had to buy fashion tape to make sure i didn't trip or damage the dress.

Gorgeous! Fit pefectly and was chic and stunning. I wore the size 4 and am 5'7" and 127 pounds. I am on the busty side (34D) but I did not feel like I was spilling out of the dress or showing too much skin! The length was perfect with 3.5 inch heels.

Beautiful for formal events! The dress fit amazingly well- I got compliments from strangers all night! I'm usually between a 2 and a 4 and this 2R was perfect! I wore it with 3.5 inch heels and the teeny train in the back dragged a little anyway and my toes barely peeped out. Because the top is a bustier you don't even need to wear a bra but I did, just in case. HIGHLY recommend this dress.

RTR was not able to send the original dress I had ordered, luckily this dress looked amazing!  This dress fit like a glove in all of the right places.  At first I thought this dress was entirely too boring, but my perception instantly changed after putting it on for the first time.  I received a ton of compliments.  The 8XL was actually long enough for me, almost too long!  I wore 4" heels and the skirt touched the ground. Tall girls rejoice!!!  I'd be interested to see how the 8L compares.
Fabulous dress, great fit and very elegant. I am slim, toned and  a 34dd. The 4 regular fit vet nicely. The length was perfect with a 5" heel.
Dress fit true to size and I was able to walk in it comfortable in 3" heels. I'm 5'0" Great dress for an elegant event at the Twins Stadium. Fit very well

Hands down the best dress I've rented thus far, and I've only had great experiences.  This is the most flattering dress I've ever worn.  If I could invest in buying it, I would without a second thought.  I have a very hourglass figure and sometimes these types of dresses can be unflattering.  Not the case here.  The waist is very tapered so I'd keep that in mind.  While I ordered a Petite since I'm so short, RTR immediately notified me that it was no longer available.  Along with an apology, they sent hem tape to make sure it wasn't too long.  Didn't even need the tape, just had to be mindful.  I've honestly never received so many compliments from a dress.

All the compliments I received for the classic dress. Thank you RTR for making this event epic 
 In 5"9  so the XL dress was more than long on me. I'm a 32A so the top was a little to large put a patted bra and beauty tape work well. This was not my fist choice of dress but  I'm more than glad that I did rent it because it was soooo worth it. In love with the dress wanted to wear it for the rest of my trip.

Runs Small & Short I  ordered a size bigger than I normally wear and it was still tight, i'm guessing two sizes bigger would of worked. I'm 5'7" and the regular was really short. It hit me at the ankle. If I had no choice I could have closed the zipper and looked like a stuffed sausage with a short dress on. But fortunately I had ordered a back up dress that fit better.   I did not wear this dress.

Sexy yet classy I wore this dress for a friend's wedding and it did not disappoint! The petite was still a little long for me so I had to wear very high heels. But the fit was very flattering even on a petite frame so I didn't mind the extra length. I would definitely recommend this dress and I feel like it would look great on all body types.
last minute success I wore this to a black tie event for work. It was very comfortable and flattering!  A sure bet...

Perfect for black tie function at work Rent the Runway has made special occasions at work so easy. This particular dress got nothing but rave reviews, and so many compliments throughout the evening. Although I was worried about wearing a strapless gown while working, this held up without any cause for concern. The boning on the sides helped keep everything together. And the length was perfect for 3" heels. Will definitely consider renting again!

I wore this to my sorority's formal, and it was perfect!!  Classic and elegant! The dress fit so well!  It highlights curves beautifully and the peplum is super flattering.  It has a little stretch.  The length was perfect on me with four inch heels; it just brushed the floor.  I will say that the material is very thick, and I was hot (temperature-wise) for most of the night.  It wasn't a huge deal, but I had to take some dance breaks to cool off.  I also wore the Falling Teardrops Necklace from RJ Graziano rented from RTR, and I thought it was absolutely perfect for the dress.
Cute, comfortable Loved the dress, Great for a night you aren't feeling the skinniest because the peplum hides the middle area. Bow is a great detail.

I got such nice compliments! It fit well, but was long on me because I was in a walking boot from a broken foot. If i had 3-4 inch heels, it would have been perfect. Very appropriate for a military ball, without showing too much skin. I wore a black tuxedo-style blazer with it, with little jewelry. Throughout the night, it got a little looser and my boot kept pulling it down:( but it would have been great with the right footwear!

Everyone complimented me :) The dress fit perfect! It gave you some curves too! And i loved walking around in it knowing that everyone was staring at my sparkly dress :) It was absolutely beautiful <3

Everyone adored it and loved it! Well I received this dress earlier than the expected date which was VERY good! When I tried it on, everything was tight and right! By tight meaning, it was the right tight around the chest area since I am a very small girl (32 A). When it came to the zippering however, it was a wee-bit difficult for a couple of seconds but gladly enough it zipped all the way. I had no problems with the dress, everything was fine but NOTE: Please hold onto the bottom of the dress to avoid any damage if you're wearing a 4 inch heel and you're about 5'8"and up like me. Or just wear a heel that a bit more taller. I do recall myself pulling my dress up a few times during my prom event but overall I give this dress about 9/10. It's a very glamorous dress and I just loved how my dress was basically the highlight for everyone at prom! I felt like I was a star.

Love Rent the Runway! Love Rent the Runway!  I rented this dress for New Years Eve in New York CIty and it was great!  Like others, I will agree that the zipper is very difficult to get up and down, you will definately need someone to help you with this!   The fit was great and length was good, although it was a little challenging walking through the streets of New York City.  Just hold it up and you'll be fine!  Bonus - it was very cold that night and the dress is heavy and kept me warm while we were outside!  Definatley recommend it to others!

Regal Sparkler!!! This was going to be my wedding reception gown...but though it was beautiful it felt a wee bit on the "heavy side" to wear on a steamy hot August day. Though I didn't get to show it off to everyone. I loved the way it looked. I will rent this one again for a cooler day!!!

Sparkle City! GORGEOUS! This dress catches the light in such a beautiful way. It's head-turning, compliment-inducing, it doesn't require a lot of accessories - it's really a statement piece & just an elegant dress overall.

I wore this dress for prom and absolutely loved it! I felt glamorous and classy; many compliments! I'm 5'6'' and got the 4L, since many reviews said the regular was too short. However the long was a little long on me, if your shoes are high enough it would be fine though. I was nervous that it was strapless and would fall down, but the dress has some boning and also a strip of sticky plastic to hold it in place.

This dress really accentuates your waist, but it also shows all of your curves so if you are self-conscious maybe this isn't for you. 

Overall just a beautiful dress, I totally stood out at prom and my date and I looked like we were going to the Academy Awards instead of just a dance.
My daughter looked and felt like royalty for her senior prom. She said she danced the night away. This dress is a god send for fit. it has give and stretch and allows for comfort while being fierce.

Very pretty dress. Has stretch which hugs your curves. Fits large I felt This was my second choice dress.  I did not receive my first choice dress, so I wore this one.  I got a 2R and a 4R.  I usually wear a 0 or 2.  I felt that it runs a bit large. It also has stretch to it, which was flattering for fit but also made the chest part large. I felt I had to keep pulling it up so it would fall off my chest!  I was able to wear a strapless bra with it which helped keep it up some.  Overall, a very beautiful dress. My husband loved it, and I got MANY compliments all night for it. Definitely recommend it if you want to feel elegant, beautiful, and steal the attention of the room!!!

Perfect Sparkly Dress! The dress was beautiful. I wanted something sparkly and this was definitely it. I ordered the 10L and the 8L and the 8 fit perfectly. The material is a lot more flowy than it looks it pictures which makes it more comfortable. I am 5'10" and with the long I wore flip flops. I could have worn a small heal, but not much more. I got compliments on it all night and renting through RTR was a great experience. I was very happy and will be renting more dresses from them!

I stunned everyone in the dress. It was classy and elegant. It fit perfectly, even though i would've gone with a 2 regular instead of long, but they were out of my size. It was the perfect dress for my occasion.

Stunning! So fun to wear  I loved this dress!! I wore it to a Mardi Gras ball in Louisiana and it was perfect. I was very nervous about the 6 fitting (I usually wear a 6 in long dresses but was nervous because of the skin tight design) but it worked out great. The design of the back was very flattering and hid any unwanted curves. I did add dress tape at the top to keep it from slipping down (I wear a B-C). Definitely need spanx and tall heels (I'm 5'6). Got so many compliments on the dress!!!

Beautiful dress; great fit. The dress is stunning and I got a lot of compliments.  The long wasn't long enough for me to wear heels, unfortunately, but I'm glad it almost touched the floor with flats.  The zipper is a nightmare, but after a lot of grunting, it zipped and fit well.  Beautiful dress, great fit and it seems as it would be flattering on most people.  Great experience; thank you!

Tons of compliments on the dress, beautiful evening. I got the 0R and the top clasp above the zipper broke, while the 2R had exposed boning. I had a formal event that night so I struggled through the lesser of two evils and had some pokey boning. The 2R was too long for me 5'3" in 5 inch heels, but I carried on. The 0R would have worked with length, but without the clasp it was hard to get the zipper up. The dresses that were sent to me had clearly been worn many times before and the little things about the construction showed that. 

Also, a lot darker gold than the picture shows. Also VERY HEAVY dress. So if you have to carry it/walk a ton, don't do it. Also don't count on a lot of cleavage with this dress. Being so heavy it kind of flattens you out and pulls down any attempt of push up.

Plus side: got a TON of compliments from random people I didn't know. Literally pulled aside twice.

So many complements!  Wish I could wear it again! Overall I loved this dress and felt so beautiful in it.  The color is a darker gold as many have mentioned, but since I wore only earrings and no necklace, it was fine to wear normal gold colored jewelry.  I am about 5ft 3.5 in. tall and wore 4 inch heels.  I think I could have worn slightly shorter heels so that dress would hit just a bit longer in the back (my right heel got caught up on the lining layer of the subtle train a couple of times).  Some other reviewers mentioned how the fabric hangs and isn't so flattering if you have a bit of a tummy.  I did find this to be true -  it certainly didn't hold anything in.  I adjusted where the ruching lay a few times during the evening so that it wouldn't accentuate my belly bump as much.  The bustline lay more straight across on me than in the picture online and it didn't feel like it a wire in the front of the cups, whereas my backup size (0R - way too small for me) felt like it had a heavy wire to give the cup shape, but it still looked great that way.  This was my first time renting from RTR but I will definitely do it again!

Glam gown has old Hollywood look. I  loved this dress. It's a classic fitting gown and the material in the front hides figure imperfections. I usually wear a size 12 but the 14 fit me in the hips better (I am hourglass shaped). The top was a bit loose but I wore a padded bra to help with that!

The dress was perfect for the occasion. Photographs perfectly.  After looking over many reviews I decided to get a 2R and a 4R which I thought was small, but the reviews seemed to agree it would work. It did not. I had to have renttherunway.com overnight a 6R and an 8R. The 6R fit like a glove. I wore taller heels (4 in) and the length was perfect. I got tons of compliments on the dress and it photographed perfectly. I would highly suggest using this dress.

Best dressed by far A really beautiful dress; I was definitely the best dressed at the company holiday party. Wore this to an Old Vegas themed party. Stayed put, pretty comfortable to wear (didn't dance so not sure about that). I'm 5' 4" and I just wore flats. It was a little long, but not too bad. I did wear a strapless bra to get a little more oomph (it doesn't have a built-in bra) but you don't need one. One thing to note: it's hard to get on without a second set of hands.

This was perfect! Lots of compliments! Fit is great. I am a 34C bust and fit nicely. I wish I had worn spanx under because it doesnt hold you in like a Herve dress. The length was great for my height and 4 inch heels. If you much taller the dress could be too short though. Very sparkly in a glamourous, luxe way! Love it!
This dress was gorgeous, form fitting, but not restrictive. I got a ton of compliments! I ordered the 0R and 2R. The 0 fit better. Dress seems to strech a little after you have it on

A classic attention getter I'm 5'2 and approximately 110 lbs and the 0P fit me like a glove. I didn't need to wear a strapless bra or undergarments. The gown was nicely lined on the inside and felt very comfortable. It was also nicely tailored and hugged all the right curves. But best of all, the gold sparkle of the dress was beautiful and caught everyone's attention without screaming for it! As I was walking out of my apartment, a few strangers commented how lovely my gown was. So it's definitely was a hit.

This dress. It fit me perfectly! I wore it for our Graduation Formal & felt like a goddess. The fit was snug, and the length was perfect. I'm 5'4'' and even without heels, it was a good length. The sequins got caught sometimes, but never tore nor ripped. My only caution is that it is a little heavy, as the other reviews said, but it wasn't overbearing at all. Thank you RTR for having such an amazing dress!

This dress made me feel glamorous!  I got compliments on it ALL night long.  The fit was perfect.  I am a 12 usually and I wore a 10, didn't need a bra because of the built-in bustier and I didn't need spanks because the cut of the dress smooths out everything.  The only con was the sequence scratched/irritated the inside of my arms but that is a small issue, totally worth it.  I would rent this AND any other Badgley Mischka dress!!

Pretty dress. Not nearly gold enough. Color is muted. A little long. My heels were only two inch. Gotta go higher to keep this off the floor. 
A drink was accidentally splashed on me. You couldn't even tell.

Golden Goddess!!!! So I ordered a 8l and 6l it seemed like the size 8 they sent me was regular so I ended up wearing the 6L. It was perfect for my figure. I am tall so I couldn't wear that high of a heal without my shoes showing. I have really big boobs so it was sorta tight on the busy, but by far I feel like I worn this dress the best! I was so scared it wasn't going to fit or be too short and it ended up being perfect!!!!

Sparkle perfection for Mardi Gras! This has been my absolute favorite dress from RTR and I rent for tons of formal occasions and events! It was comfortable and fit like a glove. The sequins didn't scratch and it was SO flattering. The gathers in the sides and back were perfection, the top stayed put with no tugging and I was able to dance and move unrestricted. The color is gorgeous - a soft glam gold. Loved it. Wanted to keep it!

I went to a formal wedding on New Year's Eve.  It was quite the event. The dress fit like a dream.  I'm pretty small up top, so the larger-boobed might want to go for a larger size.  It was a little heavy, because of all the sequins, but I felt like a million bucks!  Every time I see the bride, she reminds me of the dress and tells me I was the best dressed there! (this was New Year's 2012)

Gorgeous dress for the Marine Corps Birthday ball. 





 I loved this dress. It ran true to size, very flattering, I got compliments all night. This was my first rent the runway experience and it was a good one. Beautiful gold color.

Flattering, classy, sparkly dress! Solid dress that hugs the body well.  I got many compliments throughout the night.  Only negative is that it gets scratchy in the chest area.  I'm 5'"6, 115 lbs, and the 0 long fit like a glove.  I wore 5.5 inch platform heels and the length was perfect.  Will definitely rent from this site again!

Eye-catching, beautiful and comfortable for a formal event The dress was gorgeous, though a little more fitted than I'd have originally chosen for my 3-month post baby self. I wore the 10 for the fit in the hips which made the bust a bit large. The 8 fit fine, I just thought the 10 was a little more forgiving. It was comfortable for dancing. My heel caught occasionally on the small train in the back but wasn't a consistent problem. The regular length was just right with a 3-inch heel.

The dress was beautiful.  It was easy to move around and to dance in.  I recieved many compliments   Everyting about the dress was positive.  I am so very happy that I selected this dress for my event and for my first rental from Rent the Runway.  The entire process was very smooth and easy. The dress was in perfect condition.  Great dress! I will definately rent for Rent the Runway again.
Easy and fun to wear! FUN and PERFECT dress to wear for a ball.  I wore this to a Mardi Gras Ball!!!

You will receive at lot of compliments! I wore this from prom, the theme was Hollywood. I wanted to tryout renttherunway for a year now and this was the perfect opportunity. When I was looking for dresses, I wanted something that would standout from everyone else. I felt amazing in this dress, it was easy to move in, and not to big. Everyone complimented me and said that I look like I belong on the red carpet or that I looked like a young Whitney Houston. This dress is absolutely gorgeous!
Everyone absolutely loved this dress (including me!) Great fit, although I should have ordered the petite since the regular was too long.
Loved the dress and will definitely use RTR again!! The dress ran true to size and has a complementary fit

i will never forget how stressed i became after a misunderstanding with a dress cancellation on my order, and almost didn't receive my other items because of miscommunication. Things got worked out and received the dress on the day of my event. I really appreciated the girls working the door at the event. They complimented me by telling me that my dress was the best one they have seen all night so far!  Loved the way the dress looked on. Got so many compliments at the event and even before! the only reason i gave it 4 stars is because im not very busty up top so i have to keep making sure through out the night that my girls where coming out for a show. other than that i would rent the dress again!

Beautiful dress! I loved this dress, I was fearful that the sequins would look tacky but they were wonderful. It was however longer and heavier than I would have liked. even with my 4 inch heels. The bust was also an area of concern, the boning dug into my chest and flattened my boobs, I had to pull the dress up all night. But I think thats just a consequence of having a 34 DD and wearing a strapless gown. Nonetheless it was an absolutely beautiful dress, I highly recommend it to anyone with smaller boobs!

Everyone loved my dressed! I wore this to my second Marine Ball. The fit was perfect, i got 2 sizes, the 2R and the 4R. The 2R was very fitting, but decided to wear the 4R just because it gave me room to breath. But the overall fit was perfect. Very comfortable, and i will definitely be getting more dresses from this site!
I got many compliments! A little heavy but manageable : )

perfect party dress for my wedding! I wore this dress at the end of my wedding reception. It was PERFECT. It felt so fun and glamorous. I am a little short, and the regular was the perfect length. I wore flat sandals because I was the bride and my feet hurt lol and it brushed the floor but i could walk and dance just fine without feeling like i was tripping over it. It was very stretchy, I could have worn an 8 but when I ordered the dress they didn't have an 8's available.

I felt like Cinderella.  Beautiful dress! I felt a little flat and so I wore a padded strapless with the dress and it was perfect.  The length was just right with 3 inch heels.  It was super easy to return too.  The dress was so magnificent at our Navy Ball, I'm using the pictures for our Christmas card!

I read other reviews about this not being tummy-flattering, but didn't believe it.  Believe it! I thought that this dress would hide a little tummy since it has extra material, but I was wrong.  I don't have a massive tummy, but it fits almost like spandex and was not flattering.  I wouldn't wear this if I wasn't under a size 6 athletic build if I was you!  I ended up going with my back up.

Golden Goddess I felt like a golden goddess and got compliments all night long. Of course they wanted to know where I got the dress...RTR of course! I ordered this in a size 14R, which I typically wear in formals, and a size 12R because of some of the reviews stating the dress would "grow" as the night went on. The 14R fit ok but was a little long so hubby helped me into the 12R which ended up fitting like a glove once I got it all zipped up. I'm so happy I decided to wear the 12R, it was a nice snug fit and I didn't have to adjust it during the night. By the end of the night the sequins did irritate the under side of my upper arm but nothing unbearable. My full length pictures didn't turn out but this dress is very complimentary to all shapes and sizes with just the right amount of stretch to fit this curvy girl.

We felt and looked like movie stars!!  This dress is unbelievably gorgeous!! The 2P fit me perfectly! It hugged in all the right places. I am only 5'2" tall and I wore 3.5 inch heels. The petite length just covered my shoes and the small train was great. The sequins of the dress reflect the light so beautifully. Being small chested, I did wear a strapless bra with this. The dress stayed up but I did have to pull it up a couple times. The only complaint I have was the boning in the upper bodice area would kind of poke into my ribs so it was a little uncomfortable at times (this mainly happened while dancing) but it wasn't too bad! I wore a vintage fur shawl over it and a beautiful necklace that was also rented from RTR. People commented all night on how much we looked like movie stars! I got so many compliments on my dress, I felt so confident and wonderful in it! Thank you RTR for your wonderful service!!
Perfect for the Gatsby gala event. Slips down a bit on the bust area so order a size smaller and the work on the dress hurts the arms after a while but looks gorgeous and perfect for a evening gala
Made New Years Eve Special! Fit was perfect!  I felt beautiful in it.  I received compliments all night long!

This dress photographed beautifully...so glamorous!   It runs large and long...should have gone with a 4R, but it was still wearable.  The sequins did scratch up my arms while dancing as well.  Overall it was a gorgeous dress; I would definitely rent it again!!

Best Prom Dress Ever!! I was so worried when I rented this because I'm a size 4 and my backup dress, the size 4, was unavailable so they had to send the 2.  But it fit perfectly and it was gorgeous and I was in love with this dress!  When I went into prom, one teacher said it was the best dress she had seen all night and I got sooo many compliments!  If you want to look and feel like a princess, especially on your prom night, I would highly recommend this dress!!

I didn't like this dress. It was itchy and it had wires sticking out. It looked tacky in person, didn't fit well, and it had wires sticking out. It was also very itchy and did not look appealing at all.

The dress looks amazing in the dance floor. I LOVED this dress!!! I got so many complements at prom. I definitely made a statement with this dress. The dress has some source of wires that hug your curves to make them look great, but it can be a bit painful specially when you are dancing the whole night. I'm 5'7 and it fit a bit short. Overall I was very glad I chose this gown.

It reminds me of an oscar statue was a compliment that I received I wore 12L and it was perfect. I'm curvy and this dress is perfect if you are curvy. It looks better in real life than in pictures. I never wore anything sparkly before ( i live in NY and sparks are not our thing) but I'm glad I gave it a try:) rent it, you'll shine to the best dressed list of the night

The theme of NYE was old Hollywood Glam and this dress delivered! The fit was perfect. I did wear a strapless bra for support. Overall, the dress fit like a glove. I received tons of compliments that night.

This dress made me feel like a million bucks! I loved the old Hollywood glamour! Fit is great, but at the end of my night it got a little itchy, but it wasn't bad at all. Nothing to really complain about, I loved it!
Perfect formal dress! Definitely stands out in a crowd. Great fit, comfortable and easy to move in.

This dress dropped jaws as I walked through Nashville's Opryland resort to attend a military ball. As other reviewers have noted, boning in the chest area needed to be adjusted every time I stood up/sat down to avoid poking, but it was worth the little bit of pain to sparkle all night. Great for an hourglass figure, as it complimented my small waist (though it certainly didn't camouflage my hips); it took some adjusting and a strapless bra to avoid the dress squashing my bust down and causing it to spill out of the top, but when I got everything settled, it was the perfect amount of cleavage for somebody with a moderately full chest. I'm only 5'2", and I thought I'd need killer heels to pull off the regular length (as there is no petite length option), but 2-3" heels worked perfectly.
I felt like royalty it's an amazing dress. Its elegant and made me feel and lool beautiful. Im 106 lbs and this dress was way too small. And the sequense do hurt a bit at your under arm area
This gown was extremely comfortable and so great at hiding the butt and belly! Will rent again! I usually wear a 6 but it was a little big in the chest. I ended up wearing the 4 and it was perfect!

Looked Very Elegant I wore this for a black tie affair and it looked gorgeous.  I felt great in it .  I am a size 8-10 in a dress, so I'm definitley happy I ordered the 10 and 12.  The 12 worked best. I wore 4" heels and it was still about an inch too long, but ok.    The "rubberized" top was a bit exposed--it was irritating to keep pulling up.  I did wear a support bra to enhance my bust.

Sparkle & shine! Dress generated compliments alllll night. It looked great but was a tad uncomfy to wear. Does have boning which is a plus for support & push up. I had a 0 long & it could have been 1/2-1 inch longer to be ideal. 

If you're willing to put up with the uncomfortableness of  a heavy full length sequin gown then DO IT, you will be the bell of the ball.

This dress makes you feel like a princess I wore this dress for Senior Ball & it was perfect! It fit so great complimented my body shape so much. I got so many compliments on how elegant I looked with the dress, I felt like a princess! No one else had a dress like that either, it was very unique & super flattering. I would definitely recommend this dress!

Everyone loved this dress. The color is gorgeous and really stands out among all the LBD's. Fit like a glove and was comfortable. The slits were fun, but definitely still appropriate for a formal affair. The back has a nude/mesh lining and beautiful lace overlay to give the illusion of a backless cut out. Some of the lace detailing on the cap sleeve and back had to be steamed to lay flat, but could have worn it and been fine without doing so.

Bright blue. Loads of compliments.  Though the fabric feels a little coarse at first touch, the dress is actually really comfortable to be worn all night long. I'm 5'8" and wore 3" heels and was good with the long. When I took the heels off to dance, it obviously dragged a bit. But wasn't bad. The color (as others have mentioned) is bright blue, not the navy pictured. I was nervous about the slits. Standing up, they're not noticeable/classy. But they're aggressive when you're sitting. If you're modest but want to try the slits out, bring a shawl to cover your legs while sitting.

Absolutely perfect for a wedding between winter and spring Fit really good. I am 5'6 and wore 5" heels, so the 6L was perfect. The fabric is tight enough and loose enough to wear a bra and still be very comfortable. The only con was that the lace sleeves seemed a little worn, but besides that felt great!

Elegant and sexy! I loved wearing this dress and I would suggest it to anyone! I went to a gala and got compliments galore! It's very body hugging, but in a flattering way, so not to worry. Trust me, you will love it. :)

Perfect classy dress for a beautiful wedding! The color of the dress was such a pretty royal blue color. I liked the delicate lace detail on the sleeves & back. The dress didn't come in the most perfect condition but there was nothing noticeably wrong with the dress. Most bcbg dresses tend to run small in the bust area so it was a tight fit up top and a little loose through the hips. Overall it was a beautiful dress and fit the occasion perfectly for a gorgeous private estate wedding.

gorgeous color and great style
 I wore this to a black tie event and got so many compliments on the back and the great fit. 
It was a little snug on the bust and a little long; but I'm 5'1, I had to wear a big heel. The color really stood out with mostly everyone in black and the back really makes the dress.

I loved this dress and received so many compliments all night! Ran true to size. I am not sure how it would fit anyone with a larger chest I am a 32B and the chest was the tightest part on me. The length worked well I went with the 2L and I am 5'10 and the dress barely touched the ground without shoes on.
Perfect fit! Since i am short and am a bit bigger on the bottom area i ordered a 6 and 8. The 6 fit perfectly

Blue Sophistication! I thought it was going to be the NAVY blue shown on model. But the dress is more of a COBALT blue... which I loved! The size two was tight at my chest, and slightly lose at my waist, but I have a very small waist. It fit close enough though that no one knew it was slightly baggy at waist.  I loved the sleeves and it was gorgeous while walking.

Beautifully designed.. a work of art! I tried this dress on in the BCBG store and it fit me nicely- but, I did know that I needed spanx because the dress is unforgiving for anyone who has a bit of a belly... however, when I got the rented dress- it fit me differently although in the same size- I realized that the top lace part had stretched out- so it made the dress looser and didn't hold "the girls" in as well. It was pretty long- and so wear high heels! I received many compliments on it- I would have rested it higher- but I felt a little uncomfortable in it knowing that all my curves were on display.

Fabulous dress with gorgeous details!  This was my 1st choice for a black tie event but I didn't end up wearing it because it was 10 degrees outside that night and I knew I would be freezing all night even at the event and ended up wearing my 2nd choice dress with long sleeves instead. However, I will be renting this dress again (on a warmer occasion) because it is absolutely stunning. I love the color and absolutely gorgeous details on the back. The dress is fitted at the bust but runs slightly large at the hips (nothing too drastic). It was still a great fit overall especially since it is fitted enough that you do not need to wear a bra with it. The length was also perfect which was a plus since I usually have a difficult time with long dresses being extremely long on me even with heels. I was able to wear the dress with 3" heels and I was not stepping on it. The slits are high but they do not take away from the elegance and class of the dress at all. Fabulous dress and I can't wait to rent it again!!
I got a lot of compliment  all night long The dress fits perfect, I didn't have to wear the back up size. I felt good in the dress, didnt want the night to end and I was sad to return the dress.

This dress was perfect. The fit was amazing. The material is AMAZING!  The fit was impeccable. I am incredibly petite and this fit like a glove. The material was wonderful. It felt very expensive. The color was a right dark blue.  The lace was in great condition.  Received great compliments all night.

Classic, yet sexy. I was very hesitant about this dress at first, but once I tried it on I was floored at the outcome. This dress hugs your curves in all the right places and gives a great hourglass shape. Not only did I love the cut of the dress, but it was UNBELIEVABLY COMFORTABLE. I did not wear a bra which I was super nervous about because of my chest size, but I had full support just from the dress itself. I was shocked that I had zero worries when wearing this dress. I would recommend it to anyone. My only challenge was the length- given I'm only 5 feet tall on a good day, the fabric tape was my savior, the tape stayed put all night! I will absolutely continue to rent for an event again.

RTR needs to get Jenna from the customer service phone a huge raise!!! The reviews on this website are incredibly helpful and this dress needs more of them! I found out the wedding I was going to was black tie TWO nights before the event!! I rented a few dresses in a panic and the girl on the phone was a HUGE help. This dress ended up being beautiful. The color and detailing on the back was amazing! I'm typically a size 4, but the 6R fit best.

THIS DRESS IS A STUNNER!  My husband and favorite puppy loved it!!! This dress is the perfect combination of simple elegance and sexiness.  Be ready to hear lots of compliments!!   The cobalt blue color and unique back lace detailing will make you stand out at any event.  My 4R fit perfectly and the stretch fabric hides any Spanx lines.  I wore 3" heels and was able to easily dance the night away.  This dress was perfect and I would definitely rent it again. Thank you RTR!

STYLIST REVIEW! Loved this new BCBG dress. Comfortable fit. Does have a side zipper and it can run a little snug in the bust so I would recommend sizing up if you are a C cup or larger. Highly recommend this dress for pears as the slits give some room on the bottom of the dress. It's beautiful and very high quality! Would be great for a black tie event. Would be great with gold or silver jewelry!
Love Love Loooooove  I had a charity event to attend & I have had my eye on this dress all year! I am so glad I got this dress! It fit perfectly & I felt amazing in it! Highly recommend this dress!!
The perfect dress! The lace back is amazing.  I wore 5 inch pumps with the dress and it was the PERFECT length. I loved this dress!
LOVE this dress and want to buy it!   I wore this gown for a formal work affair and it fit like a glove.  I got compliments all night long.

Couldn't have asked for a better experience! Ahhhmazing dress!! Fits beautifully. As many others have said the pictures don't do it justice. The color is a beautiful cobalt blue. I wore a long and 3inch heels, was perfect. I was between sizes but opted for the larger for comfort.
Got tons of compliments all night! Loved the details of this dress. Very comfortable..still a little long on me and I got the regular, but I'm on the short side...I just wore really high heals.

Comfortable and flattering for a black-tie wedding I could have worn this dress all day! It's very comfortable and easy to walk, sit and dance in. The back is gorgeous and it looks sheer but actually has a light lining so that you can wear a strapless bra with it without it showing. I ordered a 4L and 6L and ended up wearing the 4L and it fit perfectly. The 6 was too loose in the waist and hips. I'm 5'9 and wore 3 inch heels and the length was just right. The slits in the front go up pretty high, especially when you are walking around so just something to keep in mind!

So many compliments and the color was gorgeous in person ! Very form fitting but well lined. I wore a backless bra but probably didn't need it. The high slits took me out of my comfort zone, but still very fun for a night. Loved it!

The draw-dropping looks I got from everyone. It's a tad heavy material but it clings in all the right places.  Also the back is see -through so they can see your bra if you don't wear a sticky one. All in all I ABSOLUTELY LOVE THIS DRESS!!!
The back is gorgeous! I got a lot of compliments on the outfit.  .

RENT THIS DRESS!  Esp. flattering for hourglass figures.  I have been looking at this dress for forever, but was hesitant to rent it since I am big-busted with a short waist and carry a little extra weight in my stomach, so the tight style / non-adjustable straps made me nervous. About a thousand spin classes finally made me confident enough to rent it for a gala, and now it is probably my favorite rental EVER. The color, thigh-high slits, and back of the dress are stunning, and I got so many compliments all night! It's definitely tight, but cut in a flattering way if you're self conscious about your stomach. I think it runs TTS, but order a size bigger if you're nervous. I'm also big busted (34E) and found that the fabric was thick and tight enough / the lined back gave me enough support that I was confident to go totally braless (which is rare). I think this dress could be harder for smaller-busted girls as it was definitely right for me. As an added bonus, it is SO comfortable, even with a sit-down dinner, and I felt stunning. If you're on the fence, go for it! I'll be renting this one again.

Felt very elegant and got lots of compliments. The dress is very understated so wear it with flashier jewelry. First, the dress runs small so if you are a 4 then go with a 6. Second, I am 5'6 and wore 4 inch heels and the long size dragged on the ground. Luckily, rentherunway.com will overnight you a new dress if you have an issue like that. I got the regular size on the day of the event and it worked perfectly.

Beautiful statement dress for a formal wedding!  I loved this dress but it did run a little small. I am 5'2" and about 110lbs and 0R was just too small around my ribcage. I ended up wearing the 2R and it was perfect. The slits were not too much at all and with 4 inch heels on it was an ideal combination. If you are looking for the perfect mix of sassy/sexy and classy, this is the dress for you!
Beautiful lace detail The dress was definitely a bit tight for me, but it's form fitting in a good way.  I received a lot of compliments all night.  Probably would have gone up one size.

I wore this dress to a hospital gala. This dress was absolutely beautiful and I received many compliments. If you have wider hips/thighs it will run a little snug, however, overall the dress fit pretty true to size. I am 5'7 and was able to wear high heels with this dress.

It was a beautiful and glamorous dress I was pretty hesitant because I am only 4'11, that the dress was going to drag on the ground all night. I wore 4 1/2 in heels and my boyfriend only stepped on my dress once, and it was going up the stairs.  The fabric color is really pretty once you put it on, and photographs prettier.  The slits were only slightly awkward when I sat down, but when walking it never felt like I was showing too much leg.  It was definitely a 2 person job to zip up in this, but the 0 fit much better than the 2 since I am petite.  I didn't want to return the dress, but it was perfect for a formal wedding.  Thanks to all the previous reviews that confirmed this was a perfect formal wedding dress that looks more amazing in person than the photos!

Tons of compliments all night! Gorgeous dress!  I'm typically between a 2 and a 4 but I have larger hips; the 2 fit through the upper half, but I definitely needed the 4 for my hips. 
Form fitting, beautiful, I got tons of compliments all night long. Photographs well; is more of a colbalt blue than a navy. The slits in the front are high, but not noticeable when you are just standing. 
Dress is gorgeous; open back. I wore a stick on front only bra, but that is probably then only knobs you can wear. I wore low waisted spanx type underwear, due to the lace low back, you couldn't do traditional ones. 
My first time using RTR, will definitely use it again!
Best dress ever! Loved it! The slits on the dress scared me but they ended up being the perfect touch. Although, it was hard to wear spanx in this dress but I didn't wear a bra!

Beautiful dress, just not for my body type. I knew renting this dress would be a little risky as I am way more curvy than the model, but it's just so beautiful!  The dress was true to size, and fit, but I was going to be too self conscious, so I went with my backup dress.  The slits were high, and the dress itself was fitting.  I could have gotten away with wearing it, I just felt more comfortable in my backup.  Curvy girls think twice before choosing this dress.  Best for long and lean body types.  Totally beautiful dress, which I could have worn it.

Absolutely amazing and perfect dress! Wish I could keep it! I rented this dress for my Prom at school and was a bit nervous because it was set to arrive 24 hours before Prom started.. 
I ordered the 4R (I'm about 5'4") and the 2L as a back up because the regular length wasn't available. I tried on the 4 and it was baggy and unflattering and I was heart broken, but when I tried on the 2 it fit perfectly! It was a little tight in the chest area, but otherwise absolutely amazing. My date was 6'8" and I decided to wear 5 inch heels so the 2L was the perfect length. There's a nude almost sheer layer of fabric in between the lace in the back and my actual skin so I was able to get away with wearing a strapless nude bra. Everyone loved my dress! It's classy, elegant and gorgeous and the lace in the back captures a lot of attention. So simple and easy! I'll definitely be using RTR again and again.
amazing color! The double slit and lace back....sexy ;) Cant wear a spank because of the low back.

I got a lot of compliments! Very sophisticated dress.  If you are petite be sure to wear very high heels. The dress was very long and there were a couple inches on the ground for me. This didn't make the look any less pretty though!
I loved it! Perfect dress So comfortable with the M slit, and I felt gorgeous. Definitely need to go a size up from what you might normally wear in stores.

It was my Senior Prom The dress was fantastic it was comfortable and I felt beautiful in it. I tried on the 4R first and it fit but it was a bit too long. I tried on the 2R on a whim, was surprised that I could fit it and the length was perfect. There was a tiny tear in the seam on the left side of the dress that my mom was able to sew up. I was also able to wear a nude strapless bra with it and it didn't show. I wish I could keep the dress forever. Will definitely use RTR again.

I've never felt so amazing in my life! There is only one other time I've felt so amazing about putting on a dress, and that was my wedding dress! The body is really well constructed, the slits give it enough sexy while being elegant and the lace back is to die for! I had so many compliments all night and even weeks after. I wore some spanx but I couldn't figure out how to wear a bra with it.

Love the color and fit! I love this dress! I went to a June, indoors wedding and felt great all night. I would not wear this dress outdoors in the summer, the material is a bit thick and I would have felt warm. However, because the material is on the thick-side, it is a bit more forgiving on curves. The 4R fit me perfectly, though I definitely needed the high heels. I never go bra-less, never, and I felt comfortable without one all night without adjustments. Walking upstairs was a bit tricky with the double-slit, but the compliments came all night, and I felt great!

Stunning Dress! I rented this dress for a formal work function and it was absolutely beautiful! I rented one size larger than I typically wear after reading several reviews and I'm glad I did as the size larger fit really well. The dress was very comfortable and the sleeves stayed up fine without any fabric tape. I would absolutely rent this dress again!

The color was beautiful!  The color was beautiful! I'm normally an 8 but the 10 was more comfortable.  The slits came up a little short when I sat down but it didnt ruin the evening. The back was AWESOME! I got so many compliments.  The picture I included is terrible and doesnt do the dress justice.

Simple yet sexy...a guaranteed attention getter! The material is form fitting yet super comfortable, and the slits give it that extra something that will have everyone looking at you while stand and walk around!

Received SO many compliments on this dress.  This dress was my backup, backup, backup and it fit perfectly. The slits came up to just the right height to make dancing easy and comfortable. The bust was a bit tight, but not too low cut. Looked great for a black tie wedding in early October. I don't have hips and usually have trouble with fitted dresses, but this fit great!

Amazing! and super comfortable Absolutely loved this dress. Wore it to a black tie wedding and, though I initially was concerned about the slits as it was a conservative crowd, it ended up working out so well. Received compliments all evening. Would definitely recommend!

Gorgeous black-tie beach wedding, lovely lace details I mostly loved this dress, but I did not anticipate how high the slits would be and didn't realize that there were two! I ordered this dress as a replacement from the airport on my way to a destination wedding. The color was nice and I liked having a structured top with the lace cap sleeves. The back is lined, not see-through, which was also nice although i didn't need to wear a bra with the dress, i could have., and I was able to wear waist-high shapewear without worrying. 

The slits, however, had me pulling at the dress all night! When seated, it was difficult to avoid a loin-cloth look no matter how primly I crossed my ankles.

Great dress , sexy and classy at the same time I rented the 6L and 8L for a wedding. The 6L fit but since my chest is large, i decided to go with the 8L. The dress is a cobalt blue color, definitely makes you stand out. The length was perfect, i am 5'7'' and wore high 4 inch heels and the dress grazed the floor.
Dress is definitely form fitting. A friend told me that the dress "fit me like a glove". Received many compliments from many people. It has got a bit of stretch also. The back is very nice, all lace and sexy. You could see the sleeves were a little worn out and had a few stray threads floating around, i guess because too much use.
The slits are very high, standing up no problem but you will show a lot of leg once you are sitting down.
Made me feel like a million bucks and it showed.!

I felt like the second best dressed to the bride The double slit added a sexy glamorous look to this dress that just made it that much more perfect! It was incredibly comfortable and I was moving and dancing all night. I needed to kick walk a bit but it was a small price to pay for being comfortable and overly complemented ALL NIGHT!! This dress is the way to go
The dress is beautiful and perfect for a formal wedding The dress fit really well except that it was really tight around my bust. I couldn't wear a bra with it but I didn't feel like I needed to.

color, fit & lace details were stunning The fit was very true to size. The slits in the front were slightly out of my comfort zone, but I loved every other aspect of the dress. I ordered the Long length and was able to wear 3 1/2 inch heels.

I was the MC for our Marine Corps Ball, this dress made me feel so glamorous! It was perfect! I'm curvy and athletic so not every dress fits the same. I wear anything from a 0-6 it just depends on cut, and I also wear 34DD. This dress was true to size and just brushed the floor with 3 in heals. I felt beautiful and the color is an amazing royal blue. The slits up the front are SO sexy and show just enough leg- I danced and presented at the ball and felt totally covered and comfortable. Tons of compliments. I can't wait to have another event so that I can order again!
pretty dress, but runs fall runs small, nice dress

Very flattering and comfortable The dress fit well, but was a little bit long. The 0P fit with 3 inch heels on, but when I changed into flats, it dragged a bit. It was very flattering and I got tons of compliments on it. The lace back and the slits meant that the dress was very cool despite the 80 degree weather.

People told me this dress was made for me! I wore this dress to my senior prom and the compliments I received on it were endless. The fit was great on my body type (petite, athletic, small chest, big hips) and people told me that my dress was very flattering. I was a little nervous receiving my dress in the mail two days before prom, but it ended up fitting perfectly. I wore 4 inch peep toe nude wedge heels with it which looked great with the blue color. It was really helpful receiving two sizes in the mail because I thought size 0 would be too small for me, but it fit perfectly.  This dress was a great deal and I will definitely use Rent the Runway again.

RTR made getting ready for my event a breeze! Saved me time & money! Can't wait for my next event.  This dress was a dream! It was so comfortable and it hugged my body perfectly! I used gold Oscar de La Renta earrings (also from RTR) and a gold clutch. It was classy and perfect for my Oscar themed formal. All of my sorority sisters gave me a compliment on it. Definitely renting from RTR again!!! Extremely happy!

This dress was a show stopper! So many compliments and extremely comfortable as well.  Fit was great, form fitting in all the right places. Was able to wear without a bra no problem. 

The long allowed for my heels and still fell perfectly to the ground. 

When sitting your legs will defiantly be showing.

Great dress - fun night! I have a wide back and the dress was a little hard to zip. Other than that, it fit great! I wore heels that were about 3" and the length was perfect. It was my third choice, but it was a beautiful dress and I got so many compliments!
The dress fit great and everyone complimented me on how gorgeous it was.  I wear a 34 DDD so I was a little nervous about the top fitting right but it did so busty girls you can wear this dress!!!!

Absolutely beautiful dress 1st. RTR experience. Dress came as scheduled on Thursday, wore it on Friday, returned it on Saturday. This dress is extremely forgiving of a less than perfect body  with extra around the tummy. It hides the flaws while it enhances the figure. I wanted to wear floor length so got the 10L and it was perfect with 4inch heels. The return process was so very easy; placed the dress in the return bag, sealed  and dropped off at the UPS store.

Stunning dress! Loved the shape of this dress. I got lots of compliments and was very happy with my choice. The one con: the dress I got was rolling over at the top, exposing the rubberized strip that is meant to help hold it up.  I got the long length and wore 4.5" heels and the dress was a tad long, but that is better than being short!

Fabulous!  I felt like the belle of the ball. The other reviews indicated this was true to size which I found to be the case.  I am almost 5'8" so rented the "long"...wished I word have ordered the "regular" because I didn't want to wear 3" heels.  No issues sitting or dancing in it.  Received raved reviews. 

This was my first time renting a dress and it was a very positive experience.  Both the dress and the backup arrived on time and it was a breeze to UPS back the day after the event.  Love this service!

I Felt Like a Queen! My husband and I go to a black tie fundraiser every year in early March.  As soon as I saw the picture RTR posted of this dress on Facebook when it came in, I KNEW this was the perfect dress!  I wanted to wear it so badly that I was nervous to try it on when it finally came but I had nothing to fear.  

The top fit perfectly, nice and snug (without being to tight) and the extra elastic band kept me from having to pull it up all night.  The length wa also perfect, I wore it with 3" heels, and the train followed after me just as it should.  I do think you could also go with 4" heels and still be fine.

I'm slimmer in my hips, so I did find the dress to be a little big in that area, but not so much that it was noticeable and it made sitting down and getting in and out of the car easier.  I would definitely recommend this dress to anyone who wants to feel amazing!

I felt beautiful wearing this dress. Wore this dress to a black tie wedding. Accessories are from Charming Charlie. Heels worn were 3' 1/2. This was a back up from two other dresses I had previously ordered due to damages from previous renters. However, customer service helped me get this dress on time and gave me store credit. The dress is a bit heavy and I will not lie, dancing was a bit uncomfortable. However, the compliments I received made it worth while. I would wear this dress again. It was easy to use the bathroom while wearing this dress. At 5'1 and wearing 3'1/2 heels, I ended up using fashion tape to hem the bottom of the dress, so I can dance the night away. :D  I did this after this photo was taken. You can see that the dress was a little long.
Loved the dress! So many compliments!!  Fit so well. The bottom was heavy, so I did have to keep pulling it up. Perfect for a formal affair.

Compliments all night! This dress is absolutely gorgeous. The cross-over fabric is universally flattering and does a great job of covering up spots where the dress doesn't fit perfectly.
