The size 0R was a bit loose overall on me, but still looked great. The length was perfect with 3 inch heels. I wore this to my company's Masquerade Ball Holiday Party and received compliments all night.
What a fun night! The dress was gorgeous! Perfect fit. I am 5'9 and I was able to wear a 3 inch heel with the dress. It was perfect! Compliments all night and I felt fabulous.
The delivery time and availability of dresses, also loved my dress and the way it fit ! The dress molded to me, danced all night in comfort at prom.

looked like a million dollars! wish i could wear this dress over and over again dresss is gorgeous - top fits tight and stiff, but that worked well for a long night of dancing.  the bottom is a little bigger (had room in the hips).  overall the construction is very elegant and expensive, and the dress looked amazing.  

however, when i got this dress, the zipper broke on the four while I was trying it on (even though the dress was not too small on me), and then when I tried on the six, the fabric on the pleat at the bottom came undone, so basically I had two unwearable dresses. 

rtr refunded me fo the replacement of the zipper, but it was a massive nightmare running around trying to find a seamstress to replace a zipper in one day (since I received my dresses the night before my event).  besides that hiccup, the dress was truly amazing.  it runs long, so beware, because I was in giant heels and still felt nervous about tripping over the hem all night.

Great for someone older. The dress was very elaborate and very beautiful.  There's no doubt that it felt like it was well made and high-end.  However, I felt like it would have suited someone slightly more mature than me - or at least someone who was into more formal fashion than I was (it is also likely that I'm just not chic enough to pull it off).  I think this dress is great for any formal event - it is perfectly appropriate for every fancy occasion - it's not loud or wild.  However, the fact that it is just black made it feel a little too aged for what I was hoping for.   I admit that it is also likely that it didn't have the sexy factor  for me because I have less curves - and I don't think the dress was particularly helpful to accentuate the little curves that I do have.
Perfect dress for black-tie wedding Very flattering.   I am 5'10 and 135# and the size 4L fit perfectly and hit the floor with me wearing 3" heels.  Very classic look.

This dress was stunning! The fit was pretty close, however it was too tight in the bust to wear a bra. Perfect length and actually very comfortable. I was able to move easily considering it is a mermaid style gown.

I chose to wear this dress for a military ball. The dress was absolutely beautiful and fit perfectly The dress is very fitted and shows off your curves, which is ideal for most body types. I'm a shorty so the dress was long on me. I wore 4 inch heels which made the dress the perfect length. I'm usually a size 4, but the 2 seemed to fit better so I'd recommend getting your usual size and maybe a size smaller just in case.
The dress is super classy and really reminds me of Audry Hepburn. I normally wear a 4 in dresses but I feel as though a 2 would have fit best.

Received compliments all night, beautiful dress! I normally wear a 6, the 8P was a perfect fit. This dress was very comfortable to wear. If your wanting to hide your midsection, this is the perfect dress for you. I loved it and will rent it again!

The dress made me feel so comfortable!
 This dress is absolutely beautiful when worn- fits very well around the waste with room to breathe and still sit comfortably! I received compliments on it all night! The only downside is that the pink straps that are used to hang it constantly peek out from the back...so pin them down...and the back tends to roll down a little bit- but absolutely not enough to keep me from renting it again! Loved it!

It was a Black/White Masquerade party and a lot of fun to dress up.   Pros:  The dress is absolutely gorgeous.   Compliments Compliments everywhere.  The cinching at the bodice is very slim fitting and flattering. 

Con:  The zipper broke several several times.  I had to take the dress off two times, remove the zipper, and sew the zipper to my bra so it had some reinforcement.   The dress was not too tight, I think the zipper went bad.  It was missing a few teeth.

Loved this dress!  I rented this for a formal, and rented a 14R as the backup.  I wish I had sized down, because the 12 was a little bit too big.  I think it looked absolutely gorgeous, but it was just a litle too large in the hips.  I actually have another formal and rented this dress again in the 10 and I am so excited for it to arrive.

It has been more than a week since the event and people are still talking about my dress.  I ordered a 4R and order the second one a size larger. I tried both and they both  fit. However, the size 4 game me more of a shape and it felt better. I did not have a problem with the length. I wore platform shoes and it was perfect. The zipper was a little tricky, but nothing to worry about. The fabric tends to be hot at times, but the dress is gorgeous that the little details do not make a difference. I will definitely rent a dress again. I received many complements on the dress, so many in fact that people are still leaving comments on my Facebook about how fabulous I looked. Thanks Rent the Runway!!!!!

OMG - Gorgeous Dress!!! I wore this dress for a benefit concert and I loved it!!! The fit was perfect as well as the length. I received compliments throughout the night. Another win with RTR. I highly recommend!!!
The dress fit in perfectly with the setting at The Homestead. The dress fit perfectly and was just the right length to wear with heels.
Felt amazing in the gown!  This dress fits true to size. I wear an 8, however, with my bust, I ended up wearing the 10 just for more room and a more comfortable fit.
Gorgeous gown  Picture doesn't do it justice. Beyond beautiful details.

Great shape to this dress, gives a nice hourglass figure.  kind of  a nightmare, the zipper broke in the middle of the event! Thankfully my husband was able to fix it because I couldn't. Not happy with that part of the dress but before and after the zipper broke, I liked it.

AMAZING!
Perfect dress for a perfect night.  My first Ball and my first time renting from RTR.  Unbelievable experience.   This dress was absolutely the PERFECT  dress.    Words cannot describe how this dress looks and makes you feel.   Cannot wait to rent it again?
Thank you "Rent The Runway" !

Chose this dress for a black tie Gala. It was lovely. Very pleased with the look!  FIT - I tend to have a problem finding dresses that fit well. Given that I just had a baby 6 months ago, not everything seems to be as it use to be :) That being said, I still fit into a 4, but reserved both the 4 & 6. I am also at a height that puts me in between regular and long. At 5'6, most regular sized dresses are great for length and 3 inch heel. I had to go with the long, the regular was all rented out. With that being said I had to wear 6 inch heels. The dress hugged everything perfectly, and the top stayed up with no problem. I am not well endowed so I normally get a little nervous with strapless dresses. But this wasn't a problem.

PROS - quick turn around from the staff at RTR. I couldn't decide if I wanted to rent or buy for this Gala. I kept going back and forth. I sent several e-mails to the stylist, they responded quickly and gave me all the info I needed. I was so happy I rented! 

CONS - I was silly, and didn't read the full description of the dress. There is a TRAIN. And if you'e like me and rented the long instead of the regular and you are in between sizes. The long is LONG. I had 6 inch heels on and the dress still had length to it (the train part), so careful when you walk, the second size they sent me, it looked as if someone may have put a heel through the dress. I contacted them, and they responded immediately. And have taken care of the situation. Even though the dress was long and had a train. I can't really complain. 

All in all great dress! I cannot wait to rent again! Not sure I'll ever buy another dress ;) 

Thank you staff at RTR, saved me some serious cash and made me look/feel beautiful! 

B

Red Carpet Worthy! I rented this dress to wear to a black tie law school function, and I was very nervous at first because I had never rented from Rent the Runway. I ordered a 6L and an 8L--to be safe--and the 6L fit fantastically. The only area where I had any give was in the hips, but I concede that I do not have very broad hips. 

The only other note that I would make is that the dress does seem to run a bit long. I am 5'7 and I wore four to five inch heels on the night of the event, but I still had to lift the dress up to prevent myself from tripping time to time.

I won an award at my company year end  awards gala and felt confident and gorgeous accepting it. Fit was like a glove... Extremely hard to use the rest room In. Top was a little lose which never happens for me but was still ok. I got so many compliments on the dress throughout the whole night.

Gorgeous Red Carpet Gown! I wore this gown to a red carpet event and it was a complete hit! I was very satisfied with my RTR experience and have already recommended this site to my girlfriends.  The dress I received arrived a day early, still had the tags, and had never been worn.  I ordered the long, which worked out perfectly, since I was 6'-0" tall (with heels) and the gown just barely grazed the floor.  However, toward the end of the evening  the bunched bottom fabric came loose (at the "mermaid tail") and the dress grew 3' longer. I was a bit surprised, although I may have stepped on it and snapped a thread. So, for taller ladies, I would recommend not going with "long" if you will be dancing or walking quite a bit.  This gorgeous dress should be worn with care.

I got a lot of compliments in this dress. For me, it was figure flattering and pretty comfortable. I ordered and 8 and a 10. I am usually closer to the 8, but on this dress I couldn't zip it up past my chest. The 10R fit perfectly, even the length. The layered look of the dress hid my flaws, and there was a little tulle at the bottom to give it some spunk. For the first time in I don't know how many years, I didn't wear a bra. There is enough structure and boning, along with a wrap around strap to pull your bust in and be secure the whole night. My only thing is that this dress had a little wear and tear. Some of the plastic boning stuck and and literally scratched me. I put a band aid over the exposed plastic and wore spanx, which was a buffer between me and the dress. I didn't feel the poking at all through the night.

What a fabulous dress. I felt like a star and received many compliments!!!  I normally wear a size 4 but the 6L fit like a glove and was the most comfortable dress I have ever worn. I has it on for more than 12 hours for my nieces wedding.

Everyone loved my dress including me. 
I got a lot of compliments and it made my event amazing.  The bust part of the dress was kinda big. I had to pull it up all night but other than that the dress was amazing.
Great dress Was a little tight in bust but I wore it with fur bolero - so looked great

This was the perfect Hollywood glamor dress for our school's Old Hollywood fundraiser.  I ordered the 6L and 8R. I ended up wearing the 6L (never tried the 8 on) and the length was perfect- I'm 5'7" and I wore 4" heels. I normally wear a 6- for the most part this dress ran true to size. It was a tad big in the bust, but I wore a bra and it was fine. It was also a little big in the hips, but I often have that issue because I don't really have hips.

The dress ended up looking great even though the folds of the fabric weren't that flattering. The fit was definitely small, so I'm glad I sized up for the second size. However, that dress seems to have too much wear: the zipper kept sticking (very frustrating), the inner corset had painful wires sticking out and into my skin, and the inner buckle wouldn't stay closed so that also rubbed against my side.
Otherwise, it would have been very comfortable!

The dress was perfect, and I felt great in it.   Usually, I have a hard time with dresses.  I have small shoulders, and back, but bigger waist, and legs.  Normally, when I buy a dress, I have to buy a size up, and then have the chest area taken in.  This dress was perfect. I was nervous about what size to get, whether the 8 and 10. The previous review made me think I'd need bigger.  I knew I might have trouble with the bust area, and went with the 6 and 8.  The 6 was perfect.  As soon as I put it on, I felt great. The top was slightly big, but ok with my strapless bra.  The body of the dress was great not tight at all.

Sorority Formal Loved the dress! Gave more of an hourglass figure than this picture lets on, but was super flattering! I thought it was going to look odd on me since I had never tried a mermaid style before, but I got SOOO many compliments! Felt beautiful!
THE ONLY THING: Do not plan on dancing in this one... luckily I went solo this time so I didn't have to dance, but sitting down was also a little bit of a stuggle and general leg mobility was too. Keep this in mind!

Very comfortable, flattering dress! Based on reviews, I rented a 10R and 12R.  I wore the 10R, but an 8 would have fit better.  It was pretty form fitting, so it stayed up, despite the extra room.  The material is much nicer than in the photos; it's not just a shiny satin, there's some texture to it.

I wore this dress to the season opening gala at The Met  It fit perfectly and I received compliments all night long. A room full of celebrities and everyone kept telling me how beautiful my dress was! I had to sit through the 4 hour opera in it and was surprised at how comfortable it was.

Forgiving and elegant Beautiful gown. I ordered a 4 but the 6 fit like a glove. Great for anyone that has curves and didn't need a bra either. Ruching is very flattering as well as if you don't have a flat stomach - although I did wear spanx. Very comfortable as well!
This dress was wonderful and I felt like a true diva!! I won best dress of the party! Runs a little small around the bust area.

Love this dress!  Pros....very flattering and comfortable. Got a ton of compliments. LOVED the dress!

Cons....Sitting down required a little adjustment:) The material didn't have much give. Definitely not a deal breaker though.

"I instantly noticed you from across the [dimly lit ballroom full of 1000 people in black tie]."  This is my first RtR rental and I was VERY nervous about length.  Law Prom had a red carpet theme this year, and when I saw the dress on the site it seemed perfect in theory.  I did a showroom appointment so I could try it and and was psyched that the ONE size that was available for the date of my event fit on my (disproportionately large) hips and butt AND was long enough (but barely! you can see in the picture taken from the back that any movement lifted the hem enough to expose my shoes, which were the flattest flats I own.  The showroom girls were awesome and helped me choose accessories and navigate the rental process.  

The bodice is very thoroughly structured with metal boning and a waist tape, so I didn't have to pull it up a single time the whole night (downside was that one of the bones was wearing through the casing and poked me all night, and the hook for the waist tape wasn't sewn on well and popped off at some point).  There is NO STRETCH to this thing, so you have to get the size that fits around your largest part.  For me that was my lower half.  It was definitely snug on the butt, and sitting down wasn't super fun (all the more reason to stay on the dance floor!), but the dress is well structured and durably lined and smoothed all my lumps and bumps out amazingly.  I had intended to buy a super-padded black strapless pushup bra to make the top a bit more proportional, but I didn't have time and ended up wearing my regular lightly-lined VS strapless, and it was fine in that the dress didn't fall down or gape open and expose my boobs if I leaned forward.  If you are a slender size and have a proportional hourglass shape, this dress will look fantastic on you.  Can't wait to rent again.

Spectacular Looking Dress This dress was absolutely beautiful and looked great on.  However, it is not the most comfortable dress to wear.  It is very fitted with boning and internal under bra snap which was very restrictive, but kept the dress in place without a lot pulling up needed.  Bending over is next to impossible, so be sure not to drop anything.  This dress was true to size so I ended up wearing the four which fit just right. I wore this for a black-tie affair and got tons of compliments.
It's a beautiful dress, but runs very small in the chest.  Couldn't zip it all the way up. Very small in the chest, true to size every where else.

It fit like a glove and everyone told me how gorgeous it was all night!   Definitely a wonderful choice, it fit perfectly and adding a pop of color with the necklace and lipstick added to the glamor.  
Unfortunately, I had to go out and buy shoes because I am all of 5 feet tall.. so in this picture i am in 6 inch platform shoes..so if you're petite like me make sure you've got tall shoes! 
So, so happy with this dress and RTR, thank you for making my night!!

Beautiful dress! I originallly ordered an 8L, my usual size, but it was a little large. I ended up wearing the 6L. It was a little bit of a struggle getting it on, due to the bad zipper, but once I got it on, the dress was perfect! It never moved and I danced the whole night. The fit was very flattering to my curves. I would highly recommend this dress to anyone!
WAY too big :( Unable to wear to my event due to the dress being too short and the bust WAY too big (I'm a DD and that's saying something). So disappointed :(

This dress made my night!  I absolutely loved this dress!  It was very comfortable and fit perfectly.  I felt beautiful and glamorous the entire evening. I wore the 2R although I had the 4R as well.  I almost wore the 4  however it gaped somewhat in the bodice so I opted for the 2 for a more snug fit.  The design of the dress made it narrow near my knees that presented a small issue when ascending stairs, which I had to do early in the event. As for fit, I am 5' even, and weigh around 105lbs.  The regular was the perfect length when paired with a platform 3" heel.  I would definitely rent this dress again.

Old Hollywood glamour I found this dress to run true to size. If you're anything over 5'7" and plan on wearing heels then definitely get the long. I'm not usually a black dress gal. I love color, but this is a black dress that wins in every way possible. The fit is perfection and hugs you in all the right ways.

I wore this to a black tie wedding, and it was stunning I got compliments on it all night! I wore 4" heels and the dress was was right at the ground. I wasn't worried about people stepping on it. It made me feel like a princess, and every time I moved the flare on the bottom moved with me. 

It was a little difficult to walk in at first, because of the the tight / stretchy material but I got used to it pretty fast. Great fit, true to size. 

There seemed to be a small gap in the chest area, it can be fixed with a strapless bra. 

When I took off my shoes to dance, the dress was really easy to hike up a bit. 

There's a small clap / closure thing on the right hand side (as you're zipping up the dress) make sure you close that, or it will be poking at your all night :)

Great dress! Rented this for a pageant I had to crown people at, and it was almost perfect! Even though I ordered the long it was still short  when I put on shoes, but it was very comfortable and flattering with all the rushing. The fabric is a little weird but it is a fabulous dress!

I wore this gown to my first ball and this was the first time I used Rent the Runway. The gown fit true to size and looked great.  However some of the boning had pushed out from the seams inside of the dress, poking directly into my skin (very painful!).  My husband came up with a genius idea to make it bearable--he said to put a large bandaid directly on my skin (where it was poking the most) and put another smaller bandaid right over the exposed boning so I could have double protection.  Worked like a charm!  RTR should make sure to fix any boning issues with dresses, but if you are in a bind, the bandaids are the way to go.  Otherwise, the dress looked great and I kept getting compliments the whole night on how fantastic the dress looked.  I was also able to pair the dress with my wedding jewelry and shoes (which I haven't worn since I got married last year, so that was an added bonus!)
Wore to prom and I loved it! It fit great! I am not curvy but this dress gave me curves I loved... I felt so classic and elegant

Stunning! I ordered this as my back up dress but ended up wearing it to my formal event.  It's absolutely gorgeous!  Definitely a curve-hugger.  I wish the dress was longer - which is why I'm only giving this dress 4 stars.  I'm 5'9 and had to wear low heels (or no heels) for the dress to touch the ground.  The dress was snug on me, but I don't think I would have had the same look if I went up a size.  I would definitely rent this dress again.

Fit's like a glove! This is a beautiful dress and fits very well without being too restricting.  I was concerned with the mermaid skirt but it has plenty of room to walk comfortably.  I wish I had been able to wear this dress, it was so pretty.  Unfortunately after reading several reviews I went with a 12R because I wanted to wear flats without dragging the dress.   It was just too short for my liking though.

I received the dress one day early which was great! This dress is AMAZING.  I ordered both the size 4L and 2L.  I ended up wearing the 4L because it does run a little snug.  I'm 5'6", 130 lbs and the size 4L fit perfectly.  I wore approx 4 in heels and the dress still graced the floor.  Perfect for any black tie event!!

Very Glamorous and Flattering! As a first time RTR client I was a bit nervous about the dress, but was very happy to discover that the  dress is beautiful! was very flattering to my hourglass figure. I have a large bust so was concerned about it being strapless but didn't have an issue with the top at all. Everything stayed in place and flatters every curve with the way its constructed. I was also a bit concerned with the length since I am a bit on the short side, but with my heels it fit great! Got plenty of compliments! overall very happy and will definitely use RTR in the future!

Wore this to the Magic Castle in L.A. for New Years! I had someone stop me at my event and literally say "THANK YOU" for wearing this dress. I LOVED it and I felt super hot in it. My only critiques are the following. I'm really a size 8 but the bust in the size 8 was just falling right off me. I'm average chested and even with pinning it and fashion tape I think I would have been holding it up all night so I wore the 6 instead, which still fit BUT the hemline hit the floor with flats on so I couldn't wear heels...which maybe was for the best anyway. I was on my feet for like 7 hours I probably would have been swearing by the end of the night. 

The other problem with the size 6 was that I didn't actually sit down in it or walk up and down stairs in it until the event and when I sat down for dinner suddenly realized HOW TIGHT it really was around my hips. I was wearing a pair of spanks underneath and I totally went to the bathroom and just took them off and put them in the trash so I could breath.  

And finally make sure you can walk around easily in this dress. I was stepping on the hem whenever I went up or down stairs and nearly killed myself a few times. 

Overall though I LOVED it.

Gorgeous dress! Received many compliments! This dress is absolutely stunning! The color is bright and beautiful. I've never received so many compliments.  I'm 4'11.75" and going with a petite size was definitely the right choice.  I'm usually a size 4 or 6, but the 4P fit best.  The dress is a little long and I wore 4.75 inch heels, but 5 inch heels probably would have been best.  I did end up stepping on the dress here and there, but it was worth it! If you're under 4'11" then this dress probably won't work for you unless you're comfortable with wearing shoes over 5 inches high.

Watching my cousin marry the love of her life. The dress and color was beautiful. I received so many compliments on it. The only issues were that even the 6P was too long for my 5'3 frame and the underwire around the bust was extremely tight. Also, I only received one size instead of the two that I requested so luckily it fit me otherwise I would not have had a dress for the wedding I was attending.
Beautiful color! This dress was amazing! It was comfortable and striking at the same time. I totally stood out in a party with lots of dark colors.

Loved the color!  It fits well and was very comfortable. I couldn't wear heels but luckily the dress was still a wearable length. Absolutely loved the color. 

Be warned if you go to a formal event, for which a lot of women will use Rent the Runway...four other people wore this same dress that night (luckily I was the only one in pink) but this dress is very popular.

I received so many compliments on this dress and will definitely be renting from RTR again! Fit is true to size. Length was perfect for me. There was a small imperfection on the skirt, but it was near the bottom so it was fairly unnoticeable.

Such an incredibly comfortable and gorgeous dress! I got compliments all night on this dress! It was so comfortable. I went to an outdoor wedding and it was so light and airy, it was perfect! The zipper was a hassle to get up, but fit comfortably. It was a little long for me, so going up and down stairs was a struggle. Otherwise, I loved it!

Great dress, wore the back up instead. I rented this as my 1st choice for the Marine Ball in Las Vegas, but wore my back up rental instead.  I ordered 2 sizes; 4-way too big, and 2 too much dress for my stature.
The dress was beautiful!  The color is more magenta in person than hot pink as the picture indicates. This dress would have been great on someone a little taller.  I am just not used to a flowy dress.  I realize now that I look better in Slimmer silhouettes. From now on I will always order a back up dress!  Thanks RTR!

So glamorous! This dress made me feel so beautiful.  This dress was so gorgeous! I wore it to my boyfriend's senior prom and got tons of compliments. The color is more vibrant in person, almost like a neon fuschia. And the fabric moved so beautifully. The regular length was perfect with 4" heels (I'm 5'5"). My only complaint was that the bodice was a little large on me-- because the dress would slip down and show the back of my strapless bra, I ended up wearing it without a bra, and I needed to use fashion tape in order to keep the dress up. A size 2 would've probably worked a little better. But overall, the dress was phenomenal. I would highly recommend it to anyone.

Beautiful color, not great style This dress runs incredibly long. TOO long. I am 5'8 and wore 3.5 inch heels and the dress was dragging on the ground. Everyone kept stepping on it, which was really annoying, especially when I was in mid-stride. The bust is not a flattering pattern. I felt like the dress made me look flat with weird draping in the front. Additionally, the waist is a bit high and the skirt fabric is full so it does not show off your physique well. The dress kept sliding down and I had to yank it up all night even though it was the right size. The color was beautiful and the fabric is really nice and flowy. I think this dress could do in a pinch for many body types.

The one other caution is that there were at least 3 other girls with the same dress (different colors at least!) and now that Rent the Runway is so popular there were many girls that had the exact same dresses, same color, that I recognized from browsing the site, so you might have to think about that. Try to pick something unique.

Perfect dress for a formal party with a dance floor! I got so many compliments on the color and flowy cut of this dress. I wish I had gotten a petite size, as i had to add a belt to make it work, it was a little too large! Also, the dress is quite long! I'm 5'3" and wore 3 1/2 inch heels and there were about 3 extra inches of fabric at the bottom.

The dress was beautiful, perfect color. The dress runs small on the bust, so I would definitely go a size up.  I am 5'9 and the site recommended a "long", I ended up having to wear 4-5 inch heels (which I never do) b/c the dress was dragging on the ground.  Overall, it was wonderful, but next time I would go with an 8R.

Lot's of compliments, fun to dance in, overall great pick!
 Great length, very comfortable!

This dress was stunning on my bridesmaids! We rented this dress for my wedding. The color really popped and all of the girls felt glamorous in their designer dresses. The zipper was tough, but we got them all up day of the wedding. Our sizes ranged from 8-16 and everyone wore heels.

Made for the extra pop of color for our engagement photos! I'm 5'2" and wore 5" heels. This dress is long as you can see... I liked that it pooled for the pictures since that's what I was going for. Unfortunately the petite wasn't available... if you're on the shorter side I'd opt for the petite. I didn't wear any bust undergarments and felt well secured and comfortable. The top/bust is a little large.

The color of this dress is amazing and the neckline is gorgeous.  The fit was perfect and although I had reservations about wearing a strapless dress, the piping in the bodice really kept me feeling secure all night long. The cinched waist was very flattering and the flowy skirt was a lot of fun to wear. This was a perfect gown for my boyfriend's business school gala and I got a ton of compliments. The main issue I had was that the zipper was a little busted and I almost wasn't able to wear it bc it just wouldn't go up, even with my boyfriend trying for about 30 min. I ended up having to put it on backwards, zip it up that way and turn it around, which was not ideal. I suggest RTR does a few additional quality checks and makes sure the dresses zip up properly.

The dress was very flaterring and looked great in pictures. Many compliments! I ordered my regular size and a size down like advised. I should have ordered a size up. The dress was tight and I probably would have worn the next size up but it looked great and was perfect for the occasion.

The dress was beautiful, and I received a million compliments.  Very glamorous! I can't stress enough how beautiful the color of this dress is.  I think it would be flattering for all skin colors.  It was super comfortable and secure (even being strapless).  I felt very glamorous in this dress.  I was a little worried about the length, but it wasn't a problem.  I just wore tall heels - with Dr. Scholls gel inserts- and it was fine.  The fit was perfect and I am definitely excited to rent my next dress.

The dress was very beautiful for pictures!! This dress was very beautiful, but way too long.  I am 5'2" and even with 3-4inch heels it was too long.  I had to pick up the front of the dress and carry it when ever I walked anywhere.  This dress would be better for a tall thin woman.  The bodice was very tight as well, but I was able to get zipped in with help.   I normally wear a 0 or a 2.
Flattering for a formal wedding! Fit true to size, and was supportive enough that I did not need a bra.  Would rent again!
Stunning! Beautiful, elegant gown. Loved wearing this color! Excellent fit. Thanks, RTR!

Great fit, so beautiful with amazing pop of color! Super comfy too, would wear again in a heartbeat. I absolutely loved the fit and how the dress hung on me, along with the gorgeous color. And it was beyond comfortable to boot! I got lots of compliments on it and felt super glamorous all evening.

My favorite long dress I've ever worn! I wish I could have kept it for myself-- I received so many compliments and it looks just as great in person as it does in the pictures! It was so comfortable and I never had any issues with it falling down like I thought I would. It was a liiiiittle big in the top but a size smaller would have been too tight. I have wider hips so I really liked how it flowed throughout the waist. 100% I would rent it again! And I got the necklace shown on the model and that was perfect too! It was long but I wore 5 inch heels and then it was perfect! (I have short legs so all dresses are long on me)

Elegant and unique... I felt like a princess.  The fit was perfect.  I ordered a 2L and a 4L because I love extra length.  I wore three inch heels and there was still plenty of fabric trailing the ground.  The 2L fit me perfectly, but the zipper was broken.  I was not able to get it zipped until we used chapstick on the zipper.  It definitely sticks, but the half hour of struggling with it paid off.  The only reason I would not give this dress 5 stars is because of that.  

I received so many compliments on the dress because of its simplicity but fun and elegant color.  Everyone was constantly complimenting me and asking me where I got it.  Rent the runway is about to get a lot of new customers!

Tons of compliments! The dress made me feel great!  This dress was perfect! I felt like a princess! It does run long...i had on 3 inch heels and it still dragged a little...but it still looked fantastic! perfect night!

So many compliments on this dress! Love the color This dress fit me true to size. The one thing that was tough was that i was ALMOST tripping on the dress a lot. It looked beautiful in the breeze and everything. Perfect for the black tie optional wedding I attended!

Loved the flowy elegance! I wrote that it ran true to size, but I'm not sure. I usually wear a 2/4, but I had to wear a 6 in this dress. I had a baby 5 months ago, so I may still be a bit bigger than usual. The color of this dress was beautiful!! Very flattering on my light olive skin tone. The length was a bit annoying though.

A great color and comfortable! This dress was great for a black tie wedding I attended. The dress itself was the right length for my height, however the top layer was a little too long even with 4in heels. Got a ton of compliments. The boning in the corset is slightly tight but I felt secure that there would be no wardrobe malfunctions. Overall great, id totally rent it again.

Great color! Perfect for the summer black tie wedding!   Loved this dress! Beautiful color and so much fun to wear. I went with the 4 because the 2 was too tight in my bust. The dress was a little long so I needed to wear my highest heels. Really great gown! Glad I rented it!

I received compliments all night long. This dress is GORGEOUS. The cut. The color. So elegant. I felt like a million bucks in this dress.  It was very slimming.   I'm 6" and 193 pounds.  The 14L was a little snug (I'm between a 14 and a 16 and they only had the 14L available).  The length was surprisingly spectacular.  It was long enough that I could actually wear a 2 inch heel and still have to hold it up occasionally (mainly on stairs).  I was expecting it to fit more like a tea length ... but it was a gown on me!!  Don't hesitate.  This dress is stunning.

I received so many compliments! The dress was the perfect length, but as Im 5'6" and wearing 3" heels, I would have ordered the regular. Luckily the reviews were true about the length. I couldnt really fill out the top but it wasnt that much of an issue. it was a great dress, would definitely rent again.

It was pretty long on me but I am only 5'1. Other than that, I LOVED this dress  Fitting was accurate besides the length. I got a petite but it still dragged on the ground quite a bit. Other than the length, it was perfect and I would definitely rent this dress again. I wish I could've kept it!!!
The color of the dress The dress was amazing. The color is absolutely stunning and I received compliments all night long.

Loved the color! Hated the length because I'm short! I wore this dress for my cousins wedding. Everyone loved the color and fit of the dress but it was too long for me. I was wearing 3-4 inch heels and it was still long.Then again,  I'm also not even 5'1 haha! Overall, the dress was beautiful but ran large and I wouldn't suggest it for short/petite ladies.

Having a designer dress at Prom without spending the money This dress was perfect for my Senior Prom!  I loved the color and it fit perfectly! It was a little long, but a lot of my friends dresses were too so I wasn't worried.  I will definitely use RTR again it was on time and easy to use!

Vibrant color, good fit, perfect length for petites I originally ordered this dress in green but instead one RTR sent because the 4P wasn't available in that color. I ended up wearing this one and loved it! The color was vibrant which stood out. The petite length was perfect for me since I am 5"4 and wore 2.5 inch heels. I didn't have to pull the dress up at all night. My date loved it as well!
gorgeous dress! a bit long, but over all a stunning color and fit
Loved it. I wore a sheer scarf over my shoulders at the pink ribbon charity event except in photo.   It was lovely, a little long, the color popped in photos, was comfortable, and stayed up nicely.

Compliments all night long! Fits true to size and super flattering. I loved everything about this dress! My date loved the dress and so did all of his fraternity brothers and dates! Only tricky part was the difficult zipper, but nothing too difficult to handle. Would definitely rent again!

Felt amazing in this dress! The dress is true to size, it was an amazing fit.  I had bought a strapless bra to wear under it but the boning was so good I didn't need it and went bra less and felt totally secure all evening.  The zipper was very sticky and it took allot of tugging by my husband to get it zipped up (and this wasn't to do with it being too tight or anything) so its good I had help or I would never have been able to get it done up on my own (hence only 4 stars).  I'm 5ft5 and with 4 inch heals the dress was the perfect length.  I felt great in it and got lots of compliments all evening.  I love this site, I'll be using it again!

Great color! This dress ran surprisingly large. I am usually a size 10 in Badgley Mischka but the 8L fit really well. The dress only gets 4 stars because the fabric appeared slightly worn. I know it's a popular rental, and it was looking a little tired. As for the length, the 8 Long is LONG! I had on 3.5 inch heels, and at almost 5'9", i was still tripping over myself all night. The dress was super comfortable though, and looked great with a turquoise necklace!
Didn't wear but it's really pretty I ended up with a different dress because I was worried this might be a little too bright for evening.  However, it's beautiful and fit perfectly.
Simple and elegant dress. This dress fit true to size and was bright but not overwhelming. It was perfect for the formal event I attended and I'd definitely recommend it!

Beautiful dress! Simple but glamorous. I felt like a princess! :) I loved this dress! So many compliments. Runs pretty true to size. I am 5'10" and was torn between getting the 8R and 8L, and I'm very happy I went with the 8R because it was plenty long enough. With 2 inch heels it still trailed the ground a little bit. So don't get the long size unless you really need it!

Best dressed at the wedding (besides the bride lol) This dress is magical!! The color is so vibrant and really made me stand out at the outdoor wedding I attended.  I had multiple people come up to me to not only compliment the dress but tell me I was the best dressed guest!! YAY!! The dress does run a little big so size down. I usually wear a size 6-8 because my bust is very large but I was able to slip the dress down even when zipped! I dont think my bust would have fit in a 4 so I would have ended up wearing the 6 anyways but it ended up fitting just fine. LOVED IT!!

It was the perfect dress for the occasion and I loved the color for spring! It's a tight corset so you don't have to worry about it falling down but it pinches a little when you sit down so sit up straight!

The dress was great for military ball! I usually wear a 6 so it was a little big because they were not able to send the 6 but it worked. It was a little long as well I should have gotten an R not an L. Great dress and received a lot of compliments on it. Really pretty color.

Beautiful gown! I got so many compliments about the color of this dress! The dress is definitely more pink than in the model photo. As to the length, it was longer than expected... the chiffon layer was actually longer than the lining, so that's what I kept tripping on (with 5" wedges). The previous reviews about the difficult zipper were VERY accurate. I ended up having to rub a little lip balm on the zipper to make it work. Also, there was some plastic boning in the bodice that was poking out, so I just wrapped a band-aid around it for the night so it wouldn't bother me. Overall, it was a great experience with RTR and I will definitely rent again!

Gorgeous (and comfortable!) dress This dress fits very true to size. The waist is fitted enough that you won't spend the whole night tugging up your top, but it's still comfortable enough that you can eat dinner and dance the night away. (Perfect for a wedding!) The color is also incredible -- it loks just like the picture, maybe a bit deeper.

Beautiful dress, just too big Pros: Cheerful, vibrant, flattering dress.  A dress that you can dance and eat in and still look beautiful.

Cons: Way too big.  I was holding it pinned back in the picture.  Very large in the waist.  Also, too long even in heels.  Should've gotten the  size two instead.

The color was very unique and very flattering. The body of the dress was very run-of-the-mill gown. Incredibly small in the bust -- could have worn the 6R, but it cut in too hard on my chest. Wore 4" heels, probably would go with the long if I were to rent again.

Beautiful dress that works with a baby bump Dress was perfect for a black tie wedding at 6 months pregnant.  The R length was great for wearing with flats.  One note, the boning on the sides would make it harder to wear if my bump was any bigger.

It was the perfect pop of color for a formal event! Fit true to size and loved that it was structured on the top but flowy on the bottom. Very lightweight and breezy, but still formal and elegant. Such a great Rent The Runway experience!

Beautiful Color, Terrible Fit I rented this dress in a 0R and a 2R for my law school prom, and unfortunately neither size fit. In RTR dresses I typically wear a 2, and sometimes a 0, but the 0 was huge. The bust was so big there was no way it was going to stay up and the dress was about four inches too long, even with 2.5 inch heels on. After a few gown-type rentals, I have learned that the long dresses on RTR are a stretch if you're 5'5" like me and I plan to stick with only short dresses in the future. The color was gorgeous though, so if you have a large chest and are pretty tall, this is the dress for you.

Flowy dress and lovely color, but too long I received this in a 2R and I couldn't even close it across my ribcage. In general half the time I have to wear size 2 and the other half size 4, so it might fit others true to size. I didn't think this dress was very flattering on the chest and it was way too long even with 4 inch heels. I loved the color and I think it would fit someone with a fuller chest and hourglass figure much better. The picture is without heels.
Hot! Hot! Pink! Wonderful dress for a formal occasion. Regular length worked for taller 5'11" fashionista. Hot pink color stood out in a sea of black dresses at this outdoor summer formal event.

So fabulous I rented it twice! Once in green and then in Pink! Fits great! I only wish the  6P was available. I still rented it as it was a TV appearance and I knew no one would see the bottom. When I wore the petite, I still needed very high heels.

So easy to rent! Great process.  The dress was stunning in pictures! I received so many compliments on the dress and the amazing color. In a sea of dark dresses, this stood out in a classy way. The dress stretched out slightly and I had to pull it up a lot towards the end, but it wasn't too bad. Would definitely rent from RTR again!

Got a lot of compliments on this dress. Color was wonderful and felt comfortable.  I weigh 134 and I am 5'3". I am a 34B. I tried other short dresses from this site but it was not a good fit for me. The long dress worked much better for my body type since I am more of a pear shape, and I felt much more comfortable in it. I got a 4R.

Don’t try to put a 12 body in the size 10!  LOL So this dress has a minor issue, it does’t cup the breasts.  It kind of just lays on top of the body with what seems to be no form. It was ill fitting.  Didn’t love it, so glad the back up was amazing.  The color was rich but the fit was off.  It may work better for smaller busted girls. I tried to post photos but the site was not cooperating...sorry!

Gorgeous color, great fit, perfect length. Easy and fun!  I had originally rented the Monique L. Glass Slipper Gown for a black tie event, but it didn't fit. So RTR overnighted me this dress! I had rented the gold sequin version of this dress about two years ago for a wedding, and it fit like a dream then and now.  The color is vibrant and different- looks great in photographs.  Got lots of compliments.  Although I am 5"8, the dress was not too long. Other reviewers said it was much too short, but even with heels, it was a perfect length. I danced all night long! 

I paired the dress with a rhinestone necklace, yellow shawl, and nude shoes. I felt tres glamorous!  While usually I like to go for a dress that is a little more different/unique style-wise, this dress was easy and beautiful. I recommend!

Pink is the New Black Love love LOVED wearing this dress! I wore it to a summer wedding. I felt like a princess. This hot pink top and neon red bottom dress is so fun for a summer wedding. The colors were bright, fun, and definitely stood out in the crowd. The cut of the top is so flattering in pictures and the open back is a fun surprise on the dress. Received lots of compliments, photographed well, and would definitely rent again! I ordered the 4R and 6R. Both fit, but ended up wearing the 4 because it was a little more form fitting through the top. Also, the 4 had a brighter pink on the top. The 6 looked a little faded on the top (more magenta than hot pink). I wore about 4 inch heels and the dress still hid the heels, which was great (I am about 5'6). And, if you are smaller on top, no need for a bra! It is form fitting enough that it is like a built in sports bra. Perfect for a wedding or special dressy occasion. Perfect for dancing and comfortable to sit down in.

Loved it! I received so many compliments on this dress. I absolutely loved it. It was perfect for a black-tie-optional wedding. It definitely fit true to size. It was a little tight around the neck area but I think a bigger size would have been too big in other areas.

Amazing dress, super flattering. Fit was great. I wanted to get the Petite size but it wasn't an option so I went regular. I wore like 4/4.5 inch heels and the dress didn't drag on the ground. I loved the colors and got a TON of compliments. One negative was that the dress I wore as well as the backup size both had tons of wrinkles in the fabric when I opened them.
Lots of compliments Paired this with the Jules Smith Tribal Necklace and loved it.

Stunning colors and flow of dress! The back of this dress is beautiful and the right amount of edge for a classy formal event. The colors are stunning and stylish. The fit was perfect. With a little bit of a looser top near the waist give this dress a super flattering fit. Must Rent!
Great colors and comfortable dress! Perfect for a black tie wedding. I was 4 months pregnant and the dress gave room for my expanding waistline.

Perfect Wedding outfit!!  While this rental process wasn't the smoothest it has ever gone with Rent The Runway this was an amazing dress! My rental got messed up so I had to go with the 10L which really was too long but some nice heels and a few glasses of Champagne made it all ok! My boyfriend loved the dress and comments on how different and amazing it looked several times! I could have gone down a size but the pink color at the top of the 10L was brighter than the other dress. Overall it was an amazing dress and really nice fit! Would definitely recommend and rent again!

This was the perfect bridesmaid dress for my BFF's wedding in her pink/orange color scheme. I tried a 2R and 4R and at 5'5" plus heels, the length just skimmed the floor and was fine. The 2R fit but snugly so I went with the 4R to have some room to move/dance/breathe. I'm a 30E bust so the 4 was better in the chest. The halter is definitely snug around the neck, though the arm holes cut a little low - my strapless low back bra would show sometimes when I moved, and because I went with the slightly larger size, the back would sag slightly below my bra in the back, even though the bra was low cut in the back. Overall the dress would be more flattering to most if the top panel was an inch or so shorter, so you could see the cut in of your waist, but on me it showed just enough of a hip curve to feel flattering and not too boxy. The fabric is super durable and doesn't wrinkle (perfect for events!) and the colors really pop. Even with its minor issues, I totally recommend this dress and loved wearing it. I was comfortable in it for close to 10 hours as a busy bridesmaid.

A showstopper. It's the perfect pop of color for an spring outdoor wedding. Compliments all day! The 0 was a perfect fit as far as the body was concerned. I found the neck a little bit choking, but it wasn't too bothersome. The 2 was more comfortable around my neck, but was too big otherwise. I wore the 0 and was comfortable in it all day/night long. You can't wear a bra, obviously - I wore silicone nipple covers. Though even without them, the fabric is thick enough that you wouldn't be exposed. 
I wore the dress with a 3-inch heel, so it did touch the ground, but it didn't drag, and I wasn't stepping on it so it was actually the perfect length. Don't be afraid to rent if you're fun-sized like me ;) this dress actually makes you look taller!
Also, I have to say that this dress is super comfortable. It's not binding at all. You've got a lot of room to sit, dance, and EAT. 
One of my best rentals ever.
Love it! Very pretty dress.  Just remember, you must wear a backless bra and you cannot wear spanx (because of the cut of the back.  I would definitely wear this again and got a lot of compliments.

Kate Spade Vibes!!! I absolutely LOVED  wearing this dress!!! I wore it to a formal wedding this past weekend that my husband DJ-ed for a friend of ours and I received so many compliments on this dress. I fit perfectly in the chest area so I didn't have to wear a bra. I'm only 5'6 but I ordered a 6L because I wanted it to be long and I wore 4" heels with it. One girl I met in the bathroom said this dress looked like it would be by Kate Spade based on the colors...and I totally agree with her! It was a fun dress that stood out among so many ordinary dress :).

I felt gorgeous and it was really comfortable!  I normally wear a size 4 or 6. RTR couldn't actually send me the 6L as my backup size- it was returned late- but luckily the 4L fit really well. It was just a teensy bit tight in the chest and the neck clasp was also a little bit tight but not so tight that it was an issue. I am 5'9 and wore 3" heels. Just my toes were peeking through at the bottom and it looked fine. I danced a lot and so the neck clasp came undone quite a few times! But luckily it was barely noticeable because my hair was down and the dress didn't open up at all. I don't think I've ever gotten that many compliments on a dress I've worn before. Super fun! It covers a lot, but with arms, shoulders, and that bit in the back showing, it still feels very sexy. My husband loved it! I would recommend it for sure!

A wedding to remember.... I ordered the 6L, with the 8L as a back up.  I ended up wearing the 8L, because the 6L was a little snug in the back, and made the dress lay funny along the zipper.  I was thrilled with the way this dress made me look and feel, not to mention the ability to dance all night long!  Great dress, with tons of compliments!

Nice dress This dress was very pretty! I loved the bottom - fit my hips and waist great, and was perfectly flowy and gorgeous on the bottom. The top, however...the material was wrinkly around the bust (not because it didn't fit, just because that was the material) and it looked like it was cheaply sewn. Sad because otherwise it would've been gorgeous! I didn't end up wearing this dress, but would have had I only ordered this one.

Absolutely love this dress!  I am 5'2" and thought the regular was going to be very long on me, but it was a perfect length. Definitely suggest getting a longer length. The outer layer of the dress was about 2 inches shorter than the inside layer, luckily no one noticed.

Wore this to a black tie invited wedding in Toronto.  Overall I really loved wearing this dress, felt super pretty. It was really easy to dance in and move in, not restricting at all. I also sweat a lot, but didn't seem to be a big problem. I think I wore my sticky bra which worked fine for the bust. The only thing was the neck was a little tight, but after enough wine I stopped noticing it. Also looking back I wish I'd gotten my arms more in shape, since your arms are very visible in this dress.

Perfect dress for a formal wedding. This dress was perfect and I never wanted to take it off. I wore it for a formal wedding over Memorial Day Weekend. The bright colors kept it from being too stuffy and I got tons of compliments on it. I wore it with platform sandals that were 2.5 inches tall and the dress was a perfect length. For jewelry, I wore big green statement studs and an opal cocktail ring. I didn't end up needing a bra with it. The only con would be the high neck line bothered me at first, but as the night went on, I didn't even notice it. I almost didn't want to send it back!

This dress is beautiful! This dress is beautiful; I think it would be flattering on most anyone.  Loved the colors!!  I wore a 4R with 4" heels, and the hemline skimmed the floor.  I felt like I had to give an extra kick when I walked, but for the most part, it was just fine.

Loved this dress! The second I put this dress on, I was in love. It was absolutely perfect. I didn't need to try on the back up size, as the 4R fit wonderfully. The 4R was quite long, and I had to wear four inch heels for the dress to still skim the floor as I walked. Also, the clasp in the back kept coming undone throughout the night. Even with that though, I would rent this dress again. Loved it!

Vibrant, Fun, and Comfortable. It was a hit. LOVED this dress. It clasps at the neck and lower back. It is so comfortable and easy to dance in. Wasn't tight in any problem areas. Loved the colors. It is just as vibrant as it is in the photos. HIGHLY recommend.

Not for pear shape This dress is even more beautiful in person but unfortunately I couldn't wear it. I have hips and the bottom half wasn't fitted at all. I would definitely recommend it for someone who is more straight up and down. I also felt like the 4L was too big. I would have been better off with a 2L.

LOVED this dress!  Wore this dress to a formal dinner, and had random people to stop me and compliment me on how much they liked it. Comfortable, and fit great. Did not need to wear a bra with it. Would definitely recommend.

Bright and fun!  I was so excited go see this was offered in petite. I wore a 2P and the size, fit and length was just right. It was perfect for a summer wedding outdoors and I received a ton of compliments!
Bright and fun maxi This maxi wasn't necessarily the most figure flattering, but it was so fun to wear. It is a great color and great material. Would still recommend for a casual or dressy look.
I got so many compliments on this dress and it fit perfect!  I am between 5'9 and 5'10 and i ordered the 4 Long and it was the perfect length. I would recommend this dress to anyone!
This was perfect for a black tie event It was shorter than expected. I'm just under 5'7'' and it was too short with normal 3.5 inch heels.

Love the color and fit, but not for tall girls! I rented this dress in a 6L, my normal size that I order from RTR, and it was so short! I'm 5'10" and was planning on wearing flats anyways (because they don't make dresses long enough for me to wear 3-4" heels!) but this dress was a good 3-4" off the ground even with me wearing no shoes. I was so disappointed because the fit everywhere else was great and the colors were vibrant and beautiful! Thankfully, I ordered a backup dress in a different style and ended up wearing that.
This dress was perfect for my charity gala event! There were a couple others girls wearing this dress at the event (oops!) but it looked great on each girl, no matter shape or size!

LOVE this dress!  I got this dress in a size 0 and a 2. The zero fit me, but was a little snug in the rib area, so I ended up wearing the size 2.  The colors in this dress are AH-MAZING! People were stopping me all night to compliment me on my dress.  It was super comfortable, but the length was long...I wore 4 inch heels and the dress was still pretty long (to be expected on someone who is only 5'3"). I highly recommend this dress! It was the perfect dress to wearing to a Labor Day Weekend wedding!
Great colors.  Slightly worn looking. It was long even with 3-4 in heels, I am 5'4 3/4.  Didn't need a bra.

Beautiful fun dress extremely flattering dress. I'm 155lb 8'5 and the 8 fit perfectly.  I had the ten as a back up, but did not even try it on since I had a lot of room in the 8. I have muscular shoulders and a bigger chest and did not feel that the top was tight as some reviews stated. Overall was a fun dress, felt great, and received a bunch of compliments.
Absolutely Stunning I loved this dress! I did need to wear about 3 inch heels as it is a bit long, but other than that it was perfect and I had compliments on it all night.

Dress of the night! I'm normally a size 6, but was able to wear a 4 in this dress. The neck area was a little tight, but I preferred the way it fit my waist. The skirt is high-waisted so even though it showed some skin in the back, it was high enough to cover any love handle problems. I received countless compliments. I wore the long and it drug the ground a little bit, but I was wearing flats. The material is thick enough that you do not have to wear a bra and no one will notice. I did not have a problem with the neck clasp staying closed, but I could tell that might have been a problem if I had worn the size 6 because the clasp was a little stretched out. It was an amazing dress and I wish I could wear it again!

Perfect dress for standing out at a black tie event!  Definitely plan for a backless bra if you're like me and don't feel comfortable going braless (though it probably would have been fine!) 2R was perfect length for 3 1/2-4 inch wedges if not a tad bit long. Super flattering and really really fun dress overall!

If you wanna look BANGIN', this is your dress, ladies. I can't say enough good things about how incredible this dress is. I'm tall and thin, but definitely have curves in the good places, so I tend to fall in dress sizes between 4-10, which is certainly difficult when ordering online. However, this dress is pretty true-to-size and I can only echo what other reviews already have said. The neck is snug, but didn't bother me. As far as length, I ordered the long and was only able to wear a 2.5 inch wedge, which lifted the dress off the floor just perfectly. The colors are simply to die for! This dress draws a lot of attention and compliments, so be ready to have all eyes on you! It's so lightweight and was perfect for an indoor/outdoor, evening wedding in SC (and in AUGUST!!). This gown is everything you hope it to be, so stop reading reviews and order it already!!

Didn't want to return it! I absolutely loved this dress! The 4 fit like a glove and the long was perfect with my heels (the regular showed too much of my shoes). It was so comfy, and held up well for all night dancing! A little tummy from baby number two born six months ago was well hidden, and I wasn't self conscious at all. I'm seriously considering buying this one. Made me feel stunning! So many compliments! Even from the bride!

Lots of compliments I liked that the dress was not too long. I am 5'6 and wore 2.5 inch heels and length was perfect, maybe a centimeter too short but I loved that I was not tripping all over it.  If you want higher heels, then you probably need a long. Also, no need to wear a bra with this dress. the neck tightness didn't bother me.

Gorgeous colors! Gorgeous dress that stood out in a sea of black dresses. I was a little nervous because most people that posted reviews wore smaller sizes, but throw some spanx on and anyone can pull this off! Fine without a bra and I'm a DD. The open back also made me nervous, but it covers all the scary places. I'm just over 5'6" and the long was fine with short heels, maybe a little long, but better than regular would have been. 

People were not joking about the top clasp coming undone, plan to have someone help you safety pin it and you're good to go!

This was my backup dress but ended up being perfect for this casual/punk rock/tattoo artist wedding! This dress, because of the colors, could dress down really well. I wore very light turquoise jewelry and a sea-foam colored clutch, which ended up being playful enough to blend in with the evening picnic wedding and also held up to the more adventurous rocker outfits in the crowd :)
I wouldn't choose this for a formal night event - the fabric/cut/color felt easier to dress down than it would be to dress up...but I'd rent again given its comfort and ease throughout the evening. Also, I'm 5'1", wore 3" heels and the dress covered the shoes (fine by me) and hit the floor but didn't look too long, in fact, it was perfect!

N/A I like to wear flats when possible so I ordered the size 6R and 6P. The 6P turned out to be a tad too short so I went with the 6R and a 1.5 inch wedge sandal and the length was perfect! Got so many compliments throughout the night and felt comfortable as well. Would definitely recommend renting!

Beautiful, Comfortable Dress! I LOVED this dress!  I was initially concerned about going bra-less, but everything was held in comfortably for the entire night.  I ordered the 2R, which was the perfect length with my 3 inch heels.  I was comfortable moving around and dancing all night, even after snacks, dinner, and drinks.  I got a ton of compliments from people at the wedding and friends who saw pictures.  I wish I could keep this dress forever!

Beautiful, high quality dress! Wish it would not have shown up damaged.  I am so upset this dress showed up to my door damaged because it was stunning. The colors are bright and vibrant and the material is thick, you can really feel the quality in construction. I am usually very skeptical about sizing and material, but let me tell you this is a TRUE to size dress if I have ever seen one. I would also note that while it did not show up in my search for "full bust" or "apple" it fit me perfectly with no puckering. I say this to help any girls that worry if their chests will fit; they will! I am 5'6" of all leg and when I tried it on with 4.5" heels it would almost have been too long but just by a teeny bit. Many of the reviews stated that the zipper was an issue and I would probably agree. The material around the zipper (whole length) had separated completely making it impossible to wear and I assume this was from it being tugged at numerous times by others. I also noted this issue on the backup size 6L which was very, very difficult to zip.
I felt great in this dress! So comfortable. Tight around the next but not uncomfortable!  Very heavy, dont wear in hot souther weather. But i would suggest this to anyone ( and have!)

I loved this dress -- wore it to an upscale hotel wedding and felt effortlessly elegant! I am not a girl who likes to go bra-less but felt totally comfortable in this!  The back of the dress goes far enough to make you feel secure.  I was able to dance all night, no problem.  Length was perfect with a medium wedge heel.  I got tons of complements all night!
Lots of compliments, really fun to wear.  Normally I wear a 6L, but the neck size was a bit too tight, so the 8L fit the best.

Such a beautiful & flowy dress! Easy to put on and move around in.  The minute I saw this dress I knew I had to rent it! It looks exactly as pictured - the pink and red combo are a real winner. I rented the 2R & 4R (the petite sizes weren't available) – which I am glad I did. I paired it with red heels and the length was just right. I wore stickies instead of a strapless bra since the back was open. Surprisingly I fit both the 2R & 4R, but went with the 4R cause it was less wrinkly. I saw many reviewers say the the neckline bothered them/was tight, but it was no issue for me at all. If you're on the fence about it - I say go for it! It's a gorgeous dress and the compliments won't stop coming ;)

Loved this dress!  So many compliments. This was perfect for a formal summer wedding.  Love that it came in a long option.  I went with the larger of the two sizes as the top was a bit tighter on me and the 6L wasn't as bad particularly around the neck.

Perfect for spring wedding! I accidentally ordered 4L but it worked out fine. I'm 5'6" and it just came short of hitting the floor while in heels. I loved this dress so much. Its so modern and flattering. Not to mention comfortable.

Absolutely loved this dress! It flowed well and looked great. I got compliments from everyone! Tighter on top, may be snug on someone with a bigger bust. Flowed nicely to cover my hips. With 3 1/2 in heels it was the perfect length.

This dress was so comfortable and beautiful! I really loved getting to wear it! I felt super comfortable all night in this dress, and contrary to other reviews, I had no trouble with the neck clasp. I will say that while I never felt that the dress was tight around my neck, I did have a very distinct line around my neck at the end of the evening from the neck line. Other than that, I really enjoyed weraing the dress and was able to dance all night without feeling exposed or having to constantly tug and pull on it. I was glad that I ordered the 4L as my back up size. I am 5'8" and since I was planning on wearing heels, the 4L was definitely the way to go. I definitely recommend this dress. It is fun, flirty, and extremely flattering!

Loved the dress, despite having a twin!  Dress was so good that I didn't even mind that someone else was wearing it! I had ordered a 4R and a 6P. The 4R was too tight around the neck and the shoulders but it was also loose and frumpy looking around the middle. It was also too long, but that was to be expected for my short legs. The 6P on the other hand fit perfectly! looser around the neck and shoulders and somehow not as baggy around the middle.
I got so many compliments on it.  Girls wanted to take it off me.   Fit perfect.
Beautiful and just the right length, so much fun to dance in.  The back clasp comes undone if you're dancing  and jumping up and down.
The dress was so comfortable and the fabric was very forgiving.  backless bra is a must!

Fabulous dress for a wedding.  I got so many compliments on this dress. I knew I had liked the style but was sure how the colors would look on me. It was a last minute swap in-store since my other dresses didn't fit at all. I had to wear my 4inch heels just so it didn't drag since I'm short. It's very fun and flirty dress as well. Fit was perfect as well. Would surely rent again.
This dress is great and very flatering to all figures.Colors are beautiful! Several Compliments.  I had no issues with the clasp in the back staying on.

I've never felt more beautiful in anything in my life!  Absolutely LOVE this dress! I actually rented a different dress for a wedding last weekend, and when RTR couldn't send that one in my size, they sent along this AMAZING dress.  I cannot say enough wonderful things about it.  The colors are beautiful, the fit was true to size, and I got compliments all night.  The neck was a little tight, but that works for me as it kept my (rather large) "girls" in check.  If I had the option to buy it, I would have!

Gorgeous Chicago wedding Being 4'11" I should have known not to order a long dress but I just could not resist.  This dress is absolutely stunning so I rolled the dice and hoped for the best.  The color and fit is perfect.  But if you are short just be aware that you will have to wear your highest heels possible.  I got a pair of 5.5 inch heels and the dress was still about half an inch too long.  I ended up just holding it when I walked and danced.  Overall I felt so beautiful in this dress, I didn't even care about the length issue.

Beautiful colors and lovely fabric - fit comfortably and I danced in it all night!  I wore this dress in size 4P, because it was the only size available. It was VERY snug around the ribcage because I'm. Normally a 4R. The colors were outstanding and the open back was classy and different from a normal dress. I received a lot of compliments and I danced in this dress all night. The 4P wasn't short, but I was able to get away with flats vs. heels. I wore diamond studs and a nude clutch with the dress and it matched perfectly.

I went to an Indian wedding. The colors were PERFECT, and the fit was elegant.  + I wore this dress to my boyfriend's cousin's wedding. It was perfect around lots of family members as it covered me in all the right places.
+ The colors were BEAUTIFUL. Couldn't get enough compliments on them.
+ The back of the dress is really the highlight - I recommend getting sticky cups as a bra to wear with this dress.
- The neck is pretty tight, but I found it totally manageable.
- This dress was a bit too long, but I also can't wear super high heels, so I lost some height there. While walking, I had to lift up the dress so it didn't drag, but it was 100% great when I was dancing and moving the dress!
TIPS: I enjoyed pairing it with pretty green, seaglass earrings from RTR (see pic). I also used light purple nail polish to add another colored accent.

Too short I typically look for shorter dresses...because I'm short and don't want the dress to fall at an awkward length. This one is the perfect length when you first put it on but as you wear it the hemline slowly creeps upward. Was something I was conscious of the entire evening and was distracting. It's also of a much flimsier fabric...more spandex-ey than I had imagined which combined with the short length made it feel less classy. Overall I love the colors and the open back, but I wouldn't rent it again. Not the quality of dress I'm used to from RTR.

I loved the bright colors.  This dress was truly unique from everyone else's dresses. I've had my eye on this dress for a long time and couldn't wait for the opportunity to rent it.  After reading the reviews I decided to size up and get the 8 and the 10 and I'm glad I did.  The dress is tight in the bottom and big on the top.  The eight fit, but I was very self conscious about it being tight in the butt so I decided to go with the 10 which was very loose everywhere else.  A little double sided tape on the shoulders worked great to keep them from falling down.  The colors are beautiful and I loved the open back.  The material is very thin so I couldn't wear spanks underneath because a line showed where they ended.  Also the hem wouldn't lay right.  Overall I think it is a really pretty dress, and I did get compliments on it, but the fit was so weird that I didn't get the glamorous feeling I usually get in RTR desses.  If you are thinking of renting it I would definitely suggest sizing up and strongly consider picking a different dress if you are pear shaped...there are just so many other dresses that are more flattering for our body type.
It's comfortable and very different This dress was amazing! I got so many compliments on it the entire night.
Perfect alternative to the LBD.  Fit true to size. Runs a tad short. Other than that, great dress. Another great experience with RTR!

This is a really cute and fun dress. It's super easy to wear and very eye-catching.  The material is very light, which I didn't expect, but I liked that about it. I didn't have any problems with the dress at all. I got lots of compliments and the back is very stunning. It's a little short, but it didn't ride up at all when I walked or danced, so that was a major plus. Just added a black sweater and black heels and voila! Very happy with this free birthday rental.

I didn't end up wearing this dress.   This dress was really cute from the front, but unflattering in the back.  I loved that the back was out, but it made my butt look really long.....not a good look.  I have a longer torso and most jumpers don't look good on my either.  So, if you are a person that looks great in jumpers, then get this dress.  But if you are a taller girl with a long torso avoid it.

All the compliments I received on this dress. This dress turns heads.  It is gorgeous, especially from the back.  The print on the back definitely flatters even a less than perky backside!  Beware, it IS short and it DOES ride up as you walk.  Worth it though.

Didn't get many full body photos BUT this dress was great! Compliments all night  and felt confident Dress was a 'good' kind of tight. Very flattering and the low back but high neckline made it a sophisticated sexy. Only concern was it was a little short. I kept having to pull the dress down but that was a minor issue. Great colors and coordinated well with nude strappy heels.  Would definitely recommend
perfect for graduation This dress was great.  The only problem i had with this  dress was the length.  It was a little too short.

Tight and thin fabric.  I didn't wear this dress, but unfortunately as I got this delivered to my office the previous day and worked late, I didn't have the opportunity to try it on within the return window. It was very disappointing, especially as it seemed the size 6 had a zipper defect in that it wasn't sitting right on my hip (like, it would pop out and you could tell there was a zipper there). I rented this to go to the Belmont Stakes- I was looking for a summery day dress. Fortunately I had an alternative in my closet. I wouldn't recommend this dress as it's designed to hug the skin, which isn't apparent in the photo. It's unlined, and I was expecting nicer fabric. I don't think I would have been comfy all day in this. However, the colors are beautiful, and it looks terrific on the hanger. If you are looking for a tight dress, you might like it.

Colorful and unique!  This dress is the perfect combination of uniqueness and classy.  It has a great colorful print, but not too splashy for a cocktail party.  The low back is fantastic to make a statement.  While I loved this dress, it did run a little small, I normally wear a 0 and I felt that was just too tight/not as flattering throughout, luckily I had the free backup size.  Based on the material, the bottom does ride up a lot too - completely manageable but just something to watch out for!

Rave reviews from friends and strangers alike! Fit was a little bit off, as it was slightly snug at the hips but was very loose at the bust and shoulders. 
However, didn't have any issues with sleeves slipping off while wearing.

got tons of compliments! really adorable, wish i could just buy it :) i ordered a 0 and 2 and had a hard time deciding which i should wear. the 2 was too loose on top so i went for the 0 and it was great.

Wore as my birthday dress for a date with my BF to a play. Summer sexy for sure! Its a fabulous dress, so if you are wondering if it's right for you and this is your style.. don't doubt it!

Wore the 10 for the length as the dress is truly short! The 8 fit fine though. 

The colors, the style, it gives the perfect amount of everything. Sexy but appropriate, yet totally party and/or hot date worthy. Fits great because it oddly has room but you wanna have the flattest tummy you can.

Double sided tape is MANDATORY. It has to go on your shoulders and on your back underneath the dress because if not it will slip constantly. I bought it knowing that from other reviews so double sided tape =  non issue.

Other than that, the pictures speak for themselves! 
It actually make the butt look a bit smaller than it actually is, just as an fyi but that's fine because you want the focus to be more on your back, less on your butt or else it could get a bit trashy. lol.

Happy renting ladies!

Great dress for a formal day party I ended up choosing the 0 over the 2 because of the upper body fit. The 2 was a little big around the armpit area. Both sizes fit a little snug on my butt, so if you have any butt at all I would plan on ordering a size up. Even though the butt was snug, it didn't pull across the front or make the dress look too small. I wore it with a shawl to avoid feeling uncomfortable with the tight parts. The fabric is a little unforgiving, so prepare for that. Fashion tape would have helped with the sleeves rolling up and with keeping the low back in place. The material also made it easy to travel with because I could make it small enough to fit in a purse and it didn't look wrinkled later. Overall, the dress was perfect. I will definitely be ordering it again.
Stood out from the crowd with the vibrant colors and absolutely loved that it was backless Only downside was that it tended to ride up while dancing so be careful ladies...
Such a fun dress! I got so many compliments! I loved this dress! loved the open back! fabric is light and stretchy, very comfortable!

Loved the bright print and the cut of the back! This dress was comfortable and easy to dance in, but it's definitely short (I wore little shorts underneath so as not to limit my dance moves)! It also rides up a little.

Cute, but shorter and tighter than I expected. The cut of this dress and the pictures gave the impression of a structured cotton dress, but it is actually a very stretch dress. I rented this dress to wear to a day-time event and, at least for someone of my height, it was really more appropriate for a night out with friends. I didn't end up wearing the dress, for this reason.

HOT dress for HOT times This was the perfect little dress for a night out in Miami. Loved the multi-colors and open back. Could go with practically any color shoes or accessories. The length on me was perfect since I'm only 5'2", but think it could be a little too short for taller girls.
