Wore this awesome dress for a welcome dinner for a wedding in NOLA Runs true to size, loved the open back.  I didn't have any issues with the sleeves falling down or really any fit issues.  Would love to have kept it!

Dress that stands out from the pack! I have had this dress in my hearts for some time now. It looked sexy and fun and I loved all the bright colors on it. I know some people commented on how the sleeves were puffier than they thought they would be, I personally loved that feature. The dress is short, but I didn't find myself pulling it down all night. It is super tight around the stomach region, if that is not a feature you usually like to show off I would just keep that in mind. The good news is the bright colors/design does camouflage things a bit. Overall really beautiful and I would rent it again! I wore the dress with black pumps which I thought complimented it nicely. Would have loved to wear the dress with a bright shoe but nothing was really working for me. So black it was! I got quite a few compliments throughout the night.

I rented this dress for my Master's Commencement ceremony last May and absolutely loved it! I ordered this dress about 4 days before my ceremony because I couldn't find anything to match my blue shoes and clearly I'm a slight procrastinator :) But, RTR saved the day! They even shipped it to my house a day before I actually needed it. The dress is a little on the short side, but that was fine with me because I wore a robe over top of it anyway. It was the perfect dress for the occasion!
Such a fun dress! Love the color and back! only con- a little short, had to tug it down at times. Would rent again!
SEXY!! LOVED EVERYTHING ABOUT THIS DRESS A SURE STUNNER SEXY AND CLASSY DIDN'T WANNA RETURN HIS I'LL SURE MISS IT LOVED IT SO MUCH

The back was my fav part!  And I got tons of compliments :) it fit pretty well, but, as all the other reviews said, it did ride up as I walked.  that was the only part that bothered me.  other than that, it was a hot dress and felt good in it.
Fabulous dress for any day event! Really great fit and a stunning back. The dress was super comfortable and I got tons of compliments

Fun, flirty party dress! I was a little hesitant about this dress at first but it actually worked out way better than I expected! The fit is great and true to size but it is rather short. You can't wear a bra with it which so you if you want extra support you will have to wear a backless, strapless bra. Overall, it was a very fun, flirty and young dress and I liked it much better than I thought I would!

Cheerful and easy to wear, with just enough glam. I wore this for a show and nightclubs in Las Vegas. It was an easy-wearing dress and got lots of compliments -- and didn't wrinkle in my suitcase. It definitely stood out in a sea of black and gold metallics! My only complaint about the fit is that the open back means the sleeves would sometimes slip off over my shoulders -- the way a bra strap does -- and I needed to occasionally tug them back up. I felt comfortable going bra-less in this dress and leaving my back completely bare.
Love this dress! This dress is absolutely adorable - the only con is the length. It runs pretty short so if you aren't used to wearing minis be careful!

fun, unexpected Graduation dress I wore this dress to my college graduation, it was an unexpected twist on the classic "little white dress" most girls were wearing. It fit my body like a glove (the material is a light weight and stretchy). It was so comfortable and I didnt even need a bra with it (which was good because of the open back). looks great paired with gold jewelry, i wore nude shoes but I wish I had some cobalt blue ones to wear with it I think they would have looked nice. I would definitely rent this dress again, I was sad to send it back so quickly

Great dress - loved the color and material.  Really comfortable material.  I wore the 0 and never actually tried on the 2.  The 0 fit great but did feel a little short, as the stretchy material can ride up a little while dancing.  The neckline is also pretty high so it cut right against my neck when sitting.  But in general, true to size.  Definitely need a backless (sticky) bra.  Perfect for a cocktail party or spring wedding.  Fun dress.  Great colors.  Easy to pair with accessories.

Wore it to my Engagement Party, got compliments all night! Striking, colorful, form fitting, however it runs short, so tall girls beware as I spent a portion of the night making sure it wasn't riding up. That being said, the dress is beautiful. I wish I had a picture of the back to show how pretty the whole look is.

I wore the dress to a Mardi Gras themed formal event. Lots of compliments on the fun bright colors!  Great dress.  Only complaint was that it was short and that I constantly was pulling it down throughout the evening.  I didn't have any problem with the sleeves staying up though.  Would definitely rent again!

Colorful, flirty and fun! Slightly more conservative in the front (although this shows some leg!), the wow factor of this dress comes when you twirl around. That back! Grab an adhesive bra or prepare to go braless, as this option wouldn't work with your traditional one. I slipped this dress on with a pair of gray booties for a New Year's Eve dinner and dance party, where I felt super-confident and received countless compliments. I will definitely keep this designer in mind for future rentals!

LOVED this dress! Perfectly for the summer! Loved this dress. I wore it during the day-- a spa day with my girlfriend. It is great for a petite girl. I am 5'3" 103lbs, and I really struggle to find a dress that doesn't look frumpy on me. This dress was pretty short, good fit, and the back makes it AMAZING. I would recommend it highly!

Prepare to get compliments! This dress was my first pick for a gala I attend yearly. Noticeable dresses always make the best impact and this got the bill!

The dress itself has a great shape, especially in the sleeves, but it's incredibly comfortable, almost like a nightgown.

The back of the dress, which might be the most stunning, prohibited a bra, but was not the slightest issue. My only pick is that it did ride up my thighs a bit, making a short dress even shorter.
Cute, fun, love the open back! Runs a bit small but also has some stretch which helps to make it more forgiving. I've rented it twice so it's a winner for me.

I was around all of my friends and had a great time and felt confident in my amazing dress I chose. The dress was a little looser on me, but that could be because of the open back. I ate a lot of food so by the end of the night I didn't mind the extra belly room. I had to keep pulling it down because it would shimmy up a little but I didn't mind. I got plenty of compliments on it and the colors were great for the season and I would think they could work for any season!

Love the design and back of this dress! This dress was great! I could have gotten away with the 4 (my usual size) but it felt a little tight in the hips and was also a little short for a wedding so I decided to size up to my backup dress which was a 6. Unfortunately the 6 came with a rip in the side seam. It seemed like RTR knew about this and sent it anyway because the dress had a piece of blue tape on it and a red piece of paper stapled around the arm. I removed those and did a quick fix in order to wear it that night. The dress itself does run a little small and the bottom is kind of weird - it's like a modified bubble hem and it looks a little uneven/sloppy. Other than that, the dress is great and was the perfect mix of fun, sexy, and easy going for an upscale backyard wedding.

Cute, Sexy & Sassy! This dress was so comfortable and easy to wear. I was in the HUMID city of New Orleans and this material was perfect - almost like workout material. As the other reviews suggest, it does ride up as you walk/dance, but it's a small price to pay to look this cute! Actually, with the humidity, the dress stuck to my thighs and butt so it didn't ride up while I was outside. I wish I took a photo of the back of the dress as it was my favorite part! I got tons of compliments, and gave credit to RTR! :) No need to wear a bralette or pasties... I'm a C and didn't feel like I needed the support as the dress was tight where it needed to be and held the girls in place. Plus, if you get cold, you couldn't tell due to the bright colors on the bust and torso! ;)

A fun dress for a fun wedding! This dress is a lot of fun and gets a lot of attention! I purchased my first Nubra for this dress, and it worked out great. There is no support in the dress, so busty girls won't be able to go braless. Even though the dress is fabulous, I didn't feel as confident as I normally do in my RTR dresses. The design is not best suited for curvy, hourglass, or pear-shapes because the skirt is rather slim. I still wore my usual size, 0, instead of going up a size because the shoulders fit best on the 0, and that was more important for the dress to work. The fabric is rather thin and delicate, but fortunately the print hides any imperfections you may feel insecure about. Of course, you must feel rather confident about your back! While dancing the already short skirt rides up, and the shoulders can fall off. I wore it J.Crew hot pink suede almond-toe pumps and no other accessories.

Great dress! Love the fabric and cut! Warning!! Order a size up if you are busty! I absolutely LOVED this dress and I am so so sad that I couldn't wear it! I recently had a breast augmentation so I am still figuring out what sizes work for me in certain cuts! It definitely was a tad tight around the girls. I might have sported this size in my younger party days, but it didn't seem to be an appropriate fit at my age. Should have gotten the 4!

Great dress for a birthday The size 4 fit a little tight so I went with the bigger size 6.  The low cut back is nice but it was a little baggy around my lower back area so it wasn't very flattering in the buttocks area.  Overall it was a really fun dress to wear.  It was about 32 degrees but I wore it anyways for my birthday dinner.

This dress was awesome!  Many compliments!  I wish I had some pics because it was such a cool dress. Definitely have some dress tape to make sure the shoulder and back areas don't slip around.  I wore a backless bra (stick on) and some spanx, the fabric is kind of thin and I did not want any lines to show.  Overall, it was a fun dress, no one else had anything else like it on, it was a major hit and I can't wait to rent it again!

Beautiful dress I love the dress, the back was the best feature. the front made my belly stick out a bit but overall it was fine. very short but not trashy short. didnt like that when i danced i felt llike the dress kepted moving out of place. the shoulders would come down, i always had to adjust myself. its definitely not a party dance all night long type of dress. its a sit down look pretty have dinner take pictures kinda a dress for sure! ;-) but i loved it. Got many compliments all night. ;-) thank you RTR for all your help.

Fun dress to wear out In Vegas! Dress was a little bit short, but worked well for Las Vegas.  Would probably be too short for some events, especially if you are on the taller side.  Dress was tight, but fabric was very flattering.  Back was very cute.  Did not wear a bra.
Very comfortable dress. I got a lot of compliments on it. Forms well to the body.  I go back and forth between a 2 and a 4. I wore the 4 as the 2 was too tight in the hip area. The 4 fit perfectly.

Such a fun dress and very flattering shape! Got the 4 and 6, chose the 6 because I felt like it would be good for dancing around at my friend's wedding. I loved everything about this dress (in fact I'm on the hunt to find it on sale now) except for the little strings you use to hang it up kept showing. If it were mine, I would have cut them off.

Fun dress for my birthday dinner date night! This dress is shooooooort!! I'd been eyeing it for a while and it's very fun but I'm glad I didn't wear it to a wedding or a work event. It was fun and sexy but showed a LOT of leg and back! You have been warned! Also, get 2 sizes because while the 10 did fit me better, the 10 and the 12 looked like completely different dresses. The pattern was much bigger and darker on the 12. Also, this is good for smaller chested girls because there's not much you can do in the ways of a bra.

Perfect for a Birthday Party. The dress is stylish and the back really makes this dress a bit sexy.   The dress looks great in pictures too.   The shoulders were a bit big on my small top.   The material is stretchy and pulled up when I would move around... so I was a bit self conscious.   Overall, a very fun dress.

Sadly wasn't able to wear the dress I got the 4 and 6 in this dress for my birthday dinner and sadly wasn't able to wear either dress. The 4 definitely fit better than the 6. I didn't think I had a long torso, but the hips on the dress hit way too high causing it to look frumpy and ill-fitting.  Colors are gorgeous and the back is awesome.  Would work well if you have a small torso.  Also, as other reviewers mentioned this dress is definitely on the shorter side

This was the perfect dress to celebrate my birthday in Vegas! This dress runs small so order 1 or 2 sizes up depending on your chest size. I wore one size up and it fit well! The dress also runs short, but the material is stretchy and can be pulled down! Got lots of compliments in this dress. Would rent again!
So fun! This dress is fun, sexy, and different. I received many compliments. Overall, it was true to fit, but as others did say, it does ride up.
Flattering and easy to wear. Flattering, easy. Pretty colors. Short enough for short girls.

This was my first dress with RTR and I can't wait for my next! Looks like the start to an addiction I rented size 2 and 4, but opted for the 4 because the 2 was pretty short. If I was wearing the dress to Vegas, no problem, but this was a wedding. I had no problem with the open back. The skirt road up a little but wasn't a hassle. Loved how colorful this dress was! Definitely not your dept store style dress! I felt for very fashion forward :)

Perfect for a rehearsal dinner...LOVED it!  I rented this dress for a fairly formal rehearsal dinner. I was hesitant for 2 reasons - 1. I was worried there would be too much white in it and 2. They only had the larger size available. Well I'm glad I went ahead and ordered it, because the white was very subtle, and the larger size fit perfectly! I loved the open back (couldn't wear a bra) and got so many compliments on it.

Gorgeous style, but needed lots of fixing.  I was ready to love this dress - it was my first RTR rental, and I was so psyched to wear it to all 3 weekend events (bday party, bridal shower, formal auction event) thanks to its versatility. 
The fabric is very comfortable, silky smooth, and breathable. Be prepared to tug at the bottom of it, as it comes up all the time. The sleeves kept coming off, too. 
I loved the open back, and enjoyed the compliments - I received many, but it was too much work, I couldn't relax from all the fixing.

Fun, Flirty, and Fit like a glove This dress was an absolute hit at my casual couple's wedding shower!  The dress is lighter weight than I expected which was perfect for my outdoor event.  This was my first experience as a Rent the Runway customer and I couldn't have been happier!  RENT THIS DRESS you will not be disappointed!!
It fit odly. The dress was really tight and short so make sure you size up! ALso oddly loose on the top.
Cute, fun, flirty dress! The 0 for me was even a tad big in the top but overall fit nicely!

In love with this dress Lilly has done it again - the PERFECT dress.  I loved this dress so much that I actually looked up in the Rent the Runway website to see if I could buy it!  The color is bright and cheerful.  Fit was true to size or a tiny bit large.
Many compliments on this dress! Fit seemed true to size. I went with the 2 to add a little more length since it was a family wedding.

Classy and sexy!! I wore this to an outdoor vintage country wedding. It was perfect for the occasion!   I wore it with a jcrew necklace that made it perfect! The dress was the right length for my 5'4 frame if I was any taller I wouldn't be able to lift my arms. Not easy to buckle shoes in this dress so you may need some help:) I received so many complements and was told I looked classy and sexy!!

Pretty for a casual event This dress was pretty but more for a casual event, so I ended up not wearing it. I am 5'8 and it was very short! Also the fabric is really not forgiving, so it would be very uncomfortable to move and sit in. The lace is large and not that nice of material. It would be a good dress for  a very casual wedding or bridal/baby shower.

Fun and Flattering I received many so compliments on this dress. The pink stands out but is not too loud. The dress is very flattering as it skims your curves, but the fabric is heavy enough not to cling. Great dress if you want to showcase your legs. Like other reviewers have mentioned, beware that it is dangerously short. I could have worn the size 0, but went with the size 2 for a little extra length, and I'm barely 5'2". Don't try to bend over or lift you arms above your head, as you won't have enough coverage! Overall, I loved the dress and was sad to return it.

Perfect bachelorette party dress I wore this dress for my bachelorette party for a wine tour. This dress was so comfortable and high quality, I loved it so much, it was really hard to have to return it!! I'm 5'4" and typically wear a size 0 but although the 0 fit it was too short and when I lifted my arms my entire backside was exposed. So the 2 was my choice because of the added length and the looser fit was great for a day full of eating and drinking anyways!

Fun color! Short though...  Loved the color of this dress- I knew the wedding color was "peach/coral" so I'd fit in with the color scheme without trying to look like I was a bridesmaid. Ordered a 2 and 4, and had to wear the 4 for length (I have a long torso and short legs, so it didn't LOOK short, but oh man... boyfriend aka best man and I made and set up cornhole at the venue, and the shorts I wore underneath were definitely necessary). I tucked the ribbons in the back because I felt ridiculous with a big ol' bow in the back. I have muscular arms but these were almost a little loose. Whole dress was actually on the loose side since I sized up... created a tummy in some photos, which I don't have... I didn't feel super confident but overall happy enough and would order again now that I understand how it fits me.

I wore this dress for a graduation party at a country club. I loved the look if this dress. The overall fit of this dress was great. The sleeves are lace so there is no give in them, making it a little difficult to dance. All in all was a great dress!
So many compliments! Awesome dress. Great, fun summer color! Loved the bow in the back. Runs a little on the short side

Very cute dress, but short! I rented this dress for Easter.  It is a beautiful color and is very comfortable and flattering.  I am only 5'3" though, and it was very short on me.  I flashed the world bending to put my daughter in the car.  I usually wear a 4 in most brands, but the 2 worked better.  The 4 was much too loose in the waist.

Engagement Photos I wore this dress for our engagement photo shoot. It was STUNNING. I received so many compliments on the dress walking downtown Chicago. The dress ran a TAD large around the waist area, but I would still rate this a true to fit, as it was perfect in all other areas. I'm 150lbs, 5'8. The dress length was perfect. I would for sure rent this dress again.
Great wine tasting dress I wore this dress wine tasting for my birthday. This dress was very comfortable but a bit on the short side. I love the bright color.

The color is beautiful and the lace is great. Its nice to pair with black leggings as i did! I  The fit was tight! Fir a size 10 wow! But thankfully it fit! Next time for lilly dresses i am gonna run up a size with 12.

Great color I loved the color of this dress; it's very vibrant. I ordered the 2 (my normal size) and a 4 as the back-up. As other reviewers have said, it fits snug in the hips. The 2 fit perfectly everywhere but the hips for me, where it was a bit snug. Honestly, I probably could have worn it and been fine, but because it was tighter, it looked shorter. Knowing I was going to be raising my arms to hug people at the wedding and dance, I didn't want to worry about tugging it down all night so i went with the 4. Looking at pictures, I should have probably worn the smaller size. While it gave me the room in my hips and the extra bit of length, it looked a little baggy on me at times. Despite this, it was super comfortable and I got tons of compliments from strangers all night! I paired it with a rhinestone bauble and nude peep-toe wedges.

Cute  but too small for a BUSY Girl I would have loved to wear this dress because the color is amazing, and the ribbon detail on the back is so cute.  However, the bust was wayyy to small for me.  It was more a combination of the area, arms, bust, and shoulders, so I did not get to wear this dress out.

So girly and bright! I loved wearing this dress! The fit was pretty spot on what I typically wear. I'm only 5'3 so the dress didn't feel incredibly short on me, but I can see why other girls were concerned about the length. I wish that I could wear it again!

Love Loved this dress! I got so many compliments. looks great in photos the color is amazballs!!!!  i wore the dress with Kate spade Bright Beryl Necklace, and with a mint Classic Pointy Toe High Heel Pump
so cute !

A big hit! I rented this dress for my bridal shower and I got so many compliments! I am a very petite girl and have had problems with rentals fitting me well in the past. I looked at the reviews and since a lot of others said it ran a little small, I went for it. I found it fit me SLIGHTLY loosely, but it still looked great. The color is amazing--it is SO pink. It's a great quality dress and the lace patterns are still very nice and not worn. I see what other reviewers are saying about it being short, but I am 5'1", and so it landed just above my knee. It was actually the perfect dress for me. I will definitely rent this dress again--thinking of renting for a wedding in a few months!

Color that packs a punch! Lovely dress and wonderful fit. As always, is short almost on any height. The color is very bright pink and packs a punch! I would recommend wearing with a statement necklace.

Perfect Easter Dress I loved wearing this dress! I actually rented it because I tried to purchase and couldn't find my size.  I wore the two as opposed to the zero due to length for church on Easter.  The dress was very comfortable & I loved wearing it!

Perfect pink and lace combo
 A little short. Couldn't really do the YMCA  but I still felt fab
Beautiful dress and color.  I usually wear a 2, but that was a little snug.

bright, comfortable dress, good for a summer wedding Even with long sleeves, this dress was comfortable and lightweight for an evening summer wedding. I found it to be true to size. Sometimes I find that Lilly dresses run a little small, but this one seemed like a true 2 (I might even have liked to try the 0, but the backup size that I ordered was a 4). It was a very bright pink- the photos of the dress are accurate. I loved wearing it!

Cute dress, pretty color. The dress is a beautiful color and the fabric is very nice. I was not impressed with the fit but the dress still worked well for a more conservative outfit as a wedding guest.

so gorgeous but too short! rented this for my friend's bridal shower. loved the color, the fabric, and the fit of this dress, but it was just too short! RTR customer service was the BEST EVER and is sending me similar styles that will hopefully be long enough!

Awesome first experience...love the color! This was my first experience with RTR and was nervous about how the dress would fit because of my pear/athletic shape. I got the 6 and 8 and surprisingly ended up wearing the 6 because it was a little more form flattering. The color was great, it is almost like a two toned magenta/bright pink. The event was a friends spring wedding so even though i usually gravitate towards black dresses to purchase I was happy to get to try a bright bold color. Agree with the other girls that it is on the shorter side.

Pretty in Pink My 13th year old daughter used it for a neon yacht party.   The dress was a hit; she looked like a Barbie doll.   Not only is this dress elegant but short and sassy for someone of her age.

I received so many compliments on the dress!  Very comfortable and easy to dance in!  The fit was perfect a little tighter in the bust area and loose throughout the stomach area making for a perfect fit for a wedding.
I got a lot of compliments on the color. It was great.  I had to wear the larger size cause of my  big arms, but overall I loved this dress.
Loved the dress!  Perfect for a baby shower!  A nice bright color. It was a little short.  I'm 5'7" and was happy I could wear tights with it!

Actually worked for New Year's... would wear it again in the spring or summer  I was really unsure about the pink going into it but the color was PERFECT and really worked for the New Year's party I was at, I stood out and got a lot of compliments. It look good with tights under it (it was almost below zero in the Midwest) but would look good bare legged as well. It didn't restrict me from dancing and I thought the fit was flattering. My only complaints: I could go without the bow in the back, the dress would be gorgeous without it. And the sleeves were a little tight. If not for those, I could have probably worn the 4. 

I would definitely rent this dress again for a spring or summer wedding.

Perfect for my Bridal Shower! This Lilly dress was perfect for my bridal shower! The color is bright and beautiful and I got so many compliments on it. It fit well - it wasn't too tight or too short. It was the perfect for the occasion!
It was a perfect dress for my engagement party. I am 5'9" and it was a bit short, but great! The back of the dress was a great accent as well.

Vibrant dress that is sure to stand out! I wore this to a cocktail party at my law school and got a lot of compliments- it certainly stood out among the dresses everyone else was wearing! I've tried a lot of different Lilly Pulitzer dresses (both from RTR and otherwise) and know that the brand's sizing is not consistent- but I wear a 4 in pants and ordered the 4 dress and it was the correct size- phew! My only reason for not giving 5 stars is that the dress isn't the most slimming from all angles, and you can tell that its been worn before.  Other than that, I was very satisfied with dress, and was happy that it ran true to size!

Not my favorite dress I didn't love this dress and would definitely not rent it again.  The size 8 was frumpy on me, so I wore the size 6, which was SUPER short - like if I raised my arms it barely covered my butt short.  I'm 5'2, so for something to be short on me is rare. I actually wondered if maybe it had shrunk at some point.  Overall I just didn't find the dress to be flattering at all.  It made me feel like I had a tire around my mid section because of the way the lining laid under the lace.  A picture from the side looks like a big blob as it just kind of hangs straight down.  I didn't even receive one compliment on this dress like I usually do with my RTR dresses!  It wasn't terrible, but I definitely didn't feel good in this dress!

Great style, fantastic color.  I ordered a 2 and a 6 in this dress (typically wear a 2 or 4, but 4 was not available). The 2 fit great, but was a little snug in the arms when I first put it on. Fabric gave a little after just a few minutes. It was pretty short on me, and I'm only 5 ft 3 in, so if you are tall, I'd be careful about ordering this one if you plan on dancing and lifting your arms a lot (the dress comes up a bit when you lift your arms!) It's loose through the stomach, which is nice, but a bit tighter around the hips and thighs (at least for my body type), so it's not a dress you can dance wildly in. :) The color is great - I received a ton of compliments on the dress all day, mainly about the color. (And the owner of the wedding venue insisted on taking photos of me on some of the wedding furniture because she loved the color so much - thus the cheesy pictures!) I wore it with gold flats.

Super cute, Flattering to my  body and I would wear it again.   Unfortunately, I didn't wear this for very long, but I did love the dress.  The color went well with my blonde hair and blue eyes and flattered my athletic body.  I am 5'7", so it was pretty short.  I wouldn't be dancing and waving my hands in the air, but it wasn't indecent.  It was a bit tight in the shoulder area, but not overly so.
I rented this dress for my high school reunion.  The dress was a little tighter and shorter than I thought it would be but I thought it still looked great on. LOVE the color!
Easter Brunch I felt like it was a little tighter than I hoped but it was still comfortable and perfectly sweet for the holiday!
Short Unfortunately I did not wear this dress. Being 5' 8" I was a bit uncomfortable with how short it was. However, if you are of smaller stature I absolutely recommend.
n/a wore it for easter.  Great dress but definitely short : )
Beautiful and Bright This is a beautiful dress.  The lace is chunkier and fun.  The only downside was the length of the dress.  It was way too short.

Gorgeous color makes you stand out star - compliment city! Wish I could give a 4.5 because I really loved this dress! Only complaint was the bow tie in the back is really bulky and difficult to tie yourself in a way that doesn't look like a sloppy bow, so make sure you have a fashionable girl friend around to help you tie it cute.  Also the lace pattern looks much nicer in pictures than in person, but still the dress is beautiful and the color is amazing. I'm usually a 4 and wore a 2, length was sassy but not too revealing for a wedding.
Different dress, great color Fit perfectly

Great dress, slightly short. The dress was a fantastic color and comfy enough to wear all day. I ordered a 6 and an 8. The 6 fit better but was so dang short and not appropriate to wear to the event I was attending. I ended up wearing the 8 and felt a lot better about length. Got compliments about it all day!

Fabulous, Fun Pink!  Great dress. It is quite short, even on my 5' frame. It was comfortable and stood out in all the black. I got tons of compliments on the great color and overall look. The bow in the back adds a really fun accent. I would love to own this dress and would definitely get it again!

This dress was perfect for a summer wedding I had to wear the bigger of the two sizes, and the dress was a little short, but still fit well. I was comfortable, and felt bright during a summer wedding. Would rent again for sure.
I rented this dress for my sisters wedding. It was WAY too short! There was no way I cold have worn it.   I have no idea who could wear it.  Unbelievably inappropriately short.

Vibrant color and flirty lace fit I wore this dress for a bridal shower I helped host.  I LOVED it!  It was the perfect amount of stretch and such a vibrant color.  This was truly a dress that I didn't want to return and would recommend it for anyone.
The color was great! It was shorter than expected
The color of this dress is amazing!  The top part fit a little big,  #graduation

This dress fit perfectly and I received so many compliments all night long! It's a great pink color...favorite part, even with the cut out back I could wear a standard bra.  I wore with nude patent pumps and it was a hit.  I would totally consider buying this dress.

Stand out dress! This dress was very comfortable and I received many compliments on the vibrant pink color.  The only con was that the dress was a little baggy in my midsection which would have been better if it was more "form" fitting.  

Overall, great dress and perfect for a wedding in the summer!

It was a baby shower for my sister and having the perfect pink dress added the perfect touch! The dress was beautiful but if I had bought it rather than rented it I would have taken it in. I would normally wear a size 10 but the bust was a BIT snug so had to go with the 12. Although it was a little loose fitting for this reason, it also made it comfortable and I received many compliments on it! Overall size was true to fit and I would recommend it.

Adorable and conservative The dress has a beautiful back with a ribbon tie, so you can wear a size up or down, depending on how you want it to fit.  Minimizes bust with high neckline.  I'd recommend wearing a pink bra, just in case the lace shoulders don't match up.

youthful and playful gorgeous in the pictures, but didn't notice the big bow in the back. it makes this look very young. also my sleeves were a little worn out so they were not as tight fitting as I would have liked them to be.

I received so many compliments on this dress. The only place this dress was a little tight was in the arms.  I am only 5'3" so the length was great for me, I could see how it would be short on a taller person though!

The dress was a hit! I wore it to a bridal shower, and I got so many compliments on it.  I am in between a size 4 and 6, and because it doesn't zip all the way up in the back past the bust area,  I was able to pull off the 4 comfortably.  The dress is a little short but so am I, so it looked ok.  I don't know if you beautiful, leggy, tall ladies should wear it unless you are okay with a really short dress!  But the color was fantastic, and I really enjoyed wearing it.
What made this event amazing was being able to wear such an amazing dress at an amazing price!!   This dress is amazing!! Loved everything about it! Great Length, perfect style, and classy yet sexy!!

Loved this dress!! This was the perfect summer dress for a wedding. I received so many compliments from family and strangers walking down the street. It was very comfortable, no adjustments necessary. The pockets were so cute too! I would definitely wear this again.
loved it and received so many compliments! It was every so slightly tight around the shoulders, but that was my own fault :)  It was a fantastic dress and the skirt had pockets!

I wore this to a Western Themed Charity Event. I got lots of compliments & felt like a million bucks It fit true to size, was very flattering, could easily be dressed up or down. 
It ran a little tight through the chest. I probably would have worn the 0 if it had been a little looser up top.
The pockets were super handy.
This is a dress that I would love to own.
Beautiful fit and color! Fits perfect! I wore this to a rehearsal dinner and got so many compliments. I wanted to keep it afterwards!

LOVE! Amazing color- so vibrant. The fit is very flattering. I was 10 weeks pregnant at the time that I wore this and it covered my mini bump perfectly. I got so many compliments on this little number
Fun dress for spring/summer wedding! Lovely dress - fit a little big in the chest area, but other than that, really enjoyed wearing it.
Love it. Perfect Everything was great. Wore to a daytime wedding and got many compliments. Stood out and fit just perfect.
Super flattering The smaller size fit well. I didn't wear a bra but didn't really need one. Only downside was that I wasn't the only girl in that dress at the wedding

Perfect dress for a bridal shower! I rented a 4 and 6 for a bridal shower and ended up wearing the 4, although it was on the shorter side. I got a ton of compliments! It was very comfortable and the color was perfect for a spring event. I do recommend!

Pretty! I liked this dress for the most part.  It was pretty shirt when I was sitting down.  I have a more athletic butt and thighs and the bottom of the dress was a little restrictive in the dancing but overall a nice dress.

Everyone loved the dress and it made me feel do beautiful.  It fits really tight in the chest area so I went up a size. I'm a petite person but the length was perfect! I felt really beautiful and loved every moment wearing it! #glamorous

Perfect dress The other reviews were right that this is a great dress. I got so many compliments throughout the night. I was worried that this dress would be too summery for a late fall wedding but it wasn't. the pockets were great too.
LOVED this dress! This dress was perfect for a fall wedding.  I got so many compliments!

Wore this to a cousin's wedding.  It was the perfect blend of summery and fancy. Fit was true to size.  I opted to go for the 14 rather than the 12 because it was a tad longer and looser and I wanted to be able to sit and move.  It had little snaps to hold a bra strap in place but the straps were thick enough that they didnt show anyway.  I'm a little thicker in the middle and this dress hid everything I wanted it to.  My only complaint was that when i sat, it really rode up and the lining came down past the lace.  Overall, it was beautiful and I wish I could keep it!

Gorgeous Day, beautiful dress, lots of champagne!  I love this dress!  Fit true to size, it flattered despite the fact I haven't seen a gym in over a year, and made me feel great for a beautiful, outdoor spring wedding.  I can't wait to rent it again!
Rtr allowed me to have a beautiful dress for a beautiful occasion. Fit great, and had room to move. The perfect dress for the occasion.

Loved the lacey detail and neckline.   Felt very pretty for a summer wedding! What a beautiful dress.  It has pockets which is always fun!  I rented 2 similar dresses - hoping one would work.  I loved them both - ended up wearing this one to the afternoon wedding, and the other to the evening reception.  I am 5'3" and this is a shorter dress so was able to show off more leg which made me feel taller.  Wore a neutral colored heel so as not to take away from the dress.

Classy, comfortable dress for a summer wedding This was a perfect dress for a summer wedding. The color popped beautifully and garnered a bunch of compliments. It was classy - not too tight, and knee length on me as I'm 5-1. It felt great all evening and I was able to dance comfortably. Highly recommended!

Flattering, comfortable, and has pockets! I'm usually a 4 in vanity sizing and 6 in "real" sizing, but both dresses ran slightly large on me, even in the chest area. The 4 was still wearable but unfortunately I realized last minute that I shouldn't wear red to a Chinese wedding, so the dress went to waste :(

Tons of compliments and very flattering! I wore this for a 4th of July wedding and think it was perfect! It hugged at the waist which made it more flattering. It's a little short, so I had to be careful when I sat down. The zipper is very fragile so I would definitely be careful. Overall a great first RTR experience!

Perfect dress for a fun wedding!  I loved this dress and the color! There was no stretch to this dress so busty girls beware. The 6 was still super snug in the chest area but not to the point where it was uncomfortable. The length was perfect, not too short or too long.
LOVE IT! LOVE THIS DRESS!  It has pockets which, in my book, makes a dress awesome!  Got lots of complements! It was also the perfect shade of red, because it wasn't in your face red!

I felt so great in this dress!  This dress was very true to size. I'm typically a size 4 - it fit perfectly. It showed a bit more of the chest area than I thought it would, but was still a very classy look! The length was perfect and I loved how the skirt flared a little (to hide a lot of the stomach area). I have small shoulders and often have trouble with the top part of dresses but this dress was perfect. I wish I could buy it, I felt so beautiful and comfortable all night long!! I would definitely rent it again, I received a lot of compliments.

My husband loved this dress!  I could have worn a size 12 but the condition of the dress wasn't as nice as the 14. The RTR customer service people were amazing they said they would ship me new dress or would credit me. The dress is a beautiful color and SO comfortable. You can wear a regular bra with it which is awesome. The only thing that was a slight con is when you sit it is pretty short but it wasn't a make or break situation. Love this dress I would rent it again!

Being the only one in red made me stand out in the best way! This dress was for an October wedding reception in Arizona. The dress is a lovely red with orange-ish undertones that worked well with my olive complexion. The nude color under the red lace is what makes the dress special.
I waited until the last minute to order this rental which meant I was limited on dresses I liked and sizes. I only received the size 14 and it was a little large on me but not too big that would have made it unwearable. However, I think a size 12 would have suited me well. Enough room around the rib cage, bust and hips for a very curvy girl.
So easy to wear a normal bra, pair it with almost any strap heel, and either statement earring or a necklace.

Cute and Sassy I was looking for a rehearsal dinner dress to our casual soiree.  My fiance at the time wore jeans and a button up and our venue was a casual Italian restaurant, so I too wanted to dress a bit casual, but still girlie and a little dressed up.  This was a good dress for the occasion.  I'm normally a size 2, but by the time I wore this dress, I was probably more like a 0, so I got a second size because I wasn't sure, and the 0 fit better.  It's fitted at the top, but roomy in the skirt.  The 0 came up in length as well, so it felt much smaller than the 2.  It came out great in photos!

Beautiful & well constructed Unfortunately, this dress was too large for me. I am very petite with a moderate sized chest for my frame. The length was perfect, but the waist and bust were too large. I almost didn't wear it and forfeit the rental all together because I was unhappy with how large it was. I ended up wearing it, though. Cute dress, just too big.

this was the most amazing dress tthe fit was great the cut was great and i am 5'2" and that was great too! It was so flattering and everyone complemented the dress. The color stands out in a sea full of black. This is a MUST RENT!

compliments and pockets! I wore this dress to a wedding and got so many compliments all night. My backup size had a problem with the seam, but RTR was willing to overnight me a replacement if the other size didn't work (luckily it did).  FYI, the dress is a little short. But who doesn't love pockets?

Pop of color, true to size but too short for my long legs Loved the bright color of this dress and wanted to love the style, but it was just too short for my long legs and didn't flatter my small chest. I rented it as back-up to my first choice Shoshanna dress because my first choice wasn't available in my back-up size. I found that Shoshanna dresses run pretty true to size and opted to wear a similar style, which I LOVED (Watermelon Lace Dress)

I loved this dress! This was a perfect dress for my outdoor, evening work party.  It even had pockets which was great for my phone and lipstick.  Super color, eye catching, great cut, perfect in every way.

had so much fun at cousin's wedding in this dress!
 beautiful poppy lace with neutral underlay! very comfortable to dance in. im a 32B and i thought the size 0 top was still a bit loose, but overall very easy to wear!
Loved this dress, I got tons of compliments and it was super comfortable to dance the night away in. The dress fit true to size.

Loved the color and the lace! The color is gorgeous. It' s a little on the shorter side when you sit down, but not terrible. Easy to move in, photographs well, and the pockets are the best! The zipper seemed to get stuck, despite it not being a size issue. Overall, was really happy with this dress. Would definitely recommend!

Arrived on time!
 Loved the color of the dress, perfect for a 4th of July wedding. Received many compliments. Ordered the 4 and 6 but didn't even need to try the 6 on, the 4 was loose. Great dress unless you want something more fitted.

I wore this for my grad ceremony for my bachelor's degree. It was a great color to stand out in! The lace was beautiful. However the fit was a bit tight around the chest and midsection. The neckline was lower than I expected so I compensated with beige tank under. It was an appropriate dress to be around family and was very elegant as well.

I wore this to my sisters rehearsal dinner. I needed something special! Only the 6 was available (I probably would have ordered an 8 as well for backup) but I thought, what the heck, let'e hope the 6 works! It fit perfectly. I absolutely loved it. I didn't have to wear a bra with it because it was so nicely made. The length was perfect on my 5'4" frame. It was such a flattering fit. I wanted to keep it, ha!! love love LOVE.

This was better than my first rental because I absolutely loved the dress and it had a better fit. Both the 0 and the 2 fit me the exact same on the top half. The 0 fit overall but I liked the way the 2 rested/fell in the back, so I chose to wear that one A size 4 definitely would have been too big.  I accessorized with gold jewelry and shoes. This dress is beautiful and I really didn't want to return it!

Wore this for my fiancé's Christmas party, everyone loved it! Got tons of compliments on this amazing red lace dress. I was also impressed that it had pockets! I wore it with strappy nude sandal-pumps and got tons of compliments. Gorgeous for any occasion!
Great dress for a bachelorette party! Fit very well and flattering color! Would rent again.
Perfect dress for a fun party! The fit was great.  I am a 32 DDD, so i was a little worried about the fit up top, but it was awesome.
The color made me stand out on my birthday. The dress fit nicely.  The color was beautiful especially if you want to stand out for a special occasion.
Loved! Fit great even with a larger bust. Great because can wear with a regular bra.
Beautiful fit and color. Snug through bust but comfortable. Beautiful dress. Pro- can wear any bra

This dress fit great and was so comfortable! I got so many compliments on it.  The color was beautiful, and the dress fit great. I'm large busted and had no problems fitting into the top. Great length for a 5'5 person.

Fun dress for a wedding! I loved this dress! I ordered the 6 and ended up wearing the 4 as it was a bit more form fitting. The smaller size was a bit tight in the bust area but otherwise perfect. I got a lot of compliments on the color and it was comfortable to wear and dance in all night. Bonus? It has pockets! This was my 2nd weekend in a row in a RTR dress and I can't speak highly enough of the service!
Beautiful dress...loved the color Great dress. Got a lot if compliments. Would rent again...love that it comes in other colors, too.
anniversary dinner with my husband :-) Beautiful color and LOVED the lace...received so many compliments!

Simple and cute.  This was my backup dress, but I ended up wearing it since the other didn't work out. It was simple and easy. The lace on mine did seem a little old and worn, and I had to pick off a lot of pills on the fabric. I guess it's just been rented a  lot. The neckline was really flattering and the waist gave the dress a great shape. This dress was also very light and comfortable. All this made it super simple to put on and go.
Great date dress. Super pretty dress.  Shows a lot of cleavage which my date liked :).

Overall comfortable and pretty My dresses (sizes 4 & 6) arrived in a RTR garment bag. What a GREAT idea RTR! I hope you stop using boxes all together soon!

The dress was lovely although a little too big around the waist/hip area but the bust fit perfectly. The material under the armpit area dug into my skin a little but it wasn't too bothersome. The size 6 was big overall and I imagine the 2 would have been too snug. Also, I didn't realize the dress had pockets until half way through the night! Overall the dress could have fit better but it worked and was mostly comfortable.

Great color for a holiday party! I am normally a size 10 but I read other reviews that said the dress had no "give" (which is true) and is a bit tight in the bust. Well, I am a 38DDD and can say that I am glad I ordered the backup size because it felt so much more comfortable to go up a size. I love the color of this dress and the pockets!
I loved this dress!!! I didn't want to return it The puff in front my stomach was a little too big, I had to keep holding it down on the side for photos

Dress was a great fit and was comfortable enough to dance the night away in! First time using RTR, and it was a great experience! The dress fits pretty true to size although I probably could've worn the dress in a size 4 for a slightly better fit.  Beautiful color and I felt very pretty in the dress. Was perfect for the pre-Derby charity event that I attended!

The material is gorgeous and if I could have just remade the bottom, it would be perfect!  The extra pleating at the hips made the material stick out on my already big hips. It was also so short, wouldn't be acceptable sitting down.
N/A Fits true to size. The dress is more red than the red-orange that shows up on the RTR website, which was exactly what I was looking for!

Beautiful color The color and lace details were beautiful. I'm sad I didn't get a better picture of the dress. Not a wow dress but I definitely got compliments. I wore a size 6 and it fit great in the bust area. It was a bit big in the stomach and skirt area when standing but tight and short when sitting. I'm glad I tested the sizes sitting like others recommended. Overall I felt very pretty in this dress and happy, once again, with my rental.

Pretty Color, but too short I am familiar with the designer and loved the silhouette, color, etc...Unfortunately, the dress was simply too short on me.  I am 5'8" and it was border line inappropriate when I sat down.  This would probably be a perfect option for anyone 5'6" and under though!

Great dress I wore this to a rehearsal dinner, and I was constantly getting compliments from everyone. I'm a 32 DD, and from the comments about ordering up for your chest, I thought I was going to need a size 10. I usually wear 8/10, and the 8 was even a little loose at the top. Pair the dress with a nice skinny belt to cinch in the waist. Great dress overall. Oh and of course the pockets were a wonderful touch.
It was very comfortable and the color was great!  perfect length and fit was true to size

Loved this dress, it was so comfortable and made me feel beautiful! Great fit, however, it's a little small in the chest area, I couldn't wear a bra with it but the fabric is sturdy enought that I didn't need to. I wear a 34B so if you're much bigger than that you'll probably need to go up a size.

Great dress I wish I owned this.  The fit is perfect, the construction is thoughtful, and hey, it's got pockets!  I wore this 4 months after having a baby and people didn't believe I'd had a kid.  SO flattering.

Very flattering! This dress really cinches your waist and is simple and classic. I have a cheaper dress that is similar but this blows it out of the water. The fabric is really nice and I got tons of compliments!
A fun night in a lovely dress.  High waist leads to flattering silhouette for those with a less than a flat stomach. Straps have a tendency to fall down and twist.

I got tons of compliments on this dress and felt great in it! This dress is great for a fall wedding! It is very flattering and I got tons of compliments on it. I'm usually between a 6 and an 8 so I ordered a 6 and got an 8 as my backup. The top is designed to be very fitted so although the 6 fit, I felt uncomfortable with how tight it was and ended up going with the 8 which looked and felt much better. Because I have a fuller bust, I was nervous when I ordered it that the low cut would show too much cleavage but that was not the case at all. Definitely rent this dress!

Disappointed I have been wanting to wear this dress forever, but the material is a bit too shiny and the dress is a bit too long. Hit right above my knee. That said, the top is flattering and I loved the detailing and thickness of the material.
cute formal black dress. easily dress it up with some jewels. I'm 6'0 so the dress was a little short on me. The fabric was trench coat-like. Would look good on women with small bust size.

Perfect for NYE in NYC! This is the first dress I rented from this site and it was amazing! The dresses were waiting for me on my porch 2 days ahead of time and the size 4 fit perfectly! I paired it with a necklace I found in Macy's and thought it looked great.  I would highly recommend this dress for anyone with a pear or hourglass shape because of how well it shows off the natural waist.  I will say though, the bust was a little snug but was not uncomfortable.

Cute and effortless I liked this dress. I usually would never go for a dress cut in this style (flared skirt), but I decided to give it a try. The only warning I have is that if you have any kind of bust you may want to order the size up. I am usually a true 4 and my chest did not fit into the 4 properly. My chest is not that large, I am a small C, and sometimes B. The 6 fit fine in the chest but I felt that the skirt area was a bit too big for my taste. If I could have combined the 6 top with the 4 bottom it would have been perfect. Also I am 5'9" and I was worried about the length, but it actually was a tasteful length even with 4 inch heals, so that was a positive. Overall I would recommend this dress to someone who has a smaller chest.

great basic dress I ordered a 6 & 8. I ended up wearing the 6 because the straps on the 8 were way too long, and they were only a little loose on the 6. The bodice part of the 8 was more comfortable; the 6 was snug up top but wear-able. The length on both sizes was fine. The fabric is heavy; I wouldn't want to wear this in the middle of summer. The pockets were a great touch. I'm not giving this dress 5 stars because of the strap length, but overall, I really enjoyed wearing this dress!

This is a perfect dress for dancing! This was a beautiful dress - LOVED it. It fit like a glove and I felt like a queen. I received so many compliments!The fabric was a little more stiff than I expected, but still very comfortable.

Beautiful dress! This dress makes you feel amazing.  It emphasizes all the good and hides the bad.  I highly recommend for any event.  I received so many compliments from both girls and guys!  The fit is perfect, but might be tight in the bust if you are a bit bigger there.  Oh, and it has pockets!

Rented this dress for a homecoming dance, but I was unable to wear it! The dress was more casual than I thought it would be. It has a very structured top with ribing around the bust, and it did not fit there. I am 36D-DD and it would not zip at the top. I got both a 6 and 8 and neither fit, so I ended up sending it back (which was fortunately a very simple process)! If it had fit I'm not sure if I would have worn it because it was a bit casual. More navy than black and probably better for an event like a birthday or a date not a semi-formal dance! Overall great experience with RTR even though I did not wear the dress!

Loved this dress for homecoming!! Super comfortable! The dress fit like a glove and was made from high quality fabric! It wasn't too short or too long, the straps were just a tad loose and would fall down every so often!

This is one of the best dresses I've ever worn! The dress fit me perfectly, I am very short but the straps still weren't too long like many reviews said. I thought it looked kind of velvety in the pictures, but its actually a very nice thick material that feels waterproof. It looks black sometimes, but it is definitely blue in the light. It is not velvety at all, but it is shiny. The pockets are great! They fit an iPhone 5 and even a bulky wallet, however the wallet was visible from the side. It is a bit low cut in the bust but not enough to make me feel uncomfortable. I wore it with short black shiny heels, a silver bracelet and necklace, red lipstick, and an updo. It doesn't twirl around well, but it also doesn't blow up in the wind. I would buy it if I could!

This dress -- it has pockets! -- is the dark navy color of a teal dress I'd worn before. Perfect. This fit in the waist and is free in the hips but I'm only a 32C and it gave me substantial cleavage. I looked great (and you will too!) but for anyone with a bigger bust or who wants a more modest look, consider sizing up.

I was very happy with this dress! Sexy fit w/ pockets! Boobalicious! This dress was great because it accentuated my bust, downplayed my hips and made my waist look tiny. I felt cute and flirty! I was a little worried about the length being too long (I'm only 5'2" and wear a size 8), but it was fine - hit just above the knee. My husband thought I looked very "Pin Up," which I thought was a great compliment.
perfectly paired dress with necklace! runs large, hit just above knee- looked great!

This dress was a hit! It was perfect for the winter wedding I attended!  I wish I could have kept it! I am normally a size 6 and it fit like a glove, I didn't even bother trying on the 4. The material is thick enough that I was able to get away without wearing a bra and no one even knew. I felt so chic and my fiance loved it! The dress is simple yet classy and can be paired with shiny, bright accessories!

Loved the dress! Did the Stylist Surprise and they sent some cute earrings to go with. Rented the 2 and 4 -- both fit, but went with the 4 because although it was a little large in the bust, it felt like the skirt had a little bit more material around the waist.  The fabric is thick and wrinkle-resistant.

Very flattering! This was my backup dress, which I wore to a summer wedding.  I only ordered the size 4, which was very snug and required a helper to zip up!  I would recommend sizing up, especially for those with a larger bust.  The combination of the tight waist and flared out bottom is lovely.

Great dress for a black tie optional wedding!  Wore this to a BTO October wedding and was so happy with the dress. The bodice is very fitted but didn't make me feel uncomfortable, and was balanced out by the full skirt. The material is thick but has some stretch, and looks more like a charcoal grey than it does navy. I wasn't able to/didn't need to wear a bra with the dress which was great, and the pockets gave me somewhere to put my hands in pictures so i wasn't always hand-on-hip girl in every photo. Great dress!

Flirt neckline and full skirt! I really like the style of the dress, but the fit wasn't great on me.  It nips in at the waist and I'm pretty straight down w/o a pronounced waist so it was tighter in the waist than I would have liked.  I typically wear a 2, but got 4 as backup size.  I really couldn't tell a difference in the two sizes but ended up wearing the 4 hoping it would give me a little more room!  Also, if you've got a full bust, you probably wont be able to wear a bra... and if you do, definitely wear black.  On the right body type I think this dress would be amazing!

I felt beautiful, classy, and comfortable all night long. The fabric of the dress is thick and very supportive from the waist up. I was happy with the length, which hits mid-thigh and the color is a very dark navy even though it looks black. This neckline is extremely flattering, even for smaller busted ladies like myself! My favorite part of this dress is the small pleating on the waist, which creates lovely waves in the skirt below.

Underwhelmed The dress was nice, but nothing special. If I found it in a store for the price I rented it I probably wouldn't have purchased it. I typically wear a 4, but because reviews said it ran small I got a back up of a 6, and I'm happy I did. I guess I have broad ribs, because I couldn't zip up the 4 all the way. The 6 however, was fairly loose at the top. I definitely needed to wear a bra because I had very little support, despite typically filling out tops because I'm a C/D cup.
I didn't have a bad experience, but I don't know if I will use Rent the Runway again, and certainly not this designer.

My boyfriend could not stop saying how great this dress looked!  I absolutely love this dress. It fit so well and was so comfortable. I was worried about cleavage but with a strapless bra it was perfect. The material is thick and a really dark blue, making it look black. It has a full skirt and pockets, which I love. I definitely did not want to send this one back!

Everything I had hoped for! :) I rented this dress for my birthday party, which consisted of dinner at a relatively fancy restaurant and bar hopping / dancing. It was absolutely perfect! It was formal enough for the restaurant, but flirty and fun enough for the actual partying. The material is great and has a lot of give to it! It fit like a dream! It accentuated all the right spots and hid any problem areas. I am so in love with this dress, just like I knew that I would be! :)

The confidence boost from knowing you look good always makes it a good night! They even sent a cute NYE hat with my purchase! I wore this to a NYE party and got tons of complements! The fabric was a bit unusual it was slick to the touch but it showed well in photos. This dress does great things for your body. Mine was a little tight since they were out of a 2 i had to squeeze into a 0 but since it was new years i didn't mind it being a little more leg and cleavage ;) I definitely recommend this look. since the color is a simple dark navy you can do a lot of fun things with jewelry and shoes.
Perfectly Flirty Adorable and flirty, it was supportive enough to wear without a bra as well!

This dress is gorgeous and incredibly flattering! I received so many compliments.  Perfect fit. I have a small bust, but this dress definitely enhanced it. I'm slightly on the tall side, and yet I found the length to be great - not too short.

Perfect mix of classy and flirty! Loved wearing this dress! It looks black but is actually dark navy. It is structured/fitted in the bust and waist and would be very revealing on someone with bigger than a C cup. I have a short torso and it did bunch up a bit in the middle, but overall was a great fit and very fun to wear for a bachelorette party.

Extremely flattering! I love love love this dress!  The fabric is thick and forgiving and the cut is extremely flattering.  The details on the bust/waist make you look tiny.  The straps were a bit long for my shorter body, which gave me a little bit more cleavage than I'm comfortable with, but it wasn't too bad.  This dress is a perfect way to showcase "the girls" and downplay your hips and butt.  I wore this with a soft little red cardigan and red heels for Valentine's Day.  Very comfortable!  I'd recommend this dress to anyone.

Love it! This dress is so much cuter than it looks in the picture. I loved it. The top gave a bit more cleavage than I needed, though I would rent it again. The skirt is very flattering and the fabric is nice and thick. It's very comfortable and since I filled it out on top I didn't have any problem with the strap length.

An oddly sized dress. I was very excited to wear this dress to a friend's winter wedding. The material was thick enough, but the sizing was very strange. The 4 was far too small in the bust, but fit nicely everywhere else. I tried on the 6, which was enormous in the chest and the straps were very long. RTR did not include fashion tape with this rental, so I made do on by own, but it was a very disappointing rental.

The compliments and the dream fit I loved this dress. I got so many compliments from both men and women!  I love the retro fit especially the sweetheart neckline and the way it cinches you at the waist. I felt absolutely great in this dress! The fabric is thick_perfect for a fall wedding and the flared skirt is great for dancing. I felt sexy and classy all at once. 

I wore a size 4 and it was a bit tight on me around the ribcage (but that may be because I have a wider ribcage). The color is a deep navy blue. It looks almost black in person, but in general photographs in looks navy.

L
The way the dress flowed on the dance floor. It was sexy but modest, which was perfect for a wedding. It hit above the knee for me, and the neckline wasn't too scandalous.

Playful dress, beautiful material. I rented this dress for my engagement photo shoot. The cut of this dress and the pockets make it very playful. The color (a deep navy) is subdued but photographs beautifully and allows you to have fun accessorizing. I am typically a true size 2 in dresses, and I did find that the top portion of this dress was a tad tight. Bustier girls may need to size up.

Flirty curve making dress! The dress was a beautiful dark navy blue with a very tight top but a very forgiving middle/bottom. The tightness of the top made me wish I hadn't worn a bra as I was left with some uncomfortable indentations, so the top is small enough that you can bra-less and still look phenomenal. This dress really does lift your bust and bring in your waist to show off beautiful curves, while also allowing you to eat and not feel like you can't enjoy yourself. Also... pockets. Functional, good looking, pockets <3

VERY flattering-- waist not dinner-friendly   Wore this to an October wedding, and it looked great! Was a little concerned with how low-cut the bust line was, but a little fashion tape helped.  Waist was tight (couldn't fit a strapless bra in it), and I could see a larger-busted woman having difficultly with the top, but over all I liked the dress and wore it.

Great dress!     
 Runs small.   Wore a 10 but could have done a 12 I think.   My other dress this weekend was a 6!   Straps were super long and I had to shorten them.   Thick and luxurious material.

loved it! so lady like and flattering Hugs in all the right places! had so many compliments on the dress - it's a beautiful navy color you can dress it up or down... lovely! I would rent it again, or buy it!
Amazing dress! Very flattering. Got a ton of compliments I usually wear a 4 in dresses, but this ran small on top

Wanted to keep it! I rented both the 2 and the 4, expecting to wear the 2 as that is my normal size. I couldn't tell much difference in the two sizes, except the 2 was smaller in the boobs and about an inch shorter. They were both just as fitted in the waist. The boob area was pretty small, I was unable to wear any type of bra (which was fine because the fabric is thick), and tried to push the girls down as much as possible. For that reason I went with the 4. For a smaller chested girl it's probably great for creating some cleavage. The fabric is gorgeous & feels wonderful! It was perfect for dancing in all night and very comfortable. The navy was beautiful, I'd love to rent the dress in one of the other colors sometime. I included 3 pictures so its hopefully possible to see the dress details.

Perfect for a night out! I wore this dress to my best friend's bachelorette party. It's very sexy without being uncomfortable or difficult to wear (not too short or tight, etc). I got lots of compliments. Also, the pockets came in handy! I wish RTR specified whether or not dresses have pockets, bc it's a detail I love.

My RTR moments are always unforgettable because I look like a million bucks without having to pay a million bucks. I wore this dress to the Philly in Style event and received many compliments.  I was the most excited about the pockets because I could carry around my phone and lip gloss without anyone knowing.  The dress runs small because the 4 was tight and I typically wear between a 2 and a 4.

Adorable and flattering I loved wearing this dress. It is a stretchy material and it is very comfortable. I usually wear a 4 but opted for the 2 because the top was a little loose for me. The skirt is full so it fit my hips perfectly. A little cleavage barring but my husband had no problem with that. I would love to buy this dress.

Beautiful dress! I loved the sweetheart neckline, and how the dress flairs out at the bottom.  It was very fun!  The fabric is very thick and doesn't' have as much stretch as I needed at the bust.  I had to wear it without a bra, but it is lined very well and worked out just fine.
Super cute,  blue and black pattern was unexpected I did not realize it was like a paisley pattern. Very comfortable. Cute style but I felt too cute in it. I went for a little sexier of a look.

You will receive so many compliments in this dress! The fit was true to size. I am a 36C and usually wear a medium dress size. The 6 fit my body perfectly. The cut and fit were sexy but in a very classy way. I wore gold jewelry; however, this dress could easily be paired with coral or another bright color to add more pop to your outfit. I felt so beautiful in this dress that I didn't want to take it off! :)

Darling ress This dress is darling! Super flattering & comfortable. RTR is wonderful. This process was so easy & it was really fun to have a new dress that doesn't end up hanging in my closet never to be seen again. This dress is the perfect summer wedding or party dress!

Fit like a glove! There wasn't a whole lot of give in this dress but the 2 fit me perfectly. Came up to a good length for a Sweet 16 and didn't show too much on top, but was still super fun. Good price, good fit. Would definitely rent again!

- I rented this dress for my work Christmas party. I was so happy with the style and fit! It was sexy, but I didn't feel uncomfortable wearing it to a work party. I know the dress is navy, but I still wore black heels. Maybe because of the fabric and because I was in a dark restaurant... I think the color could go either way.
easy and multi dress for the weekend! YEAH!  I liked wearing this dress, it was very girly and fun! Good SOLID black Dress!

Will rent again! So flattering! I've never worn a 6 in my life BUT-while the 4 fit fine it was tight around the ribcage and my boobs were a little squished-so the 6 was perfect-fit like a glove!!!!! So classy and the pockets are fantastic!

Beautiful dress.  Really feminine.  Makes you feel like a princess. Fit amazingly well.  The dress has pockets which is a plus! I think the straps were a bit too long though and there's no way to adjust--in order to maintain the right cleavage I had to stand very tall and proper 24/7 or else the straps would slide down and my bust wouldn't achieve the right look.

Perfect for a wedding - classy, cute, and fun! The fabric was a little shinier than I had originally imagined, but not in a negative way.  It made the dress more formal-esque.  Great fit.  Beautiful dress, I wish i could have kept it!

This dress was really flattering and very comfortable. Wonderful dress to dance in! I am a true size 6 so I ordered the 6 and 8 sizes. Thank god I did bc the 8 barely zipped and this line def runs small. The 6 fit like a 4 and the 8 fit like a small 6. Overall the dress is stunning on and its a beautiful navy color and basically goes with any type of accessory. I wore a chunky diamond necklace and sparkling shoes. The whole outfit was a real hit.

Great fit and it has pockets! I wore this dress to a beautiful garden wedding and it was just enough formal and fun. It fits great on the top and the small straps made it perfectly comfortable to dance in. The pockets are a fun added touch and its not too short either. I loved wearing it! For a semi-formal event I definitely recommend this dress!

My Go-To Dress I love this dress and have actually rented it a few times now because it just works perfectly.  I'm more of a pear shape with a tiny top, so it works perfectly to show off my top, push up the girls and then it flairs perfectly so that it never touches the hips.  I added a chunky gold necklace and it can be dressed up for a formal party or wedding.

Definitely cute... just not for bigger chests! I actually did not end up wearing this dress bc my boobs (34DD) were literally popping out of the top. That being said, I think this dress would be so cute if I was a cup size smaller... 
Great material, color and cute- such a fun party dress!

This was the first time I used RTR.  It was a fantastic experience. The dress fit beautiful, very true to size.  The color is fantastic.  I was attending my son's fiancee's bridal shower and it was a classic and not too young (I am 53).  I wanted to try RTR before I got something for the wedding.  I will definitely look on RTR for a dress for the wedding.  Thank you for making it easy to look good.
Beautiful Color! Loved this dress, hides tummy area. Runs pretty big though, so orders second size down.

The color is gorgeous This was the second dress I got for NYE, the first one just didn't fit well. The color is so pretty and flattering. I got so many compliments on it! It is a little baggy around the waist but I think that is the style of the dress-- it's not a skin tight fit (which is great if you plan on eating! haha)

Amazing Sorry that I don't have a photo- but this dress was awesome!  I will totally be renting this again, and again, and again!  This is my first lace overlay, and I have no idea what the heck took me so long to rent!  No need for Spanx, although it is very short, so I would recommend wearing full underwear.  So comfortable, stretchy and beautiful color.  Highly recommend!

Perfect for a morning wedding! I had rented this exact dress before in pink, and couldn't resist this color for a morning wedding. It was perfect, and the photographer actually asked me to hold things in front of my stomach so she could use the dress as a colorful background (which I was happy to do - I think it's awesome too). The length is pretty short if you're tall like me, but not unmanageable. I highly recommend this one.

Pure perfection! This was my second time renting this stunning dress. I wore this dress to a charity event. The color was vibrant and lace made it elegant. The fit is pretty spot on. I paired this dress with nude heels and received compliments all night. I did not want to return it!

I wore this dress for my son's baptism and it was perfect for the occasion! This dress was comfortable and very flattering.  It's a bit short so I wore the size 8 to give me a little more length.  The color is beautiful and looked great with coral jewelry.  I'd highly recommend this dress for a daytime event or wedding.

Beautifully made dress that is flattering!  I wore this dress for an 80th birthday party with family and family portraits. It fit well and true to size. It was a great length even with high wedges. I wore it for several hours and it was very comfortable. I receive many compliments on the color. It fits like a shift dress. Lovely look! I would recommend this dress to any of my friends!

I received tons of compliments all night long! Fabulous dress! Very comfy and lightweight, perfect for a summer wedding. The color is gorgeous. It tends to run a little big, I usually wear a 6, with 4 as my backup. The day before it was to be delivered I received a call from RTR saying the six was returned damaged. The rep told me they would still send the four along with another dress in my two sizes, they were so accommodating!  I needed up wearing the 4 in my original choice. It is a short dress so if you love your legs then this is the dress for you!
The color is great and the lace is beautiful..such a pretty dress! No complaints..great dress!

Casual cocktail dress This dress runs a little small so I recommend ordering a size up.  I usually wear a 6 and I ended up wearing the 8.  The material is a little thinner than I expected and tends to hug the body.  Overall this is a nice cocktail dress. Due to the material, I recommend wearing it to a more casual event.

So many compliments. Love this dress. I love this dress! The color is amazing and the dress is so comfortable. It seemed to run a bit large. I am 5'2 and this dress was pretty short on me. It was wearable, I just had to be cautious when  I bent over or sat down. Over all I love this dress and will rent it again!

Was so happy I could just rent a dress and not worry about the hassle of trying to find something! I wore the size 4, it seemed at first the arms were going to be tight at first but when I lined up the seams correctly it was perfect! It looked great without the belt as well, yet it also helped add a little shape to my figure. I was worried this would be too hot to wear during the summertime in the Midwest but it was not! I wasn't uncomfortable, too hot, or anything! I am glad I had two different dress size options it definitely helped to make my decision knowing at least one should fit!
So many compliments!  Love love love this dress! Perfect fit! Highly recommended!

Perfect style and color for brunch I had mixed feelings about this dress. It was a beautiful color for an early spring brunch party and it was comfortable enough to be worn all day. I got a ton of compliments! Many of the reviews said that the dress ran big, and I would say "it's complicated." The dress has a nude slip that is separate. The slip is stretchy and clings to your curves. I was able to wear the smaller backup size (size 6) slip. When it came to putting on the size 6 dress portion, I was not even able to put it over my head and get my arms through. There is NO stretch and no zipper- you have to put it on over your head. I have broad shoulders and athletic/muscular arms, so I had to wear the size 8 dress. Once I had it on, it did look big. I would not recommend this for curvy women or women with muscular arms.

Perfect Despite being 16 weeks pregnant, found this beautiful, fun dress for my birthday dinner. Gorgeous color and lace. Comfortable & sexy. Love that RTR now has a bump friendly option in body type when looking for a dress. Wore my typical size 2 despite being pregnant.

Fantastic dress! Great color, fit, and style. Runs large. The color of is this dress is fantastic both in person and in pictures. It's definitely eye catching and I received a ton of compliments. The dress is a shift dress, so it doesn't hug the body very much. I would definitely recommend going a size lower for a better fit. I am usually a 4 but opted for the size 2. It still wasn't tight (room in the stomach area - always a plus!) and was incredibly comfortable throughout the whole night of dancing. I wouldn't recommend this dress for someone tall. I am 5'3'' and found that the length was perfect when standing straight but a bit short when sitting. Overall, this has been my favorite Rent the Runway experience and I will definitely be renting this same dress again.

Great for a Shower This dress fit true to size.  The 4 fit me, but I decided to go with the 6, which was a little but more comfortable.  At 5'1" the length was perfect, although a tad short when sitting.

This was my first RTR dress and I was so happy with it! Came right on time and fit like a charm! Since it's a shift dress it's not form fitting in the middle, which I knew going in. I thought it was just a tad too loose for my liking and wanted a defined waist so I added a gold glittery belt and it worked perfectly! Even without a belt the dress is gorgeous! I would definitely recommend this dress to anyone!
