Looked very worn. I rented this dress for an April wedding. While it is a beautiful dress, you could definitely tell it had been worn a lot. There were several pulls and loose strings. That is probably due in large part to the material. I still got lots of compliments but my overall opinion was that it looked very worn.
Loved it! It ran large, I usually wear a 10 or 12, but the 8 was perfect.  It's a gorgeous dress.  I wore it for a baby shower I hosted.  It was perfect.

Beautiful color, beautiful dress! I wore this to a nice dinner date. The color is amazing! I found the fit to be true to size. It was a little short when sitting down but otherwise a perfect fit and a perfect dress for the night. I would rent this again.
The color and lace design of this dress  Not as form fitting as I would have liked as it was baggy in some areas. Beautiful dress none the less with many compliments on the color.

Gorgeous Dress - prefect for a daytime event!  This dress felt so good to wear!  So comfy and flattering.  It was a bit short but worked out okay.  I do have short legs and when dresses/skirts hit me at a certain place my legs can look even shorter.  This dress did not do that.  I paired it with nude heals to help make my legs look longer too. I highly recommend this dress for a daytime party, shower, birthday.   I wore it to a Mother Daughter Charity League Tea and it was perfect!

This dress was SO comfortable and there was a lot of space for eating/drinking! LOVED this dress! Got so many compliments, my boyfriend even wanted to buy it for me. It was a bit short when it comes to dancing and raising my arms, but besides that, I thought it was a prefect length.  Wore this with grey/tan heels.
Easy shipping process. Received the dress on time.  Beautiful dress! It was very comfortable to wear but very short if you plan on dancing!

I received compliments on the color and style of the dress! This dress runs large! I normally wear a 4 and I ended up wearing the 2 but probably needed the 0. 

Pros- pretty dress, comfortable, beautiful color

Cons- runs really large and if not the right size can look baggy

Would have been perfect, in the correct size!  Great color, and comfortable. Ordered a 2 and 4...received two size 4's...should have worn a 2!  Therefore, the dress was not as flattering as it could have been.

Very comfortable & beautiful color! The reviews are very accurate on this one.  The dress definitely runs large, and I probably could have worn a smaller size if I had it.  Pros: The color is beautiful and the dress is very comfortable (slips right on!).  Loose in the midsection. Cons: Is a bit "sack like" as other reviewers have also mentioned. May have been different with a smaller size though.  Overall: I would wear again!

This dress is perfect for day to night wear! I rented this as my free birthday dress from RTR and felt like a million bucks. I rented a 2 and a 4, and while the 2 fit better around my torso, my arms were a bit too muscular for the tight sleeves (thanks wedding workout). The 4 was a bit loose but comfy during the day. I received lots of compliments and would definitely rent again.

Beautiful and comfortable! This dress was perfect for the wedding I was attending, which was essentially a casual hipster event. The dress was super comfortable and looked beautiful. I was complimented multiple times during the wedding and had no issues with it. As a note, the dress is a little short so mind yourself when you're bending down, and if you're looking to make this more "form fitting", you may want to find a belt to go with it.

Cute!  I wore this dress to my mom's birthday party and it was perfect! The color of the fabric is a lot more vibrant in person than in pictures and the lace is gorgeous. Like others have already mentioned, there's little shape so it's not figure flattering (I look heavier than usual). But, I expected that and the dress is still really cute.
Did not like the fit This was the backup dress that I ordered. It did not fit me well, I felt it was like a giant t-shirt.
Perfect color and shape for my baby shower! This shape was perfect for my growing baby bump.  I had no issues wearing my normal size during third trimester and got compliments all day!
Just perfect! Second rental of this dress. The cut is simply perfect!

Loved this dress!!! I was a little nervous because all of the reviews said it runs big. It ended up fitting me perfectly! It is made to be a little loose around the hips, which I expected. Don't be discouraged if you're about my size, I was shocked that it fit based on other reviews. It was absolutely beautiful and I loved the color. It goes well with the Kate Spade necklace I wore (which I also rented). 5"4, 111 lbs.

Nice dress for a baby shower The dress was very nice, I really liked the color. I am pretty petite, so I thought it was a touch longer than I would have liked, but I don't think it was something others would notice. I was pleased with the sleeves, I thought they were going to be tight or long, but it fit well.
beach night wedding Was perfect beach wedding at night, was just enough coverage to stay warm, comfortable but a bit short, I am 5.4".
Very short but cute Perfect if you're under 5'3. The dress looks really cute on but sitting down or bending over without showing your booty is going to be a challenge.

Surprised how much my husband liked this shift dress!  So comfortable too! This is a shift dress so you have to expect it to be a little boxy. I ordered the 0 and the 2 and went with the 0.  There was a little bit of shape with the 0; the 2 just hung there. It's a really pretty color, and I just love lace. The dress is really comfortable as there is more room than a fitted type dress. Overall, I was happy with this choice. Great for the spring outdoor wedding I attended.  Even my husband, who would typically prefer a more fitted dress really liked it.

The color was perfect for a Florida wedding. I received many compliments on it. The dress ran pretty short. If you plan on  moving around a lot, this isn't the dress for you. The color was outstanding although some of the lace seemed a little frayed due to many people having worn it previously.
Loved it!  Got several compliments. Very comfortable. The 0 also fit but was very snug & would be impossible to sit in.

Gorgeous, comfortable dress! I wore this dress to a wedding, and it was comfortable and absolutely beautiful! I could have kept on wearing it! The lace is stretchy and lightweight. At 5'2" and 127 pounds, the size 4 could have worked but looked a little too boxy. On the other hand, the size 2 stopped mid-thigh and was very flattering. It clung to the right places but still allowed me plenty of room such that I never felt self-conscious about by midsection. The sleeves were a little tight around my athletic shoulders, but that didn't stop me from dancing all night. I would definitely rent this dress again!

Great color, perfect for the Memorial Day wedding I wore it to.   I'm 5'6 small boned and slender with a bootie. This dress definitely showed off my legs and rear end.  It was a little baggier than I'm used to in the front.  It was by far the most comfortable dress I've ever worn to a wedding. Several people complimented me on the dress and a few of my friends wanted to borrow it.  Too bad it doesn't come in a 00. .

Lovely dress but WAY too short! I wanted to love this dress. The color and the lace were beautiful, but the dress was obscenely short.  I am not that tall, but the dress was mid-thigh on me.  I felt that it was inappropriately short for the wedding I was going to.  I am so sad it did not work out

I loved the color and the lace!  Wore this for a summer wedding and it was perfect. But...ladies over 5'6' be warned...it's SHORT. I was a bit self-conscious however, the fact that it has longer sleeves and a more modest neckline helps balance out the leg length. That said, it's super cute and comfy. I took everyone's advice and size down. I'm usually an 8, but the 6 fit great.

So feminine and pretty. I wore this to my wedding shower. I loved it! I was a little bit more of a "shift" type of dress, meaning that it didn't highlight my curves. I was very comfortable in it and felt so pretty. It was beautiful in pictures and it was exactly what I wanted. It has a little stretch to it, so it's forgiving. I'm petite, so it wasn't an issue, but it's short.

Loved this dress! I really should have read other ladies reviews. I was expecting a form fitting dress, I ordered a 2 and a 4, figuring the 4 would be the one that fit. When I received the dresses, I immediately tried on the 2, assuming it would be too small. It wasnt tight at all. I wish I would have ordered the 0. I dont think it looked bad, but I would have liked it to be a little more form fitting. I got tons of compliments on this dress. It really is a beautiful color. I would rent again, but I'd just order down a size

Gorgeous color, flattering fit, and lovely cut = perfect casual party dress! I wore this for a backyard party with Jack Rogers and a statement necklace.  It was comfortable because of the slightly A-line cut, and very flattering.  The color is just gorgeous - reminded me of Caribbean island water.  The dress was a perfect length, hitting about a hand's length from my knee.  I received tons of compliments on the dress, and was sad to return it.  I think this dress could definitely be dressed up if accessorized as pictured, but it really worked great in a less formal setting as well.

Got so many compliments! Great color, great dress!  I absolutely loved this dress. It looks much better on than it does when just looking at it. Not for every body type,  in my opinion. I loved the color, and I got a ton of compliments on it. I am very tall, and it did run a little short!
Cute dress for a day event Rented this dress for a friend's engagement party. It was a little tighter than you would expect a shift dress to be but still cute on.

SUCH a great dress! I fell in love with the color of this dress and it was perfect for a summer wedding. I had read the other reviews so I knew it was a "straight up and down" shape. I ended up belting it as well and it looked super cute. I'm a size 2-4 on the bottom and rather busty. The size 2 fit both the top AND the bottom, a total rarity! I think the dress would hang even better on someone not quite so top heavy, but all in all a happy rental!

Perfect date night! This dress was perfect for a date night to see Hamilton in Chicago. The color is much more vibrant in person and the lace is pretty. The dress is a nude slip and lace overlay, which are completely separate. I could have worn either the 2 or 4 but ended up wearing the 2 as the length was a little better on me. Classic shift shape. Perfect for Spring weather!
Amazing color- was a little bigger so I belted it.  Found it to be a little long, and loose through the middle so I belted it and it was perfect.
Fabulous dress!  Loved this dress.  Great color, comfortable and I got lots of compliments.  I felt that it ran true to size, although it was a tad short - I'm 5'7".

It fit great, was the perfect length, and was perfect for dancing. I got a million compliments and happened to match the color scheme of the wedding. Loose around the middle - would have looked better belted (to show off waistline). That said, it ended up being a blessing - I ate a ton of delicious wedding cake!
TONS of compliments & I felt beautiful all night.  It was a little big but it looked great!

Needed something quick and fun for the bridal shower I was throwing and this dress was perfect! This dress is fun and flattering! I know
some reviews thought it ran big, but I found it true to size for me. I can range from a 4 all the way to an 8 depending on the designer. The 4 fit great but the 6 gave me a little more room to move and I figured since it was for a wedding shower flexibility was good. I am on the short side so I found the length to be just right as well. All in all a great dress for a formal party!

Elegant dress for spring and summer! The dress comes with a nude colored slip that is silky feeling and soft. The lace dress was easy to put on and not constricting around the arms. The dress hangs nicely since there is a slip underneath. I received many compliments on the color and overall look of this elegant dress. It's perfect for a spring/summer special event. I would definitely rent this dress again.

Overall pretty & very comfortable Got this for an outdoor wedding that was going to be a little cooler (it was actually very cool out). This was incredibly comfortable. I went with a size 2 & 4 and should have really done 0 & 2 because of the nature of the shape of the dress but it looked fine. My fiance was a fan and it was just really comfortable. Comes in two separates pieces (the slip and the lace dress part).

This dress is AMAZING!!!  This is such a fun look and I felt so comfortable in it. The color, pattern and silhouette all just worked. This dress will totally give you your Roaring 20's sassy moment you're looking for!. It fits true to size, there was maybe just a tiny bit of room in the midsection so I probably should have ordered my backup size under instead of up just to see- but I was really happy with the fit. I rented for a military banquet and it felt perfect for the event. Minor warning: Can feel a little scratchy and rides up a little when seated. I would definitely rent again!

Elegant I wore this dress to a show in Vegas. I felt as though it ran a little small as it was extremely short (I'm 5'3.5"). It does not provide much give/stretch so I went with the larger size. The dress is really beautiful - I would definitely rent it again.

I loved this dress and received a lot of compliments at the wedding! I rented this dress for a friends wedding and after reading other reviews I decided to get my usual size and a size larger. The 6 fit fine but was too short on me so I ended up wearing the 8 which had a little less shape but was the length I wanted.

Made a great vacation unforgettable I love, love, love this dress. I wore it to dinner on vacation with my boyfriend for our anniversary. My only disappointment was that the size 2 was not unavailable because I wish the fit was a bit more snug. Otherwise, I wish I could own this dress and wear it everyday.

I loved wearing this dress to my boyfriend's holiday party.  I got compliments all night! I loved this dress, and it fit a little snug but I was comfortable in the 14 (I am typically a 12-14 in dresses) though the arms were a little tight and a little itchy.  I wore this with opaque black tights and black heels, and got compliments all night. I felt confident and beautiful and I wish I owned this dress!

I got so many compliments on my dress! The dress was amazing and perfect for the wedding.  Dress is perfect only negative thing is the arm rubs against the sequence and may hurt a little. Nothing to serious . The dress is super cute and short perfect for shorter girls like me.

I loved wearing this dress! Lots of compliments and it was flashy, but not too much!  I wish that I would have went a size up on this one. I am 5'2 and 127lbs. It was tight in my bust and arm area. I wore spanx panty hose, which helped, it is was very form fitting. If I would have gotten a six, I don't think I would have had these issues. Super Cute dress!
I was able to dance and not worry about the hem riding up the entire night! The dress fit great. It wasn't too short, and I got a lot of compliments.
LOVE I loved this dress it was so pretty and comfortable.  I could have probably gone up a size to the 4 but the 2 was fine.

Sparkliest 30th Birthday! Wore this out for my 30th birthday and was definitely the sparkliest one there! Got lots of compliments and loved the colors and pattern on the dress.
Cons: Because I am tall and have a long torso, like all minidresses this one was borderline on length so there was no room to bend down and when I was sitting the liner would pull up a bit and so I was sitting on the sequined outer layer which was a bit uncomfortable.
Pros: Didn't have any issues with the sequins scratching my arms like they often can with these kinds of dresses. It really stood out and was well made. Got tons of compliments!
Fit: As a long-torsoed lady with a curvy butt and hips, I had to size up from my normal 4 to a 6. If an 8 had been available when I rented, I would have probably preferred that - there was no extra room around the hips. It has no stretch, so as a B cup it fit me fine on top but Cs and larger would also want to size up for the bust. This dress was probably designed for a very straight and narrow body type but with the right sizing curvier girls can rock it too!

I received endless compliments on this photo-ready dress! I liked renting this dress and think that it came out really nicely in pictures. I think that the length was appropriate and did not have any issues sitting in the dress. However, because of the sequins, I was a little itchy at times and found the material to be pretty stiff when trying to move/dance. This would be well suited for a more formal cocktail event where less movement is expected (and not for a night out dancing). Overall, great rental!

Perfect. I loved this dress, and everyone else did too. It was actually very comfortable. It is a little short, but that was only a problem when getting out of the car, etc. Generally, I felt awesome in this dress and will likely rent it again. It's my favorite RTR choice to date.

Great shift dress. Comfortable and flattering.  Wore size 6 since reviews said it ran a tad small. Wish i ordered the size 4, as the size 6 was a bit loose in the hips and waist. Overall very comfortable and looks great with t-strap heels.
Received so many compliments on the color! Runs true to size, but just be cautious about the length if you have longer legs!

Unique, elegant, and feminine dress - perfect for an evening wedding! Ordered no back-up size since only one size left was available (2, my usual size), and luckily it fit. It was still a bit loose around the waist, particularly in the back, so I probably could have squeezed into a 0 but the 2 allowed me to eat more and made the dress more body-skimming as opposed to glove-tight. I didn't have any of the scratchy issues that other reviewers have mentioned but I found that because there was no stretch to the dress, it was a bit restrictive around the leg opening, which made it hard to move quickly and sit down or stand up quickly, etc.  My husband said it was a shame I couldn't buy the dress because it was so striking! I would definitely rent it again since it's a very easy-to-wear dress; it's lined and once you zip up the hidden back zip closure, you don't have to worry about tucking anything in or making sure something stays in place. And all those sequins make you sparkle and look polished without you needing to do much else!

Great dress for evening party!  This dress fit great. I can understand why some women would complain about the sequins bothering their underarm-- it happened a little to me but once I got dancing, I forgot all about it. The colors are muted which was great. I didn't upstage anyone by being in a super shiny dress. I danced the night away in this dress and loved it!

Perfect dress for a winter city wedding! The dress was fairly true to size. I would say a little snug on the hips but I'm an hourglass-to-pear shape and this was more of a shift dress than an A-line, which would have been more forgiving. I wore with black tights, normal underwear and normal bra (it's always awesome when you don't need any special undergarments!). Got loads of compliments all night long.

Gorgeous! Had a hard time returning it. I decided to go up a size so that it would be roomier when dancing. I agree with other reviews that said the sequins were a bit irritating. Overall, this dress was gorgeous and I wanted to buy it instead of return it!

LOVED . THIS . DRESS!  I wore it to a birthday party and it was perfect. Received many compliments. Comfortable, easy to move in, and not scratchy (I thought it would be but was surprised that it wasn't). Would wear it again! ;)

Everyone loved it! I ordered a size 10 and 12 based on the reviews. The 12 was just a little big on my waist, but the 10 was too small on my chest, so I went with the 12. The dress was very comfortable, but did scratch up my arms a bit from the sequins. I received tons of compliments on the dress, and I definitely recommend it!

This dress was simply gorgeous! I felt so fancy and was able to dance the night away!! :) I rented the 2 and the 4 (backup size). It ran true to size and I wore the 2. Both would have fit well, but I liked the length of the 2 better. Both dresses were beautiful and in great condition. The sequins were a little uncomfortable under my arms toward the end of the night, but they didn't bother me until the very end. I would definitely recommend this dress. I was also extremely impressed with Rent The Runway's customer service. They answered all my questions and made shipping super easy. No issues whatsoever! I will definitely be renting from them again!

Fun and sparkly! I ordered this dress as a backup and ended up not wearing it. It was very fun and sparkly! Lots of sequins. The fit was similar to a shift but I typically wear a 4-6 in dresses and the size 8 was a little snug in my hips. Also, I'm 5'3 and it was fairly short on me.

Perfect sparkle for my birthday brunch! I wanted a sparkly dress for brunch, but not too sparkly since it wasn't for the club. This dress was perfection. I am a normal size 8, but since it was out I ordered a 10. The dress was a little loose, but I didn't mind one bit. It was a cold day in Chicago so I paired the dress with thigh highs and it looked great! I am so glad I chose this dress and would definitely rent again.

I wore this for a "Sparkle & Shine" night on my friend's Bachelorette.  I'm very glad I got the back up as it ran very small. While it looked awesome, it was very short (could not bend over), and my under upper arms got pretty scratched up from the sequins. It worked perfectly for the night and I received many compliments, but I would probably not rent it again.

This did not disappoint! Beautiful, fun, stylish. Felt very special in this dress.  This was for my nephew's wedding. My sister, the mom of the groom, was wearing sequins & I knew this was a fancier wedding, so I felt safe that it wouldn't be too much. I was truly expecting the 12 to work & had planned for a 14 as a back up just in case from reading it ran a little small or short, but they were out of the 14, so thankfully I got the 10 instead & it fit perfectly. The 12 had too much gap on hips and neck like. The sequins under the arm bothered me none. It was comfortable, not to hot to wear on a summer day, & easily paired with many color options. I rented a gold cuff, earrings & a gold clutch from here as well. All went beautifully. Toes painted gold, nails navy, black heels. I got so many compliments just as the other descriptions say. It really made me feel beautiful. I would only suggest to make sure it's that fancy of an event so you don't take to much shine away from the others ;)  Very very pleased! 
( It wasn't too short til I had to get in my van and drive, then it kinda formed into a shirt, ha. But sitting at the table wasn't too bad, just had to scooch it down a bit here & there. )

What a dress! The most unique, fun, and stunning in the room! This dress was a huge hit at a Christmas Banquet I attended. I ordered both an 8 and a 6 and the 8 was way to big. I wish I would have gotten a 4 and 6, but a 6 still fit nicely. It's not the most comfortable dress because of the sequins, but there's a price for fashion. It was a statement dress with incredible detail and design. It has more of a navy blue undertone than I was expecting, but it just added to the dress. The length was also great. It hits a few inches above the knees, so nothing to worry about there. I would recommend this dress to anyone!

every girl loves to sparkle! I wore this dress for a romantic dinner out with my boyfriend and drinks with friends after in Charleston and got 4-5 compliments upon walking into dinner! It hugged my body just right and made me feel absolutely fabulous. Sequins are a girl's best friend!

Beautiful dress for a 1920's themed work party! I wore this dress for my husband's 1920's themed holiday work party. I had a ton of compliments and felt great in the dress! The lower back of the dress fit a bit loose, however the rest fit quite snug.

The service of Rent the Runway is great at getting you what you need! It fit great, not too snug and not too loose. The sequins would rub against the my arms and irritated me a bit, but it was worth it. I received a lot of compliments throughout the event and really felt amazing in the dress. A solid choice.

Obsessed!  Got tons of compliments. I was worried that this dress wasn't going to work with my larger bust, but it honestly fit perfectly.  I rented a 6, but also got an 8 because everyone said it ran small, but I thought the 6 was great.  I guess my only con would be that it's a bit short, so if it's a more formal event then it might not be the best choice.  However, I was at a casual wedding on a farm, so it went with the occasion really well.  A woman even told me it looked like the dress had been made for me.  I honestly can't recommend it enough, even for us larger chested gals!

Two best friends getting married The dress fit PERFECTLY.  I ordered a 2 and a 4, and very comfortably fit in the 4.  I was worried that the dress would be too heavy for an outdoor wedding in August on the Chesapeake Bay, but it wasn't thick or heavy like I expected.  The dark color and covering in sequins allowed me to wear whatever i wanted underneath (I wore a regular bra and regular bikini underwear).  I got compliments from so many people at the wedding and I wish I could buy this dress to wear over and over.

This dress was super fun to dance in and I received many compliments! The dress does done small. You do have to have broad shoulders to wear it. The sequins to rub a bit on the underarms, but it become unnoticeable after a while. After reading the reviews I ordered a dress size up from my normal and an even bigger one for back-up. I had to wear 2 sizes up because when I raised my arms in my normal size dress it raised the whole dress up a bit too much.  I loved that I could wear a normal bra in it and that there was plenty of chest room. Other than that this dress was super fun to dance in and it made me feel slimmer and sexier. I would definitely rent this dress again.
Perfect for a wedding This dress is an eye catcher.  I opted for the 4 to gain a little more length.  It is quite short.

almost perfect I wore this to my graduation ceremony for my masters degree. I really liked it, I have an athletic build and the dress kept me looking very feminine. I am 5'6" 137# and wear 34c/d bra. I couldn't wear a bra with a size 4 because it was too tight in the chest (but that was ok because it looked fine and you couldn't tell at all). Also, the dress was pretty short on me. Any shorter, and it wouldn't have been appropriate. size up for super chesty! and if you're super tall I'd skip this one! but for me, it was great.

Stunning dress, a little worn Loved this dress!! Photographs beautifully. Comfortable even though it's a sequined dress. It was showing some signs of wear. Some of the sequins were fraying off around the hem and arms. I usually wear a 0 but the 0 was not available so I went with the 2 and it worked fine due to the sheath/cut. A little loose but still looked great! So nice to be able to flex between 2 sizes with this cut of dress.

This dress was gorgeous and I received so many compliments! Perfect for my best friends wedding! I would have worn a 4 but I have very broad shoulders so I went with the 6 and it was perfect. The sequins are a little rough on the arms when they run but otherwise the dress was perfect. Comfy and light. Fit in all the right places. Will definitely rent this dress again!!

This dress was perfect for a new professionals holiday party! Loved this dress and was so sad to send it back! I typically wear a 4/6 but went with the 4 because the 6 felt a little frumpier and less form fitting. The sequins were a little scratchy against my arms, but not too bad. I got so many compliments and one guy at the party even came up to me to tell me I had the best dress there! The Anton Heunis Lotus Pendant Earrings that I ordered complimented it perfectly too!

This was a comfortable, sparkly, unique dress to wear as a guest of a wedding. I ordered the 2 and the 4.  The 2 probably fit a little better in the torso/abdomen area, but the 4 fit much better around the arms and was a tad longer.  Some of the reviews talked about the sequins rubbing on the arms and legs as the night went on, but I didn't have any problems at all.  Overall the dress was super comfortable and was something I wouldn't normally wear so I glad to be able to rent it!
Perfect for a New Orleans wedding! The dress was incredibly comfortable.  I fit in both the 12 and 14, however, I chose the 14 for length.  In the 14 it passed the fingertip test.

This dress is beautiful and really is an attention grabber! I loved this dress and it fit me like a glove.  I had to go up one size from my normal as the 12 felt a little constricting.  But it was very flattering and comfortable!

I received so many compliments on this dress! Perfect for a Vegas wedding. Going for the size up was a wise choice - I wanted a looser fit because I knew I would be dancing. This dress doesn't move or stretch very well, so unless you're going for the tight club look, definitely go for a size up.

Totally amazing! Loved it! It's a little short, which worried me a little but it wasn't too short. I got so many compliments too! I didn't want to send this back! If you looked closely you could see some loose threads but they didn't detract from the dress nor were they an issue.

Bright and fun I wore this dress for my baby shower, and it worked out perfectly. I ordered two sizes, including one size up from my normal one in case my bump was an issue, but there is a reasonable amount of stretch in the material and I was just fine in my normal size 0. I am very petite, and it hit just at my knee in length, but I was able to easily fashion tape it a little shorter. It was really beautiful and fun, with the gold looking stunning in pictures. I wore it in the fall with black knee high suede boots to make it a little less formal for the shower, and it looked great. I highly recommend it!

Adored This Dress; Perfect for Short Women I absolutely loved this dress. It was flattering and the sequins are subtle but eye-catching. The only issue is that the dress is very short. I'm 5'2 so it wasn't an issue, but anyone over 5'5 might have an issue.

The event was fabulous, and the dress made it even better! I'm usually between a 2-4.  The 2 was slightly too tight around my butt/thighs, so I opted to wear the 4.  It was slightly baggy in the stomach area, but it didn't matter- it was fine to be a bit loose.  The arms were a bit tight, but comfortable.  I was nervous the sequins would be itchy, but the liner on the inside of the dress was soft.  It was a great dress!  I loved the way it looked, and it was just fancy enough for the occasion!

The Dress was a Hit...but not the Fit! I wore this dress to chaperone the senior prom. The dress was a great fit for the occasion. It felt appropriate for the occasion without being floor length.  My boss loved it, my coworkers said I looked striking, and my boyfriend couldn't stop complementing my curves and how sexy I looked. While the dress got rave reviews the fit was a struggle. It truly runs small. I usually wear a 6 or an 8 depending on the cut and I needed a 10.  If you would like to wear it you should size up. While I got in it (Thank God for Spanx), I felt like a stuffed sausage and I couldn't lift my arms above my head. Also the sequins were a bit cumbersome and might need to be flipped as not to be a bother.  Although I felt that it was a little short on me (even at 5'3), no one else did.  Still I was cautious when out on the dance floor. Also I should note that the dress is easy to accessorize. You just need a good earring and bracelet. Overall in the right size the dress is fun, flirty, fabulous!

Loved the sparkles. Fun yet classy. Only downside was that it seemed a little worn out. It was stretched out in the thigh/butt area so it downgraded the quality of the dress. However, I felt comfortable in it and received tons of complements. It was better than I expected for a last minute rent the runway request.

This is such a fun dress!  It runs a little small, though.  I am almost always a size 0 in dresses but this was actually a little tight around my butt & thighs. And because of that it was a little shorter than I would have liked it. It made it difficult to sit down. I would recommend going up a size. And it's probably best for shorter women because is so short. Overall, I felt beautiful in it, though!
Dress was easy to dance in and fun to wear. I'm petite so the length was perfect - just above the knee. Felt true to size.

Gorgeous, Flattering, and Comfortable!  This dress was AWESOME! It is much lighter weight than what you would expect. It was the perfect length and exactly what I was looking to wear to a Great Gatsby wedding. I was the day of coordinator and this was super easy to move around in. GREAT DRESS!

A comfortable, statement making dress that works on many different shapes & sizes!  This dress was comfortable for New Year's Eve while being unique enough to receive multiple compliments. My only regret is that it is not very flattering if you have larger arms. I didn't realize it last night but when I looked at pictures today I noticed that it made my arms appear larger than normal. But, if you're looking for a sequin dress that is SUPER comfortable and won't require any extra necklaces or fancy hair, this is your perfect option!
Super cute! I really loved this dress. It runs a little short, so if you have long legs, it will be short on you. It is form fitting, and really accentuated my hips.  I would wear this dress again!
Fun dress for a night out!   Fit true to form- it was a little short, but I expected that from the pictures. Comfy and easy to wear.  Really fun, party dress!

Wine Country Wedding! Dress was ideal for the occasion - an outdoor summer ceremony, an indoor reception (rustic but still chic and glamorous) - it was the perfect cocktail dress at an event where some people were black tie and some where just suit-jacket-and-slacks.  I ordered the 2 and the 4, and didn't even try the 4 once the 2 went on, but I feel like a size 3 would have been JUST right.  Even though I'm generally on the petite side, my arms have always been my "problem area" and the sleeves were just a wee bit snug.  Dress was SHORT (as am I!) so I couldn't imagine being taller and pulling the outfit off without flashing someone.  It got rave reviews all around - some people mentioned being bothered by the chafing of the sequins but it didn't affect me.  Also, dress was very light (versus other sequined dresses I've worn).  Would say other than the fact that it does run a bit small, I did have to keep "sucking in" my tum all evening to get the most flattering look out of it (whereas with other dresses you can breathe more easily and it doesn't show every single, ahem, "roll."
This dress was great! I wore it to my sorority formal and got a ton of compliments :) I usually wear a 4, but I saw that it ran a bit large and the 2 ended up fitting great.

Very fun and sparkly dress!! I wore this dress for NYE and loved it! The dress was a bit snug in the torso area and I should have ordered the 8 and 10 (instead of 6 and 8), but it was great for one night! This is a very fun and sparkly dress - I would definitely recommend renting!

Formal and fun for evening wedding This dress looked beautiful and was very easy to wear. Based on other reviews I ordered my normal  size (8) and also sized down (6). The 6 fit very nicely and was more slimming around the middle however I felt that it was way too short for a formal wedding. I chose the 8 which was more length appropriate but less form fitting. I still received many compliments on the dress.

Beautiful Dress, Even better in Person  This dress was great I loved it, this was my second time using rent the runway and it was successful yet again! This dress is gorgeous I wold recommend getting it. It complements your curves, the sequins just make it there not too over the top just enough. The one problem i did have with this was it rides up super easy when dancing or when you lift your hands about your head. One last thing it that the fabric of the slip doesn't breathe easy, it is very hot. But I would still recommend getting the dress it's worth breaking a sweat  dancing!

A ton of people commented on how much they liked the dress! I received compliments all night.   The dress fit wonderfully! It was about thigh length, fit the bust and waist as described and was not restricting or tight. I was able to dance and eat as much as I wanted without feeling uncomfortable. This dress was definitely one of the best I have ever worn.
Show stopper dress! So many compliments on this dress! Definitely one of my favs ever rented! Fit was true to size, a little on the short side though. Most importantly it was comfortable

My best friend picked this dress as her bridesmaid dress.  This is my favorite dress that I have ever worn... EVER! When my friend picked this for her wedding, I never thought that a dress like this could look good on me. I have pale skin, and gold is just not my color. All of the bridesmaids had different hair and skin tones, and this dress looked good on EVERYONE. I highly recommend this dress! Very flattering, and it fits so comfortably. I'm not very tall (5'5"), but I still needed the long with heels.

felt very glamorous!  Loved the way I felt in this dress. The fit is comfortable and has good stretch. Sequins were a little itchy under the arms but to be expected with sequins. I could have used some extra length at 5'7", the regular showed my shoes bit it was really fine and not noticeable.  Rented this as a bridesmaid dress and was very happy overall with the look! Highly recommend!

Wore this as a bridesmaid dress when I was 6 months pregnant.  Felt glamorous! Heavier material, just a hint too long for my petite body, and the sequins under your nails as you lift the dress is a KILLER!

Amazing Dress!! This dress was amazing! I was worried it would be too big because Im only 100 pounds and very skinny. The dress fit perfectly! I got compliments the entire night:) I also purchased the NuBra from this website to go with the dress and I high recommend it. The only thing that bothered me was the sequins under the arms scratched a bit, but I barely noticed it throughout the night. I had a very hard time parting with this dress, its a must have!

Stunning Glamous Bridesmaid Dress I wore this dress to be a bridesmaid in my best friend's wedding. I am 5'5" and 145 lbs, I rented both the 6R and 8R. Both dresses fit but the 6R hugged my curves better. I wore a NuBra and Spanx that fit just fine under the dress. My heels were 3 1/2 inches and the length of 6R was perfect, any longer and I would've been stepping on the back of the dress, which is longer in the back. I received a lot of compliments on this dress, more than any dress I've ever worn and posted to social media. It is eye catching and truly glam. It was very comfortable and forgiving. I would highly recommend this dress to anyone.
Received so many compliments on my dress! It was perfect for the NYE wedding It was perfect!

This dress made me feel incredible! This dress was so pretty!!! I ordered based on what my normal clothing size was and ordered a long as I am 5'8 and planned to wear heels. The dress was very true to size and fit like a glove! I wore 4 inch heels and the dress was a great length. The dress has a small train that was long enough to be a great touch but so long that it gets in the way. The draped back was so pretty! I was able to wear a regular bra with the dress just by tucking the draping into my bra. I received many compliments on the dress all night. The best part was how comfortable it was! The sequins didn't rub on my skin and it was very easy to move around in. I wore the dress with a very pretty pair of royal blue heels which looked great. I'd recommend doing a pop of color with your shoes. It should be a royal color however because the dress is gold so dark blue, red, or emerald green would look fantastic. I didn't wear jewelry because the dress is so flashy. I did a red lip which went great with the dress and the sort of old Hollywood feel it has. Rent this dress because you won't be disappointed! This was also my first experience with RTR but it won't be my last. The dress arrived mid day, the day prior to my event and both sizes were in excellent condition. After I mailed them back I received email confirmation that RTR had received them. Really great experience overall!
The way my dress made me feel!! The fits was perfect!!! I am usually a size 0, and I got the 0R. The dress complimented all the right areas on my body. Length was perfect too.

AMAZING - would be 5 stars, but it was too short!!!!!!! This dress is absolutely amazing and by far my favorite Rent the Runway dress yet.  HOWEVER, the dress is so so so short - and I am only 5'3!  I originally rented the 4R and 6R - both fit, but the 6R was definitely more flattering ... while barefoot.  I couldn't wear a heal of any height without the dress looking ridiculous.  I'm short, so I typically have the opposite problem and find myself buying extra tall heels to make up for too-long dresses.  I called RTR right away and they luckily had two new sizes to send via overnight mail - another 6R (in case the original had been altered) and an 8R.  I ended up wearing the 8R because it was just long enough that I could wear the tiniest 1 inch heel.  Did I mention I am only 5'3?  I would 100% recommend renting a long if it is available.  I also would recommend going a size up (and buying a good pair of spanx!)  if you are a little self-conscious of a skin tight dress.  I'm typically a 6, but I would argue that the 8 fit my body much better.  I wish I could give this dress 5 stars - it is so amazing when it fits properly, but the length issue was a problem (though it doesn't look it in these photo as I'm wearing flats).
Felt like a movie star! This dress fit perfectly!  The back was a gorgeous element to make the dress even more glamorous!

I felt so glamorous! I wore this to a black tie wedding in NYC. I am 5'3" and with a 1" platform and 3" wedge heel, the regular length was perfect even for a night of dancing. You have to really be careful of underwear lines. I would probably try Spanx if I had the opportunity to wear it again just for a smoother look. The back was gorgeous! I wish I could've worn it all weekend!  Highly recommend!

Perfect Black Tie Gown! Overall, I loved this dress. I wore it to a formal black-tie optional charity event in downtown Chicago and it was a hit - got so many compliments! I'm 5'10" and I ordered the long and it was definitely long enough, even with 3" heels. The fabric was also light enough that I didn't feel like it was dragging the whole night which can be a pain with sequins. One thing I will say is that this dress runs VERY large. I'm typically a 4, sometimes a 2 depending on the designer and I was still swimming in the 2. Definitely order at least one size down, maybe two.
I could have worn a 4 Long...I am 5'7" it was a little short for me good luck finding a good bra for this dress

The dress was perfect! It stood out amoung the other dresses and was comfortable as well! Loved it! The dress fit great- was flattering and comfortable! I usually wear a 4L, however decided to go for the 6L so it wasn't too tight in some areas ---and I could eat more at dinner! The dress was flashy so I didn't even need to worry about jewlery. I also went braless which was nice to not have to worry about the right undergarments. I would totally rent this dress again!

It was my birthday party and the dress definitely helped making me the star of the evening. Classy. Elegant. Beautiful dress. I am very glad they didn't have the long in stock so I ended up renting the regular. With 5 inch heels you could only see the tip of my toes. Once the shoes came off, the dress dragged on the floor. I'm 5'8". I normally wear either 8 or 6 for size. Size 8 fit perfectly. I highly recommend this dress. It's just gorgeous.

Stunning and comfortable!  Loved everything about this dress. I wore the 2R rather than the 4R... and I actually think a 0 would have been better, so my option is that it runs a little big. I was nervous that the dress might look a bit tacky/flashy prior to ordering it, but it turned out to be elegant and classy. Looked and felt like an $800+ dollar dress.

I absolutely loved this dress! Many people asked me about the dress I felt like a million bucks! I fluctuate btw size 4 and 6 the 4L worked best for me and it was not snug at all. And the back was perfect! I am 5'9" and I weigh 150 I am a little wide in my hips but the dress fit like a glove. The only complaint I have it's that it's a little short in the front but just shorter that what I would prefer but with nice shoes it works well. Very comfortable dress it looks very glamorous I felt beautiful in it! Definitely recommend it!

Beautiful sparkly super formal I am a size 16 usually, 6'0" tall.  The 16L fit me well but was almost four inches too short.  I had the 18WL as a back up size and it hit the floor beautifully.  I opted to wear heels (a rarity for me) and it was still basically long enough.  Super comfortable, not as unflattering on my uncomfortable body features as I suspected!  This was my back up size of my back up dress and I'm so glad it worked out, or I would have been wearing something I already owned after spending money to rent!!

Beautiful This dress was gorgeous, especially the back! I felt amazing all night and received so many compliments! I wish I had ordered a size down though; it ran large and the stomach felt a little baggy (as you can see in the photo).

I felt like I walked into the room dripping in gold! Everything about this dress was wonderful! I felt like a sophisticated yet sexy woman. Got plenty of compliments! Another beautiful woman was wearing the same dress at the ball and she looked great as well!

A show stopper, elegant dress! The dress was incredibly comfortable, I didn't want to take it off! I had so many compliments in this curve flattering dress!! I felt like a princess the entire night. Rent The Runway is amazing!

What an awesome dress,  I received compliments all evening.   The fit was flattering on my figure. The slip began to show under the bottom of the dress as the evening  progressed.  The was the only drawback.

Lovely & Comfortable  This is a beautiful dress. One of the best I've ever worn. It fit great. I'm on the taller side of 5'6" and I wore some simple nude flats. I'd suggest that unless you are VERY petite you should order the longer version if you are planning on wearing heels. I'm also usually a size 4 so I'd recommend sizing down. I did wear a backless bra for this dress. I wore my hair down and wavy without a problem of it getting caught on the sequins.

Accessories: nude flats, sea foam green teardrop earrings, cream clutch with gold details.

Gorgeous dress.  Very comfortable and received lots of compliments. Perfect for a black tie wedding.  For tall ladies (5'10" or taller), even the long size might be a little shorter than expected.  Mine fell just above the ankle in the front and just above the bottom of my heel int he back, so it doesn't necessarily give the long train effect that you see in photos from shorter women.  Otherwise, the fit is perfect.  Sequins made my arms a bit sore from the scratching at the end of the night, but it took several hours of wearing it to get to that point.  Overall, I highly recommend the dress and definitely suggest going a size down for the backup size because the material has some stretch and give to it.

The dress was stunning and I got tons of compliments, even from strangers.  Fit perfectly.  With the cap sleeves and the stretch material, it felt more like pulling on a t-shirt than a tight uncomfortable dress.  I wore the long size, so I got some higher heels than usual to go with it.  Also, I found a layered gold necklace that I wore backwards to drape down my back.  I loved this dress!

I mean, the dress was long and curve-hugging, with gold sequins.  It was perfect! The dress fit well.  My tummy is my problem area, but Spanx helped to smooth everything out.  I was also very happy to be able to wear a regular bra.  I'm only 5'4, and I was very surprised that I needed a long, because I've never needed a long anything. The length of the gown was perfect with my heels.
Perfect bridesmaids dress This was my bridesmaids dress for a fall wedding and it was great. The material is a little heavy, but it's not too hot. The dress is also pretty stretchy, which was nice!

Our entire bridal party received endless compliments on this dress!  Beautiful! I would say this dress runs mostly true to size in the way it fits the body.  However, I didn't find the 4 Long to actually be long enough, so this may not work if you are super tall.  I'm only 5'7" and most of my shoe was showing from the front, so I would go with a very short heel or flats.  I would recommend shapewear if you're insecure about your tummy/lower half, as the dress is pretty clingy.  My spanx weren't visible at all, even with the low back.  The description states that a standard bra can be worn with the dress, but I didn't find that to be accurate.  A sticky bra worked perfectly!

AMAZING. It looks like liquid gold and moves beautifully. I still get compliments on it! Fits perfectly and the sequins aren't itchy at all. Definitely get the long if you're tall or if you're wearing heels. I wore 2 inch heels and the long size was almost too short.
This dress was perfect! Lots of compliments. It fit like a glove and I felt great wearing it.   Perfect.

So much fun to wear!  I wore this for an Old Hollywood themed party and it looked amazing. This was my first RTR experience, and while most of the reviews said the dress ran a bit large, I was nervous having never worn Badgley Mischka before, so I ordered my regular size and one size up as the spare.  I could have gotten away with the size 2.  It was very long on me, but I think that was because it was a tad loose.  I'm 5"5' and was wearing 5 1/2" heels and it was still on the floor.  Super comfy  and I got a lot of compliments!
Loved this dress and received tons of compliments. Fits like a glove. The fabric is quite stretchy, so I would recommend to order a smaller size. I loved this dress.

Changed into this as my reception dress at my black-tie wedding, and it made the PERFECT statement! I normally wear a size 6, and the 6 Long was the perfect fit with three inch heels.  So many compliments on this dress - I felt like an old Hollywood starlet!
I got compliments from everybody at the wedding!  I felt like a movie star! Fit was great. There is some stretch to the dress so it's comfortable.
sparkly and comfortable! This dress is amazing. Comfortable but damn it looks good!  It's got stretch.
Stunning, absolutely stunning Beautiful dress and fits perfectly and looks perfectly on. I will absolutely rent this again...showstopper

Simply amazing!! I was really nervous about using Rent the Runway because I wasn't sure how the dresses would fit and how I would feel in them.  I was able to go to the store in Georgetown and had a great experience with the staff there.  They were helpful and made finding the dress super easy.  I ABSOLUTELY loved this dress and felt amazing in it.  I wore it for a black-tie wedding and got so many compliments from people at the party and even random people on the street.  I would highly recommend this dress because you will feel like a superstar!

I felt like a Hollywood star!!! This dress is AMAZING!! I danced all night and felt very comfortable. I received many compliments throughout the night. It runs true to size. I'm usually a size 10 but had to wear the 12L because RTR didn't have the 10 in Long. Rent this dress. You won't regret it!!!

I felt like an Oscar Award!! I loved this dress.  I wore it for my dental school award banquet.  I wanted to sparkle as I walked across the stage to get my award :)  This dress was beautifully slinky, slightly heavy, in the best way possible.  Exquisite.  I loved it the moment it came in the mail.  I wore spans.  It was very comfortable.  I would rent it again.  I loved this dress!

absolutely perfect dress I wore this dress for my junior prom and it was absolutely stunning. I got so, so many compliments, and my date adored it. I normally wear a 0-2 and this was a little bit big, but it wasn't anything I couldn't deal with. 
All in all, it was definitely the best dress I've ever worn. It was really hard to send it back.

Loved the dress, very long though! The description said this would be okay for someone 5'2, and I wore four and a half inch heels at 5'1. Gorgeous dress, and I ended up using 30-40 pieces of fashion tape (took me 25 mins) to tape the dress up about 3 inches. Got compliments the whole night! Worth it!

Marine Corps Ball and I felt like the 'bell of the ball'! The dress fit so wonderful, like a second skin.  I expected to at the least fight with the shoulders all night but it was perfect.  Other mentioned itching under the arms but I never noticed.  The dress was true to fit for me as I wear a 4 and with the reviews ordered a 4L (needed every inch of length) and a 2L.   Thanks to spanks (after 3 kids everyone needs spanks) I had the confidence to wear the most beautiful dress a the event.  So many complements and I hope I have a reason to rent this again soon!

Gorgeous dress that makes you stand out! This dress was stunning! I wore it to a black tie wedding on New Year's Eve and received a ton of compliments! The fit in the body was perfect - not too tight or too loose. I did have to safety pin the hem up an inch or so, even wearing three inch heels, but that's pretty typical for me. I would highly recommend this dress and would certainly rent again for the right occasion!

Gorgeous dress!!!  I am 5 ft. 8 in. tall and I wore a 4L with 1 1/2 inch heels. The length was perfect. I usually wear a size 6 but I thought the size 4 fit better in the waist The dress was form fitting but had a lot of stretch so it was very comfortable to wear and dance in during the entire evening. The color is a beautiful gold, very elegant. I was stopped multiple times during the evening and told that I was the best dressed at the prom. I was also told that I looked like the Golden Globe statue!! I would definitely wear this gown again and highly recommend it.

Gorgeous! Worn backwards! Ha! Loved it! Gorgeous gown, worn for military ball.  Very stunning on. I have a bigger chest so when I tried the dress on the appropriate way, it just did not look good.  I was about to return the dress until I found out I couldn't get another sent to me overnight due to my zip code not doing deliveries on Saturdays.  I reread through reviews and saw that one woman wore it backwards so I tried it, and sure enough it worked!!! My husband loved it!  Thanks RTR for another fabulous dress!

I accessorized this dress with a platinum diamond gatsby-esque bracelet and simple pearl earrings. I loved this dress! The dress itself stands out, so I wouldn't over accessorize with jewelry. I received compliments all night. It fit true to size, and I would definitely recommend it for any type of formal affair!

It was an amazing night at the Emmy's! This is an amazing dress! I have never felt more beautiful in any dress ever in my life! I am usually a size 0, and the 0R was perfect for me -- with heels of course! The weight of the dress was just right that it never moved or fell off awkwardly, even though the back is quite low. I got so many compliments on my dress, even an Emmy winner from a very famous AMC Drama complimented me at an after party!! :) If you want to be the belle of the ball in a chic, slim silhouette and sparkle in any photo from the night, this is the dress for you!

This was the perfect bridesmaid dress! It photographs beautifully, day or night. The dress fits like a glove on any body type! I ordered a 2L and 4L, and picked the smaller size. The material is stretchy and lightweight, which makes it very comfortable to dance in. The sequins are thin so you don't have to worry about snagging the dress or itchy fabric. I highly recommend this dress for any wedding, party, or event! I received a ton of compliments and love how the pictures turned out!

So beautiful! I didn't end up wearing this dress but instead I wore the Shimmering Blush also from Badgley Mischka. However, this dress is super pretty and glamorous! If the other dress hadn't fit me well, I definitely would have worn this one!
Received many compliments on the dress!  It fit beautifully. No bra needed which is great!

I rented this dress for a hospital gala.  I received so many compliments and felt amazing. I am nearly 5'11'' and all of the other reviews of it being a bit on the short side are true.  I took back the first heels I had and went with a nice 1'' heel.  It was my husband's work event so this dress was a nice sexy yet conservative style.

Perfect dress, perfect man, perfect evening The dress fit like a glove.  The length, style, quality, and fit were all perfect.  I usually am not a sequins type person, but the sequins were beautiful and quality.  I had so many compliments on this dress.  I would definitely recommend it!

The dress was absolutely beautiful!  The dress fit perfectly, I was nervous about wearing a dress to a wedding that I couldn't try on since I have such a problem with finding the right fit. I was pleasantly surprised that the dress not only fit perfectly but was also comfortable. I received so many compliments on this dress and felt confident wearing it. It was a little long on me but that was expected. I would order from RTR again, and I wish I could own this dress!

Wore this as a bridesmaid for a wedding. We received numerous complements on the dresses.  Loved the fit. Very flattering. The shoulders seemed a bit large, but other than that it was great. I am 5'1 so I was worried about the length but with 3.5 inch heels the 4R was perfect. Great dress!
Not the easiest dress to wear, but stunning as a bridesmaid dress.  You will need spanx no matter how tiny you are, but overall for a skin tight dress I actually felt really good in this dress.

Tons of compliments on this glamorous dress! I wore this dress as a bridesmaid. Overall, I really liked it. It was comfortable and flattering on all body types. However, it ran very short. I ordered a 4R and 2L and the 4R was way too short. Many bridesmaids had this issue. You also CANNOT wear a normal bra or even a low-back bra with this, despite what the description says. Backless bra is the only way to go.

Flattering, gorgeous dress for all shapes and sizes!  This dress does run large (due to the stretch in the material so definitely size down a size or two). It is low in the back so either a low bra strap is needed if your wearing one. 

This dress gives you a great shape and has a fantastic gold color that compliments your skin. The fit is perfect, as I mentioned, it has stretch so you can move around without any issues. I am 5'3" and wore about a 3" heel. If your tall, you should definitely get the longer size but if your petite in height, the regular with a heel is just fine. You will not be disappointed!
Classic beauty Perfect fit. The petite length was perfect for my height. Very comfortable and hangs nicely so no worries of imperfections to be hide with Spanx. I received lots of compliments.

LOVED IT! This dress was perfect for my husband's black tie company party. It was a hit! I felt beautiful and glamorous. The dress was comfortable and easy to move around it.  I normally wear a size 6, but the length was a bit short. I wore the 8 and felt great all night!

Gorgeous Bridesmaid Dresses! All four bridesmaids had different body shapes and this dress flattered everyone! The dresses were in great condition and we got more compliments than I can count. Phenomenal rental!!

Pretty dress, lots of compliments I ended up wearing my back-up size because the lining caused the dress to lay strangely on the smaller size. The smaller size fit better, but because of that issue, I ended up going larger. The larger size was too large in the bust area for me, but I would venture to say if you are larger in the bust than me (34B) you may need to size up for the bust or select something different.

Moves really well- very pretty! As others mentioned, the rib cage area is super tight! I'm a 34B and I couldn't comfortably wear or zip the Medium dress at the rib cage although it fit everywhere else. The large fit well and I'm usually a size 8 in dresses. Definitely size up!

Very light and comfortable dress. Perfect for a summer wedding! I ordered the Small and the Medium. The medium fit a little big around the waist and in the bust area. I put the small on and it fit definitely on the tighter side but perfect. It gave me the defined waist I was looking for. I probably could have gone with out a bra but I wore the adhesive bra for a better look. The dress was nice and flowy. I received many compliments on the dress and maybe event converted a few people into renting too!

Tons of compliments on this dress!  I was very excited to rent this dress but nervous because I did read a lot of reviews about the neck being tight, but a lot of people still raved about the dress. I ended up wearing the small, as the medium was too big around my chest and stuck out on the sides. However, the small was very tight around my neck. I got used to it at first but as the night went on the tiny strap that are tight around neck started irritating my skin. But sometimes you gotta take the good with the bad, because other than that I looooved the way the dressed looked and I got so many compliments all night. So overall, I'm happy with my rental and it was worth a little pain :)

Beautiful wedding on a warm late summer night I absolutely loved this dress! Really beautiful and the flow on the skirt is really wonderful. The neck area is relatively snug, but it's nothing you won't get used to. The small does run a little snug, so if you eat a lot it can be a bit constricting, haha! I really wish I could have kept this dress. I definitely recommend it.
Fit like a glove I'm not usually a L but that size fit like a glove.  I didn't have the neckline problems everyone else seemed to have.
Comfortable and beautiful! Loved this dress! It fit really well and was a unique cut. Had to wear a sticky bra since I found the material on the top a little too thin to go bra-less.

Beautiful; but need to have a long torso to pull it off The dress is stunning! The cut outs and print make the dress feel perfect for summer. However, you need to have a long torso to wear this dress (I don't think height matters). Because of where the waist hits, it made me look like I was pregnant. Because of how the top lays, I looked flat chested. If you are curvy like me, this probably isn't the dress for you.

Amazing dress, snug on the chest  I absolutely adore this dress, but unfortunately, it was too snug across the chest on me and I could not make it work comfortable. Fortunately, however, my best friend was able to wear it and she looked stunning. It fit her like a glove and was so flattering and also so unique. I definitely recommend the dress, but would suggest sizing up, especially if you are busty.

Beautiful pattern, great for a spring/summer wedding! Very beautiful dress. It was a bit tight around the neck which I've never experienced before (I think I have a normal sized neck...) and a bit too tight to wear a bra. The next size up would have been a bit more comfortable but  the upper chest was completely stretched out so I decided to stick with the smaller size. All in all I was very happy with this dress!
Loved this dress and wanted to keep it! Prettier in person. Received lots of compliments. Snug in the chest but loose under the armpits. Difficult to wear any sort of bra.

This dress was great for a daytime wedding and for dancing.  I had to order an XS because the small was not available on the weekend I needed. The neck was very tight, but I assumed it would run a little small. I received many compliments on the dress, and if I had more reasons to wear it, I'd consider buying (but in a small).

Beautiful print, nice flowy silhouette  I wore this dress for Easter Sunday. It was so beautiful, I loved the cut back on the top (which made my arms look more toned) and the detailing with the cutouts around the waist and bottom. I am short so the length was almost to my ankles. I love walking in it, felt really light and airy, perfect for the beginning of spring

Perfect dress for a summer wedding  I loved this dress! So elegant and fun for a summer wedding. I am usually an XS/0 and this dress fit great with the exception of the neckline being a little high, and the armholes being a little tight. Otherwise - a perfect dress!

This dress is a great summer wedding option! I am almost always a small or XS in dresses but this dress is quite snug in the chest (and I'm a 34B) so I opted for the medium. The medium was bit gapping in the armpits but I wore a padded bra to try and fill it out. Otherwise fit and feel was great. Also being 5'3" I was worried about the length but it worked perfectly.

I wore this dress for my cousin's outdoor wedding in Michigan. I would absolutely wear it again! I loved this dress and received a ton of compliments on it. As other reviewers have noted, the neck was a bit snug. This was ultimately the reason why I decided to wear the Medium size dress as opposed to the Small. Even though the body of the Small fit great, the neck would have been unbearable. Luckily the Medium still fit nicely and was comfortable enough to last through several hours of drinking and dancing. I could tell the dress was well made as it was very figure flattering.

The dress has a beautiful cut and is very flattering. I felt amazing in this dress!  The pattern is unique without being distracting and the cut is very flattering if you are small waisted. The inside slip does ride up however and can be annoying because it was hard to readjust without going to the ladies room and pulling it back down.

Fun, modest, great summer dress I wore this to an awards ceremony for my husbands job.  I was looing for something nice but modest. This dress fit the bill. My profile will not let me change my size so I will say that I am a 34DDD. It was tight around my chest. I actually did not wear a bran with it because the extra padding caused it to pucker at the very top but it was fine with out the bra and kept me in. I was worried that I was showing too much side boob but my husband said I was fine. It was a great dress for the event. I love it and would totally order it again.

Great dress for outdoors or daytime event! I rented this dress for Easter brunch. It was beautiful, and I got lots of compliments! The dress was heavy though, there is a lot of fabric in the lower half. I'm 5'8, about 125 and usually wear a size 2, though can run 0-4 depending on brand. May be a lot of fabric to deal with for shorter renters. The XSR was too small for me in the bust so I wore the Small...there was a little extra space in the armpit area but it wasn't noticeable to others and didn't bother me once I had it on. Overall, loved it!

worn to a Rehearsal Dinner -- beautiful dress and fit -- will rent again!  I typically wear an XS/S, and rented the XSR (size small was not available for the dates I needed). It was slightly snug at the neckline and bust, but I think the size small would have been too large through the rib-cage. I loved the dress, and the print is beautiful. I got compliments on it all evening. Overall, highly recommend this dress.

Perfect for an outdoor wedding! I loved how this dress looked and I got so many compliments! It was a blast to dance in. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because the neck of the SR dug into my shoulders uncomfortably, but the MR was way too big in the chest and gaped around the arms, so I just dealt with it. The slip was also short & tight but the dress was so flowy that it wasn't an issue. I would recommend this dress as long as you have smaller shoulders!
Made a Gorgeous Graduation Dress Medium fits like a 7, Large fits like a 9. Might be tight on top for bustier women. Also the handkerchief trim runs longer than it looks on the model, and I'm 5'10"!

It was perfect for a Florida wedding. Received so many compliments. SO fun to wear! As everyone says, it is very tight on the top. I didn't mind though because the material/fit made it possible for me to not wear a bra. I would recommend this to ladies that are not necessarily well endowed :)

Gorgeous This dress does run small through the waist. The large had enough room to be comfortable sitting throughout the day. It is a gorgeous dress and paired well with an olive blazer I had in my closet.
Fabulous Dress! This dress is fun to wear. It is a little fitted through the bust and hips, but then flows nicely.

Gorgeous dress! I wore this dress to a spring wedding and  it looked fantastic. I wore it with a pair of espadrilles I got tons of compliments. 
If I have anything negative to say it is that I found the neckline a bit tighter than I would normally like.

Great dress for summer wedding - Received TONs of compliments Bust was tight, couldn't wear a bra but it was fine. The underliner was very tight so anyone with hips will have an issue. I just folded it up inside and wore a slip.

Perfect dress for an outdoor wedding in the mountains of Utah! I loved this dress! I gave it a 4 because it fits true to size but like everyone is saying the neckline is weirdly tight. I could zip up the XS but I think I would have choked to death if I tried to wear it out. I got lots of compliments, it's flowy and perfect for an outdoor wedding. Very comfortable as well!

Such a unique and flattering dress! I loved this dress and got so many compliments on it. Perfect for a winery wedding. It's pretty tight around the neck--like left marks that took 24 hours to go away tight--but worth it. The rest of the dress fit well and was very flattering.

FAVORITE RENTAL YET!  This dress is gorgeous. I loved it so much that I've reached out to Elliatt to see if they'd print it in white for me for my wedding dress... we'll see... I would advise large-chested ladies to maybe stay away from this. As a solid 36B girl, the top part definitely flattens you out a bit. It's snug. However, the cut up top is so flattering with ZERO arm pit spillover - huzzah! I received compliments all night, and the pattern and cut was perfect for a spring Saturday night wedding at a wild flower center. I've never worn a dress with the hem "bandanna" style until this dress, but I'll look into this cut again. Very fun to dance around in. Highly recommend y'all to try it out!

I wore this dress for my birthday weekend!  The medium was a little big around the under arm but it wasn't a big deal at all! The dress was beautiful, you can dress it up or down depending on your event! Loved it!

A best friends bridal shower with wonderful weather LOVED this dress.  The blue floral print looks wonderful in person and pictures.  The material of this dress is so nice/soft/beautiful, came out of the bag with zero wrinkles.  The dress is perfect, so many compliments...great dress to TWIRL in.  Perfect for an outdoor bridal shower.  I did not wear a bra with the dress, and the bottom is thick so any underwear are suitable.  ONLY NOTE...the neck is a bit tight.  A tag at the back of the neck was itching all day/night (had to put some tape over it).  And the area around the bust is also tight...there is no stretch to the dress.  Also rented the blue Rebecca Minkoff clutch to match.  Overall I loved it!!

Loved this dress. The cut out makes it really fun and GREAT dress to dance in A little on the conservative side, but great for a family wedding. I got quite a few compliments and certainly felt beautiful. I was only able to order a large because the medium was rented on the dates I needed. The large was a little big on me around the rib cage, but worked out fine. I have a broad chest and am fairly muscular so the large was probably a better around my arms. The cut was a little annoying around the neck line, but not so much that it was uncomfortable. I have a ton of fun dancing and spinning.

This dress was BEAUTIFUL, I got tons of compliments. Never wanted to send it back. I read the comments about the garment running small and wanted to get a S and a M, but they only had the size S. I fell in love with it and ordered it anyway and threw the dice. The dress fit, but BARELY and it was pretty uncomfortable on the high neck and shoulders. I would wear it again even though it was really tight because it was simply that pretty. Definitely get the size you think you need and the size up. I am 5'5" and 133 lbs, athletic and wore the size S.

Lovely dress for shorties but runs small on top. This is a great dress although I was unable to wear it due to the chest area not fitting me properly.  The cut out at the waist was a nice surprise.  I normally wear a large and the xlg was to small on top but perfect below the waist.  This dress was made for pear shaped girls.  I am top heavy 38C/D with small waist for my size .  The waist was perfect.  I'm 5'2" and the height was great, a little shorter than a maxi and the high lo hem is flattering for any height.  The XLG fits like a 10/12 size.

Floral perfection for the horse races!  Our company summer event was at the Del Mar horse races this year - and this dress was perfect for the occasion. As others have stated -- the dress is tight at the neck. The medium was unavailable for the dates I needed, so I rolled the dice on the small - and it worked out. Nicely lined, very flattering, lots of compliments. Would be a beautiful dress for a spring/summer wedding. Loved this dress.

My date canceled so I didn't get to wear it out, but I twirled and danced through the house :-) The description said it fit small, and that was true. So I ordered an extra large, which fit great everywhere except for the bust. It was way too tight and although it zipped up completely, it completely flattened me out (I wear a 38 DD).

My absolute favorite rent the runway dress! Perfect for a summer wedding.  I am typically a Small for dresses and blouses, but I ended up ordering a medium after reading other reviews of the top section being tight. I am so happy I did, because it was very snug with a bra on. I have a wider torso wearing a 34-36 bra band size, but without the bra on it fit like a glove. It was the perfect summer wedding dress and so fun to dance in!

I loved this dress! I wore it for a late summer wedding and it was perfect.  The dress fit well. It was snug in the chest, but not too tight. The overall vibe was perfect for a summer wedding with lots of dancing. The hem and dress had a lot of movement, which was really fun. The floral pattern is also really pretty in person (brought out my blue eyes).

STUNNING dress that is incredibly flattering. Tight in the bust.  I received so many compliments on this dress that I wore to a rehearsal dinner (and may even wear to my own in a few months!). The ONLY reason I couldn't give this 5 starts is because the bust is INCREDIBLY tight, and I even wore the size up. 

I felt beautiful in this dress and it was perfect for a warmer early-fall night. Can't say enough about the quality of the material, the design and the length.
Fantastic Dress!  This dress was so much fun to wear! The neck was tight, but otherwise very comfortable. I wore it New Orleans, and it was great in the heat, and I got so many complements!

Classy outdoor Victorian patio wedding This may be the most comfortable and flattering dress that I've ever received from RtR. It is true to fit, the fabric is light and breezy for warm weather, and it made me feel chic and elegant the entire evening. I have a small bust so the top wasn't a problem whatsoever, I wore a strapless bra underneath. The dress comes with an inner slip lining, so you don't have to worry about it being sheer. I would rent this dress again in a heartbeat!

"Who is that goddess?" said the reflection to the mirror I loved this dress! I wish I had taken pictures of myself in it. I wore this dress on a date and felt like a little princess in it. It has just enough of a flowy hem to make me feel like a little girl-- without actually looking like one and the print is beautiful. It was a little tight at the waist, but I have a fairly large bust and a small waist so I loved that about this dress. I got lots of compliments in this one.

Comfortable and classic look! Rented this for a wedding. I was a little worried that it would look too white and I didn't want to look like I was trying to upscale the bride on her big day but it wasn't and it turned out to be a great fit! I wear a 6 or 8 dress size and the medium regular was a great fit. I am a little larger on the top and it was a little snug over the breast area, but not enough that it wasn't comfortable. The large was big in the chest and waist region.  The length is just below knee length. Great for dancing!! I only wore nipple pedals and no bra since the top was snug enough. Wore nude wedges for heels,  paired with a black clutch and white and rose gold kendra scott earrings. Great quality for the price. Would absolutely rent again.

. this dress is beautiful and flattering! It wasn't too long even though I'm 5' 1". However, the neck does hug a bit tightly and the zipper jams intensely at the middle seam - I needed a friend to help me zip into the dress or otherwise wouldn't have been able to wear it.

Feminine, comfortable, lovely! I ordered this dress for Easter and it was perfect! It runs a bit small so I ended up wearing the M, which was my backup size.  Worked perfectly with strapless bra. Loved this dress, would rent again!

Really beautiful dress I wore this dress for my rehearsal dinner because I wanted a white gown with beautiful details. The dress does fit tight around the neck (as mentioned in other reviews), but for one night it was tolerable. I received many compliments on the gown. The dress was very comfortable and did not stick to my legs. I highly recommend this dress.

Dress was more beautiful in person! Many compliments!  The dress was beautiful, I received a lot of compliments and it was very flattering. Pro - The material was really good and felt expensive. Con - the material was really thick, so it did not stretch at all, mainly at the neck.
