It was incredibly tight at the neck and I wish the strap material had some stretch to it so it wouldn't have felt like I was wearing a bag of bricks around my neck all night - what do they say, beauty is pain. ha :) I shared a photo of the marks I still had on the back of my neck, 12 hours later. Other than the neck straps, the dress fit perfectly and was very flattering. Just an FYI, I attempted to size up to the M but it was too big and the neck seemed to be very tight. *I have a pretty small neck/shoulders too!

it was gorgeous and my first pick but it is very small on the top half and I couldn't get it zipped! it was gorgeous and my first pick but it is very small on the top half and I couldn't get it zipped! luckily I had a back up dress that was just as beautiful

Fab Flowy Dress I have waited a long time to rent this one as it my size was always unavailable and finally I was able to rent it and it did not disappoint! The dress was very well-made, the cut was very flattering and the asymmetrical design of the bottom was just fab! Although the material already looked worn out, it was still a very beautiful dress! I highly recommend it! In fact, I would be renting this again come summer time!
tight on the neck would have been an ok fit except for the neck. It was too tight around the neck. Kind of chokey. I need to go a size up for it to work.
beutiful color and great fit especially for anyone looking to hide baby bump or post baby bump.  very tight around the neck

Super cute dress for bridal shower Loved this dress. It runs a tiny bit small, but is very comfortable. The slip rides up, but it wasn't a big deal for me- you can't see through the dress. The dress may be too long for shorter women. I'm 5'8" and I liked it on me, but it hits mid-calf and might make shorter women look even shorter.
Flowy and elegant.  Loved wearing this dress Lovely dress.  Sophisticated for a summer wedding and comfortable.  Beautiful fit.

Great dress for a summer wedding! The dress is beautiful and flowy with unique eyelet features below the chest.  As other reviews mention, it is VERY tight at the neckline and due to my more muscular neck and shoulders, even the larger size dug into my neck.  I wore it anyway, with my hair down, but it was noticably tight.  Definitely size up!  Otherwise very comfortable and I received a lot of compliments!

Perfect, except the tight neck I loved this dress, got tons of compliments, and would have gone in search of it to buy for my permanent wardrobe EXCEPT the high neck line was incredibly annoying. I have a small neck and still felt like I was being subtly choked all night and had to get a friend to zip me out the second we were in the car. Would consider wearing again for something short like a shower or a rehearsal dinner, but definitely not a whole wedding/reception.

Beautiful print, loved the fit, and flow of the dress. The neck style of the dress was a bit tight.  The dress was "true to size" and perfect for my event. I  loved the dress, it was wonderful for dancing, and comfortable all night. I ordered a small and medium, went with the medium, due to the neck style of the dress. I received many compliments on the beautiful pattern and small "cut out" details.

Gorgeous & Unique - Perfect for a Summer Wedding I absolutely loved the design and drape of this dress. I sized up a size since the dress was tight in the bust area and the fabric doesn't stretch. The straps at the shoulder/neck area were very tight and rubbed all night - a little extra strap length would've fixed this issue. Other than that, I loved EVERYTHING about this dress and got compliments throughout the evening!

I loved this dress! It was perfect for a spring wedding and I received a lot of compliments.  This dress was perfect. I was surprised the fabric is not as satin-y/formal as it appears in photos but this actually makes for a really earthy, bohemian, gorgeous look. I paired it with silver toned wedges, a matching clutch and light blue Kendra Scott earrings. The fit runs a little small. I usually wear larges and had to wear the extra large back-up size. This was my first experience with Rent the Runway and I was extremely nervous since shopping online doesn't usually work for me. It was a great experience and I was so happy with the way the dress looked on me. I was comfortable and felt confident in it.

Flattering, but a bit tight after dinner. Overall, I loved this dress. It's flattering and unique, but I did end up changing into the medium after dinner...I was lucky that the wedding reception was in the hotel! Otherwise, I would've been a bit uncomfortable in the chest. I'm a 34C and ended up laboring to breathe in the smaller, so if your chest is and larger, I suggest sizing up.
Great semi-formal dress! Not as structured as I expected, but the back is so sexy! Super comfortable.
This dress was the perfect mix between classy and sexy! The fit is very comfortable with a lot of stretch! If i could go back and change one thing I would have gone with a size 2!

Senior sorority formal I wore this for my sorority formal. Honestly, it wasn't as short as everyone made it out to be. I always wear a six and the six fit fine. I didn't use fashion tape for the shoulders but they didn't really slip much - just had to adjust when I stood up from sitting (which I almost always do anyway). LOVED it overall and got lots of compliments.

The most fabulous gay man I know said "You look like you're about to go STOMP a runway!" GREAT DRESS A little bigger than I would have liked, but the length was good - the 0 might have been too short for my liking.  I taped the dress in the back for modesty, because I didn't wear a bra with it ( the fabric is thick enough so it's not a problem).  This dress was comfortable and looked fantastic.  I felt awesome in it!

Cute and comfortable This dress was very comfortable.  Not too short but short enough to show off the legs.  For me in particular it was a little loose, but I normally wear between a size 4 and 6 and 4 wasn't available.  Wish I had gotten to try that on, but it still fit pretty good.  Loved the back of the dress!

It was the perfect dress for homecoming! (:  I wore a 2 and at first i wasn't too sure about the dress when I tried it on, but then once I got all done up I loved it! It felt like the back was too big or baggy when i tried it on but it ended up being the right fit and not bothering me at all. Great dress (:

Sassy, comfortable, heading turning dress Would rent this dress again! Received so many compliments and was able to dance the night away, very comfortable, sassy, and a little sexy with the open back.

I rented this for my 30th birthday in Vegas.  Perfect little party dress! The dress was a bit big, as I expected it to be but with a little ingenuity I got it to fit.  It looked great and I felt wonderful in it all night.  The sequins can be a little itchy by the neckline, but nothing I couldn't easily ignore.  Shorter than I thought it would be but was actually pleasantly surprised by that.  Husband loved it!
Sparkly! The dress fit super awkwardly. The open back was huge on me and it was so short, I couldn't bend down at all. After taping it to myself it was cute tho! Love the sparkles!

Fun, comfortable! Very comfortable, but VERY short. I'm only 5'3" and typically wear a size 2, but had to wear the size 4 because otherwise it wouldn't even cover my bottom. That meant that while it was long enough, it kept slipping off my shoulders because it's backless and the top was too big. I'd be nervous to rent if I were very tall and thin, or if you have a booty!
Overall, pleased with it though, and got a ton of compliments!

Elegant, yet sexy. This is a beautiful dress.  The exposed back really makes the whole look pop.  You will definitely need a self-adhering bra (or no bra at all.)  It's very complimentary to women with fuller hips and thighs!  The blue sequins are smaller sized, and they don't seem to pull or rip off easily.  It did not scratch or irritate my skin at all the entire night.  It is a little short, but it also did not ride up, so that was a positive.  I love that it's a little bit classy and a little bit sexy altogether.  Perfect for a Vegas night out/bachelorette party!

Loved the low back! I wore this dress to my Law School's Barrister's Ball. I ordered the 4 and the 6 and both fit but I felt the six was more flattering around my hips. I used backless bra but the material is thick enough that you could go bra less. I also used fashion tape to secure it in a few spots and was comfortable dancing all night long without any worry of the dress slipping off at the shoulders.

PERFECT dress for Vegas...the back is sooo sexy and got a lot of attention at the craps tables! This is truly a gorgeous dress, I wish I owned it!  This was my first RTR experience, and I'm now obsessed!  I was really impressed with the condition of the dress...when it arrived, it felt as if I had *bought* something (nicely pressed, wrapped, etc).  I wasn't sure what to expect, so that was a pleasant surprise. As for the size, I would say it fits true.  I have a small frame...but mama's got hips, so (like every other dress in my life), the 2 fit better in the top and the 4 fit better in my hips/but region.  But, when in Vegas, always go for the shorter/tighter version, right?!  It was the right choice, I wasn't uncomfortable, and let's just say some heads turned when I walked by :)

The dress was perfect for my bachelorette party! Sexy and a standout without being over the top! The length of this dress and the back are so sexy.  The shimmer is understated and just adds more glam.  Loved wearing this!
I wore this for my bachelorette party. IT WAS PERFECT!!  I loved the length even if it was a little short.
This dress was cute and glamorous.  Wore it to a wedding and i loved it.   Fit perfectly.

I loved this dress! I wore it for a bachelorette party in Las Vegas and the sparkle was perfect! I ordered this dress as my “backup style” and it ended up being the one I chose! The shorter length and open back paired well with the more conservative front. I wore two small pieces of fashion tape on my upper back to keep it from slipping off my shoulders.

Understated dress, until you turn around I LOVED this dress. It was a little shorter than I expected, but the dress was so comfortable and so stunning it didn't matter (I wore black stockings and I was completely okay). The dress is a lovely dark blue,but doesn't SPARKLE unless lights are moving or you are taking a picture. but the back was what made the whole dress. The open back almost shocked people. I couldn't wear a bra, and as I am a 38DD that can be an issue. I managed to use a stick on bra (stuck to me, not the dress), with a little reinforcement and felt very secure all night. This dress hugged all the right places and hid all the right places. I would have bought it on the spot had RTR given the option.

Va Va Voom! This dress is beautiful. The color is stunning and is a real head turner. I wore this to a Persian birthday party bash (which are extremely lavish and impressive) and felt great in it. If you don't get the importance of looking good  when invited to an event like this, please ask a Persian friend. ;) This dress runs a little small and so I ordered up a size, which was the way to go. It is a bit short, but I still danced in it without any issue and felt very comfortable the entire evening.  I did not get a great photo to share (sorry!) but I wanted to show that  in the evening & outdoors you can see the sparkle and color well. Even the mermaid (yes... there was a mermaid there) I took this photo with complimented me on the dress!

Fun and sexy!  LOVED this dress. I wore it for a night out in Nashville on a girls weekend. I'm usually a 12. The top was a little bit loose but wasn't annoying. The 10 fit on the top but was too tight everywhere else so I ended up wearing the 12. I am a 36D and didn't have a problem not wearing a bra--the material is thick enough that I still felt supported. This dress was super fun and I got a ton of compliments! Would definitely rent again.
Perfect dress to see Britney in Vegas! A little loose on the sleeves and very short, but perfect for Vegas!

Pretty color, delicate sequin, runs big but is comfy and sexy. This is a very pretty dress, the color is a nice deep blue and the sequins brightens it up. I received many a compliment. It's not a structured dress, it's stretchy so the sizing is generous. I wore a 2 but would of been better off in a zero. It's short but not too short. I'm not very tall so the length was perfect for me. You will most definitely need fashion tape for the back and shoulders and pasties for your boobies. I wore it for a Holiday party and overall I really liked this dress, I felt very pretty and sexy in it.
Compliments all night long! Rent this, you won't regret it!

I wore this dress for a semi-formal holiday party held at the Monterey Bay aquarium! This was my first rent the runway experience. I loved everything about this dress. I wore the size 0. The back was a little bit loose, but with some fashion tape it stayed in place all night without any slips. Many people have said this dress was too short, but I thought the length was perfect. I felt both classy and sexy in this dress, I will definitely rent from rent the run way again!

Lovely dress Lovely dress for a city loft wedding. As other reviewers have said, the shoulders can occasionally slip, though I had no real malfunction. The open back is great.  I wore a sticky bra with it. I'm petite, so dresses tend to seem a little longer than they should on me. Not this one. It was a true mini.
Perfect fit.   I received tons of compliments.  Easy to dance in.  The sequins were not itchy like I expected.  Runs a little short  but still wearable.

Holiday Party 2016 I wore this for a company holiday party and got SO many compliments.  I wish I had taken a picture of myself in the dress, but it was a whirlwind evening.  It was a little loose on me near the shoulders, but I think if I had a bigger chest, the dress would have had something to cling to and would have been less loose.  The looseness wasn't bothersome, though.  I would say that it is a little on the short side, but I wore the dress with sheer black stockings, so I wasn't very self-conscious of it and didn't find myself pulling it down as much as I thought.  All in all, another GREAT dress rental and one I would totally recommend.

Shined on the dance floor! This dress is a beautiful color, the sequins are fun but subtle. The fit is funny, though - it is VERY short, even on my petite 5'2" frame I was worried about it riding up. Also, because the back is open, the shoulders have little structure and feel lose. My friend was on slipping duty, and definitely had to pull my shoulders up for me a few times. But it was easy to wear without a bra and was a fun dress for my dance event.

I loved that this dress was sexy without being over-the-top. I rented this for a holiday party because I felt like dressing up for people who normally see me in my sweaty gym clothes at 6am. I was worried that the sleeves wouldn't fit my upper body, since I tend to have problems with sizing in the shoulders and upper arms of clothes; but I was pleasantly surprised to see the size 2 fit perfectly. The shoulders actually were a little loose, as other reviewers have said, but it wasn't a problem. I also had NO problems with gaping in the back. I wore a backless, strapless bra only for a little extra padding. The dress is definitely the shortest thing I've ever worn, but I felt like the high-cut front compensated for it. You're only young once! I didn't wind up with a good photo of it because I was too busy having fun.

Rented this for NYE and I would absolutely rent again!!! So comfy, didn't have to adjust/pull down all night, and the material didn't itch or irritate at all. I have a very small chest and larger hips so it's hard to find a good fit, but this completely flattered my shape and I received compliments all night!

Beautiful sparkle for NYE This dress fit perfectly and was just the right amount of sparkle for New Years Eve.  I got so many compliments on the dress.  I read in the reviews that some people had trouble with the sleeves sliding down, but I did not have that problem.  I purchased a backless, strapless bra to wear with this and that worked out well.  I highly recommend this dress for a fun occasion!  I did not want to send it back!  It looked great with black tights.

It was my freshman Homecoming dance. I received SOOO many compliments and no one else had this dress I am 5'4 and weigh 120lbs with an athletic built. I wore a size 0. It was a perfect fit. I did wear volleyball spanks underneath so I could dance with no worries! It also was a very comfortable dress to wear. (my shoes were not, though!)

Sexy back!  I am usually a 4/6, ordered the 4 and it was perfect for sizing. It was a little short but I ended up wearing tights (not pictured) which made the dress feel more conservative. The square cut low back was so cute for my holiday party with my college friends! The cap sleeve was very structured and gave great shape to the dress. The sequins were comfortable enough to not wear a bra with (bc of the open back). Got a lot of compliments and would definitely rent again! (Please excuse my messy room selfie!)
Holiday Party Everyone loved the open back! It was very pretty, but it was also kind of short which made bending over impossible. Other than that, it was the perfect sparkly dress!

Good music and good friends A little loose around the shoulders (because of previous renters)
Classy with a low back for a little extra 
Great first RTR experience!

Eye Catching Dress  Delivery of the dress gets full stars, because it came a day earlier than expected and was packaged very well. 

The dress looked pretty much the same as pictured on the website. It's fairly stretchy, so you could squeeze into a smaller size, if needed. I wore Spanx to ensure the silhouette would be smooth as it IS a dress that would display all lumps and bumps. I didn't require more than petals, as I'm fairly small chested. My delivery didn't include double sided tape, but luckily I had some...and I did need to use it, the dress does tend to slip off otherwise. And I just felt more secure being taped in. 

Overall, I really liked the dress and it photographed well. I received some compliments, namely because it's such an eye catching dress; the color and the bling bling of the sequins can't be missed! I'm a bit sad I have to return it, haha!

Beautiful dress and flattering fit i absolutely loved this dress.  I wore it to a celebration dinner in NYC and it was perfect.  Just the right amount of sparkle...I was worried it would be too flashy, but it was subtle.  The fit was very flattering and true to size.  I ordered a 2 and 4 just to be safe and wore the 2.

Tasteful & gorgeous - wish I could've kept it! I wore this dress to my boyfriend's fraternity formal, and it was perfect! I usually am a size 6 but was afraid it would run small so I ordered both the 6 and the 8. The 6 fit perfectly, and I probably could have gotten away with a 4 had I ordered it. The sleeves do tend to slide a bit, but not often & dress tape isn't necessary. I had a backless bra but chose to go without it just because the sticky sides were visible, but either way is comfortable and not noticeable
So comfortable and flawless! People were right it was not itchy. I heard it ran small but i did not have that issue. It was pretty stretch fabric. Great way to not wear the typical LBD.

OBSESSED I rented this dress for a new years eve party and I LOVED it! I have super wide hips and so I can rarely wear fitted dresses but this dress looked amazing and didn't make me feel self conscious at all about my hips.  It is fitted it all the right place and the back was fabulous!

The perfect night-out dress! I rented this for my bachelorette party in New York, and it was perfect! I didn't even bother trying on the larger size when it came in because the 10 fit perfectly. The waist hit me in the right place, and the fabric has enough give but is still strong enough that it holds you in somewhat. I wore Spanx with it and my butt looked awesome (my lower half is larger and I tend to hide it normally, so being able to flaunt it was great!). My chest is relatively small so I was able to go braless, which is good because the backless part will show any kind of non-backless bra. The length was not too short on me either because I'm at least 3 inches shorter than the model - on my height it passed the fingertip test, at least until I went crazy with the dancing. Bending over is ill-advised :-). This is the perfect sparkly party dress for showing off on a night out in the city. I wore neutral gray stilettos with it, danced all night and got all sorts of compliments and attention - until I showed them my ring and "Bride to Be" sash! Definitely a rental I will do again, for the hubby this time...

Fun and flattering dress! Got tons of compliments! It's pretty short (I'm 5'10"), so I wore it with tights,  but it's perfect for a party (as a New Year's Eve party dress it would be awesome!) Both the 4 and 6 fit, but because the 4 was a little tighter, it stayed in place better, so I wore that size.
loved this dress!  It's on the shorter side, but loved it none the less!  I ended up wearing the 4 instead of the 2 because it felt a little better in the hip area.
Great dress This dress is beautiful and fit perfect. It was a little  on the short side so when I was dancing I had to hold it down. Otherwise I loved it!,,,

Cute NYE dress I had been eyeing this sparkly dress for a while and finally rented it a NYE party. I had a hard time picking between the 2 and 4, since the size 2 was significantly tighter and shorter, but the size 4 was falling off my shoulders. I ended up going with the 4 and luckily there were no wardrobe malfunctions. Would recommend for an event that requires sparkles!

Perfect first RTR purchase!  This dress was so great! So comfortable and so so pretty, i rented it for a high school prom. Got compliments all night and it was so easy to move in. The low back was not that low and fit almost perfectly, did not even have to use fashion tape! Wish I could have bought this dress, overall amazing dress.

If you're looking for a head turner... Stop looking! I rented this for homecoming and I got so many compliments! People were awe struck at how beautiful it looked! 

Fit- The fit hugged the armpits and hips with a looser fit on the legs which made it easy to walk in! 

Pros- May I say that this dress left everyone speechless!!! The neckline was a good cut because drop earrings was just enough without having to add a necklace as well. The open back was stunning! It wasn't too low and just perfect for a dramatic look. 

Cons- The shoulders slipped off at times but that could've been easily solved with fashion tape! My only regret is the length with could've been 2-3 inches longer but since I was just going to homecoming it didn't bother me much. 


LONG STORY SHORT- This dress was my first rent from RTR and you can guarantee I'll be renting again!

I wore this to my sorority's Fire&Ice formal! I got so many compliments on the dress, and it was a great fit--true to size. I knew the dress needed fashion tape based on past reviews, and Rent the Runway is AWESOME and provided a sample pack in the box the dresses came in.  It was a very pleasant surprise, and shows how awesome the site really is. I gave a 4/5 because the back is a little loose and when dancing it can be a little annoying. All in all, I had a great experience and will definitely be renting from them again :)

This dress is a head-turner. Perfect for Vegas, & surprisingly comfortable for the short, tight fit  Overall, I really loved wearing this dress. Two small complaints - the sequins irritated the inside of my arms, and the back was more stretched out than I would've liked... I wore a size down from my norm and the back still rippled/hung loose. It definitely was not a big enough deal to change the look - I was probably more self-conscious of it than was necessary!

beautiful color, cute back cut, many compliments! I wore this to my semi formal and absolutely loved it! I'm usually a size 4/6 and while the  6 fit me (in a hugging-your-body kind of way), I liked the way the 8 fell and felt more comfortable with the looser cut. The color is stunning and was just the right amount of subtle (most people at my event were wearing dark colors) and fun (the sequence really popped)! It's a bit short, but I still felt comfortable dancing all night. If you're worried about length, I'd get a size up just in case. All in all, I loved the dress and would highly recommend it!

The dress was great, perfect for a high school senior homecoming! The dress was super comfortable! The fabric was not what I was expecting but it looked great on. It was a little loose so I chose to wear a smaller size! The open back dipped to the perfect spot!

Great dress! I was given compliments all night, definitely worth renting again. This dress runs pretty true to size, if not a bit bigger. Since I'm pretty small I needed dress tape and a sticky bra... without the tape the dress kept sliding down my shoulders. I also have a pretty short torso so length wasn't a huge issue and it reached about mid/lower thigh. I was worried this dress wouldn't fit well due to my size, but it fit great, and the sequins look beautiful in low light.

i actually didn't get to wear this dress as it fit me weird.   There is a seam right at the waist that made me look pregnant, not to mention i couldn't wear a bra (I am a C cup and the ladies would be flopping around) and it was very very short!  Beautiful dress, but not a good fit.

I wore this event for my colleges Homecoming party.  I got a number of compliments on it! I ordered the dress in sizes 6 and 8 because the dress looked like it ran small based on the model in the picture.  However after trying on the dress when it arrived I realized it ran a little big.  The 6 was slightly large in the shoulder area.  Despite the dress being a little larger than I expected I got a number of compliments on the dress! It was easy to move in and not to short and not too long. 

I would highly recommend this dress just order a smaller size.

Dress fit perfect, was comfortable, and surprisingly stayed on my shoulders all night.  It's on the shorter side, but not too short. And the material is thick, which was helpful since wearing a bra is not an option. The shoulders stayed up through lots of dancing and without tape.

LOVED THIS DRESS!!!  It was a little big in the back so I just used fashion tape and it worked perfectly. I wore it to my junior prom and got so many compliments on it . Absolutely would recommend this to anyone with wide shoulders!

Amazing... I wish that I owned it  I wore this to a holiday party and loved it. It was the perfect mix between elegant and sexy. The dress fit true to size everywhere except in the shoulder area - it was a little big there and gapped oddly with some movements (there was dancing involved), it was not noticeable though. The dress hit my upper thigh but was fitted all the way down so I didn't have to worry about it coming up too high. I fell in love with this dress. I would recommend it to anyone!

Great dress - lots of compliments!! I ended wearing the size 2 just because it seemed a little longer than the 0, which felt too skimpy even though I am only 5'0" tall.  The open back was really pretty and the color was great. Very comfortable dress, would wear again.

A simple easy to wear dress This was my first RTR dress, and overall i was satisfied and will most likely rent for other special events. I picked this dress for new years eve in buffalo ny (probably should have gone with long sleeve, but thats my own fault) The difference between the 2 and 4 were minimal, but i found the dress to be awfully short. I'm 5'3 and theres no way i could bend over. The fabric was not what i was expecting but was extremely comfortable and stretchy. I also didnt have too much of an issue with the sleeves falling down, but to be on the safe side i placed some double stick on my shoulders. The only thing that was discouraging was the color, the picture on the website makes it look like a dark slate blue, but the actual dress is more of a brighter blue.

Loved this dress! It was the perfect party dress!! The shipping was so easy!
Look forward to my next My first time using RENT THE RUNWAY, I was skeptical about the dress arriving on time since my event was on a Sunday. To my surprise it arrived 2 days before, which was perfect although the return shipping date turned out to be the following day after my event. I had to race to a drop off location to ensure my return. I originally ordered a size 4 but wore the size 6 only because the dress is really short & didn't want to spend the night pulling the dress down. I also used double sided tape for the low back plunge just in case but didn't really need it. I'd say it was true to size. I definitely see myself using RENT THE RUNWAY again. LOVED IT!!!!
